NVDABackupManager.description: A simple backup add-on for NVDA. It asks what you want to back up (configuration, profiles, dictionaries, add-ons, scratchpad), creates a zip backup with a manifest, and allows restoration with a recommendation to restart NVDA. It also supports automatic backups with a configurable interval.

mvsep_minus.description: NVDA add-on for removing vocals and creating professional backing tracks (instruments) via the MVSEP API.

Thoughtfulmind-s-NVDA-Addon.description: Supplement for announcing actions related to the clipboard.

wordAccessEnhancement.description:
The WordAccessEnhancement add-on adds scripts built into the base version of NVDA and brings:
keyboard shortcut (windows+alt+f5) to display a dialog box to select between most types of objects (like comments, revisions, fields, footnotes, notes, misspellings, grammatical errors...).
key combination (Alt+delete) declare the row, column and page of the cursor position or the beginning and end of the selection, or the current cell,
keyboard shortcut (windows+alt+f2) insert comment,
key combination (windows+alt+r) report a revision at the cursor position,
key combination (windows+alt+n) report a footer or footer at the cursor position,
changeable NVDA key combinations (control+Down Arrow) and (Control+Up Arrow) (which move the cursor paragraph by paragraph) with skipping blank ones (configurable).
some key combinations for moving in the table and reading its elements (row, column, cell),
adds special keyboard shortcuts for Word view commands mode,
the ability to move sentence by sentence (alt+ Down Arrow) and (alt+ Up Arrow),
keyboard shortcut for reporting document information (windows+alt+f1),
Improved spell check accessibility (Word 2013 and 2016):
keyboard shortcut (NVDA+shift+f7) report spelling or grammatical errors and suggested spell check correction,
key combination (NVDA+control+f7) report the current sentence under focus.
For more detailed information, refer to the module help.
This module has been tested with Microsoft Word 2016 and 2013.

clipboardEnhancement.description:
The ClipboardEnhancement add-on enhances NVDA's ability to work with the clipboard and the last spoken speech.
• It allows you to copy the last spoken content to the clipboard.
• You can add the last spoken speech to existing clipboard data.
• Supports insertion of the last spoken text at the current cursor position.
• Line-by-line and word-by-word viewing of the clipboard contents is available.
• The add-on has the function of opening a web address or file path with one key.
• It can notify the user about changes in the contents of the clipboard.
• Implemented support for clipboard history (up to 500 records) with the ability to view and copy.
• You can take screenshots of the current item, window, or entire screen and save them to the clipboard or file.
• Built-in clipboard editor allows you to edit text and view information about images.
• The add-on includes a feature to repeat speech slowly, highlighting words for better understanding.
• Added the ability to query the meaning of a selected word or phrase using the built-in dictionary.
• Separate commands are provided for quick navigation through clipboard text and recent speech.
All keyboard shortcuts can be configured in the NVDA Gestures dialog.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

radioSureAccessEnhancement.description:
The RadioSureAccessEnhancement add-on improves the accessibility of the RadioSure program of the same name when used with NVDA. 
The add-on provides:
Script to start or stop the current station without moving focus.
Script to switch to the previous or next station from the list of already played stations without moving focus.
Script to increase or decrease volume without moving focus.
Script to turn off or restore volume without moving focus.
Script for announcing the volume level without moving focus.
Script to start or stop recording the current station without moving focus.
Script to display a list of favorite stations.
Script to display the RadioSure settings window.
Script for reading the name of the current station and the status bar.
Script for sounding the playback buffer.
Script to show or hide the search area and list of radio stations.
Script for going to the editing area for searching for radio stations.
Script for going to the list of radio stations (search result).
Script for clicking the Top button.
Script to exit the application.
Scripts for activating the context menu of the station list column headers for filtering the list.
Ability to use the spacebar or Enter key to press buttons.
Configurable disabling of progress bar tracking.
Script for randomly playing a station from the list.
Compatible with RadioSure 2.2, earlier versions are not supported.
For more information about functionality and keyboard shortcuts, see the user manual.

notepadPlusPlusAccessEnhancement.description:
NotepadPlusPlusAccessEnhancement improves the accessibility of the Notepad++ text editor and adds features for easy editing of Python and Markdown files.
It includes most of the features from the NVDA_notepadPlusPlus add-on:
Speak the result of the Control+B command (move to a paired character, such as a parenthesis),
Voice movement between bookmarks (F2 - next, Shift+F2 - previous),
Notification about lines that are too long,
Availability of autocomplete,
Availability of incremental search,
Supports Find Previous/Next Match functions.
For Python files:
Transition between classes and methods,
Import code from the editing window.
For Markdown/txt2tags files:
Preview the HTML result in the NVDA virtual buffer or browser,
Navigation mode by headings, links and citations.
For the DSpellCheck plugin:
Notification of spelling errors when moving through lines.
Additional features:
Voice number and line indentation,
Scripts for setting indents,
Voice cursor position after pressing Home,
Comparing the selected text with the contents of the clipboard,
Move to the next line ending with a tab or space,
Formatting the voice of the document name:
Shortened path to the file,
The file name before the path,
Skipping backslashes along the way,
Error notification from DSpellCheck (experimental).

apprentiClavierAccessEnhancement.description:
The ApprentiClavierAccessEnhancement add-on provides voice assistance for students learning the ApprentiClavier keyboard (French version and for the Azerty French keyboard).
Compatible and tested with French versions of ApprentiClavier 1.0.9 and 1.0.10.

recuvaAccessEnhancement.description:
Although this application is relatively accessible to use, the RecuvaAccessEnhancement add-on tries to improve the accessibility of the Recuva file recovery program as follows:
Naming specific objects without labels.
Prevent unnecessary focusing on unknown objects.
Adding a "KEY_Search_RESULT" script to read the overall search result again.
Automatically expands the window with the search result.

clipspeak.description:
The Clipspeak add-on allows NVDA to automatically announce clipboard operations (such as cut, copy, and paste) as well as other common editing operations such as undo and redo.
To prevent announcements in inappropriate situations, Clipspeak checks the control and clipboard to make an informed decision about whether such an announcement is necessary.
You can select either just the copy-cut-paste announcement, or also the copy-cut-paste announcement in NVDA, Options, Preferences, Clipboard Operations.
By default, Clipspeak gestures are mapped to the gestures commonly used in English versions of Windows:
Control + Z: Undo.
Control + Y: Repeat.
Control + X: Cut.
Control + C: Copy.
Control + SHIFT + C: Copy file path (Windows 11 only).
Control + V: Paste.
If these combinations are not used to perform such tasks on your version of Windows, you will have to reassign them in the Input Gestures configuration, Clipboard category.

audacityAccessEnhancement.description:
The AudacityAccessEnhancement add-on adds additional functionality when working with the Audacity multi-track editor:
Script reporting sound position
Script to notify the start and end of a selection,
A script that reports the state of the Pause, Play and Record buttons,
automatic report on changes in sound position,
automatic reporting of selection changes (can be disabled),
support editing timer control,
using spacebar to press a button,
Script reporting peak playback/recording level
Script to report play/record slider level,
Script reporting playback speed
Script to display the add-on user manual,
Script to display the audacity tutorial written by David Bales.
This version of the add-on has been tested with audacity 3.6.2 x64, 3.5.1 x64, 3.4.2 x64, 3.3.3 and 3.3.0.
Older versions of Audacity are not supported.

whatsAppEnhancer.description:
The WhatsAppEnhancer add-on for NVDA provides full accessibility to the modern WhatsApp desktop app (from the Microsoft Store).
It automatically disables problematic overview mode for stable navigation and fixes other interaction issues caused by the application's transition to WebView2 technology.
Main features:
smart filtering of phone numbers and repeated prompts in the chat list, convenient viewing and copying of message text, as well as the function of re-reading the last voiced text by characters, words or lines.
The add-on retains full support for all built-in WhatsApp keyboard shortcuts.
The solution is intended for users experiencing focus instability, view mode auto-enablement, and other accessibility issues after updating the application.
Note: All add-on features and keyboard shortcuts are listed in the add-on help.

VLCAccessEnhancement.description:
The VLCAccessEnhancement add-on adds many commands to improve accessibility for vlc media player:
A script to announce the duration of the media you have already listened to. A script to announce the playing duration of the remaining media. A script to announce the total duration of the media. A script to announce the current speed.
automatic announcement of status changes such as pause, mute, change in pitch or playback speed, as well as settings for repeat or random playback, volume level, toolbar shown or hidden.
scripts for setting a playback position mark and then playing from this mark
script to resume playback from timestamp saved by VLC
correct reading of the status bar
ability to change some problematic VLC keyboard shortcuts
and other improvements such as:
access to playback controls (representation of Javi Dominguez's role)
access to the Effects and Filters dialog
correct declaration of the name and meaning of the sliders
removing unnecessary html text in the description of some objects (source code from Javi Domínguez).
list of available NVDA commands +Control+h.
Compatible with VLC 3.0.

voiceInput.description:
Voice Input add-on for NVDA that provides ultra-fast speech recognition for text input.
Recognition is completed in less than 0.5 seconds.
Text is entered directly into the active window of any application.
The add-on does not steal focus or break NVDA browsing cursors.
Intelligent analysis of spoken punctuation is supported.
The bilingual parser converts voice commands in English and Indonesian into the corresponding characters.
Capitalization and spaces are automatically applied.
An instant text translation function is available.
You can speak your native language, and the translated text will be printed in any chat or document.
For recognition, the OpenAI Whisper Large v3 engine is used through the Groq Cloud cloud service.
Powered by LPU hardware accelerator for sub-second recognition speed.
A free Groq Cloud API key is required to use.
The user configures his key in NVDA settings.
Control is carried out using the key combination NVDA+Alt+V.
This combination starts and stops voice recording.
The hotkey can be changed in the NVDA input gesture menu.
Pronunciation of more than 20 punctuation marks and special characters is supported.
You must have a working microphone and an active Internet connection.
Note: The developer has not implemented the localization feature.

unigramPlusRussianMod.description:
The UnigramPlusRussianMod add-on is a modification of the well-known unigramPlus add-on for convenient work in Unigram with a Russian interface.
The add-on adds even more hotkeys for quickly moving through the main interface elements, provides convenient interaction with messages and greatly facilitates and speeds up work in the Unigram application.
“Russian Mod” implements various useful improvements, and also promptly fixes regularly occurring problems after updates to the Unigram application.
You can get detailed help on keyboard shortcuts by using the Alt+H command while the cursor has focus in an open Unigram window.
The entire history of changes is collected in the help.
Note:
Please note that this modified version only works with the Russian Unigram interface; if you have Unigram in other languages, then a number of new improvements will not work for you, because they are tied to words and phrases in Russian. The author of the modification is an amateur programmer, so he simply does not know how to implement all the new improvements so that they work with any Unigram interface language.
If you use the original add-on, but want to install the mod, leaving the original one too, then you can not delete the original one, but disable it in the Add-on Store.
Works with Unigram 12.9.1 and later.
If you have previous versions of Unigram, then do not rush to update the add-on.
Previous versions can always be found in the Russian add-on store on the page for this modification.
You can report new or discovered problems, as well as track the latest updates in the author’s Telegram channel (they come out faster in the channel):
@UnigramPlusRussianMod

NVDAExtensionGlobalPlugin.description:
The NVDAExtensionGlobalPlugin for extending core commands brings many features to NVDA that can be turned on or off individually depending on your needs.
Here are a few of them:
Display a list of icons in the notification area or windows of running applications,
Help in composing a complex symbol, for example, a combination of letters, powers of 2 and the ability to add your own categories and symbols,
Extending virtual buffer functionality for the browser:
new commands for navigation mode (paragraph, split, anchor, main landmark),
new types of elements for the dialog box opened (NVDA F7) (radio button, paragraph, frame, checkbox, etc.) with a declaration of the number of elements found,
the ability to navigate through a loop in search of the next or previous element,
new scripts for tables: declaration of a cell/row/column, transition to the next or previous column/row with the declaration of the cells that make it up,
intelligent function declaration for editing commands such as: Copy, Cut or Paste, and improvements to the base NVDA script that declares text on the clipboard (NVDA c),
voice message history,
renaming keyboard keys,
selective declaration of command keys,
displaying the visible elements that make up the object in the foreground, and the ability to navigate to or click on the elements,
quick switching of voice profiles,
saving NVDA and modification keys and specific saving for the gmail.com site,
shutting down, restarting or hibernating the computer,
control of user-configured gestures,
Audio control: quick changes to system/NVDA/application volume, audio splitting, temporary switching of audio output device,
manage user configurations and restart NVDA with the exact configuration,
text analyzer,
quick enable/disable add-ons,
announcing or displaying information about the application in focus, such as its version, active configuration profile, loaded add-on,
possible use of the numeric keypad as a standard numeric keypad,
the ability to execute scripts from the “Input Gestures” dialog box,
and much more.
For a complete list of add-on functions and their descriptions, see the user manual.

runaTts2.description:
The Runa TTS 2.0 add-on enables NVDA Narrator to work with the Runa TTS speech synthesizer from AccessMind.
It uses the new synth identification runaTts2 and can co-exist with previous versions during the transition to the new version.
In the NVDA synth list, the add-on appears as Runa TTS 2.0.
Requires a pre-installed Runa TTS runtime for Windows.
The add-on supports ReadSpeaker, Vocalizer and Runa Profile voices.
It retains profile routing and Smart Switch functionality without interfering with language switching.
Handling of punctuation, numbers, dictionaries and other text policies is completely delegated to the Runa runtime.
The add-on supports control of speed, pitch, volume and other parameters via NVDA.
It correctly restores number formats that may have been changed by NVDA before being passed to the synthesizer.
A command is available to check the license status upon user request.
All settings related to voice profiles and language routing remain under Runa's control.
The add-on saves only those settings that relate directly to the NVDA environment.
It leaves Runa in charge of pronouncing capital letters.
However, the pitch cues for capital letters in NVDA continue to work.
The add-on is intended for professional use and smooth migration from previous versions.
Note:
For the add-on to work, you must install RunaTTS-Setup-2.0.0.16.exe
Currently only available in the Israeli market, with an international release coming soon.

sbaitso.description:
Sbaitso is a speech synthesizer for NVDA that runs the original First Byte SmoothTalker 3.5 engine from 1990.
This is the same voice from Creative Labs Dr. Sbaitso.
The add-on uses a Unicorn processor emulator to execute real 16-bit synthesizer code.
Enough of the Sound Blaster DSP and 8237 DMA controller are emulated to capture the audio the card was meant to reproduce.
The audio is then converted to 16-bit, resampled to 22050 Hz and sent to NVDA.
Four voice settings are available.
Speed ​​in the range from 0 to 9 changes the duration of pronouncing a fixed phrase from 1.91 to 0.81 seconds.
Pitches ranging from 0 to 9 vary in frequency from approximately 41 to 154 Hz.
Timbre turns the bass cut on or off, making the sound more subtle and bright.
Volume is adjustable from quiet to loud levels without clipping.
All settings use the engine's own range from 0 to 9 without conversion to the NVDA scale.
The engine has a limit of 255 characters per request.
Long text is automatically broken down by sentence boundaries, then by sentence parts and words.
In long continuous sentences there may be slight pauses due to the restart of the prosody engine.
Only one male voice available.
The speed range is limited by the capabilities of the 1990 engine and does not allow high playback speeds to be achieved.
Requires NVDA version 2026.1 or later due to the transition to 64-bit architecture.

dectalk.description:
The DecTalk add-on is a speech synthesizer for NVDA with built-in voices.
The add-on supports 32-64 bit NVDA.
After installing the speech synthesizer, the following versions will be available in the synthesizer selection settings:
DECtalk 4.41.
DECtalk 4.51.
DECtalk 4.60.
And in the choice of voices:
Perfect Paul.
Beautiful Betty.
Huge Harry.
Frail Frank.
Doctor Dennis.
Kit The Kid.
Uppity Ursula.
Rough Rita.
Whispering Wendy.

calendario_simples_BR.description:
CalendarioSimplesBR is a convenient and feature-rich add-on for NVDA that provides quick access to a calendar with advanced features.
It not only allows you to easily navigate through dates, but also work with personal notes, track the phases of the moon, view Brazilian holidays (both fixed and moving), copy dates to the clipboard, and calculate the days remaining until the end of the year.
The calendar opens with the combination NVDA+Shift+C or through the NVDA Tools menu.
Navigation is carried out using arrows (by day and week), Page Up/Down (by month), Home/End (by the beginning/end of the month) and Ctrl+Home/End (by year).
Additional functions are available using the letter keys: H - go to today, G - enter a specific date, F - information about the phase of the moon, D - days until the end of the year, L - list of holidays, C - copy the date, Enter - edit notes.
F1 calls up help, Esc closes the window.
The add-on interface is voiced: when you pass the current date, a high-pitched signal sounds.
Notes are saved in a secure format and synchronized between sessions.

softvoice.description:
The SoftVoice add-on is a speech synthesizer for NVDA with built-in voices.
Languages: English and Spanish.
Voice options: Male, Female, Large Male, Child, Giant Male, Mellow Female, Mellow Male, Crisp Male, The Fly, Robotoid, Martian, Colossus, Fast Fred, Old Woman, Munchkin, Troll, Nerd, Milktoast, Tipsy, Choirboy.

RHVoice Plus.description:
RHVoice Plus is an add-on for NVDA that provides a direct, high-performance connection to the RHVoice synthesizer.
The add-on works in conjunction with the RHVoice Plus application for Windows.
It allows you to use all the voices installed through the application directly in NVDA.
A wide range of languages ​​and voices are available to suit a variety of tasks.
Currently you can use the English voices Alan and SLT.
Esperanto voice of Spomenka available.
Spanish voices Carlos and Lupe.
Finnish voice Maiju.
Croatian voices Karmela and Marija.
Georgian voice Natia.
Luxembourgish voices Mia and Mil.
Macedonian voices Kiko and Suze.
Nepali voice Dina.
Polish voice Alicja.
Portuguese voices Henrique, Letícia-F123 and Letícia-Plus.
Romanian voice Paul.
Albanian voice Hana.
Turkmen voice Dunýä.
Tswana voice of Dimpho.
Vietnamese voice Vi-Vu.
The add-on automatically picks up all the voices installed in the application.
You can adjust the speed, volume and pitch of your voice.
The add-on supports switching languages ​​when reading text.
RHVoice Plus provides natural and clear speech sound.
The supplement is ideal for everyday use.

zoomEnhancements.description:
The ZoomEnhancements add-on improves the Zoom experience for NVDA users by providing keyboard shortcuts to handle alerts for various events during a meeting, provides an alternative way to view chat history during a meeting to overcome accessibility issues sometimes encountered in Zoom's native chat view, and more.
All keyboard shortcuts are described in the help.
Currently, the custom alert mode feature (where the user can choose which alerts they want and which they don't) only works in Zoom if the user interface language is set to English.

sonataSherpaVoices.description:
Sonata Sherpa Voices is an add-on for NVDA that provides a wide selection of voices that run locally on your computer.
It includes both fast voices for everyday screen reader work and high-quality voices for long-term reading.
You can clone voices from your own recordings using Pocket's voice manager.
The add-on is equipped with an accessible model manager for installing and removing voices.
You can adjust the speed, pitch and volume regardless of the model.
Automatic language switching allows you to use different voices for different languages.
Pocket voices can be created from microphone recordings or audio files.
Additional AI restoration improves the quality of noisy recordings.
You can download ready-made voice banks from the Internet.
Managing installed voices allows you to rename and delete them.
You can customize Pocket's speech generation settings.
All models are stored separately from the add-on and are saved when updating.
Sonata works without the Internet after installing models.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

YoutubeAccessPro.description:
YouTube Access Pro is a powerful add-on for NVDA that gives you rich access to YouTube right from Narrator.
All actions are performed from the keyboard without using a mouse.
You can search for videos, playlists and channels.
Play video and audio via built-in mpv player with full playback control.
Download content in MP3 and MP4 formats with customizable quality.
Create and manage your own playlists.
Subscribe to channels and browse their content by categories of videos, shorts, live broadcasts and playlists.
Use global hotkeys to control the player from any application.
Customize your download folder, video resolution, and audio bitrate.
Built-in sleep timer automatically stops playback after a set amount of time.
Export and import a list of subscriptions for transfer between computers.
Automatically check for yt-dlp updates and install them when available.
Quick help on hotkeys is available by pressing Control+F1 on any tab.
YouTube Access Pro makes watching YouTube a seamless and accessible experience for NVDA users.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

xTrack.description:
XTrack is an add-on for NVDA Screen Reader.
It allows you to quickly save and open frequently used files and folders.
The add-on provides a universal and accessible set of tools for working with media directly in Windows Explorer.
With it, you can easily convert audio and video files to various formats.
Batch processing is available with the ability to fine-tune the quality and sound parameters.
You can change the volume of audio files without losing the original quality.
The add-on allows you to mix speech with music using ready-made presets or manual settings for muting background sound.
The function of combining several tracks into one file with smooth transitions is available.
You can trim audio and video files by setting precise timestamps.
The add-on allows you to split long audio recordings into separate tracks.
You can resize and crop images in various formats.
You can view technical information about videos and images.
The add-on supports recording system sound and voice from a microphone, either separately or simultaneously.
To record sound, there are separate combinations: CTRL+Shift+Space - start/pause, CTRL+Windows+Space - stop recording.
All functions are fully accessible through a convenient context menu and support hotkeys.
The supplement significantly speeds up work and reduces fatigue when performing everyday tasks.
It integrates seamlessly with Narrator and doesn't require you to open complex programs.
Files are processed while maintaining the original quality.
XTrack supports many popular formats and codecs.
The functionality is described in more detail in the add-on help.

dengjen_neural_voices.description:
Dengjen Neural Voices is an add-on for NVDA that adds neural speech synthesis voices.
It is based on Piper technology and runs entirely locally on your computer.
The add-on provides a synthesizer driver for Piper voice models.
The built-in voice manager allows you to download and install voices from the Internet.
You can choose voices of different languages ​​and qualities.
Standard and quick voice options are available.
For voices with multiple speakers, you can select a specific voice.
You can adjust the speed, volume and pitch.
You can fine-tune the timbre and intonation of your voice.
An internet connection is only required to download voices.
Speech is generated locally without delay and without sending data to the Internet.
The add-on is optimized to work on devices with low performance.
You can install voices from local archives.
Voice Manager allows you to delete and update installed voices.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.
Note: DengjenNeuralVoices is a support for SonataNeuralVoices under a new name.

SoundClock.description:
SoundClock is a lightweight add-on for NVDA's screen reader.
It announces the current time using natural human voice recordings.
Unlike a standard speech synthesizer, the add-on uses realistic audio signals.
The sound files are recorded in an English male voice, but in the same way you can record your own set of sounds in your language and voice, and then place them in a folder inside the add-on. After that, they will become available for selection in the settings.
You can call the time announcement at any time using the NVDA+Alt+F12 hotkey.
To quickly open the settings, the NVDA+Alt+T key is provided.
All hotkeys can be reassigned via input gestures in the SoundClock category.
SoundClock supports automatic time announcement at 5, 15, 30 minute and hourly intervals.
You can choose between 12-hour and 24-hour time formats.
The add-on does not reduce NVDA performance due to its lightweight architecture.
It is suitable for users who prefer live sounds over synthesized speech.
Automatic and manual time announcements do not interfere with basic computer work.
This solution is ideal for those who need quick and easy-to-hear time cues.
Note: The developer has not implemented the ability to localize the interface.

BibleAddon.description:
BibleAddon is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to read the Bible directly from the program.
It loads biblical text from an SQLite database and provides an easy-to-use graphical interface for navigating through books, chapters, and verses.
The interface includes drop-down lists for selecting a testament and book, navigation buttons for moving between chapters, and a text field for reading.
There are hotkeys for quick navigation: Alt+1/2 to select a testament/book, Alt+arrows to move between chapters.
The add-on remembers the last position read and supports working with various Bible translations in .bbl format.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the BibleAddon category.
Note: The Bible included is in Spanish only.
The add-on currently works with Protestant Canon Protestant Christian Bibles, which contain 66 books, as opposed to Catholic Christian Bibles, which contain 72 books.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the help.

Typing SFX.description:
Typing SFX is an add-on for NVDA that adds audio feedback when typing.
Each keystroke is accompanied by clear and customizable sounds.
You can choose from several sound themes to suit your typing rhythm.
The add-on supports speaking out entire words after you've finished typing them.
This helps you better control the text you type and notice errors faster.
Separate audio feedback is provided for numbers.
You can configure the playback of number sounds in protected fields.
This allows you to maintain confidentiality and receive feedback at the same time.
Typing SFX supports the creation of separate sound profiles for different applications.
Profiles are managed through the NVDA menu.
You can easily create, rename and delete profiles.
The add-on automatically detects running applications to assign profiles.
You can turn sounds on and off, choose themes, and manage feedback.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Typing Sounds panel.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Typing Sounds category.

toggleX.description:
ToggleX is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to quickly toggle frequently used settings.
To do this, just press NVDA+0, and then one additional key.
Each switch is confirmed by voice and sound signal.
A high signal means on, a low signal means off.
A layer is only active for one click, which prevents accidental changes.
The add-on allows you to switch the sound of tables, headings, lists and links.
You can enable or disable the voiceover of cell coordinates and object positions.
You can control the sound of line indents and keyboard shortcuts.
You can enable automatic language switching and trust the voice language.
The add-on allows you to pause the processing of speech dictionaries and symbols.
ToggleX can also store up to thirteen synthesizer configurations.
You can instantly switch between saved voice settings.
To save the current synthesizer, press NVDA+0, select a slot and press a.
When loading a slot, the name of the synthesizer is announced.
Empty slots are indicated by a voice message.
All ToggleX settings are saved in the NVDA configuration.
Synth slots are saved immediately for reliability.
The add-on follows NVDA configuration profiles.
All features of the add-on are described in detail in the reference manual.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Settings Switch category.

bible.description:
The Bible add-on is designed for convenient study of the Holy Scriptures and provides advanced navigation, search and management tools for Bible translations.
This makes it easy to navigate the text, move between books, chapters and verses, work with different translations, and compare biblical passages.
The add-on allows you to:
Use a tab system to work with multiple texts of Scripture at the same time.
Quickly move between books, chapters, verses and translations.
Copy poems and fragments with links.
Look through parallel passages and passages that are similar in context.
Use text search with the ability to filter by book, chapter or verse, including smart search using the Gemini API.
Work with reading plans, track progress and mark what you read.
Load and delete translations for different languages ​​and reading plans.
You can learn about all the features of the add-on, as well as keyboard shortcuts, in the detailed help documentation.

totalCommanderExtended.description:
The TotalCommanderExtended add-on improves work with file lists in Total Commander.
Makes it easier to navigate files and folders—especially for braille display users.
Braille display:
The letter at the beginning of each line indicates which pane you are in (for example, the left or right file pane).
The letter appears lowercase when the element is not selected, and CAPITAL when it is selected.
At the end of each line your position in the list is displayed, for example 3/42.
Speech:
NVDA naturally announces your position in the list, such as "3 of 42".
Speech and braille output are independent of each other—the prefix letter appears only on the braille display and is never spoken.
General:
Column separators in file names appear as spaces, making the lines easier to read.

LinguaPal.description:
LinguaPal is an add-on for NVDA that integrates Google Gemini and Groq artificial intelligence for translation, communication and image description.
It allows you to translate the contents of your clipboard using the selected AI model.
You can communicate with the artificial intelligence in real time through the chat window.
The add-on supports attaching images to be described by artificial intelligence.
You can ask clarifying questions about the image in the same chat.
A hotkey is available to describe the currently focused window.
This is useful for understanding errors and inaccessible content.
LinguaPal requires an API key from the selected provider.
You can select the Groq or Gemini model in the add-on settings.
Setting the target language for translation is available.
You can issue a system request to change the personality of the AI.
LinguaPal automatically checks for updates when you start NVDA.
Addition hotkeys can be configured in the input gestures dialog.
LinguaPal makes working with text and images more convenient and efficient.
It helps to quickly translate, receive information and descriptions from artificial intelligence.

videoMaker.description:
The VideoMaker add-on for NVDA allows you to create professional videos with photos and audio.
With it, you can combine photos and videos into a single video with audio accompaniment.
The add-on supports adding captions to each slideshow element.
The function of creating videos with running or jumping text is also available.
You have a variety of transitions between clips, including fades and fades.
You can remove green or blue background from photos.
You can set a custom background image.
You can apply the Ken Burns effect to dynamically enlarge your photo.
A text watermark will protect your work from unauthorized use.
Projects are easily saved and loaded for reuse.
During the video creation process, a progress dialog is displayed with the ability to pause and cancel.
You can choose the output video quality from SD to Full HD.
Popular image, video and audio formats are supported.
All settings are flexibly configured in the NVDA settings dialog.
This add-on will become an indispensable tool for creating video content.
It is suitable for both beginners and experienced users.
Control is carried out using simple and convenient keyboard shortcuts.
You can always refer to the documentation for more information.
Note: The developer has not implemented the ability to localize the interface.

TwoFactorAuthenticator.description:
The TwoFactorAuthenticator add-on for NVDA allows you to store two-factor authentication secret keys and quickly generate one-time TOTP codes using a keyboard shortcut.
Accounts are managed directly from the NVDA Tools menu.
To instantly copy the code to the clipboard, use the key combination NVDA+Ctrl+2.
The add-on works completely autonomously and does not require external system dependencies.
The generated code must be inserted within 30 seconds, as many sites, such as GitHub, provide a limited time for input.
There are two ways to add accounts.
Automatic scanning of a QR code from the screen requires a one-time download of additional libraries of approximately 15 MB.
After downloading the libraries for scanning QR codes, you need to restart NVDA.
The manual method allows you to enter the account name and secret key manually.
The two-factor authenticator manager displays a list of all saved accounts.
For each entry, you can copy the OTP code or delete the account.
When adding a new entry, the secret key is verified to be correct.
The system warns you about overwriting an existing account with the same name.
All saved data is stored in the NVDA user configuration folder and is not lost when updating the add-on.
TwoFactorAuthenticator is a completely free and open source project.

addonUpdaterMod.description:
AddonUpdaterMod - for automatic or manual updating of installed add-ons.
AddonUpdaterMod is a fork of the AddonUpdater add-on, but with the added server of the Russian add-on store, which is selected by default in the source settings.
To check for updates after installing the AddonUpdaterMod add-on, go to NVDA / Tools / Check for add-on updates (if NVDA detects updates, the menu item will say (View add-on updates), followed by the number of updates). If updates are available, a list of add-on updates will be shown, each entry consisting of the add-on name, current version, new version, and update channel. Select Update and NVDA will download and apply the updates in sequence and prompt you to restart NVDA.
You can also select a Spanish store from the list of available sources.
You can change the source using the following path:
NVDA Menu, Submenu Options, Settings, Add-ons Update panel.
In the drop-down list Add-on update source: select Spanish community add-on catalog.
You can return to the source of the Russian community in the same way.
Note: The developer's support for the original AddonUpdater was discontinued in April 2025, so the original will no longer be updated.

Store.description:
The Store add-on adds to the NVDA menu the ability to view and update add-ons from the Russian community catalog and stores of other NVDA communities.
The following shortcuts are available in input gestures:
Show a window with all the add-ons and information about them: This will show us a window with all the add-ons that we have in nvda.es.
Checking for updates to installed add-ons: The store will analyze your installed add-ons and, if it detects an update, it will offer us the option to update them automatically.
Open directory with downloaded add-ons: This will help us open the directory with downloaded files. The path to this directory is set in the add-on settings.
We can assign keyboard commands for these three options by going to the NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures in the “NVDA.RU Store” section.
You can also open the NVDA menu, Service submenu and find the NVDA.RU Store submenu.
In addition, in the Store add-on you can add servers of other add-on directories yourself, and then use them to browse and search for updates.
In the add-on list window on the selected add-on, press the following keys:
F1 - pressing once will read the description, pressing twice quickly will copy it to the clipboard.
Shift+F1 - a single press will read the list of changes, a double quick press will copy it to the clipboard.
F2 - activates downloading of the add-on to the folder selected in the settings.
F3 - copies the add-on download link to the clipboard.
F4 - will open the download folder selected in the settings.
F5 - pressing it once will tell you the version, pressing it twice will tell you the tested and minimum version of NVDA, pressing it three times will copy all this information to the clipboard.
F6 - Pressing it once will copy the link to the add-on page in the store, pressing it twice will open this link in the browser.
F7 - Pressing it once will copy the link to the add-on developer's repository page, pressing it twice will open this link in the browser.
Alt+1 - will move focus to the search field area
Alt+2 - will move focus to the add-ons list area.
Alt+3 - will move focus to the information area.
Application, Shift+F10 - will open the context menu of actions.
The add-on help describes all its functionality in as much detail as possible.

translate.description:
This add-on for NVDA provides instant translation of spoken text in real time.
It's great for gaming, chatting, and web browsing.
Translation is performed automatically as soon as NVDA speaks the text.
You can select a target translation language other than the NVDA interface language.
More than 80 languages ​​are supported for translation.
The add-on works quickly and does not load the system.
Built-in smart caching remembers previous translations.
When you pronounce the phrase again, the translation is loaded instantly from memory.
You can switch between several translation engines.
Google Translate, Lingva Translate, LibreTranslate and others are available.
Modern AI engines are supported, including OpenAI, Gemini and DeepL.
To work with AI engines, you must enter the appropriate API keys.
You can configure the translation timeout from 1 to 30 seconds.
The add-on is controlled using convenient keyboard shortcuts.
Turning translation on and off is done with one combination.
The latest translation can be copied to the clipboard.
The translation cache can be cleared for the active application or the entire system.
All settings are in the NVDA Options dialog.

VisionAssistant.description:
Vision Assistant is an advanced AI assistant for NVDA using Gemini models.
Command Layer: Press NVDA+Shift+V, then:
• Smart translation (T) / from clipboard (Shift+T).
• Text processing (R).
• Description of the object (V) / entire screen (O).
• Video analysis (Shift+V).
• Local screen recording (Control+V).
• Reading documents (D).
• File OCR (F).
• CAPTCHA Solution (C).
• Direct chat (Shift+C).
• Transcription and dubbing of media (M).
• Smart Dictation (S).
• Voice translation (Control+T).
• Condition (I).
• Object marking (L).
• Manage/scan marks (Shift+L).
• Interface Browser (E).
• AI operator (Shift+A).
• Check for updates (U).
• Repeat last result (Space).
• Command Help (H).
• Open settings (Alt+S).
• Report on exhausted keys (Alt+Q).
• Advanced routing report (Alt+M).
• Quick settings (Up/Down/Left/Right).

REGEXPlusPlus.description:
REGEX Plus Plus is an add-on for NVDA that adds powerful regular expressions to any text editor or editing area.
It works even in applications without built-in regular expression support.
The add-on intelligently manages the clipboard to simulate pasting, ensuring compatibility with most desktop programs.
Press ALT+Windows+F in any text field to open the Find and Replace dialog.
The add-on automatically skips browser address bars and other non-editable areas.
If a combination is pressed outside of a supported field, NVDA will provide a clear notification instead of passing the command to Windows.
The dialog allows you to enter a regular expression pattern in the “Regex Pattern” field.
As you type, a real-time search is performed, with all matches read out loud.
You can limit the search to the selected fragment using the corresponding checkbox.
All matches are displayed in a list along with the line number and the full text of the line.
Use the up and down arrows to navigate and Enter to move to the selected match in the document.
In the Replace With box, enter replacement text.
Click Replace to change the first occurrence, or Replace All to update all matches at once.
After replacement, the add-on reports the exact number of changes and automatically rechecks the document.
The clipboard is always restored after the operation, so your data is not lost.
The built-in REGEXGuide contains 259 rules in 34 categories.
• Regex basics include anchors, quantifiers, character classes, groups, and lookaround statements.
• Everyday data covers email, phone numbers, dates, times, numbers and IDs.
• Web and Documents contains templates for URL, HTML, Markdown and CSV.
• Code and Logs offers rules for source code, log files, and file paths.
• Text sanitization and validation helps handle spaces, duplicates, quotes, and control characters.
Many rules are accompanied by a ready-made replacement example.
In the memo, you can select a category, listen to the description and press Enter to copy the template and replacement into the main dialog.
The history of the last 15 templates and replacements is available through drop-down lists.
Additional checkboxes allow you to enable case sensitivity and search only in the selected fragment.
This add-on saves you hours of manual editing and eliminates the fatigue of repeated keystrokes.
It gives a complete overview of all matches, announces line numbers and replacement results.
REGEX++ turns the time-consuming search and replace process into a fast and transparent workflow.

remoteSpeechControl.description:
The Remote Speech Control add-on solves the problem of double sound when using NVDA Remote with parallel audio broadcast from the controlled machine.
It disables NVDA voice on the managed computer while you are typing on it from another machine.
As soon as a key is pressed on the controlled computer itself, speech returns automatically.
Disabling occurs only if the password is the same on both machines and after the explicit consent of the user of the managed party.
The add-on also leaves a ring of synthesizer settings on the local machine when controlled remotely.
This allows you to change the voice, speed, pitch and volume of your own NVDA instead of the remote one.
Another function concerns the battery status when driving another car.
You can customize the battery report hotkey response with information from your local machine.
This is especially useful when controlling a desktop computer from a laptop.
To configure, open the NVDA menu, select Options, then Settings, then the Remote Speech Control category.
Enter the same password on both computers.
The password is never transmitted over the network, only its one-way fingerprint is used.
The “Automatically request disconnection” checkbox on the manager side sends the request without an additional question.
The "Allow automatic disconnection" checkbox on the managed side accepts requests immediately without prompting.
The "Synthesizer settings ring modifies this machine" checkbox leaves control of the voice parameters local.
The "Report local machine battery status" checkbox intercepts the battery status report on your machine.
You can choose the order of declaration: local first, remote first, or local only.
The Verbose Logging option helps with diagnostics by recording all activity in the NVDA log.
The hotkey NVDA+Control+Shift+M on the controlling machine enables or disables speech on the remote machine.
While asking for consent, all remote input is paused so that only the local user can make the decision.
The add-on is securely protected: each request contains a fresh password fingerprint, a random number and a timestamp.
Three unsuccessful attempts with an incorrect password will block requests for sixty seconds.
Without the correct password, no one will be able to disable speech on your machine.
This addition makes remote control comfortable by eliminating echo and confusion with voice settings.
Note: The developer has not implemented the ability to localize the interface.

wordLangSwitch.description:
Word Language Switching automatically switches the synthesizer voice when it detects flagged language changes in Microsoft Word documents and Outlook message boxes.
On the Internet, NVDA correctly processes lang attributes and the synthesizer selects the appropriate voice.
In Word, when using standard UIA access, language information is often not transmitted, and everything is read in the default voice.
The add-on solves this problem by retrieving the document language through the Word object model and passing it to the NVDA reader.
Thanks to this, the synthesizer switches voices in the same way as when reading web pages.
Completion works automatically when reading using the arrow keys, by sentence or paragraph, or when reading entire text.
Convenient keyboard shortcuts are available for control.
Pressing NVDA+Alt+W turns the add-on on or off.
The combination NVDA+Alt+K shows diagnostic information, which is useful when troubleshooting.
Both gestures can be changed in the NVDA input gestures dialog under the “Word language switching” category.
In the add-on settings, you can enable dialect simplification so that the synthesizer receives only the base language code.
A language mapping feature is also available to redirect some codes to others.
For correct operation, NVDA 2023.1 or later is required with the option to automatically switch languages ​​in the speech settings enabled.
The synthesizer must support language switching, such as OneCore, SAPI 5 or eSpeak NG.
The text in the Word document must be correctly marked up with the language indicated through the “Set Check Language” function.
The add-on does not work in Protected View, where the Word object model is not available.
Word Language Switching will become an indispensable assistant for anyone who works with multilingual documents.

globalSonicPitch.description:
Global Sonic Pitch adds a separate pitch control for supported NVDA synthesizers.
The add-on changes speech pitch through the Sonic audio processor, leaving the standard NVDA Pitch setting unchanged.
You can use Sonic pitch together with regular Pitch to achieve a combined effect.
The add-on supports synthesizers RHVoice, eSpeak, OneCore, SAPI5 and other compatible drivers.
In the settings, you can enable global processing and expand the range to 20 semitones.
A Sonic pitch value of 50 is neutral, a lower value lowers the voice, and a higher value raises the voice.
Separate Sonic pitch values ​​are stored for each synthesizer, voice, and voice variant.
When switching between voices, the add-on automatically restores their individual settings.
Enhanced Quality mode may improve clarity for some voices.
The add-on works correctly with dynamic voice settings, for example in Google TTS for NVDA.
64-bit NVDA supports standard 32-bit SAPI5 and SAPI4 via built-in wrappers.
For SAPI4, Sonic processing is only available through the WASAPI NVDA audio path.
For quick control, input gestures are available to switch and change Sonic pitch.
You can assign hotkeys to increase, decrease, and reset the pitch value.
The add-on does not change the NVDA files on the disk and does not add new synthesizers to the system.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

remoteAudioAccess.description:
The Remote Audio Access add-on transmits the system audio of a remote computer through an existing NVDA Remote or Remote Access connection.
The microphone is not captured.
The Modern version is universal and is suitable for NVDA 2026.1 and later.
The same file can be installed on both modern computers.
Either party can enable receiving the other party's system audio.
The Legacy version is designed for the old NVDA Remote 2.6.x and is fully compatible with Modern 0.3.1.
The following hotkeys are available on the host computer.
• NVDA+F3 turns on or off remote system audio.
• NVDA+Shift+F3 sends a remote test tone.
• NVDA+Ctrl+F3 switches the next audio output of the remote computer.
• NVDA+Alt+F3 returns automatic audio output selection.
The transmission quality is configured through the NVDA menu → Tools → Remote Audio Access transmission quality.
The available values ​​are automatic, 16, 24, 32, 48 and 64 kbps.
The manual value is fixed until the next shift.
Automatic mode dynamically changes the bitrate based on the delay of the real Remote channel.
The main transport codec is Opus.
If Opus cannot be prepared, the add-on safely switches to the proven PCM16 at 24 kHz in mono mode.
The first launch of Opus can download the official opus-tools Windows runtime with SHA-256 verification.
The add-on only captures the render or loopback of the Windows system audio output.
The microphone and any recording devices are not exposed, ensuring privacy.

EnhancedDictionaries.description:
The EnhancedDictionaries add-on improves work with dictionaries for NVDA.
You can now use profile-specific dictionaries, which improves performance by allowing you to use different dictionaries for different applications and scenarios.
The add-on will also help:
Import entries from the default profile dictionary.
Synchronize entries with the default profile dictionary.
Detailed explanations from the author of the add-on are available in the help.

AIAssistant.description:
The AIAssistant add-on brings artificial intelligence capabilities to NVDA Narrator's workflow.
It helps you understand the content of web pages and applications faster.
Using AI, you can suck* up a summary of the current page or active window.
The function of describing the image on the screen is available for non-visual perception of the content.
You can open the AI ​​chat to ask questions and continue the dialogue.
The content of the active page is automatically loaded into the chat for more accurate answers.
You can attach a screenshot of the current screen to a chat message.
The add-on requires locally installed Ollama or a Gemini API key.
Various sized models are supported to run on CPU or GPU.
Settings for provider and timeout model and image format are available.
Use the NVDA+Shift+A command layer to quickly access functions.
• S is for page summary.
• O - for a summary of the page structure.
• I - to describe the image on the screen.
• C - to open a chat with the AI.
• P - for chat with page content.
• X - for chat with a screenshot.
• T - to switch between Ollama and Gemini providers.
• H—for help with commands.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

enhancedTones.description:
The EnhancedTones add-on changes the way NVDA manages tones to make the process more efficient.
Additionally, this add-on features multiple wave generators that allow the user to customize the audio signal. With it, you can easily implement more generators.
If you want to create your own wave generator and integrate it with this add-on, please refer to the developer section.
This add-on was created to solve some problems with certain sound cards, which are now less common since we have better sound card drivers. But some people have reported that these problems are still present, such as long delays when playing tunes, or the first tunes not playing at all. This add-on now has more features, so it can be useful even if you don't have problems generating native tones. Try it yourself and see if it works for you.
I decided to create other tone generators to allow users to customize the sound of the beep, and some people, including myself, liked it. One user with hearing loss reported that they found it more comfortable to use the sine tone generator.
You can read more about the features of the add-on in the help.

extendedPotPlayer.description:
The Extended PotPlayer add-on provides NVDA users with convenient commands to obtain playback time information in the PotPlayer media player.
It adds four basic functions for vocalizing the timing of the current track.
The Control+Shift+t command tells you the total duration of the file being played.
The Control+Shift+e command allows you to find out the elapsed time since the start of playback.
The Control+Shift+r command announces the remaining time until the end of the track.
Control+Shift+p tells you the current playback percentage relative to the total duration.
The add-on reads time information directly from the PotPlayer window.
If necessary, it can briefly display a player message on the screen and try again to receive data.
The add-on also improves work with the time transition dialog, which is called up with the G key.
When you press Enter in this window, you jump to the specified point and the dialog automatically closes.
All commands are duplicated in NVDA input gestures and can be reassigned by the user.
The add-on works with any media files supported by PotPlayer.
It does not require additional settings and is ready to use immediately after installation.
This extension is especially useful for blind and visually impaired users who need to control playback time.

enhanced_weasel_jidian.description:
The Enhanced Weasel Wubi add-on provides enhanced support for the Weasel (Xiaolanghao/Rime) input method in NVDA.
It automatically announces input mode switches, including changing language, character width, and punctuation type.
The addition eliminates duplication when reading text entered using a space or Enter.
It correctly reads Chinese punctuation marks in Chrome and Edge browsers.
The add-on shortens long candidate descriptions by showing only brief information.
In Chinese input mode, all characters you type are silent, preventing you from pronouncing Pinyin letters.
This makes working with the input method more comfortable and efficient.
The add-on does not require complex setup and works immediately after installation.
It is especially useful for users who regularly work with Chinese.
Expanded Weasel support makes the typing experience smoother and more intuitive.

salaatTime.description:
The SalaatTime add-on is designed to obtain the status of prayer times.
When pressed once, the status of prayer or namaz time is displayed.
When double-clicked, the main window of the Prayer Time program opens.
The default keyboard shortcut for this add-on is NVDA + Alt + S, and as always, this can be changed by going to:
NVDA menu, Options, Input gestures, Prayer times.
Before use, you must install the SalaatTime program of the same name.

ExplorerInfo+.description:
The ExplorerInfo+ add-on is designed for those who prefer to use the List view
for Windows Explorer and wants to quickly, without opening the properties window, get
information about the element in focus in its window.
Commands from NVDA+Control+1 to NVDA+Control+6.
Commands can be changed in input gestures.

EnhancedFindDialog.description:
The EnhancedFindDialog add-on brings improvements to the NVDA Find dialog.
The add-on adds the following features:
Search history.
Cyclic search.
Register accounting.
Contextual information of search queries.

enhanced_symbol_cycler.description:
The Enhanced Symbol Cycler add-on allows you to flexibly customize the command for cycling punctuation and symbol levels in NVDA.
The standard NVDA+p command switches all four character levels in turn.
This add-on makes it possible to select only those levels that the user really needs.
The available levels are None, Some, Most and All.
The user can mark the desired levels in the NVDA speech settings.
Unchecked levels will be automatically skipped when switching.
The setting is done in the NVDA menu → Options → Settings → Speech.
There is a list available with checkboxes for each character level.
The addition makes switching faster and more convenient.
It is especially useful for those who frequently change the level of punctuation.
For example, you can leave only the “None” and “All” levels for quick switching.
Or exclude intermediate levels so as not to switch them every time.

enhancedDuck.description:
The Enhanced Duck add-on expands NVDA's muting control capabilities with two additional modes based on the current focus.
It runs on the Windows Core Audio session API and adjusts the volume of individual applications independently of the built-in NVDA engine.
The user can switch modes using the combination NVDA+Shift+D or through the NVDA sound settings panel.
The "Mute inactive applications" mode reduces the volume of all programs that are not in focus.
At the same time, the application you are working in maintains full sound volume.
The "Mute active application" mode reduces the volume of only the currently active window.
Background audio, such as music, remains at normal volume.
The add-on automatically tracks focus changes between applications and updates the muted state in real time.
When you exit the mode or turn off muting, the volume of all applications is restored to their original values.
Native speech and NVDA sounds are never muffled and always remain at full volume.
Two new modes are added to the standard list of muting modes in NVDA settings.
They are fully compatible with configuration profiles and take them into account when switching.
The add-on does not require the installation of additional components or administrator rights.
It works with any application that plays sound through standard Windows mechanisms.
Please be aware that applications that use separate helper processes for audio may not always process correctly.
For example, web browsers often play audio through separate processes separate from the main window.
In such cases, mute modes may not work as expected.
However, for most standard applications the add-on works reliably and predictably.
Enhanced Duck is especially useful for running multiple applications at once.
It allows you to stay focused on the active task without being distracted by background sounds.
The add-on is easy to use and does not require complex setup.
It will be a great addition for anyone who often works with audio in different applications.

visAware.description:
Vis Aware is an add-on for NVDA designed for optical character recognition, artificial intelligence image description and automatic computer control.
Most cloud engines require an Internet connection and credentials.
Ollama is used for local self-deployment, such as with the Google Gemma model.
Vis Aware provides three main modes of operation.
OCR mode extracts text from images.
Image description mode analyzes visual content and allows you to ask clarifying questions.
AI Agent mode analyzes the screen and performs computer actions to solve the task.
Recognition sources can be a navigator object, the entire screen, the active window, or an image on the clipboard.
Control is carried out using convenient keyboard shortcuts.
Add-on settings are available through the NVDA menu.
The add-on supports many engines, including Google Gemini, Google Gemma, PaddleOCR, Ollama and NVDACN community services.
Recognition results are displayed in an easy-to-read form and can be copied to the clipboard.
A feature is available to automatically recognize graphical controls when you move focus.
The add-on requires disabling screen dimming for manual recognition.
All features of the add-on are described in detail in the reference manual.

thebat.description:
TheBat add-on for TheBat (X64 - X32), TheBat Voyager email clients.
The main function of the TheBat add-on, implemented by Kvark, is that it forces NVDA to read the contents of the mail list as it is displayed on the screen and as it is perceived visually.
TheBat add-on has one more additional function - it is the voice of the selected text in letters when using standard highlighting.
Now YuriS has added correct pronunciation of address fields in the windows of a new letter and a reply to a letter.

ExplorerInfoMod.description:
The ExplorerInfoMod add-on is designed for those who prefer to use the List view
for Windows Explorer and wants to quickly, without opening the properties window, get
information about the element in focus in its window.
Commands from NVDA+Control+1 to NVDA+Control+7.
Commands can be changed in input gestures.
Note:
ExplorerInfoMod is a fork of ExplorerInfoPlus.
The modification has not been tested in Windows 11 Explorer.

AbsoluteYoutube.description:
AbsoluteYoutube is an advanced add-on for the NVDA screen reader.
It allows you to download YouTube videos and media in MP3, MP4 or WAV formats directly from your browser.
The add-on includes an intelligent background system for efficient and renewable downloads.
All functions are accessible through simple keyboard shortcuts and context menus.
The basic NVDA+Y command allows you to download videos in three ways, depending on the number of clicks.
A single click downloads the video as MP3 in high quality.
Double tap downloads the video in MP4 format.
Triple-clicking saves the audio track as an uncompressed WAV.
The CTRL+Shift+Y command gives access to all add-on tools.
Double-clicking this command opens the folder with the downloaded files.
A triple click launches a special advanced search dialog.
This search bypasses YouTube's standard algorithms and finds videos hidden in organic results.
The favorite channels feature allows you to save your favorite creators and automatically check for new videos.
Download queue mode helps you manage your downloads while you're busy doing other things.
The smart background system performs downloads sequentially, saving computer resources.
Interrupted downloads are automatically saved and resumed when NVDA is restarted.
The video trimming tool allows you to download only the necessary fragments without downloading the entire video.
The failed download manager keeps a list of problematic files for retries.
All keyboard shortcuts can be reconfigured in the NVDA input gestures section.
Detailed add-on settings are available in the program settings menu.

infovox230.description:
The Infovox230 add-on brings back to life the long-abandoned speech synthesis engine Infovox 230 from Telia Promotor and Babel-Infovox.
It provides 60 voices in 12 languages.
Supported languages ​​include American and British English, German, French, Italian, Castilian Spanish, Dutch, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish and Icelandic.
Each language includes five formant voices.
These are male, female, giant, child and zombie.
The add-on is developed for NVDA 2026.1 and newer versions on 64-bit Windows 11.
It does not require a hardware security key, administrator rights, or a separate Python installation.
The entire engine and necessary components are already built into the add-on.
Installation is done through the NVDA add-on store.
After installation, select the synthesizer “Infovox 230 (Telia Promotor)” in the speech settings.
The add-on is completely stand-alone and does not make changes to the Windows registry.
All engine settings are stored in a private file inside the add-on folder.
When you remove an add-on, no traces are left on the system.
The add-on includes a built-in 32-bit host process.
This allows 64-bit NVDA to use the 32-bit SAPI 4 engine.
The sound is transmitted over a local TCP connection.
All 60 voices are enumerated and synthesize speech without glitches.
The engine has been modified to bypass the outdated licensing system.
No longer requires a Rainbow Sentinel SuperPro or CrypKey.
Problems with language detection and volume slider operation have been fixed.
Freezes that could occur after several minutes of operation have been eliminated.
The add-on self-heals when the host process fails.
All your voice, speed, pitch and volume settings are saved.
The synthesizer works correctly with automatic language switching in NVDA.
All speech features, including bookmarks and indexes, are fully supported.
You can use all the features of NVDA, such as read in succession and pause.
This addition makes the classic Infovox 230 engine available on modern systems.
It preserves the authentic sound of the original voices.
Speech reproduction occurs without delays or distortions.
You get the full set of voices that were available in the original product.
The add-on does not require the SAPI 4 runtime to be installed.
All necessary libraries are already included.
The synthesizer has been tested and confirmed to work on Windows 11.
The supplement is completely ready for everyday use.

unigramPlus.description:
The UnigramPlus add-on adds many hotkeys for quickly moving through the main elements of the window, provides convenient interaction with chat messages, and also adds many small improvements that make working in the Unigram application much more convenient and comfortable.
For help with keyboard shortcuts, press Alt+H while the Unigram application window is open.
All details are available in the reference manual.

xPlorer.description:
xPlorer is an add-on for NVDA that turns Windows Explorer into a powerful file management workstation.
• The Robo system allows you to copy and move files more than 50% faster than standard Windows tools.
• One press of NVDA+Shift+R performs Robo-copying, double pressing for pasting, triple for moving.
• The xPlorer menu (NVDA+Shift+X) provides access to advanced name management tools and bulk folder creation.
• NVDA+Shift+Z announces the total size of selected files or compresses them into ZIP with automatic naming.
• NVDA+Shift+C copies the names of the selected items or the path from the address bar.
• NVDA+Shift+V extracts text from files without opening them or inverts the selection in a folder.
• NVDA+Shift+F2 renames the file, safely preserving the extension.
• Control+Shift+N creates a new folder and automatically names it as the contents of the clipboard.
• The add-on supports mass creation of folders from a list, converting the case of folder names and creating a folder structure from a text file.

soundAlign.description:
SoundAlign is an add-on for NVDA that transforms the audio space of your screen reader.
It allows you to customize every sound using professional audio tools.
You can control the stereo panning of sounds by sending them to the left center or right channel.
This makes navigation more intuitive and helps distinguish signals based on their spatial location.
• Error sounds.
• Addition signals.
• Progress indicators.
• Navigation tips.
SoundAlign offers a choice of five wave types including sine, triangle, sawtooth, square and original.
There are 12 envelope (attenuation) algorithms available, such as cosine Gaussian linear exponential logarithmic and others.
The global master volume slider allows you to control the level of all sounds being processed.
Progress indicators can be configured with speech intervals, beeps, or temporary announcements.
Smooth panning mode eliminates unpleasant crackling sounds when changing sound positions quickly.
SoundAlign makes NVDA sounds more comfortable for daily use and reduces fatigue over long periods of use.

AbsoluteWindows.description:
AbsoluteWindows allows you to take full control of your system and restore its performance.
The add-on has adaptive intelligence for working with a network connection.
When there is an active network connection, it shows the “Disconnect Internet” command.
If there is no network, it instantly changes it to “Connect Internet”.
You can terminate frozen applications and Explorer to restore stability.
Powerful diagnostics are available using DISM, SFC and Chkdsk.
Diagnostic results are automatically displayed in Notepad for easy viewing.
The memory clear function resets the RAM cache for instant system response.
To ensure security, you can view Wi-Fi passwords and manage startup.
Basic hotkey: Alt + Windows + W.

linkLibrary.description:
The LinkLibrary add-on helps the user organize their links or bookmarks in a library way.
In the main libraries dialog box, you can select the library or category you like and press enter.
In the dialog box that opens, you will have all the links in that category in a list and access the source URL and information about each link, if present.
This add-on does not come with a default keyboard shortcut assigned.
You can, as always, add a command or change an existing one by going to:
NVDA Menu, Options, Input Gestures, Link Library.

recordatorios.description:
The Recordatorios add-on allows the user to easily add reminders, notifying with NVDA sound or custom sound when the scheduled time arrives.
The addition includes 3 unassigned gestures in the NVDA input settings, in the Reminders category:
Open a window to add a reminder. This option will allow you to add one or more reminders. When the window opens, the focus will automatically be set to the field for entering the reminder text.
Check active reminders. This option will allow you to view your configured reminders. Selecting this option will open a window where you can scroll through the list of reminders along with their scheduled times.
Open the dialog for deleting reminders. This will open a selection dialog so you can delete the reminder.
And in the NVDA settings there is a reminder settings panel with functions: number of notifications, notification interval.
The add-on help describes in detail all the features of Recordatorios.

wikiFusion.description:
WikiFusion is a handy add-on for NVDA that integrates searches across Wikipedia, Wiktionary, and other sources in one window.
You can quickly find encyclopedia articles, dictionary definitions, Uncyclopedia humor content, and Urban Dictionary slang terms.
The add-on automatically selects the most suitable source depending on your request.
One word is searched in Wiktionary, and a phrase is searched in Wikipedia.
The results are displayed in a tree view, where each section can be expanded or collapsed.
Use the arrow keys to navigate the tree and Enter to load the selected article.
Supports embedded playback of audio files, such as pronunciation guides from Wiktionary.
To decode OGG and OPUS formats, FFmpeg is used if available.
If FFmpeg is not available, you can download the media file using Ctrl+Enter.
Settings allow you to select the language of Wikipedia and Wiktionary, enable additional sources, and customize the number of results displayed.
You can also specify your preferred language section for definitions.
The add-on supports copying results to the clipboard depending on their type.
The hotkey NVDA+Alt+I opens WikiFusion at any time.
WikiFusion makes working with wikis fast, convenient, and fully accessible to NVDA users.

SpellGuard.description:
SpellGuard is a universal add-on for NVDA that combines the capabilities of three leading AI platforms.
The add-on supports Gemini from Google AI Studio, DeepSeek for highly accurate spelling and grammar checking, as well as GigaChat from Sber.
The plugin automatically adapts to the selected provider, providing a single interface and flexible configuration.
Key features of the add-on include checking spelling and grammar, auto-copying the result to the clipboard, and inserting emoticons in four modes.
Users can manage system prompts, select a model on the fly, and customize AI behavior to suit their needs.
The add-on allows you to check selected text up to 5000 characters long in any application.
Customizable input gestures provide quick access to features, including text verification, connection testing, and opening the hint interface.
The built-in prompt GUI provides convenient tools for creating, editing and applying custom prompts.
Users can use the add-on to translate text, strictly check spelling, style text in different keys, and even answer questions.
All settings, including choosing a provider, entering API keys and managing prompts, are available through a single NVDA settings window.
SpellGuard offers an intuitive interface with dynamic display of parameters and a context menu for working with system prompts.
The add-on is intended for a wide range of users, from ordinary text editors to professional authors and translators.
With support for multiple AI platforms, SpellGuard provides flexibility and reliability when processing text problems of any complexity.
It is recommended that you read the detailed reference guide before using the add-on.

AbsoluteSite.description:
AbsoluteSite is designed for efficiency. Stop wasting time searching through bookmarks or typing long URLs.
Powerful Features:
Smart URL Capture: Instantly copies the page address without highlighting.
Categories for order: Group sites into folders for convenience.
Contextual keys: One press - manager, double press - add.
How to use:
Management: Press Alt+Backspace once to open the manager.
Adding: Press Alt+Backspace twice quickly to save the current site.
Saving: Select a category and name in the window that appears.

AbsoluteTranslate.description:
Expand your capabilities with AbsoluteTranslate - smooth, lightning-fast translation straight into NVDA.
Experience absolute clarity and absence of barriers in any language.
Keyboard shortcut - ALT+Windows+T:
Single press: Translate selected text.
Double tap: Translate the last phrase.
Triple tap: Open Absolute Translate settings.
Note: the add-on uses the Google Translate service.
All functions of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

voiceSwitcher.description:
The VoiceSwitcher add-on for NVDA allows you to quickly switch between multiple voices from different synthesizers.
Instead of manually setting speech parameters through the NVDA menu, the add-on completely automates this process.
It saves time and optimizes speech perception when working with different languages.
The add-on is especially useful for multilingual users and multitasking professionals.
It provides 10 slots for storing voice configurations numbered 1 to 0.
Each slot stores not only the voice name, but also the speed, volume, pitch and variant.
To switch to a saved voice, just press the appropriate key combination.
Standard shortcuts use the combination NVDA+Control+Shift+digit from 1 to 0.
The clever combination NVDA+Control+Shift+S performs two actions depending on the pressure.
A single press saves the current voice to the last called slot.
Double-clicking assigns the current voice to the active application window.
The add-on supports multiple voices in one slot to expand capabilities.
You can configure from 1 to 10 voices per slot.
This allows you to group voices of the same language and select them with a double tap.
The application-specific voices function works completely automatically.
When switching between windows using Alt+Tab, NVDA changes the voice automatically.
To quickly switch between the two main voices, use the key.
It allows you to instantly switch between Slot 1 and Slot 2 with one click.
The central control panel is located in the NVDA settings menu.
Here you can enable or disable the main functions of the add-on.
You can view a list of applications with assigned voices.
If necessary, you can remove or reset settings for a specific application.
The add-on is compatible with NVDA version 2019.3 and later.
Note: The author did not implement the ability to localize the interface.

specialCharacter.description:
specialCharacter is a professional add-on for NVDA designed for users who require speed and accuracy when preparing documents.
Whether you work in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) or use advanced text editors to program and create documents in plain text format, this tool significantly speeds up the typing process.
