Say goodbye to tedious memorization and typing complicated 4-digit Alt codes.
This add-on replaces legacy commands with convenient keyboard shortcuts, allowing you to instantly insert official symbols, technical marks, and specialized punctuation.
It ensures that your reports and data tables meet professional standards without disrupting your typing rhythm.
Features:
Quick character input: Replaces traditional Alt code sequences with direct keyboard shortcuts.
What previously required several taps now happens in one click.
Cross-Environment Support: Optimized to work flawlessly in Microsoft Office and a variety of text editors, ensuring consistency across all your professional platforms.
Custom Character Set: Contains two main sets (Set 1 and Set 2) that can be fully customized.
You can change, rearrange or update symbols in NVDA settings to suit your industry's requirements.
Keyboard shortcuts and other features are described in the reference guide.

AbsoluteFileAndFolder.description:
The AbsoluteFileAndFolder add-on is the best organizer for instant access to files and folders with intelligent filtering, recent history and the ability to run as administrator.
Hotkeys:
Windows+Backspace.
Single click: open Absolute folders.
Double click: open Absolute files.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Absolute files and folders category.
You can read more about the features of the add-on in the reference manual.

newfon.description:
The NewFon add-on is a multilingual speech synthesizer that supports Russian and Ukrainian.
General features:
Ability to change languages:
Changing the sampling frequency.
Sound interpolation, which allows you to simulate the sound of old DOS screen readers and book readers.
To ensure that the synthesizer reads the text as it is written, it is possible to disable the built-in accent dictionary. The option only works for the Russian language.
In addition to the main speed from 0 to 100%, the synthesizer supports additional speech acceleration, which reduces the time it takes to read text.
To get a smoother reading at high speeds, it is possible to adjust the pauses between phrases.

googleTtsForNvda.description:
The Google TTS For NVDA add-on allows you to use Google speech synthesizer voices in the NVDA screen reader for Windows.
It uses WebAssembly Technology (WASM) running in the background runtime of a Chromium-based browser.
The add-on supports Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Brave browsers as a background runtime.
After downloading the necessary voice packages, the add-on works completely autonomously.
It provides fast speech response without the need for a constant Internet connection.
The add-on provides many Google TTS voice packs for different languages.
The built-in Google TTS Voice Manager allows you to conveniently view and manage voice packages.
The manager contains two tabs for managing installed packages and downloading new ones.
Supports filtering of voice packets by language for quick search.
The add-on allows you to select your preferred Chromium browser for background work.
The function of automatic language profiles for different languages ​​is available.
Each language profile can have its own voice and speech options.
Automatic language profiles use the built-in CLD2 language detector.
Language detection results are accepted only if they are sufficiently reliable.
To work, you need to have a Chromium browser installed, as well as Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime when using Edge.
This add-on is still under development.
All functions of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

polyglot.description:
The Polyglot add-on is designed for fast and flexible multilingual translation in NVDA.
It allows you to translate selected text, the contents of the clipboard, and the last spoken phrase.
To call translation functions, use the command layer by pressing NVDA+Alt+Z.
The add-on supports automatic translation of spoken NVDA content in real time.
The built-in intelligent speech filter skips roles, states, and formatting during translation.
Polyglot uses a dynamic architecture of engines that are connected and configured as needed.
Google Translate, Microsoft Translator, DeepL, Baidu, Yandex and others engines are available.
Supports work with the offline Chrome AI engine for translation without an Internet connection.
For engines based on Ollama and OpenRouter, customization of models and request templates is available.
Translation results are cached to reduce the number of repeated requests.
The cache can be cleared manually through the settings panel or with a command from the layer.
When running NVDA in Chinese, a local English-Chinese dictionary with more than 120 thousand entries is available.
For lengthy translations, an interactive dialogue is provided with the ability to select an engine and languages ​​on the fly.
Automatic translation is disabled after three unsuccessful attempts in a row.
All engine settings are generated dynamically based on their own descriptions.
Supports switching languages ​​and engines without opening the settings window.
You can read more about all the features of the add-on in the reference manual.

audioSwitcher.description:
The Audio Switcher add-on allows you to quickly switch Windows audio devices, setting them as the default devices.
It supports up to three speakers and up to three microphones for quickly switching between them.
You can assign a different keyboard shortcut to each device through the NVDA Input Gesture dialog.
Commands are available to set each speaker or microphone as the default device.
You can also declare the current output or input device as default with one click.
When switching, different feedback options are available: signal and speech, speech only, signal only or no feedback.
All configured devices are saved in the Audio Switcher settings panel.
Disabled devices are automatically marked as "disabled" in the settings list.
A unique hardware identifier is used to prevent conflicts between devices with the same name.
The add-on is simple and easy, without unnecessary complexity.
It is suitable for users who often need to change audio devices during work.
To use it, just configure the devices in the NVDA settings.
All changes are applied instantly without rebooting.

audioLogger.description:
The Audio Logger add-on is designed to record system audio output and WavePlayer output for debugging purposes.
It allows you to record sounds played by the system and other applications.
To start recording, use the key combination NVDA+Alt+R.
Stopping recording and saving the file is performed using the NVDA+Alt+T command.
Only the last 60 seconds of audio are saved, regardless of recording length.
The ZIP archive with audio files is saved in the "AudioLogger" folder inside the "Documents" directory.
The file name contains the date and time it was saved for easy identification.
The archive contains WAV files of system audio and raw wave data.
Markers for input gestures and spoken text are also embedded in audio files.
Markers can be viewed using audio editing programs.
It is convenient to send the resulting archive to developers to diagnose problems.
Note: The developer has not implemented the localization feature.

universalTuner.description:
The Universal Tuner add-on allows you to tune musical instruments using reference tones and a microphone in real time.
It supports more than two dozen instruments and different scales.
To open the tuner window, use the key combination NVDA+Shift+G.
Reproduction of reference notes is carried out by selecting an instrument and building from lists.
The Spacebar starts or stops the sound of the selected string or note.
Number keys 1–9 play strings in order for quick tuning.
Volume is controlled by the Home and End keys, and tone duration is controlled by Page Up and Page Down.
The listening mode through the microphone is activated by the L key.
Every two seconds, the tuner reports whether the note is in tune, above or below the standard.
Chromatic mode automatically detects the nearest note without reference to the string.
If the system is accurately hit, a confirmation signal is played.
The signal can be turned off with the O key for silent operation.
The last reading is repeated using the R key.
Advanced settings for sample rate and A4 reference are available in the tuner window.
All tone volume and duration settings are saved between sessions.
The add-on is suitable for tuning guitars, mandolins, bouzoukis and other instruments.

viewNetworks.description:
The View Networks add-on displays a list of all Wi-Fi networks saved on your computer.
It allows you to view network profiles and, if possible, recover passwords.
To open the list of saved networks, use the keyboard shortcut Windows+Alt+N.
The password recovery dialog is called by the command Windows+Alt+P.
In the recovery dialog, you must enter the network name and click the “Find” button.
The contents of the key are displayed in a separate field if the password is available.
If unsuccessful, a message is displayed indicating that it is impossible to obtain information.
To clear input fields, use the “Clear” button.
Dialogs can be closed with the Escape key or the Close button.
Help for the add-on is opened by pressing Windows+Alt+J.
Information about the version and author is available via Windows+Alt+O.
The add-on does not crack passwords, but only retrieves those already stored in the system.
To work, you need the netsh command utility in a Windows environment.
The list of networks is displayed as a simple dialog with one close button.
All Wi-Fi profiles you have connected to are available for viewing.
The add-on is useful for recovering forgotten passwords from wireless networks.

pleasant_progress_bar.description:
The Pleasant Progress Bar add-on replaces the standard monotonous NVDA progress sounds with pleasant melodic sounds.
Supports several types of waves: sine, square, triangle, sawtooth, pulse and white noise.
Offers smart sound fade/fade using cosine and Gaussian algorithms.
The user can adjust the volume, frequency range and duration of sound effects through the NVDA settings panel.
Enabled/disabled by the key combination NVDA+Shift+P.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Nice Progress Bar” category for the “Toggle Nice Progress Bar” shortcut.

pageReporter.description:
Page Reporter automatically announces a summary of page elements every time a web page finishes loading in browse mode.
Instead of manually navigating the page looking for elements, NVDA reports them immediately.
Example of an ad: “Page loaded. On page 3 of the header there are 47 links, 5 buttons, 2 form fields and 4 landmarks.”
The add-on works in single-page applications such as Facebook YouTube Twitter/X and Reddit.
Each time you navigate to a new section and the URL changes, Page Reporter automatically announces an updated summary of elements.
• The NVDA+Shift+W hotkey turns Reporter pages on or off.
• In the add-on settings, you can choose what types of elements to include in the ad: titles, links, buttons, form fields, and landmarks.
• If none of the selected element types are found on the page, NVDA will simply say “Page loaded.”
• You can specify sites to disable Reporter pages by entering their domain names, one per line.
The page porter works in any browser that NVDA supports in browse mode including Google Chrome Mozilla Firefox Microsoft Edge and Brave.
Known limitations: endless feeds without changing the URL do not trigger a new ad, and on heavily scripted pages the ad may appear with a delay.
Page Reporter only works in overview mode.

game_mode.description:
The GameMode add-on is used in cases where you need to change how NVDA works during the game.
While gaming (especially action games), there is often a need to hold down keys, such as holding down the arrow keys to move, etc.
At this point, you will notice that NVDA is silent because the way NVDA works is that pressing any key will immediately abort the current reading, and holding down a key is the same as telling NVDA to abort any reading at any time. This causes the keyboard event to interrupt reading at the very moment when a new message is about to begin.
For these reasons, it was time to add a new mode for gaming, and thus NVDA Gaming Mode was born.
When you enable Game Mode, the NVDA reading principle changes as follows:
When you press a key, speech is not interrupted, but only the fact that the key was pressed is recorded.
When a new message appears to be spoken: If a key was pressed, the current speech will be interrupted before the new content is read, otherwise the new content will be queued and read aloud after the current content is completed.
You can turn Game Mode on or off by pressing NVDA+SHIFT+G.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed using input gestures in the Game Mode category.

openLinkWith.description:
The OpenLinkWith add-on is used to extract links from selected text, the clipboard, or last spoken text, display them in a list in a conversation, and allow them to be opened in multiple browsers if you have them on your computer.
You can also open one link in one default browser.
Unassigned shortcuts:
Display links from selected text.
Displays the link in the clipboard text.
Displays a link in the last spoken text.
The keyboard shortcut must be assigned independently in input gestures, in the Open link with section.

SiteMarker.description:
The SiteMarker add-on allows you to quickly save and access frequently used sections of any website.
With just a few keystrokes, you can mark important paragraphs, buttons, or controls and return to them instantly.
Labels can be installed on any element of a web page with one press of Windows+F12.
Move between marks using the J, F, D and Z keys.
Automatic clicking on elements is supported using Alt+J, Alt+C, Alt+X and Alt+Z.
To manage sites and tags, Site Manager and Tag Manager are provided.
Settings can be exported and imported using portable JSON files.
The add-on works with Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave and WebKit-based browsers.
Supports single page applications with automatic content change detection.
The matching methods available are text, exact match, or regular expressions.
At each transition, the target paragraph is spoken and the review cursor moves to that position.
Adding a new site is done by double pressing Windows+F12, specifying the name and URL pattern.
For each mark, you can set an offset to fine-tune the cursor position.
Autoclick allows you to automatically activate buttons, links or form elements.
All markers are stored in the %APPDATA%\nvda\ChaiChaimee\SiteMarker\site\ folder and can be easily transferred between devices.
The add-on helps save time, reduces fatigue and increases productivity while surfing the Internet.

sonata_neural_voices.description:
The SonataNeuralVoices add-on adds neural speech synthesis voices to NVDA based on the Piper engine.
All calculations are performed locally on your computer without an Internet connection.
The add-on does not come with built-in voices; they must be downloaded through the voice manager.
Voice Manager allows you to preview voices before downloading.
You can choose standard or fast voice option for each language.
Voices are available in three quality options: low, medium and high.
Lower quality provides better responsiveness and speed.
Once installed, voices appear in NVDA Speech Settings for selection.
In the settings, options for selecting voice, variant and speaker are available.
For voices with multiple speakers, you can select a specific speaker.
Additional options allow you to fine-tune the sound of each voice.
The length factor controls the duration of sounds.
Noise factor affects the expressiveness and variability of intonation.
The Noise w parameter regulates the rhythm and naturalness of speech.
All parameters can be easily returned to default values.
The add-on supports installing voices from local archives.
You can remove unnecessary voices and manage installed ones.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

WorldVoice.description:
The WorldVoice add-on is a driver for multilingual speech synthesizers with automatic language switching in accordance with the text language.
The driver allows you to configure language switching between the following speech synthesizers: Espeak, Windows OneCore, Microsoft Speech API version 5, RHVoice, Vocalizer expressive2 and Vocalizer from Cerence.
Note about the WorldVoice add-on published in the Russian add-on store:
This is the original driver, but with an added package of 64/32-bit kernels: Vocalizer expressive2 and Cerence (Do not enable these kernels at the same time to avoid driver conflicts).
Starting from version 5.1, add-ons with a prefix (Mod 0-Mod 3) released by the NVDA.RU community are no longer updated, because this driver contains designated kernels other than compact English and Russian voices, which can be installed through the corresponding item in the driver submenu from the zip archive or simply as a regular add-on from the Russian-language add-on store “RuStore”.

BatteryLevelAnnouncer.description:
BatteryLevelAnnouncer is an add-on for NVDA that reports battery level at configurable intervals using audio and/or speech. It offers flexible options for customizing alerts.
Functions:
Configurable notification intervals.
Alert modes.
Configurable battery test interval.
Supports custom sounds for each percentage.
\Usage:
After installation, configure the add-on through the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Battery Level Alarm.
The following intervals are available: every 5, 10, 20, 25, 50 percent, and when only 100 or off.
Alert modes available: Speech only, audio only, audio and speech.
You can set your own sounds for alerts.

easyAudioConverter.description:
Easy Audio Converter allows you to convert audio files directly from Windows Explorer without launching a separate program.
The add-on uses the built-in FFmpeg component and performs the conversion in the background.
You can select one or more files, a folder, or the entire current Explorer folder to convert.
MP3, WAV, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, M4A, AAC, WMA, ALAC, AIFF, AC-3, E-AC-3, WavPack, MP2 and AMR formats supported.
Special modes are available to extract the original audio stream without transcoding and repackaging AAC to M4A.
For MP3, you can choose between LAME and Fraunhofer Windows Media Foundation encoders.
You can save custom conversion profiles with a full range of settings, or use the MP3 Audiobook, Opus Podcast, and Archive FLAC quick profiles.
Settings include selecting target format and quality, MP3 encoder, destination folder, and subfolder behavior.
EBU R128 volume normalization is available, with presets for podcasts, music and broadcasting.
You can copy text metadata, embedded cover art, and chapter markers.
Supports saving the creation and modification dates of source files and flexible templates for output file names.
For professional use, advanced codec settings are available with control over bitrate, sampling frequency, channels and compression level.
All actions can be performed through the NVDA menu or assigned convenient keyboard shortcuts.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

OnnxASR.description:
OnnxASR is an add-on for speech recognition and voice input using Sber GigaAM V3 models.
You can download the main engine and one of two quantized models (CTC or RNNT) from the author's Yandex Disk (link in the help).
After installing the engine and model, assign a keyboard shortcut to launch dictation in the Input Gestures dialog.
Starting a dictation will start recording from the microphone, and calling again will end the recording and place the recognized text on the clipboard.
The first launch of dictation in the current NVDA session requires several seconds to initialize the model, during which NVDA may temporarily freeze.
Subsequent launches occur instantly.
The add-on settings are accessed through the NVDA “Tools” and “Onnx ASR Settings” menus.
There is a “Use Voice Input” mode in the settings to continuously recognize and send text as NVDA commands.
In this mode, you can assign your own voice commands to any scripts in the “Input Gestures” dialog.
For example, you can bind the phrase "What time is it" to a command to read the current time.
After saving the settings, the voice command will work like a regular keyboard shortcut.
The add-on supports two recognition model architectures.
CTC is slightly faster, but may be less accurate than the RNNT version.
Silero VAD is used to divide the recording into fragments.
By default, the boundary between sentences is considered to be silence lasting 300 ms.
This value may be too low for slow dictation, but will be configurable in future versions.
Full-fledged non-quantized versions of models without the int8 suffix are also available on Yandex Disk.
They take up four times more space, but provide higher recognition quality.
The OnnxASR add-on provides modern voice control and dictation capabilities in Russian.
It is suitable for typing text, controlling a computer and creating your own voice scripts.
OnnxASR is a powerful voice-powered automation solution.

Eloquence.description:
The Eloquence add-on is the Eloquence driver and speech synthesizers for NVDA.
After installing the add-on, you will have access to speech synthesizers in the following languages:
German.
British English.
American English.
Latin American Spanish.
Castilian Spanish.
Finnish.
French.
French-Canadian.
Italian.
Brazilian Portuguese.

Battery_Check.description:
The purpose of the BatteryCheck add-on is to monitor the health of the user's battery so that when it reaches 100%, it issues a signal every 10 seconds to prevent it from deteriorating.
By default, there is no keyboard shortcut assigned, so you need to do it yourself by going to the following path:
NVDA menu, Submenu options, Input gestures, Battery check subsection, Start or stop battery monitoring.
The settings are located in NVDA's general settings, in the Battery Test panel.

wordPredictor.description:
WordPredictor add-on for predictive word prediction based on n-gram analysis.
It tracks your input and suggests the most likely continuations of the phrase.
Predictions are spoken through the NVDA speech engine and pasted directly without using a mouse or clipboard.
After completing a word (either with a space or a punctuation mark), NVDA speaks up to five predicted next words.
You can accept any prediction by pressing the appropriate number from 1 to 5.
The add-on also supports part-word prediction by pressing NVDA+Alt+O.
The model learns in real time, adapting to your writing style.
All studied data is saved and accumulated between work sessions.
Comes with pre-trained data based on common English words and phrases.
You can enable or disable prediction using the combination NVDA+Alt+P.
All keyboard shortcuts can be reassigned in NVDA input gestures.
The add-on works in any application where you type text.
It is automatically disabled in terminal applications for your convenience.
You can add your apps to the exclusion list through the settings panel.
When inserting predictions, punctuation is taken into account: after a period or exclamation mark, a space and a capital letter are automatically added.
Adjust the number of predictions, beep, and training options in the NVDA menu.
Note: The author did not implement the ability to localize the interface.
All features are described in the reference manual.

wenxingBraille.description:
The WenxingBraille driver provides support for Wenxing 40-cell braille displays and CBP in NVDA.
The add-on directly interacts with the device without using third-party libraries.
All display buttons are recognized correctly and perform standard navigation functions.
Keys 1 to 40 are used to route the cursor to the appropriate cell.
The left outer button switches to the previous line of braille, and the right outer button switches to the next line.
The middle left button scrolls the braille backwards, and the middle right button scrolls forward.
The left inner button moves the cursor to the beginning of the review, and the right inner button moves the cursor to the end.
The add-on is unofficial and is not affiliated with the device manufacturer Wenxing or CBP.
It contains no proprietary components and requires legal hardware purchase.
WenxingBraille is a convenient solution for working with braille displays of these models.

wifiSwitcher.description:
WiFiSwitcher is an NVDA add-on for quickly switching between configured WiFi networks in Windows.
The add-on allows you to save up to three Wi-Fi networks and connect to them by pressing hot keys.
You can assign separate keyboard shortcuts to connect to each of the three saved networks.
The add-on announces the name of the currently connected Wi-Fi network upon your request.
In the settings you can specify the SSID for each of the three connection ports.
You can configure notifications: sound and speech, only speech, only sound or no notifications.
You can enable or disable notification when a network connection attempt begins.
The connection timeout is configured to automatically stop the connection attempt.
You can configure the interval of beeps during a connection attempt.
The add-on warns about saving identical networks on multiple ports.
If you try to connect to a non-existent network, a corresponding notification is displayed.
WiFiSwitcher is ideal for users who frequently switch between different networks.

windowState.description:
The WindowState add-on allows you to quickly find out the current state of the active window in Windows.
It tells you whether the window is maximized to full screen, minimized to the taskbar, or restored to its normal size.
The add-on also determines whether the window is docked to one of the sides or corners of the screen.
To obtain information about the window state, use the NVDA+Shift+T gesture.
When you press it, NVDA announces one of the following states.
The window can be maximized, restored or minimized.
It can be docked left, right, top or bottom.
A window can also occupy the top left, top right, bottom left, or bottom right quarter of the screen.
If the window state cannot be determined, NVDA will report an unknown state.
The add-on has an additional function that improves the standard NVDA+T command.
In the settings, you can enable adding the window state to its title declaration.
When this option is enabled, NVDA will report the window title and state at the same time.
For example, instead of “Notepad,” NVDA will say “Notepad, expanded.”
This behavior is similar to how it is implemented in the JAWS screen reader.
This function does not affect other modes of operation of the NVDA+T command.
Double tapping still spells the title without indicating the state.
A triple click copies the title to the clipboard, also without window state.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA Options dialog in the “Window State” category.
There is one option available in this category to enable adding state to the title.
The add-on is especially useful when actively using the window docking function using the Win key and arrow keys.
It helps you quickly check the result of each window management action.
The add-on works in all Windows applications with a graphical interface.
It correctly determines the state of windows in Explorer, browsers and office applications.
Docked window detection works on any screen configuration.

claritySynth.description:
ClaritySynth is an Arabic-first, multilingual speech synthesizer for NVDA.
The add-on reads Arabic text using natural neural network voices with automatic placement of vowels.
It supports reading English and other languages ​​with automatic switching within the same sentence.
ClaritySynth includes two synthesizers: a neural network one for natural sound and a formant one as a reliable backup option.
Primary Arabic and secondary voice settings for other languages ​​are available.
Implemented automatic placement of vowels for any NVDA synthesizer using the combination NVDA+J.
The add-on can read numbers, dates, times, currencies and symbols in Arabic.
Various vocalization libraries are supported: CATT, Libtashkeel, Rawi and others.
Own characteristics in the text are preserved, only missing vowels are supplemented.
Additional voices, vocoders and libraries can be downloaded via the download manager.
There is a separate tool for vocalizing Arabic text.
Settings and downloads are saved in the NVDA user configuration.
The add-on is compatible with other synthesizers and add-ons, including MultiLang.

professionalMediaDownloader.description:
Professional Media Downloader is a high-performance and affordable tool for NVDA users.
It allows you to download audio and video from over 1000 streaming platforms.
Supported services include YouTube Facebook Instagram and many others.
For quick access, use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+Y from any application.
Paste the copied URL into the appropriate field and select the desired format.
• Supported audio formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC.
• Supported video formats: MP4, MKV, WEBM with high resolution.
• The add-on is integrated into the NVDA Tools menu.
• Files are automatically sorted into “Audio” and “Video” folders.
Press Alt+D to quickly jump to the download button.
Use Alt+O to open the folder with the downloaded files.
Once the download has started, an available progress dialog is displayed.
You will receive a notification when the download is complete.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Professional Media Downloader category.

ClauVDA.description:
ClauVDA integrates Anthropic Claude's artificial intelligence directly into NVDA.
The add-on supports Claude Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 models.
Two authentication providers are available: Anthropic Direct API and Amazon Bedrock.
ClauVDA allows you to conduct a dialogue with Claude, describe the screen and individual objects.
Video analysis with screen recording and key frame extraction is available.
You can attach image files to describe the AI.
Summarizing selected text and the last spoken speech is supported.
The add-on saves conversation history to maintain context.
The response temperature, maximum number of tokens and streaming output are configurable.
To work, you need an API key from one of the providers.
Keys are stored locally with Windows DPAPI encryption.
All data is sent only to the selected Anthropic or AWS Bedrock provider.
Control is carried out through convenient keyboard shortcuts.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

radioCenter.description:
The RadioCenter add-on allows you to listen to online radio stations and save the audio stream to a file.
Recording one radio station does not interfere with listening to another radio station.
A list of keyboard shortcuts can be found in the add-on help.
The features of the add-on are also described there.

cashflow.description:
Cashflow allows you to manage payments and receipts directly from NVDA.
The main interface opens with the combination NVDA+Control+F and contains four lists of operations.
Lists of pending and completed payments, as well as expected and received receipts, are available.
In lists, you can mark operations as completed or return them to a pending status.
You can edit and delete entries with confirmation of the action.
For convenience, separate managers for payments, receipts and income have been implemented.
Supports import and export of data in CSV, JSON and Excel formats.
A monthly filter is available to view transactions for the selected period.
The add-on allows you to create encrypted backups with a password and restore data.
The playback of sounds and the choice of currency for voicing amounts are configured.
Commands for payments and receipts can be reassigned in NVDA input gestures.

cleanTerminalOutput.description:
Clean Terminal Output removes terminal cell spaces from text copied to the clipboard.
The padding eliminates trailing spaces in each line and lines consisting only of spaces.
It removes unwanted leading indents and compresses sequences of empty lines.
Clearing is done by pressing NVDA+Shift+C, after which the clipboard is updated.
In the settings you can choose how the left indent is processed.
There are three options: left align, remove only the overall indentation, or keep leading spaces.
The empty string compression feature can be turned on and off as desired.
You can turn off the confirmation sound after successful cleaning.
Error messages are always spoken regardless of this setting.
The add-on is suitable for clearing text copied from terminals and consoles.
It makes it easy to insert text into documents, emails, and code editors.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the Input Gestures dialog under the Clear Terminal Output category.

sayCurrentKeyboardLanguage.description:
The SayCurrentKeyboardLanguage add-on provides a command that allows you to find out the current language of the keyboard you are using, as well as the default system language.
If the NVDA+4 hotkey conflicts with another command, you can change it by going to the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Input Gestures.
Then find the corresponding shortcut in the System Status category.

ClearClipboard.description:
Clear Clipboard add-on for NVDA, which clears the contents of the clipboard.
It allows you to quickly delete all data from the clipboard with one keystroke.
The default is Alt+Delete.
You can change this combination in NVDA input gestures.
The add-on is useful when you need to delete sensitive data from the clipboard.
It also helps you avoid accidentally pasting previous content.
Cleaning is done instantly with voice confirmation.

sarvamAI.description:
Sarvam AI Assistant for NVDA provides access to the functions of the Sarvam AI platform directly from the screen reader.
The add-on supports text-to-speech conversion in Indian languages ​​with the ability to save audio in MP3 and WAV formats.
Speech to text allows you to transcribe audio files and microphone recordings with optional English translation.
Translation and transliteration of text between English and 10 Indian languages ​​is available with a choice of different styles.
The language detection feature automatically identifies the language and script of any text.
The AI ​​assistant allows you to chat, summarize texts and analyze documents using Sarvam language models.
OCR recognizes text from PDF and images using Sarvam Document OCR supporting 23 languages ​​or standalone Windows OCR.
The recognized text can be translated or summarized using Sarvam.
To work, you need a Sarvam API key, which can be obtained at dashboard.sarvam.ai.
All functions are available through the Tools menu or by using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Alt+S.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

mp3DirectCut.description:
The Mp3DirectCut add-on improves the availability of the mp3DirectCut program of the same name for NVDA users.
This add-on adds a number of keyboard commands for ease of use of this audio editor.
It has been tested with mp3DirectCut versions 212 to 233.

notepadPlusPlusImeFix.description:
The NotepadPlusPlusImeFix add-on restores the correct cursor position reporting when entering unvalidated text through the IME in 64-bit Notepad++ version 8.3 and later.
It fixes an issue where moving the cursor inside Chinese IME text would result in empty speech output and no braille updates in NVDA.
The add-on retains the standard Scintilla TextInfo fix for plain text in Notepad++.
Priority is given to the TextInfo of an IME input only while there is an active IME input or a reading line is present.
This add-on overrides the Notepad++ application module in NVDA.
It may conflict with other add-ons that also change the behavior of Notepad++.
It is recommended to remove or disable other Notepad++ add-ons before installation.

NeuralVoices.description:
The NeuralVoices add-on is a driver for neural natural voices from Microsoft.
The driver provides a function for automatically switching voices depending on the language of the text being read, and also provides the ability to individually adjust speed, pitch and volume for each voice.
Automatic voice switching is enabled by the “Detect text language based on Unicode scripts” checkbox in NVDA speech settings.
The desired voice for a specific language can be set in the dialog that opens through the NVDA menu → Options → Neural Voices Settings.
After installing the NeuralVoices driver, you need to install one or more neural natural voices.
To use this type of speech synthesizer with other types, you can use the MultiLang virtual driver.

discordMessageHotkeys.description:
DiscordMessageHotkeys addon for reading recent messages in the Discord desktop client without moving focus or cursor.
You can type into an input field, press a hotkey, and hear an earlier message without interrupting your typing.
The add-on downloads automatically when running in the Discord desktop app and does not affect the web version.
To read the latest messages, use Alt with a number from 1 to 0.
• Alt+1 reads the newest message.
• Alt+2 reads the previous message, and so on.
• Alt+9 reads the ninth most recent message.
• Alt+0 reads the tenth most recent message.
Focus and cursor stay in place so keys are safe to press while typing.
If less than ten messages are loaded, the add-on reports the exact number.
Alt+D moves focus to the first unread message and NVDA speaks it.
If there are no unread messages or the marker is not available, the add-on will notify you about this.
Alt+Shift+N enables automatic reading of incoming messages with three modes.
• (Off) – Automatic reading is disabled, this is the default setting.
• (Polite) – a new message is spoken after the current speech is completed.
• (Interruptive) – a new message is spoken immediately, interrupting speech.
Auto-reading only works for an open channel and only when Discord is in focus.
The mode is remembered when NVDA is restarted.
You can also set up automatic reading mode in NVDA > Options > Preferences > Discord Message Hotkeys.
All hotkeys can be reassigned in NVDA Input Gestures under the Discord Message Hotkeys category.
All features of the add-on are described in the help.

UnigramCacheCleaner.description:
The UnigramCacheCleaner add-on automatically clears the unigram cache.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+SHIFT+C - manually start clearing the cache.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the UnigramCacheCleaner subsection.
In the add-on settings you can set the period for automatically clearing the cache:
Once a day, Once a week, Once a month.
Paths for clearing the cache have already been added for Unigram from the Windows store, as well as for Unigram Beta and Update from the developer channel.
In addition, you can add a custom folder to clean up, such as the Unigram folder from your downloads folder.

freeradio.description:
FreeRadio is an Internet radio add-on for NVDA Narrator.
Its main goal is to provide users with easy access to thousands of Internet radio stations.
The entire interface and all functions are designed to be fully accessible for NVDA.
FreeRadio uses the Radio Browser, an open directory containing over 50,000 stations from around the world.
No registration required.
The add-on supports hotkeys to control playback, volume and recording from anywhere in the system.
You can add stations to your favorites and organize them.
Audio mirroring is available to output audio to two devices simultaneously.
Instant and scheduled recording of the broadcast is available.
• Supports recording songs with automatic stop when changing tracks.
• Built-in music recognition through Shazam in the absence of metadata.
• There is a sleep timer and an alarm clock to automatically turn on the radio.
• You can save your favorite tracks to a text file and listen to them on Spotify or YouTube.
The add-on uses the BASS engine by default with support for audio effects and smooth transitions between stations.
If necessary, VLC, PotPlayer or Windows Media Player are used.
All features are described in the reference manual.

nvChime.description:
The NVChime add-on allows you to customize the startup and shutdown sounds of the NVDA screen reader.
It provides six built-in sound sets to suit every taste.
You can choose classic ringtone, retro ringtone, soft ringtone or other options.
You can also use your own WAV files from your computer.
The add-on supports separate sounds for starting and exiting NVDA.
You can adjust the delay before playing the start sound.
Before saving the settings, you can preview any sound.
For proper operation, it is recommended to disable standard NVDA sounds in the main settings.
NVChime settings are located in a separate category of the NVDA Options dialog.
The add-on makes the process of starting and shutting down NVDA more personalized and informative.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Startup and Shutdown Sounds panel.

wholeWordEcho.description:
The Whole Word Echo add-on improves the ability to read out words in NVDA Screen Reader.
The standard behavior of NVDA when speech is turned on is to accumulate input characters in an internal buffer.
This buffer is spoken at the end of a word, that is, when you press space, Enter, Tab, or a punctuation mark.
However, any cursor movement, including pressing Backspace or Delete, completely clears this buffer.
As a result, if you correct an error using Backspace and then retype a word, NVDA speaks only the part that was entered after the correction.
The WholeWordEcho add-on eliminates this shortcoming.
It reads the actual text in front of the cursor directly from the edit field and speaks out the entire word.
The add-on works correctly after using Backspace and Delete.
It also supports corrections made using the arrow keys or mouse.
The word is voiced only when several conditions are met.
In the NVDA keyboard settings, the option “Speak out entered words” must be enabled.
The "Only in edit fields" mode is also fully taken into account.
When typing in protected fields, such as passwords, the add-on does not speak anything.
Terminals are ignored to prevent accidental disclosure of passwords.
If the text cannot be read or does not match what was entered, the add-on does not interfere with NVDA.
In this case, NVDA pronounces the word in the standard way.
A special category “Whole Word Reading” is available in NVDA settings.
Here you can enable or disable the main function of the add-on.
For quick switching, a separate command is provided in input gestures.
By default, this command has no gesture assigned.
The addition makes the text editing process more natural and informative.
It is especially useful when typing long words or frequently correcting typos.
WholeWordEcho is fully integrated into the standard NVDA interface and does not require additional configuration.

navigateTheNumpadWay.description:
The Navigate the numpad way add-on is intended for users who do not have a number pad on their keyboard.
It allows you to emulate numeric keypad keys using basic typing keys.
This allows you to use all the object navigation and browsing features available in NVDA.
The add-on provides four preset key shapes for emulation.
Each shape is a set of nine keys arranged in a three-by-three grid.
These keys correspond to numeric keypad positions 1 through 9.
You can select any of the four forms in the add-on settings.
For clarity, the selected key shape is displayed in the settings.
The add-on supports three operating modes: normal, numeric keypad mode and number input mode.
Switching between modes is done using the combination Shift+NVDA+F4.
This combination can be changed in input gestures at your discretion.
In numeric keypad mode, the selected keys perform all the commands available on a real numeric keypad.
The use of keys is supported both separately and in combination with Shift or NVDA.
Number input mode allows you to enter numbers using the same keys.
By default, the number input mode is skipped when switching so as not to interfere with operation.
This behavior can be changed in the add-on settings.
To quickly exit the numeric keypad mode, you can use the Escape key.
This feature is enabled by default and can be disabled in Settings.
The addition is especially useful for owners of laptops and compact keyboards.
It makes working with NVDA more convenient and efficient without the need to purchase an external keyboard.
Add-on settings are available through the NVDA menu in a separate panel.
There you can choose the shape of the keys and configure the settings for switching modes.
Note: The author of the add-on has changed the name; previously this add-on was called EmulateNumpadMode.

AutoMaximize.description:
The AutoMaximize add-on automatically maximizes application windows while NVDA is running.
You no longer have to manually click the maximize button every time you open or switch to a window.
The main purpose of the add-on is to keep application windows maximized.
This helps ensure that buttons, controls, and other interface elements are visible and accessible.
In some applications, especially web applications, controls may be hidden or rearranged when the window is not maximized.
The add-on is also useful for creating video tutorials or recording screens.
It allows you to maintain clear visibility of application windows and their interface when demonstrating programs.
AutoMaximize performs background scanning with minimal system load.
The add-on provides independent control over the deployment of standard windows and dialog boxes.
To quickly enable or disable the function, use the NVDA+Shift+A gesture.
A high beep confirms that automatic deployment is enabled.
A low beep indicates it is disabled.
The key combination can be changed or deleted in the input gestures dialog.
The add-on settings are located in a separate category in the NVDA Options dialog.
Two independent options are available for standard application windows and dialog boxes.
Maximizing standard application windows is enabled by default.
Maximizing dialog boxes is disabled by default.
All settings are saved automatically and restored when NVDA is launched.
The add-on starts working immediately after installation.
A window is maximized only if it can be maximized and is not already maximized.
System surfaces such as the taskbar are never maximized.
Windows without a title or temporary windows, including menus and tooltips, are not maximized.

ChangeSounds.description:
The ChangeSounds add-on allows you to quickly and easily replace standard NVDA sounds with custom sounds from the selected sound package.
The add-on provides a convenient dialog for selecting a sound package, previewing all sound files and automatically replacing them in the NVDA sounds folder.
Sound packages are stored in the sound_packages folder inside the add-on directory.
Each package is a separate folder containing WAV files with names corresponding to the original NVDA sounds.
The add-on automatically detects the path to the folder with NVDA sounds for the installed and portable versions.
The add-on is accessed through the menu Tools → Change sounds → Settings or by clicking on the input gestures shortcut.
All functions of the add-on are described in detail in the reference manual.

objPadMod.description:
The ObjPadMod add-on provides shortcuts for manipulating objects on the screen, including navigation and other features.
Keyboard shortcut: NVDA+Control+TAB: Switch between modes.
In the modification, through the add-on settings panel, in the general NVDA settings, you can disable the modes that you want to exclude from cyclic switching.
Please note that at least one mode must be selected in the settings, since the NVDA+Control+TAB command requires at least two modes (standard mode is always present by default), therefore standard mode cannot be disabled.
You can also select the level of voicing of phrases when switching modes: Full or short.
The ObjPadMod add-on provides four ways to use the arrow keys:
Classic (or Standard Mode): Use the arrow keys to move the cursor.
Object Navigation Mode: Use arrow keys to navigate to the next/previous/parent/first child object.
Browse mode: Use the arrow keys to cycle through items and move between them.
Scan Mode: Use the arrow keys to move through objects on the screen, regardless of hierarchy.

LION.description:
LION is a smart add-on for NVDA designed to automatically recognize text on the screen using OCR technology.
It periodically scans selected areas of the screen and speaks only new or changed text, which eliminates repeated reading of the same information.
The main application is reading subtitles in video players, streaming platforms and TV shows, as well as monitoring dynamic text in applications and games.
The add-on offers flexible settings: selecting the recognition area, adjusting the scanning interval, trimming the edges of the screen and setting the text similarity threshold.
LION works efficiently with full-screen subtitles, supports a variety of video sources, and can be used to read any text that is not available with standard NVDA functions.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Alt+N- Start or stop LION.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the “LION” category.
LION settings are located in NVDA General Settings.

TeleNVDA.description:
The TeleNVDA add-on allows for remote control and remote access to another machine. This add-on is based on NVDA Remote.
You can connect to someone else's computer or let a trusted person connect to yours.
system to perform routine maintenance, diagnose a problem, or teach you something.

invisinote.description:
Invisinote is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to view text notes from selected folders.
• The add-on provides convenient navigation through folders and files using hot keys.
• You can open a folder with notes using the combination NVDA+ALT+P or configure folders and file types using NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+P.
• Switching between folders using NVDA+ALT+[ and NVDA+ALT+] is supported.
• To navigate between notes, use the NVDA+ALT+U (previous) and NVDA+ALT+O (next) keys.
• Within a note, you can navigate by lines (NVDA+ALT+I and NVDA+ALT+K), words (NVDA+ALT+J and NVDA+ALT+L) and characters (NVDA+ALT+, and NVDA+ALT+.).
• The functions of copying the entire note (NVDA+ALT+A) or the current line (NVDA+ALT+;) are available.
• Implemented text selection and subsequent copying using combinations with Shift.
• The selection can be removed using the NVDA+ALT+BACKSPACE keys.
• Use NVDA+ALT+N to load all notes from the selected folders.
• The current note can be read in its entirety using the combination NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+A.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the category ]Invisible Notes}.

enhancedFakeClipboard.description:
The main purpose of the EnhancedFakeClipboard add-on is to report actions: copy, cut, paste and select everything when you press the appropriate keyboard shortcuts or individual keys on the keyboard.
This is a really old addition, it has stood the test of time and is still in use and remains useful.
This is a modified version of the FakeClipboardAnnouncement add-on.
In the editing controls, if you want to copy or cut text and it is not selected, the add-on will warn you that the text is not selected.
similarly, if you want to copy or cut a file in a folder and it is not selected, the add-on will also warn you about this.

LinksHub.description:
Links Hub is a dedicated add-on for NVDA screen reader that makes managing web links a streamlined, convenient process.
Imagine the situation: you regularly visit dozens of sites - news, professional resources, shops, entertainment portals. Browser bookmarks are not always easy to navigate using a screen reader, and simple text files do not provide the desired structure. This is where Links Hub comes into the picture.
Key features:
Categorize links - organize links into thematic folders for quick access.
Quick search - instantly find the link you need in the selected category.
Flexible management - add, edit, delete links in a few clicks.
Browser selection - open links in any installed browser.
Backup - Export and import categories to save data.
Who is this supplement for?
Links Hub is designed for NVDA users who:
They value order in digital information.
Work with a large number of web resources.
They want quick access to their favorite sites.
They prefer a structured approach to storing links.
You can read more about all the features of the add-on in the help manual.

VocalizerExpressive2VoiceManager.description:
VocalizerExpressive2VoiceManager add-on for managing the voices of the Vocalizer Expressive2 synthesizer in NVDA.
Allows you to view, install and delete voices for various languages.
Automatically detects NVDA interface language and suggests appropriate voices.
Supports selection of synthesis quality: compact, high, premium and professional.
Displays information about voices: name, gender, age, version and file size.
Allows you to download voice installation files to your computer for backup.
Uses data caching to work without an Internet connection.
Provides a context menu for quick access to basic functions.
A restart of NVDA is required to install or remove the voice.
Supports a wide range of languages, including European, Asian and Middle Eastern.
Note: For voices to work, you must install the VocalizerExpressive2Driver driver or the CerenceTTS driver for newer voices.
The manager downloads votes from the Russian-speaking community website.

favoriteLinks.description:
The FavoriteLinks add-on helps you organize your favorite links into convenient categories.
It allows you to save, edit and delete links in a structured and efficient way.
You can add new links, rename headings, and manage entire categories.
The interface consists of two fields: selecting a category and a list of links in it.
Navigate between fields using the Tab key.
Use the context menu (Applications key) to access all actions.
In the Categories field you can add, rename and delete categories.
It is also possible to export and import all links to a JSON file.
The following actions are available in the list of links.
• Open the link in your default browser or a configured secondary browser.
• Add a new link with automatic receipt of the page title.
• Edit the title and URL of an existing link.
• Remove the selected link from the list.
• Sort links in the current category alphabetically.
The add-on supports hotkeys for quick actions.
For example, Alt+Windows+K opens the main FavoriteLinks window.
The combination Shift+Control+D saves the URL of the current page.
Using NVDA+Control+F4 you can show the URL of the current page.
All add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu in the “Options” section.
You can select a folder to store the JSON file with links.
You can also specify the path to an additional browser to open links.
FavoriteLinks will make your work with web pages more convenient and faster.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures under the “Favorite Links” category.

terminalAccess.description:
Terminal Access adds easy keyboard navigation to 30 windowed terminal applications.
These include Windows Terminal, PowerShell, Command Prompt, WSL, and popular third-party emulators.
The add-on allows you to read terminal output line by line, word by character, without moving the system cursor.
You can read the results of commands just like a regular document.
For quick work, a special layer of commands is available, activated by pressing NVDA + apostrophe.
In this mode, each command is executed with one keystroke.
Bookmarks are available to quickly return to important buffer lines.
Table view helps you read structured data into columns with headers declared.
The add-on can find errors and warnings in program output and sound signals.
Built-in buffer search supports regular expressions and shows a list of all matches.
To work with AI tools, navigation through dialogue loops and code blocks is available.
Terminal Access automatically detects gesture conflicts with other NVDA add-ons.
For each application, you can create a separate profile with its own settings.
Window definitions are supported that allow you to suppress specific areas of the screen, such as the status bar.
The add-on correctly handles Unicode text, including CJK characters and emoji.
It is written in pure Python and is optimized for working with large terminal buffers.
Open the help guide at any time from the terminal using the command NVDA+Shift+F1.

Vol_CTRL.description:
VolCTRL add-on that will help you change the NVDA volume using a keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+Page Up or Page Down - Increase or decrease volume.
Windows+Shift+R - To restart Windows.
Windows+Shift+S - To shut down Windows.
Windows+Shift+T - To terminate the windows_tatip process.
Note: The add-on has no settings, and it is also impossible to change the keyboard shortcut through input gestures.

TelegramJusti.description:
The TelegramJusti add-on for NVDA expands the accessibility of Telegram Desktop and Unigram.
It provides convenient tools for navigating and managing messenger functions.
The add-on is based on a hybrid architecture using UI Automation and AutomationID.
It is based on the V8 engine for intelligent search of controls.
TelegramJusti offers a wide range of features for everyday use.
• Record, send and cancel recording of voice messages.
• Play and pause audio messages.
• Manage voice and video calls.
• Quickly end calls with one command.
• Open the profile of the current chat.
• Attaching multimedia files to messages.
• Create new chats without unnecessary actions.
• Instant access to the message entry field.
• Return directly to the chat list.
• Opening the navigation menu and reaction panels.
• Access to a panel of emoji, stickers and GIFs.
• Transcription of voice messages.
• Download and open attachments.
• Go to the last message in the chat.
• Turn the microphone and camera on and off.
• Screen sharing during calls.
• Automatic focus on the chat list when launching Unigram.
All gestures can be reassigned through NVDA's Input Gestures menu.
It supports x64 architecture and works with Telegram Desktop and Unigram.
TelegramJusti is actively developing and receiving new features.
The project is part of an ecosystem of accessible solutions for NVDA users.
All features are described in the reference manual.

TeamSpeak.description:
The TeamSpeak add-on improves the accessibility of the TeamSpeak program of the same name and performs the following functions for the TeamSpeak 3.x client:
Supports 32- and 64-bit client versions.
Signs some controls that do not have their own name in NVDA.
In particular, the sound of the volume control has been improved when the user places it on the screen.
Provides tree-level declarations in the channel tree. (However, for large trees the levels may not be accurate).
Prevents NVDA from saying Column 1 for every row in the channel tree.
Note: The add-on will not work with older versions of TeamSpeak or TeamSpeak 5.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

nvdaCoach.description:
NVDA Coach is an interactive training add-on for NVDA Narrator.
It helps you master NVDA commands through short practice exercises.
Instead of reading a manual, you practice skills in real time with voice prompts.
The add-on is designed specifically for beginners and those who are just starting to get acquainted with screen readers.
To get started, press NVDA+Shift+C.
The Trainer window will open with a greeting and a list of lessons.
Select a lesson using the arrows and press Enter.
Each lesson consists of sequential steps.
For command steps, switch to another window, perform the action, and return to the Trainer window using NVDA+Shift+C.
For steps with embedded text, practice directly in the Trainer window.
Keys are always available during a lesson
• Enter—go to the next step
• F1 - repeat the current instruction
• F2 - hint for the current step
• F3 - skip current step
• Escape - stop the lesson
After completing a lesson, use Ctrl+N for the next lesson, Ctrl+B for the previous one, and Ctrl+R to restart.
The add-on remembers the lessons completed and marks them in the list.
The progress is saved in the NVDA configuration folder.
NVDA Coach currently includes six chapters:
• "Getting started with NVDA."
• “Reading and moving through text.”
• “Browse mode and Internet navigation.”
• “Navigation through objects.”
• “NVDA Settings”.
• “Your keyboard.”
Built-in practice environments are provided for lessons
• live training forms for practicing TAB navigation and element activation
• text area for reading and highlighting practice right in the Trainer window
• a separate web page for practicing navigation through headings, links and forms
The add-on was created by Tony Gebhard, an assistive technology instructor.

favoriteFolders.description:
The FavoriteFolders add-on records the user's most used folders as favorites.
The registration process suggests a folder name, but you can change it.
To open a registered folder, simply press Enter on it or activate the (Open Folder) button.
To add a folder to your favorites, press the Windows key + Backspace key combination.
The add-on can be used from anywhere.

goldwave.description:
GoldWave add-on to expand access when using the GoldWave audio editor of the same name.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+C: Toggle command speaking while editing audio.
Control+Shift+P: Announces the current track position.
NVDA+Shift+R: Announces the remaining time for the track being edited.
Control+NVDA+1: Announces the channel you are editing.
Control+NVDA+2: Displays the total length of the audio file.
Control+NVDA+3: Displays audio file selection information.
Control+NVDA+4: Displays the zoom level.
Note: Requires GoldWave 6 or later and Windows 10 or later.

talkingMetaTrader.description:
TMT add-on for NVDA, designed to work with MetaTrader 5.
Allows you to navigate MetaTrader 5 using hotkeys.
In addition to the plugin, there is a separate application called ChartReader. It can read chart data from MetaTrader and convert it into an HTML table or play it as audio tones, which helps blind users understand trends, levels and values.
You can read more about the functionality of the add-on in the reference manual.

NativeSpeechGeneration.description:
Leverage the power of Google Gemini's advanced artificial intelligence to generate high-quality speech directly in NVDA. This add-on provides a convenient dialog for converting text into natural-sounding audio.
Key features:
High Quality Voices: Choose between Gemini Pro for premium, lifelike sound and Gemini Flash for standard quality and fast generation.
Single and Multi-Speaker Modes: Easily create audio for a single speaker or create dynamic dialogues with two different voices. Simply format the text as SpeakerName: to assign votes.
Advanced Voice Control: Fine-tune your output by adjusting the temperature setting for more creative or consistent results, as well as setting custom style instructions.
Accessible Interface: All controls are fully accessible, including a collapsible panel for advanced settings, making the interface clean and easy to navigate.
Seamless workflow: The add-on provides instant audio playback after generation and allows you to save the resulting .wav file for later use.
To get started, obtain a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio and enter it in the add-on settings panel, which is located in the NVDA Tools menu.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Native speech generation” category.

toolbarsExplorer.description:
The ToolbarsExplorer add-on simplifies the use of toolbars in applications,
using their research model formed by object navigation but with simplified gestures.
Teams:
Alt + context menu key: start searching for toolbars (you can change this combination in the input gestures item, object navigation section).
After the search for toolbars is completed, the following combinations will become available:
Left/Right Arrows: Move to previous/next toolbar.
Up/Down Arrows: Move up/down between items in the current toolbar.
Enter: Activates a toolbar or toolbar element.
Spacebar: performs the function of left-clicking on a toolbar or its element.
Context menu or Shift+F10: performs the function of right-clicking on a toolbar or its element.
Escape: Exits toolbar exploration mode.
Additionally, you can perform actions on toolbars or their elements using any NVDA gesture, just like navigating to objects using standard object navigation.

v2rayN.description:
The v2rayN add-on for NVDA significantly increases the accessibility of the v2rayN client for blind and visually impaired users.
It adds correct labels to interface elements, improves focus control and keyboard navigation, and provides detailed screen reading for all components: tables, lists, drop-down menus, and status bars.
The add-on includes special hotkeys for quickly switching between servers, managing profiles and proxy settings, making working with the application efficient and comfortable without using a mouse.
The keyboard shortcuts are described in the quick help.

wordAccessibility.description:
The WordAccessibility add-on improves the Microsoft Word experience for NVDA users.
It automatically reads out the text content of dialog boxes as they appear.
For example, after performing a search or replacement, the result message is spoken without further action.
If you did not hear the message, you can repeat it at any time using a special command.
The add-on also includes a debug mode to check the current interface element.
This makes it easier to control what you're doing in Word and reduces the need to manually re-read dialogue.
It does not require complex setup and works immediately after installation.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+R: Reread the last message in the dialog.
NVDA+Shift+F12: Check the current element (debug mode).
How it works:
Open the Find and Replace dialog box (Ctrl+H).
Perform the replacement (the “Replace All” button).
Confirmation message (for example: “Word made 3 replacements”).
is announced automatically.
The focus remains on the OK button.
Press NVDA+Shift+R to read the message again if necessary

reviewCursorCopier.description:
The ReviewCursorCopier add-on provides several commands for copying text under the review cursor to the clipboard.
The following commands are currently implemented:
Copy line under view cursor
Copy word under view cursor
Copy from the beginning of the current line to the viewing cursor
Copy from view cursor to end of current line
Copy from the beginning of the current word to the view cursor
Copy from view cursor to end of current word
By default, none of these commands have keyboard shortcuts assigned.
To assign them, use the input gestures dialog located in the NVDA Options submenu.
All the commands provided by this add-on can be found under the Text Viewer category.

batteryAlert.description:
The BatteryAlert add-on adds functionality to notify you of an impending low battery and a recommendation to put the laptop on recharge, as well as the need to disconnect the laptop from recharging if the battery has charged to the set level.
In addition, the add-on can remind you of these events with speech, a short sound, a short sound and speech, or open a notification window.
You can also set an interval for repeating alerts.

VAC.description:
The VAC add-on improves the NVDA presentation of the control panel and two audio repeater applications in Virtual Audio Cable (VAC).
Current features:
Naming fields in all three VAC applications using tooltips associated with each field. This approach works in VAC 4.60 and later.
Disable progress bars because progress bars are used as counters in VAC.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

RHVoiceVoiceManager.description:
The RH Voice Voice Manager add-on adds to NVDA a convenient “RHVoice Voice Manager” functionality with which users of RHVoice speech synthesizers can install or remove voices for selected languages.
Only official voices from the developer's website RHVoice.org are available in the manager.
The manager is located in the NVDA menu, Service submenu, RHVoice Voice Manager.
In the manager dialog there are tabs with languages, when selected, the names of synthesizers with the status Not installed or installed are displayed in the list, as well as the voice version.
For uninstalled voices, the “install” button is available.
On installed voices, the “delete” button is available.
On loaded voices the status is “Will be installed after reboot”.
After clicking the “Close” button, NVDA will be restarted, and voices will be installed or removed depending on the tasks.
Note: Starting from version 2026.02.28, the server address has been changed to the personal home server of the add-on developer, located in Russia.
The reason is that the official server "rhvoice.org", located outside of Russia, is not accessible from Russia without bypass tools.

NeuralVoiceManager.description:
The NeuralVoiceManager add-on for NVDA provides a convenient interface for managing Microsoft neural voices.
You can view voices filtered by language and country.
Installation of selected voices is performed automatically and progress is displayed.
Removal of installed votes occurs with confirmation of the action.
You can download voice files to your computer without installation.
For each voice, the status is displayed: installed, will be installed after a restart, will be deleted after a restart, or not installed.
You must restart NVDA to complete installation or uninstallation.
Voices are downloaded directly from the Russian-speaking community server.
Works only with an active Internet connection.

navSounds.description:
The NavSounds add-on provides navigation sounds and keyboard typing sounds. You can hear different sounds depending on the types of elements you interact with, and you can also experience different keyboard sounds when you type. with the ability to customize everything.
Navigation sounds will be played based on object types when interacting with NVDA.
Keyboard typing setting that will allow you to play a different keyboard sound when you type with NVDA, you can choose to play it anytime you press a button or focus on a text field.
Use the keyboard shortcut (NVDA + Alt+ N).
Pressing once toggles between enabling and disabling object sounds, and pressing twice toggles between reading and disabling object types. 
You can customize the keyboard shortcut to your liking by opening the nvda menu settings submenu, Input Gestures, Navigation Sounds.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu, Settings, Options, Navigation Sounds.

checkGestures.description:
The CheckGestures add-on adds search and correction for input gesture conflicts in NVDA and add-ons.
The general term (input gestures) combines keyboard commands, commands entered from braille keyboards, and gestures used on touch displays.
Each installed add-on can make changes to NVDA's configuration by adding or overriding existing input gestures.
If you have the same input gestures assigned to multiple functions, it will make it impossible to call some of them.
For more information on using the presented functionality, please refer to the add-on help.

deepseekSpellChecker.description:
The DeepSeek Spell Checker add-on for NVDA provides powerful spelling, grammar and punctuation checking capabilities using advanced AI models from DeepSeek.
Main features:
Spell Check - Automatically correct spelling, grammatical errors and punctuation in selected text.
High accuracy - Improved system prompt for maximum verification accuracy in all languages.
DeepSeek AI - Using advanced DeepSeek models for text processing.
Autocopy - The result is automatically copied to the clipboard
Tip: Get a paid API key on the DeepSeek platform to get started.
A detailed description of the add-on is available in the help documentation.

GigaChatSpellChecker.description:
The GigaChat SpellChecker add-on for NVDA provides powerful spelling, grammar and punctuation checking capabilities using GigaChat's advanced AI models.
Main features:
Spell Check - Automatically correct spelling, grammatical errors and punctuation in selected text.
High accuracy - Improved system prompt for maximum verification accuracy in all languages.
Auto Copy - The result is automatically copied to the clipboard.
For the add-on to work, you must obtain a personal API key.
The entire procedure for obtaining an API key is described in the reference manual.

CerenceTTSVoiceManager.description:
CerenceTTSVoiceManager add-on for managing voice packages of the Cerence TTS synthesizer in NVDA.
Voice Manager allows you to install, delete and manage Vocalizer voices in various languages.
The manager interface is available in the NVDA menu, Tools submenu, “Cerence TTS Voice Manager”.
Note: Vocalizer Expressive2 voices from CerenceTTS require a driver of the same name, CerenceTTS, or Vocalizer_expressive2_driver.
The functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.
For the add-on to work you need:
Internet connection to download voices.
VPN or Proxy if the voice developer server is not available in your country.

KingMouse.author: Nikita Kovalev <nikkov95@mail.ru>
KingMouse.description:
King Mouse is a new implementation of a talking mouse based on open source components.
The synthesis library was taken from the free version on a third-party site; developments from ruTTS were also used.
ChunkBefore and ChunkDelay parameters are available in the settings to eliminate cut speech fragments.
The CommaDelay and PointDelay parameters adjust punctuation pauses in milliseconds.
DecimalPoint allows you to specify the pronunciation of the decimal point in numbers, such as "and" or "dot".
The Change_speed_mode setting controls speed changes: only by the engine, only through Sonic or mixed mode.
The SingleCyr parameter is responsible for the phonetic reading of single letters B, V, K and S.
You can enable reading of abbreviations and use a custom dictionary from the kingmouse.dic file.
There are sections for setting the pronunciation of Unicode characters, replacing Latin letters with Russian ones, and voicing single Latin letters.
For convenience, a graphical configurator with tabs has been developed that allows you to edit the dictionary and settings without editing ini files.
Everything is described in as much detail as possible in the reference manual.
Note: This is a beta version, the synthesizer is under active development, so there may be various unexpected problems that are best reported to the developer.
Note: This is a beta version and the synthesizer is under active development, so various unexpected problems may arise, which are best reported to the developer.
How to do this, read the help.

ReminderApp.description:
This add-on is designed to manage reminders, appointments, anniversaries and birthdays in an original and intuitive way.

With ReminderApp, you will not only be able to create and organize your reminders, but you will also have access to an address book for your contacts.
NVDA+Shift+F1 - Stop the current signal.
NVDA+Shift+F2 - Open the ReminderApp GUI; if you press it twice, close it.
NVDA+Shift+F3 - Show a preview of reminders for the current day.

For more instructions, you can also click the Add-on Help button in the Add-on Manager.

wordNav.description:
The WordNav NVDA add-on improves the built-in word navigation and also adds additional word navigation commands with different definitions for that word.
Most text editors support the Control+Left Arrow and Right Arrow commands for word navigation. However, the definition of the word varies from one program to another. This is especially true for modern web-based text editors such as Monaco.
NVDA must know the definition of a word in a given program in order to pronounce the words correctly.
If NVDA does not know the exact definition, then words will either be skipped or spoken multiple times. Moreover, some web text editors place the cursor at the end of a word rather than at the beginning, making editing much more difficult for visually impaired users.
To combat this issue, improved word navigation commands have been created that take the word definition from Notepad++ and do not rely on the program's word definition, but parse the strings into words on the NVDA side.
The Control + Left Arrow / Right Arrow command is not even passed into the program, ensuring consistency of speech.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

Gemini Dictation.description:
GeminiDictation add-on for NVDA, which allows you to convert voice to text using artificial intelligence.
Supports Gemini providers from Google and Groq with a choice of different recognition models.
To work, you need an API key from the selected provider and an Internet connection.
Control is carried out using hot keys.
Recording starts and stops with one key combination.
The decrypted text is automatically inserted into the active window.
Instructions can be configured to improve recognition quality.
The add-on remembers the last text inserted and prevents repetitions.
Integrates into standard NVDA settings for easy configuration.
Suitable for quick notes, business correspondence and creative tasks.
Note: Integrated localization capability into the code.

ProgressReader.description:
The ProgressReader add-on for NVDA allows you to read progress indicators (progress bars) in various applications and voice the current progress through a speech synthesizer.
Discovery occurs through multiple interfaces to provide broad compatibility with a variety of software technologies.
Additionally, the add-on provides its own auto-refresh window with a read-only multi-line text field that automatically updates the progress display.
Usage:
Go to an application with an active progress bar (e.g. file transfer, loading bar, software installation).
Press NVDA + Shift + R to open the automatic update window.
When opened, the found progress bars are automatically remembered.
The window continuously displays progress in a multi-line text field.
Focus automatically moves to the first line on every refresh.
Pressing NVDA + Shift + R again will close the window.
Press NVDA + Shift + U to change the update interval (in seconds).
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Progress Bar Reader section.
Other features of the add-on are described in the help.

remotePlusPlus.description:
Remote PlusPlus is an extension for NVDA that significantly enhances the standard remote access capabilities of NVDA Remote, targeting increased productivity for power users.
The main innovation is a convenient Connection Manager that allows you to save, organize into groups and quickly connect to frequently used remote sessions.
You can instantly find the connection you need by name or host, connect in one click, or copy a link to it.
The addition introduces a unique function of instantly switching control mode (Swap Control Mode), which allows you to change roles without breaking the connection: start controlling another computer or transfer control to your own.
The ability to quickly connect to a pre-configured default server is also implemented.
All functions are accessible through keyboard shortcuts, menu items and context menus.
To ensure security, the add-on is automatically disabled on a secure Windows desktop.
