Remote PlusPlus requires NVDA 2025.1 or later with built-in Remote Access enabled.

ClipHistory.description:
ClipHistory provides the ultimate clipboard experience for NVDA.
This add-on is rock solid and has zero latency.
It is specially designed to replace the unstable Windows system with a lightweight and high-performance screen reader engine.
Forget about the inconsistent behavior of the standard clipboard history.
The Windows+V hotkey works as a command center.
• A single tap instantly opens the story.
• Double-clicking deletes all items except pinned items.
The add-on was created for those who value speed and reliability.

YTVideoDownloader.description:
YTVideoDownloader is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to download videos and playlists from YouTube in a convenient and accessible format.
The add-on includes a download queue, playlist support, and a status window to track progress.
Videos can be loaded directly from the clipboard using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+Y.
All dialog boxes are fully accessible and optimized for use with Narrator.
The add-on saves the library of downloaded videos between NVDA sessions.
The built-in player allows you to play, pause and rewind videos.
You can view downloaded playlists and read video descriptions.
The status window displays active downloads, playlist progress, completed tasks, and errors.
Keyboard shortcuts are available for all basic actions: adding a URL, opening a queue, opening a library, and opening a status window.
All keyboard shortcuts can be changed in NVDA's Input Gestures menu.
Videos are saved to the Downloads\NVDA_YTDownloader folder.
Manual addition of URLs via the download queue window is supported.
The add-on allows you to cancel downloads and clear the list of completed tasks.
Note: The add-on code does not support localization.

gestorDeEnlaces.description:
The GestorDeEnlaces add-on for NVDA allows you to efficiently manage web links by saving, opening, editing and deleting them using a simple and accessible interface.
It is enabled using the keyboard shortcut “Alt + NVDA + K”. Command (changes in input gestures), in the "Link Manager" category.
Added links open in your default browser.
More detailed information about all functions is described in the help.

Weather_Plus.description:
The WeatherPlus add-on adds the ability to quickly find out local temperature and a 24-hour forecast and a 2-day forecast.
NVDA+w for current weather.
NVDA+Shift+W for forecast for the next 24 hours and 2 days.
NVDA+Shift+w, pressed twice, provides an hourly forecast of weather conditions.
NVDA+shift+control+w for quickly entering a temporary city.
NVDA+Shift+Control+Alt+w to open Weather Plus settings.
NVDA+alt+w announces the date of the last weather report update.
Shift+Ctrl+w toggle between Fahrenheit, Celsius and Kelvin scale.
For more instructions, you can click the Help button in the Add-on Manager.

YoutubeChatClientForNVDA.description:
The YouTube Live Chat Client add-on for NVDA allows you to monitor and access chat during a YouTube live broadcast.
It reads chat messages, Super Chat donations, and real-time new member notifications.
The add-on interface includes a main window for connecting to a stream via URL, managing the flow of messages, and navigating through chat history.
Settings allow you to personalize your experience: specify an API key to access YouTube Data API v3, enable or disable timestamps, automatically read new messages, and automatically move focus.
The add-on helps blind and visually impaired users fully participate in the interactive life of streams, reacting in a timely manner to events in the chat.
To work, you need to create and configure an API key in Google Cloud Console.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the YouTube Live Chat Client category.

weatherReport.description:
Weather Report is an add-on for the NVDA screen reader.
It announces the current weather conditions for your location.
The open API Open-Meteo is used for work.
No API key is required to use.
The add-on supports searching for a location by name.
You don't need to enter coordinates manually.
You can save multiple locations.
Switching between them is done using a keyboard shortcut.
You can select additional information for your ad.
You can turn on the felt temperature.
Humidity information is added.
Wind speed is displayed in kilometers per hour.
You can display wind speed in meters per second.
The UV index is displayed.
Visibility information is available.
Sunrise and sunset times are announced.
All numbers are rounded to whole numbers.
All standard WMO weather codes are supported.
Control is carried out through convenient keyboard shortcuts.
The main command for getting the weather is NVDA+Shift+W.
To switch locations use NVDA+Shift+Control+L.
Settings are opened using NVDA+Shift+Control+W.
You must add a location before using it for the first time.
This can be done through the Tools menu or a keyboard shortcut.
The add-on will remind you to configure.
Note: In the original add-on, the possibility of localization was not implemented, so I added it myself. In the returned reports, a number of phrases are not localized; they are probably provided by the weather provider.
The settings item is located in the Service submenu.
The search for settlements accepts requests only in transliteration.

switchSynth.description:
The SwitchSynth add-on makes it easy to switch between synths.
To switch synths, press the key combination control+shift+NVDA+1 to control+shift+NVDA+6
To save the current synthesizer and its settings in the currently active slot, press control+shift+NVDA+v.

uTalk.description:
The uTalk add-on gives voice to your actions on the computer.
Instead of standard sounds, you hear custom voice messages in the selected language.
The add-on voices the commands “Copy”, “Paste”, “Cut”, “Save”, “Select All” and “Undo”.
It also reports file operations and the Copy as Path action.
You can instantly switch languages ​​by pressing NVDA+Alt+T.
Double-clicking opens the settings panel to change any phrases.
Your settings are saved automatically.
uTalk works in any application: from text editors to Windows Explorer.
Turn routine operations into a clear and lively dialogue with the system.
Combination of commands in input gestures:
NVDA+Alt+T: Switch language (single click) or open settings (double click).
Control+V: Paste.
Control+A: Select all.
Control+X: Cut.
Control+C: Copy.
Control+Shift+C: Copy path.
Control+Alt+C: Copy file.
Control+Z: Undo.
Control+Y: Repeat.
Control+Shift+Z: Repeat.
Control+S: Save.

KoruzBiz_MurText.description:
KoruzBizMurText is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to instantly transcribe audio and video files on your computer, as well as voice messages from WhatsApp into text.
The conversion is performed locally, without sending data to the Internet, which ensures complete confidentiality.
Works even in offline mode.
There are no restrictions on file size or duration.
With one hotkey (NVDA+Alt+Q) you can either transcribe a voice message in a chat, or quickly save other files (documents, archives) from the desktop version of WhatsApp to the default folder.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the "MurText" category for the "Launch MurText" shortcut.

weatherChecker.description:
Weather Checker is a highly accessible add-on for NVDA Screen Reader.
It provides up-to-date information on weather conditions.
You can find out the current temperature.
A forecast for several days ahead is available.
The add-on shows astronomical data.
Active weather warnings are displayed.
Two weather providers are supported: OpenWeather and Pirate Weather.
You can choose either one or use both at the same time.
When using both providers, average statistics are provided.
Automatic switching between providers is provided.
If one provider is unavailable, the add-on switches to a backup one.
You will always receive weather data.
Automatic location detection by IP address is supported.
You can manually search and save your favorite locations.
Weather history is available with the ability to compare with current conditions.
The add-on settings are easily accessible through the NVDA menu.
You can select temperature units.
Wind speed units are configured.
The units of atmospheric pressure are selected.
You can customize the visibility units.
You manage the list of weather parameters that are spoken.
Weather warning categories are configured.
Select how you are notified of alerts.
Control is carried out through convenient keyboard shortcuts.
They do not conflict with NVDA built-in commands.
The current weather is called up by pressing NVDA+Shift+W.
Weather forecast is available using NVDA+Shift+F.
Weather warnings are announced using NVDA+Shift+A.
Astronomical data is displayed using NVDA+Shift+S.
To switch favorite places, use NVDA+Shift+L.
Double-clicking any command copies the data to the clipboard.
Note: Weather providers require personal API keys.

GamepadSupport.description:
The GamepadSupport add-on adds support to NVDA for gamepads compatible with the XInput standard (for example, Xbox controllers and most modern PC gamepads).
It allows you to assign gamepad button presses to any NVDA commands or keyboard shortcuts through the standard “Input Gestures” dialog.
This opens up the possibility of controlling the computer with one hand using a game controller.
The add-on recognizes all the main elements of the gamepad: D-Pad, A/B/X/Y buttons, top LB/RB buttons, stick presses (L_Thumb, R_Thumb), Start/Back buttons, and also intelligently emulates LT/RT triggers as regular buttons with protection against accidental triggering.
All inputs are registered in NVDA as gestures.
For optimization, an active polling mode (100 Hz) is used when a gamepad is connected and an energy-efficient scanning mode (every 5 seconds) when it is not present.
Requires Windows 8 or later (or updated DirectX libraries) and a gamepad with XInput support.
After installation, connect the gamepad and configure the necessary assignments in the NVDA menu: Options -> Input Gestures.
Details in the help.

killProcess.description:
Kill Process is an add-on for NVDA that provides a keyboard shortcut to kill the process of the current window you are in.
To end the current window process, press: Windows + F4
(The keyboard shortcut changes from the KillProcess category in input gestures).

whisperVoiceInput.description:
The WhisperVoiceInput add-on adds local voice input using the Whisper model.
From the author:
The addition is voice input using the Whisper model.
The model is small, of very average quality. 
But it works.
In general, we install this add-on, go to input gestures, Assign our own keyboard shortcuts; by default, there are none.
Open any text editor. Let's launch the add-on. We speak with pauses for the correct placement of punctuation marks, we are not in a hurry, we speak clearly.
After you have spoken the desired text, do not rush to press the hot key combination again. We wait a few seconds and then send the text for processing.
I noticed this story: if you wait a few seconds without sending the text for processing, it is processed more correctly.
After we have sent the text for processing, the synthesizer will say in English that it is being processed.
The processing itself can take from 5 to 10 seconds. It all depends on your hardware.
The text will be inserted into the editor automatically and the synthesis will notify you about it. It will say inserted.
I don’t recommend saying a long text right away. It's better to do it according to suggestions.
I write this description without editing using this add-on.

vismaAdministration.description:
This VismaAdministration add-on for NVDA Screen Reader is designed to improve the availability of Visma Administration (2000/1000/500/200), Visma Fakturering and Visma Förening family applications version 2020.0 and higher.
It improves work with custom grids that are used as lists and editable lists, expanding the set of UIA properties for correct reading by the screen reader.
The add-on provides labels for text fields, combo boxes, and other interface controls. Functionality includes:
Speak keyboard shortcuts for the current view.
Automatic pronunciation of the number of lines in lists.
Reading a selection in a list.
Pronunciation of the position of the current cell.
Copies control information to the clipboard.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the Visma Administration category.

accessibleDiscord.description:
The Accessible Discord add-on is designed to make it easy to track events in Discord using NVDA Narrator.
It automatically announces actions in voice channels.
You will hear when participants join or leave the channel.
The add-on notifies you when other users' microphones are turned on or off.
It also announces how to mute and unmute the sound in the headphones.
New text messages in the current channel are read instantly.
The audio language automatically matches the language of the Discord client.
You can enable Background Only mode so that notifications only sound when Discord is not in focus.
Full customization of notification texts using simple codes is available.
The %u code is replaced with the user name, %c with the channel name, %m with the message text.
You can create your own templates for connection, disconnection and other events.
The add-on requires BetterDiscord to be installed.
In the add-on settings there is a button to automatically install BetterDiscord.
The installer loads with a progress bar and time remaining displayed.
Once installed, the add-on automatically copies the supporting plugin to the BetterDiscord folder.
All you have to do is enable the plugin in your Discord settings.
The add-on greatly simplifies the use of Discord for blind and visually impaired users.
All notifications are customized to suit your preferences and communication style.

TextMarksTheSpot.description:
The Text Marks the Spot add-on automatically moves the cursor to the beginning of the main content of a web page when it loads.
Sighted users instantly find the material they need, ignoring menus and banners.
Screen reader users have always been forced to go through all of these elements one at a time.
This add-on does the job for you without a single keystroke.
After the page loads, the cursor is positioned on the first meaningful paragraph, and NVDA reads it.
You can start reading right away without wasting time navigating through unimportant elements.
The add-on determines the page type and selects the optimal position for the cursor.
For articles this is the first paragraph, for lists it is the first heading, for forms it is the first input field.
If the add-on is not sure of the purpose of the page, it remains dormant.
A wrong guess is worse than no guess.
The add-on works completely locally without network requests and data collection.
Three additional keyboard commands are provided for manual control.
The Z key in review mode moves to the next semantic paragraph.
Shift+Z takes you back to your starting position on the current page.
The NVDA+Z command allows you to add or remove a site from the exclusion list.
You can disable the add-on on sites where you do not need it.
On excluded sites, one-time detection is available by pressing Z twice.
Text Marks the Spot is a simple and effective solution for quickly accessing web page content.

AccessifyPlay.description:
Accessify Play is a powerful add-on for NVDA that turns Narrator into a complete command center for managing Spotify.
You can control playback on any active Spotify Connect device directly from your keyboard.
The add-on allows you to play, pause and switch tracks without opening the Spotify app.
You can adjust the volume with percentage precision and rewind within a track.
Instant voiceover of information about the current track, artist and album is available.
You can copy links to tracks and share them with friends.
The search function allows you to find tracks, albums, artists, playlists and podcasts.
Manage your library: save tracks to your favorites, create and edit playlists.
Add tracks to your queue and view a list of upcoming tracks.
The add-on supports display and automatic reading of song lyrics in real time.
Control is carried out through the command layer, activated by pressing NVDA + G.
All keyboard shortcuts can be customized to suit your preferences.
The add-on requires an active Spotify Premium subscription to work.
You need to create an application in the Spotify Developer Panel and provide a Client ID.
Accessify Play makes using Spotify as convenient as possible for blind users.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

accessibleBluetoothAudioReceiver.description:
The Accessible Bluetooth Audio Receiver add-on for NVDA greatly simplifies the use of the application of the same name from the Microsoft Store, which allows you to stream audio from Bluetooth devices (for example, smartphones) to PC speakers.
It makes the application interface fully accessible from screen access.
Using a hotkey you can instantly launch or activate a program window.
The main function is automatic connection management: just select a device in the list and press Enter to connect or disconnect - the add-on itself will find and press the desired button in the interface.
All actions are accompanied by voice explanations about the status of devices and the results of operations.
This eliminates the need for NVDA users to visually search for elements in a non-standard UWP app interface.
The functionality is described in more detail in the help; there is also a link to the application in the Windows store.

AddonsList.description:
The AddonsList add-on provides quick access to lists of installed NVDA add-ons.
• Copy to the clipboard or view in a dialog box lists of enabled, disabled, compatible and incompatible add-ons.
• Displays general statistics: total number of add-ons, active, inactive, compatible and incompatible.
• A single press of the hotkey copies information to the buffer, a double press opens a dialog.
• All functions are available in the “Tools” category for conveniently assigning your own keyboard shortcuts.
The add-on is described in detail in the help.

virtualNotesForNVDA.description:
Virtual Notes For NVDA Add-on “Virtual Notes for NVDA” allows you to create and store text and voice notes directly in the NVDA Narrator environment.
All notes are saved automatically and remain available after restarting the program.
You can add the selected text to a new note or enter it manually through a special dialog.
A separate command is provided to quickly add the contents of the clipboard.
Notes can be navigated using simple keyboard shortcuts.
You can move between notes, change their order, and delete or replace the current entry.
Text notes support line-by-line navigation, which is convenient when working with large amounts of information.
Voice notes are recorded in high quality and can be played back at any time.
Pause and resume function is available during recording or playback.
The add-on allows you to paste the contents of the current note or a single line into any application.
After completing each action, a sound signal is played for feedback.
Managing notes is intuitive and doesn't require a lot of learning.
This add-on will be a useful tool for quickly taking notes and working with information.

accessibleKBBI.description:
Accessible KBBI is an add-on for NVDA screen reader that allows you to quickly and easily look up word definitions in the Big Indonesian Dictionary (KBBI).
It directly accesses the online dictionary database via a third-party API and presents the results in a fully accessible dialog box.
Key features include: quick word search with display of grammar marks, pronunciation and examples; viewing the word of the day and a random word to expand your vocabulary; Instant search for selected text in any application; maintaining a history of the last 50 requests; saving important words to favorites; copying the full definition to the clipboard.
Control is carried out through keyboard shortcuts (by default NVDA+Alt+K to open the main window and NVDA+Shift+Alt+K to search for selected text).
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures.
The add-on requires an active Internet connection.

CMDReader.description:
The CMDReader add-on adds command line availability in a new format.
Hotkeys:
CTRL+ALT+L : Open CMDReader log file.
CTRL+ALT+up arrow: Read the previous line.
CTRL+ALT+down arrow: Read next line.
All features of the add-on are described in the help.

ClipboardContentEditor.description:
The Clipboard Content Editor add-on allows you to edit the current text on the clipboard before pasting it elsewhere.
• It also acts as a powerful clipboard manager with unlimited history.
• You can enable append mode which automatically adds new copies to the existing clipboard without replacing it.
• The add-on shows detailed information about the text (word characters, lines, paragraphs) and can read out the entire contents of the clipboard.
• You can save the contents of the clipboard directly to a text file.
• To activate the command layer of the add-on, use the combination Ctrl+Alt+C.
• In the command layer, press E to open the editor F1 for a list of commands or full documentation A to enable append mode R to restore a backup copy of the editor I to speak information S to speak content and H to open the history manager.
• The editor has the tools “Find”, “Replace”, “Change Case” and “Text Cleaning” (removing spaces from empty lines and HTML formatting).
• History Manager allows you to restore, edit, delete and clear all clipboard items.
• In the add-on settings, you can select the language, turn on the sound, configure the protection mode with backup, the number of backup levels and the history limit (from 10 to 100 items or without restrictions).

clipboardAnnouncer.description:
Clipboard Announcer is an add-on for NVDA that announces standard editing and clipboard actions.
It is designed for users who want quick voice feedback for copying, cutting, pasting, highlighting all, undoing and redoing.
The addition does not change the normal behavior of these keyboard shortcuts.
You can optionally enable smart feedback for Copy, Cut, and Paste.
It recognizes the contents of the clipboard, announces the number of files, and warns when the clipboard is empty.
There are useful additional commands.
For example, adding new text to an existing one on the clipboard or copying the full path to a selected file or folder.
You can temporarily turn off voice acting with a special combination if feedback is not needed.
A quick command to clear the clipboard with confirmation is also available.
A separate panel appears in NVDA settings where you can choose which actions to declare.
• Announcement mode: always or smart (no repetitions).
• You can enable or disable the ad for each action individually.
• There are settings for clearing the clipboard with a confirmation request and a voice report.
• The add-on will report an error if it cannot access the clipboard.

consoleLog.description:
The ConsoleLog add-on for NVDA displays the contents of Windows consoles in a convenient dialog box.
• It supports CMD, PowerShell, Windows Terminal, Git Bash, WSL and Visual Studio developer.
• You can assign gestures to quickly open the console viewer and launcher.
• The viewer allows you to copy text, search by content and jump to the desired line.
• Auto-Tail mode is available with a customizable update interval.
• The built-in launcher opens any console directly in the current Explorer folder.
• The plugin system includes tools for developers: JSON and SQL formatting, Base64 and JWT decoding, data extraction, log filtering and resource monitoring.
• Google AI (Gemini) helps analyze errors, generate reports, and answer questions about console content.
• You can customize the font, alert sounds, tracking keywords and manage plugins.
All features of the add-on are described in detail in the reference manual.

CaptchaSolver.description:
The Captcha Solver add-on is an add-on for the NVDA screen reader that provides a convenient way to recognize graphical captchas using the paid service “rucaptcha.com”.
You can read more about the features of the add-on in the help.

ytdlpDownloader.description:
The YtDlpDownloader add-on allows you to download video and audio using the yt-dlp program.
Open the bootloader window through the Tools menu or with the combination NVDA+Shift+Y.
Paste the video link and select the download type: video or audio.
Set the file format from the drop-down lists.
For audio, you can add metadata and embed cover art.
Specify the folder to save using the Select Folder button.
Click "Start Download" to start the process.
All messages are displayed in the log area in real time.
Use the "Update yt-dlp" button to get the latest version of the program.
If you close the window during loading, you will be asked for confirmation.
To work, the files yt-dlp.exe, ffmpeg.exe and deno.exe are required in the add-ons folder.

TypeTalkAI.description:
TypeTalk AI is an intelligent voice input assistant for NVDA.
It uses Google Speech Services and artificial intelligence for highly accurate speech recognition.
The add-on can automatically correct grammar and place punctuation marks.
You can change your writing style with one click: formal, informal, condensed or bulleted list.
TypeTalk AI helps you respond in chats: set the context and it will generate a smart response.
Real-time text translation into English and other languages ​​is supported.
A custom dictionary works to replace voice commands with the desired phrases or symbols.
You can add contextual emoji automatically.
Restoring the last processed text is available.
All commands are executed through the command layer after pressing NVDA+Shift+Space.
The S key controls dictation.
R clarifies or translates selected text.
C sets the context for the smart response.
G generates a response.
A enables or disables AI processing.
T controls the translation.
E adds emoji.
I changes the input language.
L selects the target language for translation.
M switches AI model.
W changes the writing style.
Q shows the current settings.
B restores the last text.
D displays information about the developer.
H opens help.

geminiLive.description:
Gemini Live for NVDA is a real-time AI voice communication add-on.
It uses advanced Google Gemini models for natural, hands-free conversations.
You can talk to the AI ​​and hear its responses in ultra-low latency voice.
The add-on supports 30 expressive voices of different styles and tones.
If necessary, you can type messages by text instead of voice.
Rotation of multiple API keys is available for reliability and bypassing restrictions.
You can define system instructions that define the nature and role of the AI.
Adjustable temperature allows you to control the creativity of your answers.
Built-in support for Google search to get up-to-date information.
It is possible to run Python code safely in an isolated environment.
The microphone can be turned off and on directly during a conversation.
The session remains active until you end it.
Audio signals confirm connection and disconnection.
Two AI models are supported: fast and high quality.
You can start a conversation directly from anywhere with the combination NVDA+S.
All settings are saved locally and remain in effect when NVDA is restarted.
Conversation history is not saved for your privacy.
The add-on requires a valid Google Gemini API key to work.
Keys can be obtained from Google AI Studio or Google Cloud Console.
The add-on is fully integrated into NVDA through the Tools menu.

ru_tts.description:
The RuTTS add-on is a Russian-language speech synthesizer for the NVDA screen reader, created on the basis of the free Ru_tts voice engine.
The ru_tts engine is an alternative implementation of the Phonemafon-5 software speech synthesizer from the early 1990s, and is characterized by compactness, high response speed and increased speech clarity.
The presented version supports X64 and x86 bit NVDA.

supertonic3.description:
Neural speech synthesizer Supertonic-3.
Supertonic is a speech synthesis system (Text-to-Speech, TTS) developed by the Korean company Supertone Inc.
Supported languages:
English, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Estonian, Finnish, French, Hindi, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.
Supported voices: five female from F1 to F5 and five male from M1 to M5.
Also added to the current model are two user voices called Angry_man and Ironic_man found on 4pda.ru.
Voice models require high computing resources.
The driver only works on 64-bit NVDA.

enhancedObjectNavigation.description:
The EnhancedObjectNavigation add-on allows you to use single-letter navigation in any software and search for objects by name.
The add-on documentation describes in detail the following points:
Navigation mode.
Basic navigation mode commands.
Advanced navigation.
Single letter navigation.
Search list.
Improved touch input support.
The settings items are also described.

objBoundaryFeedback.description:
The ObjectBoundaryFeedback add-on plays short beeps when standard NVDA navigation commands reach boundaries.
By default, the add-on replaces NVDA's standard boundary messages with the current element and a short sound.
For quick navigation in view mode, the add-on retains the standard NVDA message and adds sound.
In NVDA settings you can change the feedback mode for different types of boundaries.
Supports moving the viewing cursor across lines, pages, words and characters when reaching boundaries.
• Navigate through objects when there is no next, previous or containing object.
• Switching the review mode when there is no next or previous mode.
• Navigation with single letters in view mode when there is no element.
• Move beyond the end of the container in view mode.
• Paragraph navigation when there is no next or previous paragraph.
• Moving the virtual cursor in viewing mode if it is impossible to cross the border.
• Move the cursor in the edited text if it is impossible to cross the border.
In the settings, you can select one of the modes: “Default NVDA”, “Current element”, “Current element and sound”, “Default NVDA and sound” or “Sound only”.
The add-on does not cover regular lists, combo boxes, and tree views.

objLocTones.description:
The ObjectLocationTones add-on plays sounds to help you locate objects on the screen while navigating.
By pressing Ctrl+NumpadDelete you can enable or disable automatic alarms.
The padding reports the position of the focused object and cursor in text fields.
The NumpadDelete gesture explicitly tells the location of the current object.
The Windows+NumpadDelete gesture reports the position of the mouse cursor.
Continuous mouse tracking is available with a customizable anchor point by pressing Shift+NumpadDelete.
You can enable the outline of each window to automatically play when it is activated.
Cyclic switching of cursor reporting modes is available.
In the settings you can adjust the duration of signals and the volume of channels.
Supports signal generation via MIDI with instrument selection.
All settings are saved and restored upon startup.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

pdfReaderForNvda.description:
PDF Reader turns NVDA into a complete desktop environment for reading and managing PDF documents.
The add-on opens standard PDF files, including password-protected ones.
There are five text extraction modes available: Blocks, Text, Words, HTML and Structured.
Extraction profiles are supported for filtering and formatting text.
Built-in optical character recognition based on Tesseract for working with scanned pages.
• Implemented speech synthesis via Microsoft Edge TTS with neural network voices.
• Creation of audiobooks in MP3 format is available.
• There is an advanced search with support for regular expressions and text replacement.
• You can create bookmarks, notes and annotations.
• Navigation through the document table of contents is supported.
• Export to TXT, DOCX, HTML, JSON, CSV and MP3 formats is possible.
Document manipulation tools are available: page rotation, deletion, range extraction, PDF merging, splitting into separate pages, image extraction and adding watermarks.
Implemented PDF password protection with AES-256 encryption.
Visual settings available: high contrast, invert colors, dark mode and separate page viewing.
The add-on saves your reading progress and restores it the next time you open it.
All hotkeys can be configured in NVDA input gestures.

audioVolumeControl.description:
The Audio Volume Control add-on for NVDA allows you to control the audio volume of individual applications directly using the keyboard.
You can quickly open the dialog (Ctrl+NVDA+Y), view a list of all active programs that play sound, and for each of them separately adjust the volume using the slider, turn the sound on or off, without affecting the overall system volume level.
There's also a convenient reset button that returns all apps to 100% volume and unmutes the sound.
The add-on's interface is fully keyboard-navigable and optimized for screen readers, including automatic focus on the last-used app.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the "Control application volume" category.

winFormsDesignerAccessibilizer.description:
WinFormsDesignerAccessibilizer add-on for NVDA that improves the accessibility of WinForms Designer in Visual Studio 2022 by automatically speaking selected components during navigation.
Main functions:
Automatic sounding of the currently selected component when: Transitioning between components (Tab/Shift+Tab), Navigating with arrows, Pressing Escape.
Explicit request (via hotkey - NVDA+J).
Track changes in the Components dropdown list.
The add-on makes the WinForms form design process accessible to blind developers.
Allows you to quickly identify the currently selected component.
Especially useful when working with complex shapes.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in Input Gestures, under the "Improve WinForms Designer Accessibility" category for the "Speaks the current element in the Property Editor" shortcut.

engelsiz_mail.description:
Engelsiz Mail is an add-on for NVDA Narrator.
It allows Gmail users to perform basic email actions through a simple and accessible interface.
• View incoming messages.
• Reading and sending letters.
• Reply and forward messages.
• Saving attached files.
• Marking, archiving and deleting emails.
The add-on only works from your computer to Google servers and does not transfer data to third parties.
A Google app password is required to connect.
Keyboard shortcut to open: Ctrl + Shift + M.
Keys for navigation and actions are available in the main window.
The letter is opened by pressing Enter.
The add-on supports the Inbox, Sent Items, Drafts, Trash, Spam and All Emails folders.
Archiving and deleting messages are accompanied by prompts.
Engelsiz Mail is designed for everyday tasks without the complexity of a web interface.
The add-on is independent of Google and is intended for the convenience of NVDA users.
Note: The add-on interface is in Turkish, the developer has not implemented the possibility of localization.

getem.description:
GETEM Electronic Library is an add-on for NVDA Narrator.
It helps blind users quickly find books in the GETEM electronic catalog of Istanbul Bogazici University.
• Search by title of the work.
• Search by author and reader.
• Search by topic, publisher and genre.
• Search by book format and language.
• Search by source institution and page number.
• View detailed information about the found book.
• Copy book information to the clipboard.
• Add books to favorites for quick access.
• Opening a book page on the GETEM website in a browser.
To launch the add-on, use Control + Shift + G.
The add-on can be opened through the NVDA menu: Tools, GETEM Electronic Library.
Favorites are only stored locally on your computer and are not shared with anyone.
There is no direct listening or downloading of files through the add-on.
The user is redirected to the book's official page on the GETEM website.
This is done out of respect for the work of GETEM and respect for copyright.
Note: The add-on interface is in Turkish, the developer has not implemented the possibility of localization.

elevenlabsForNVDA.description:
The ElevenLabsForNVDA add-on for NVDA allows you to convert any text into high-quality audio files (MP3 or WAV) using speech synthesis from ElevenLabs.
It does not replace the standard NVDA synthesizer, but works as a separate tool for creating files.
It requires an API key from ElevenLabs, which can be obtained for free on their website with a limited number of characters.
In the settings you can select the synthesis model, voice, adjust the speed, tone and volume.
The conversion runs in the background with a progress bar.
The finished file is saved to the specified folder, and NVDA announces the path to it.
The add-on includes managing API profiles, checking remaining credits, and has convenient hotkeys for quick access to basic functions.
The functionality of the add-on is described in more detail in the help.

kurum_rehberi.description:
Organization Directory is a convenient add-on for NVDA Narrator.
It helps you save and quickly find contact information for your organization's employees.
• Storing the employee's first name, last name and position.
• Storage of department and telephone number.
• Storing extension number and email address.
• Storing additional notes about the employee.
• Creating new entries and editing existing ones.
• Removing entries from the directory.
• Quick search across all visible fields.
• Copying employee information to the clipboard.
• Export all recordings to a backup file.
• Import records from a previously created backup.
To open the add-on, use the combination NVDA+Shift+R.
All entries are automatically sorted by first and last name.
Unnecessary fields can be disabled in the settings.
The add-on can be used as a telephone or postal directory.
All data is stored only locally on your computer.
The add-on does not connect to the Internet and does not collect personal data.
Note: The add-on interface is in Turkish, the developer has not implemented the possibility of localization.

suno.description:
The Suno AI Prompt Generator is an add-on for NVDA that creates ready-made English music prompts for the Suno AI platform.
• Selecting a musical genre and subgenre.
• Selection of Turkish music style and maqam.
• Setting the pace and emotional mood.
• Choosing the type of harmony and song structure.
• Select rhythm and bass line.
• Selection of melodic and accompanying instruments.
• Set up vocal type, style, timbre and effects.
• Choosing a mixing and production style.
To open the add-on, use the combination NVDA + Alt + P.
The following hotkeys are available in the add-on window: Alt+P to create a prompt, Alt+O to copy and Alt+S to reset.
All selected options are processed locally on your computer.
The add-on does not collect personal data and does not transfer it to third parties.
The created prompt can be copied to the clipboard and pasted into Suno AI.
Note: The add-on interface is in Turkish, the developer has not implemented the possibility of localization.

engelsiz_nota.description:
Engelsiz Nota is an add-on for NVDA Narrator.
It helps blind musicians and students quickly find sheet music in the Engelsiz Nota electronic library.
• Search by title of the work.
• Search by composer and source institution.
• Search by piece type and instrument type.
• View detailed information about the found work.
• Copy information about the work to the clipboard.
• Add works to favorites for quick access.
• Opening the work page in the browser.
To open the search window, use the combination Control + Shift + E.
In the work details window, you can go to the Engelsiz Nota website with one click.
Favorites are stored only on your computer and are not transferred anywhere.
Engelsiz Nota does not download sheet music files directly.
It redirects the user to the official page of the work.
All downloads occur in accordance with the rules of the Engelsiz Nota platform.
The addition was created with respect for the copyrights and work of the creators of the archive.
Note: The add-on interface is in Turkish, the developer has not implemented the possibility of localization.

BlueToothBatteryReport.description:
The BlueToothBatteryReport add-on allows you to monitor the battery level of local Bluetooth devices.
• It supports reporting for multiple devices at once.
• The add-on sequentially announces all Bluetooth devices whose charge level can be determined.
• Devices are announced in the following order: first connected, then with unknown status, and finally disconnected.
• If the battery charge cannot be determined, you will receive an appropriate error message or information about data unavailability.
• To activate the report, use the hotkey NVDA+Control+Shift+B.
• Each device is declared in the format “device name charge xx percent”.
• In the add-on settings, you can enable the “Report only connected devices” mode to exclude disconnected and inaccessible devices from the report.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the Bluetooth Charge Report category.

TiendaNVDA.description:
Single add-on store for NVDA.
TiendaNVDA add-on - integrates the NVDA.ES store and the official NV Access store into a single interface.
Features: status indicators, local management (disable/delete), backup/restore,
offline mode, translation with caching, download retries, dependency checking
and an add-on packer.
All features of the add-on are described in a detailed reference manual.

PUREtts.description:
PURE TTS is an add-on for speech routing in NVDA.
It sends all NVDA speech output over the local Wi-Fi network to the connected device.
Your phone or tablet reads text using its built-in speech synthesizer.
When you start NVDA, the add-on automatically starts the network bridge and local web server.
You open the control panel in the browser on your phone, enter your credentials and the device becomes the voice of NVDA.
Every word is transmitted to the phone in real time.
By default, audio is played through the phone's speaker.
The web control panel supports English Arabic Spanish French Russian Ukrainian and Tatar languages.
Detailed instructions for use are described in the help.

mouseEnhancement.description:
The MouseEnhancement add-on contains improvements for working with the mouse in NVDA.
Features:
Fixed mouse tracking in Electron applications (versions 2024.4 and later only).
Electron applications such as Visual Studio Code.
Experimental fix for mouse tracking in WinUI applications.
WinUI applications: for example, Windows Terminal, PowerToys version 0.86.0 and higher, some applications included with Windows, etc.
Automatically update the mouse object.
Windows Terminal: If the text block is a paragraph, moving the mouse in the Terminal control limits the text block to lines.
Fixed a part of the NVIDIA Control Panel where the content of the static text description control was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where some buttons in PDFgear were unable to receive description text.
Mouse tracking may report an option description in the Git for Windows installer. (Individual options cannot be viewed individually.)

VolumePower.description:
The VolumePower add-on for NVDA provides convenient control of speech volume and computer power functions from the keyboard.
With it, you can quickly adjust the NVDA volume level in 5% increments using the combinations NVDA+Shift+PageUp (increase) and NVDA+Shift+PageDown (decrease), while the synthesizer announces the current value.
The following hotkeys are available for power management: Alt+Windows+R to reboot and Alt+Windows+S to shut down the system.
Before performing these operations, the add-on plays a sound confirmation and gives a three-second delay, during which the action can be canceled using standard system tools (for example, Ctrl+Alt+Del).
All volume settings are saved between NVDA sessions.
This solution is ideal for users who need quick access to basic system functions without using a mouse or diving deep into settings.

withSounds.description:
WithSounds is a simple add-on for NVDA that enhances your experience with audio baffles.
It replaces NVDA voice messages for web links with short, distinctive sounds.
Instead of saying the word “link”, you hear a pleasant beep.
This is especially useful on pages with a lot of links.
• A separate bay window is displayed for visited links.
• In this case, the voice message about the “visited” status is suppressed.
The add-on is a simple alternative to the more functional add-on “Earcons and speech rules” from Tony.
WithSounds should not be installed together with Tony's "Earcons and speech rules" add-on to avoid conflicts.
Note: The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts; it starts working immediately after installation or activation.

smartVisionary.description:
Smart Visionary is an add-on for NVDA with powerful artificial intelligence capabilities.
• It supports dictation, clipboard rewriting, summarization, translation and description of screen and images.
• The functionality also includes OCR processing PDF decoding media speech synthesis export results backup settings and chat with AI.
• By default, additional key combinations are not assigned; all functions are available through the NVDA → Tools → Smart Visionary menu.
• Resource-intensive tasks run in the background one at a time, keeping NVDA responsive.
• You can manage writing styles separately from language and dialect and create your own custom styles.
• For speech synthesis, a separate dialogue is provided with settings for the voice engine of the language of emotions and the tempo of lip synchronization.
• Tools for PDF include converting audio and images to TXT Word as well as combining, separating, encrypting and decrypting files.
• Text recognition is available on individual images and in batch mode.
• Character manager allows you to create virtual characters with unique tips for communicating with AI.
• Cloud services require an API key to operate, while local Ollama models work without a key when the environment is installed.
Note: The add-on interface is in Arabic. The developer did not implement the localization feature.

klawiszeschowka.description:
The KlawiszeSchowka add-on adds a function to declare the following clipboard commands.
When you press the keyboard shortcuts Control+X, Control+C, Control+V, the NVDA program announces in speech, respectively: cut, copied, pasted.
And when you press the Control+Z, Control+A, Control+S keys, it announces: cancelled, selected everything and saved.

SileroTTS.description:
Open source SileroTTS driver for standalone speech synthesizer.
Models can be installed as separate add-ons.
The model used by the engine can be selected from the NVDA → Tools → Silero TTS Settings menu.
In the synthesizer selection dialog it is called “Silero TTS”.
Voice models require average computing resources.
The driver only works on 64-bit NVDA, starting with NVDA 2026.1.
Voice models “SileroTTS-model” in the form of add-ons can be downloaded to RuStore.
Only version 2.0 models are compatible with this driver version.
Some useful information is collected in the add-on help.

muslimku.description:
The Muslimku add-on announces prayer times according to the Islamic schedule.
Fajr Zuhr Asr Maghrib Isha as well as Imsak of the Spirit rising and setting are supported.
You can declare the next prayer Hijri and Gregorian date or Qibla direction.
Settings include selecting the country, city, method of calculating the madhhab and language.
Built-in automatic prayer reminders with the ability to set an offset in minutes.
When you double-click the hotkey, the result is copied to the clipboard.
Qibla determination is performed through the OpenStreetMap geocoder.
Provinces and districts are available for Indonesian regions.
All hotkeys can be reassigned in NVDA input gestures.
Note: The add-on does not include the ability to localize the interface; in the original, the interface is in English.

winWizard.description:
The WinWizard add-on allows you to perform various operations on the active window or its associated process.
When the process completes successfully or the window is shown or hidden, a confirmation tone is played.
If desired, these signals can be disabled in the add-on settings.
The following options are available:
• Hiding the current window in one of ten slots with the ability to display it later.
• Switch between stacks of hidden windows.
• List all hidden windows for selective restoration.
• Termination of the process associated with the active window.
• Changing the process priority of the active window from “Normal” to “Real-time”.
• Switch between top-level windows of the current application.
• Confirmation of the selected window when switching with the ability to select the old behavior mode.
• Changing the title of the active window.
All keyboard commands can be reassigned through the NVDA input gesture dialog.

advancedTranslator.description:
Advanced Translator is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to instantly translate any text without interrupting the screen reader.
• The add-on supports Google Translate, Microsoft Translate, DeepL Translate and Yandex Translate without the need for API keys or payment.
• You can translate text under NVDA focus, the contents of the clipboard, or the last spoken phrase.
• Pressing the key twice opens a comparative translation dialog, where the text is sent to all engines simultaneously to select the best result.
• Simultaneous (real-time) translation mode automatically translates the text whenever focus changes.
• Thanks to the translation cache, already translated phrases are not sent to the server again, which speeds up work and saves traffic.
• The manual translation window allows you to enter any text, select the source and target languages, as well as the engine yourself.
• All settings are controlled through the NVDA panel: selection of the default engine, source and target language, as well as options for dubbing the original and automatically copying to the clipboard.
• The add-on does not assign keys by default, to avoid conflicts, you can configure them in the “Input Gestures” section.

WinTeleport.description:
The WinTeleport add-on for NVDA makes it easy to control Windows virtual desktops from the keyboard.
With it, you can instantly move the active window between desktops using convenient keyboard shortcuts.
Move windows left or right, switch to a specific desktop by number (1 to 9), or simply get a voice alert about your current location.
You can configure whether to switch to the target desktop after the window or stay on the current one.
The add-on is ideal for organizing your workspace and multitasking, saving time on dragging windows with the mouse.
Compatible with Windows 10/11.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “WinTeleport” category.

speechHistory.description:
The SpeechHistory add-on allows you to view the last 100 lines spoken by NVDA by default using Shift+F11 and Shift+F12.
Additionally, you can copy any spoken item to the clipboard by pressing F12.
The add-on can also record NVDA speech.
Keyboard shortcut:
F12: Copies the selected speech history item to the clipboard, which will default to the last spoken text in NVDA.
Shift+F11: View the previous item in the NVDA speech history.
Shift+F12: View the next item in the NVDA speech history.
NVDA+Shift+F11: Start NVDA voice output recording to copy multiple announcements to the clipboard.
NVDA+Shift+F12: Stop recording NVDA speech output and copy the recorded announcements to the clipboard.
You can change keyboard shortcuts in input gestures, in the “Speech” category.

TrainingLine.description:
TrainingLine is a simple add-on for practicing pronunciation and calculations.
Enter text and press Enter to listen to the entered text.
Perform simple arithmetic operations (Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) - the result can be spoken, copied to the clipboard or pasted into a string.
The Delete or Backspace keys delete entered characters, and Shift+Delete will clear the entire line.
Configure the type of notifications and actions in NVDA settings.
Keyboard shortcut:
To add a keyboard shortcut, go to input gestures, in the “Training Line” category, “Open training line” shortcut.
All functions of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

TranslateAdvanced.description:
TranslateAdvanced is an add-on that allows you to translate texts using various online translation services such as Google Translate, DeepL, LibreTranslate, Microsoft Translator and OpenAI GPT4o-mini.
The add-on offers advanced features such as: simultaneous translation, translation of selected text, translation of text from an object, translation of the last spoken text, history and API key management. It's easy to set up and use with hotkeys or virtual keyboard and customizable options in the NVDA menu.
All functionality and features of the add-on are described in a detailed manual.
An Internet connection is required for the add-on to work.

enDashBash.description:
The En Dash Bash add-on adds input gestures (NVDA commands) for quickly entering en dash (–) and em dash (—).
En dashes are used to connect symmetrical elements, such as two ends of a range of numbers or dates: to contrast meanings or illustrate relationships between two things (e.g., the Mexican-American War): to combine attributes where one of the related elements is itself complex (e.g., New York-style pizza): and, when there is a space, to separate introductory expressions—like this—in the middle of sentences.
In some languages, em dashes are sometimes used to indicate a speaker change in quoted dialogue.
Non-breaking em dashes are used similarly to breaking en dashes to separate introductory expressions.
By default, NVDA+- (hyphen) enters an em dash, and NVDA+Shift+- (hyphen) enters an em dash.
These commands can be changed in the Input Gestures dialog box under the "En Dash and Em Dash Input" category.

capitalSelectionIndicator.description:
The CapitalSelectionIndicator add-on adds audio for capital letter indicators when text is selected.
When you select characters using Shift+Arrow, NVDA will use the same audio and speech cues as during normal navigation: say "caps", change the tone, or beep for capital letters.
This ensures feedback consistency.
Settings are automatically taken from the Speech section of NVDA Settings - no separate configuration required.
The add-on implements the functionality requested in issues #4874 and #12996 of the official NVDA repository.

markdownForever.description:
The MarkdownForever add-on makes it easy to convert Markdown and HTML content directly into NVDA.
Simply write or display any text in Markdown or HTML and press the keyboard shortcut for instant conversion.
The result can be viewed in the default browser or in the NVDA virtual buffer.
The add-on supports several conversion directions.
• Convert Markdown to HTML.
• Convert Markdown to HTML source code.
• Convert HTML to Markdown.
• Convert Markdown to rich HTML.
Interactive mode provides a convenient dialog box with all functions in one place.
In it you can configure the creation of a table of contents, automatic numbering of headings and the use of extended tags.
Advanced tags allow you to automatically insert the current date, time or table of contents at a specified location in the document.
The metadata block at the beginning of the document makes it possible to set the author, title, subtitle, language, keywords and other parameters, regardless of the main settings.
You can configure automatic or manual update checking.
You can choose a conversion engine between HTML2Text and HTML2Markdown.
Markdown extensions such as tables, task lists, footnotes, and heading identifiers are supported.
It is possible to save the result to a file with a choice of location and name.
The built-in HTTP server allows you to publish generated HTML documents on the local network.
HTML template management allows you to customize the visual design using CSS.
All core add-on commands use NVDA Alt Ctrl and Shift key combinations.
To call the interactive mode, use the combination NVDA+Ctrl+I.
The add-on will be useful to anyone who often works with Markdown or HTML markup in the process of creating web content.

leanCalendar.description:
leanCalendar is an add-on for NVDA that quickly reports information about the Chinese lunar calendar, solar terms, and Gregorian date and time.
The add-on also provides a dialog to request information about other dates.
• The NVDA+F11 command reports the Chinese lunar date, lunar month size, current shichen (two-hour period) and sexagesimal cycle.
• The current solar term day, hou period and lunar holiday (if any) are also reported.
• If available, the countdown to the next solar term is shown only if there are no more than seven days left until it.
• Double pressing NVDA+F11 reports the nearest solar terms, countdown to the next term and the Chinese zodiac.
• The time of the full moon, the day of the lunar phase, the combination of jianchu and the periods of sanfu, shujiu or meiyu (as applicable) are also reported.
• Triple pressing NVDA+F11 opens the leanCalendar query dialog with search by Gregorian date and time, Chinese lunar date and shichen or solar term.
• The NVDA+F12 command reports the current time accurate to the second.
• Pressing NVDA+F12 twice tells you the Gregorian date, day of the week, day of the year, week number, quarter and month length.
• Holidays, statutory holidays or working days (compensation) and Western zodiac sign are reported.
Lunar date and solar term data are calculated using the built-in tyme4py library.
Note: The add-on provides some of its results in Chinese - these values ​​cannot be localized.

VolumeNotifications.description:
The VolumeNotifications add-on fixes the problem with the volume level being spoken when pressing the volume buttons.
The add-on adds the following improvements:
If you change the volume while a speech is being heard, the speech is not interrupted, and after it ends, the final volume level that was set during the change process is simply announced.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after being turned on or installed.

nvdaSpeechLoggerEnhancements.description:
NvdaSpeechLoggerEnhancements is an add-on for NVDA that logs all text spoken by the speech synthesizer to a file.
• Record all NVDA voice messages to a text file.
• Select the timestamp format (date, time, or both).
• Control via the Tools menu without the need to assign hot keys.
• View entries in a separate log manager window.
• Save a log file to your desktop for debugging or analysis.
• Log clearing via GUI.
ATTENTION: the add-on saves ALL spoken texts, including passwords and personal data.
Be careful when sharing the log file with third parties.

reportPasswords.description:
The ReportPasswords add-on adds the option to speak text that is entered on secure controls, for example, passwords on websites, when characters are pronounced as asterisks as you type.
The add-on has its own category of settings in the NVDA settings, which are located in the Options submenu of the NVDA main menu. The command to open the add-on settings from anywhere can be assigned in the Input Gestures item, in the Configuration category.

climaspeak.description:
An add-on for NVDA that announces weather information using keyboard gestures.
It is possible to configure the city manually or automatically determine the location by IP address.
Celsius and Fahrenheit degrees are supported.
• Announcement of a complete weather report.
• Announcement of current temperature and feeling temperature.
• Announcement of weather conditions.
• Announcement of wind speed and humidity.
Results are cached for 10 minutes to prevent duplicate requests.
All gestures are configured in the Input Gestures section of NVDA.
Note: The add-on accesses the foreign weather server wttr.in, so for users from Russia it is necessary to use a bypass tool.

roleAnnounce.description:
The RoleAnnounce add-on reads the type of element under the view cursor, by pressing the assigned key combination you can hear the following types of elements: Button, link, title and others.
This add-on is useful when you have disabled many of these types of elements.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+Q - “Declare the type of the object on which the cursor is placed.”
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Object Type Declaration category.
In the general settings of NVDA, in the panel of the same name, you can turn sound effects on or off.

runWindowsCommands.description:
The RunWindowsCommands add-on provides quick access to Windows startup commands.
Press the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+R to show a list of commands.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, under Run Windows commands for the shortcut Open a dialog box with different categories of Windows commands to run.
After opening the dialog with the command NVDA+Control+R, (Select Command Type(a list of three sections is available to us.
Settings commands, Open Folder or Program, Additional commands.
A list of all commands in these three sections can be found in the add-on help.

NoSpeakRolls.description:
The NoSpeakRolls add-on disables the pronunciation of some types of elements, such as: Link, Button, Editor, Header, List, Document And other elements.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+Shift+W: Enable or disable role announcement suppression.
The combination can be changed in input gestures, in the “Don't say element types” category.
In the settings, the “Suppress role announcements” checkbox is available, which is responsible for enabling the add-on function when starting NVDA.

cpuMon.description:
CpuMon add-on - (CPU monitor) monitors CPU usage and announces the name of the process that loads the CPU the most in a period of time.
In the settings, you can turn off the monitor, set the processor load threshold and measurement interval, and also set the CPU load alert signal parameters.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts.

EmptyFolder.description:
EmptyFolder add-on that reports an empty folder in the Explorer window.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation.

markdown-to-html.description:
The MarkdownToHtml add-on for NVDA allows you to convert text from Markdown format to HTML using some keyboard shortcuts.
This add-on has the following features:
Convert from Clipboard: Use the original keyboard shortcut, NVDA+Alt+M, which can be changed in the Input Gestures settings under Markdown to HTML Converter. Once the conversion is complete, the resulting text will appear on the clipboard.
Convert from .md file: Use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+Alt+F, which can also be changed in the Input Gestures settings in the previously mentioned section. 
Just like converting from the clipboard, once the process is complete the text will be on your clipboard.
You will receive a notification in the form of a window indicating the successful completion of the conversion.
This notification method only applies when converting from a file: when converting from the clipboard, you will be notified via NVDA voice message.

AutoBeepClipBoard.description:
The AutoBeepClipBoard add-on simply emits a short beep when any new text or file is automatically added to the clipboard.
As soon as the selected text or file is copied to the clipboard using a regular mouse, use the copy command Control+C (Control+Incert pressed twice), and the cut command Control+X.
Or for text only, by clicking the copy buttons on the website and in the program, you will hear a short signal that will indicate that the copied new text has indeed reached the clipboard.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+Shift+A: Enable or disable the sound when changes are made to the clipboard.
The combination can be changed in input gestures, in the category “Clipboard with automatic sound signal”.
In the settings, there is a checkbox “Enable sound signal when changing the clipboard”, which is responsible for enabling the add-on function when starting NVDA.

filezilla.description:
The FileZilla add-on improves the accessibility of the file manager of the same name, File Zilla.
The add-on adds some keyboard commands and labels to unnamed buttons.

NVDABatteryReport.description:
NVDABatteryReport add-on - generates and presents in a fully accessible format the official Windows battery report (powercfg /batteryreport).
After generation, the add-on reads out a brief summary, including the health status of the battery as a percentage and its capacity (current and factory).
All data is organized into clear sections: overview, installed battery, recent use, 7-day discharge, capacity and usage history, and runtime estimates.
Tables have been converted into screen reader-friendly lists, with each row read out with column headings.
The add-on supports sorting, limiting the number of rows, copying data to the clipboard, viewing the original HTML report, and keeps a local history of all generated reports.
You can assign a keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Battery Report” category for the shortcut “Opens the Battery Report dialog.
All add-on functionality is described in detail in the add-on help.

xyOCR.description:
Xinyi OCR is a feature-rich add-on for NVDA Screen Reader that provides powerful text and image recognition tools.
The add-on supports both offline recognition based on PaddleOCR technology and online Baidu OCR services, ensuring high speed and recognition accuracy.
Offline mode processes text in just 100 ms, making it an ideal solution for working without the Internet.
The online mode offers two options: general and precise recognition through Baidu services.
The add-on also includes an image description feature using iFLYTEK Image Understanding technology, which analyzes and describes the content of images.
All functions are available via convenient hotkeys:
NVDA+ALT+O - text recognition on the screen.
NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+O - recognition from the clipboard.
NVDA+ALT+9 - switching OCR engines.
NVDA+ALT+P - description of the image on the screen.
NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+P - description of the image from the clipboard.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the XyOCR category.

WordBridge.description:
WordBridge is an add-on for NVDA that helps users find and correct homophone-based typos in Chinese.
In addition to identifying and correcting homophone typos, WordBridge generates detailed reports that list the original errors, suggested corrections, and detailed descriptions of each character. This helps users learn from their mistakes and gradually master correct usage, effectively improving both language skills and typing accuracy.
Before using the add-on, in the settings, select the cloud AI provider that provides the patching service.
Keyboard shortcut:
Check for typos - NVDA+Alt+O.
Show patch report - NVDA+Alt+R.
Open WordBridge settings - NVDA+Alt+W.
Open the personal dictionary editor - NVDA+Alt+D.
Submit feedback on the fix - NVDA+Alt+F.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the “WordBridge” category.
Other features of the add-on are described in the help.

audioExtractor.description:
Audio Extractor is a lightweight add-on for NVDA that quickly extracts audio tracks from video files.
• In Explorer, select the video file and copy it to the clipboard using Ctrl+C.
• Press NVDA+Alt+V to open the format selection dialog.
• Use the arrows to select the desired audio format and press Enter.
• Extraction is performed in the background without blocking the interface.
• The add-on notifies you of the progress of the process through speech and sound signals.
• To work, you need to have the ffmpeg.exe file in the globalPlugins/video_converter/ folder inside the add-on.
Note: The developer has not enabled the ability to localize the interface.

AiSound5.description:
The AiSound5 add-on adds Chinese speech synthesizers AiSound5.
After installation, nine Chinese voices will be available:
Baby Xu, Mandarin.
Da Long, Cantonese.
Donald Duck, Mandarin.
Duo Xu, Mandarin.
Ju Xu, mandarin
Xiao Feng, Mandarin.
Xiao Mei, Cantonese.
Xiao Ping, Mandarin.
Yan Ping, mandarin.

UIANotificationSwitch.description:
The UIANotificationSwitch add-on provides a keyboard shortcut to control NVDA's behavior when dealing with UIA notifications.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+I: Toggle UIA notification status: off, on, or beep.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the UIA Notification Switcher section.
UIA (User Interface Automation Notifications) notifications are a messaging system that applications use to communicate with users through accessibility interfaces, such as screen readers like NVDA.
These notifications help people with disabilities perceive and interact with app content.
UIA is a user interface automation technology developed by Microsoft to provide interoperability between applications and assistive technologies such as screen readers, screen magnifiers, and other accessibility tools.
UIA notifications allow screen readers to receive information about events in the application, such as changes in the contents of a window, the appearance of new interface elements, or the completion of operations.
This way, when you enable or disable UIA notifications in a screen reader, you control whether the program will notify you of any changes that occur in the application's interface, or whether those changes will be ignored.

aiTranslator.description:
The AI ​​Translator add-on translates selected text or text from the clipboard via an OpenAI-compatible API.
• To translate selected text, use the NVDA+Shift+T gesture.
• To translate text from the clipboard, use the NVDA+Shift+Y gesture.
• The add-on reads the translation result and copies it to the clipboard.
• You can choose an API provider: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Nous or specify a custom URL.
• You can select preset models or enter a custom model ID.
• The target language and the reverse translation language are configured (if the source text is already in the target language).
• The settings specify the API key, model, languages ​​and request timeout.
• The add-on supports reassigning gestures in the NVDA Input Gestures dialog.
• Do not use the add-on to translate sensitive data if you do not trust the selected provider.

AIContentDescriber.description:
The AI ​​Content Describer add-on allows you to obtain detailed descriptions of images and interface elements using artificial intelligence.
• You can describe the current focus, the navigator object, the entire screen, or take a photo from the camera.
• The add-on supports many providers: OpenAI GPT, Pollinations, Google Gemini, Mistral Pixtral, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, vivo BlueLM Vision (via NVDA-CN), Ollama, llama.cpp, LiteLLM Proxy and Seer.
• Descriptions can be cached to save API quota.
• You can ask clarifying questions and attach additional images.
• Built-in face recognition function determines the position of a face in the frame without connecting to the API.
• PNG, JPEG, WEBP and non-animated GIF formats are supported.
• For advanced use, you can customize the prompt and the number of tokens.
• Results can be opened in a browse dialog with Markdown rendering support.
• By default, access to GPT4 is free through Pollinations.
• To work with other models, you can specify your own API key.

NVDACNMirror.description:
The NVDACNMirror mirror update source add-on is intended for users of the Chinese NVDA community.
This can improve NVDA update speed, improve search and download speeds in the Add-on Store, and resolve issues that prevent some network operators from downloading Add-ons from the Add-on Store, thereby effectively improving the user experience.

askOpenRouter.description:
The AskOpenRouter add-on allows you to ask questions to the free models available on the OpenRouter platform.
Therefore, it is necessary to have a free account, which you can create at 'https://openrouter.ai'.
You will also need an API key, which you can generate after creating your free account.
You will then be able to open a dialog box that will allow you to either create a new chat or continue an existing one.
The add-on is described in detail in the reference manual, including steps to register on the designated service to obtain an API key.

frequentText.description:
The FrequentText add-on lets you quickly insert blocks of text you type frequently into documents you write.
To better organize text blocks, you can group them into categories.
You can set a default category for quick access to its blocks.
Command: Windows + F12 - opens a dialog box for registering, managing and inserting frequent blocks of text.
The command can be changed in input gestures in the Text Editing subsection.

emoticonosAvanzados.description:
The EmoticonosAvanzados add-on allows you to control the reading of emoji and classic emoticons in NVDA.
It uses CLDR dictionaries with over 3,900 entries in Spanish.
You can choose one of four operating modes.
In Custom mode, each emoji is replaced with its description.
In the "Grouped" mode, identical consecutive emoji are counted.
In the “Remote” mode, all emoticons are excluded from speech.
The add-on can also be completely disabled.
You can separately turn detection of Unicode emoji and classic text emoji on or off.
An option is available to suppress the reading of NVDA special characters, such as currency or copyright symbols.
Supports displaying descriptions of emoticons on a Braille display.
You can customize the format for displaying descriptions and add a prefix before each emoticon.
For classic emoticons, you can enable case ignoring.
The logging level allows you to monitor the operation of the add-on if necessary.
The add-on provides three commands for assigning hotkeys.
The “Switch emoticon mode” command quickly changes operating modes.
The Current Symbol Information command displays detailed information about the symbol under the review cursor.
The “Analyze emoticons from clipboard” command displays a list and statistics of all emoticons in the copied text.

zRadioModern.description:
zRadio Moderno is a radio player designed specifically for 100% accessibility with NVDA. With it you can:
Explore thousands of radio stations by country, language or tags.
Manage your own favorites list.
Record your favorite programs in high quality MP3 format.
Set up scheduled recording to automatically start and stop.
Access a history of recently listened radio stations.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

voiceToggle.description:
The VoiceToggle add-on for NVDA screen reader allows you to pre-set a custom number of voices in the settings so you can quickly switch between them in a circle at any time using the NVDA + Alt + V keyboard shortcut.
Usage example:
Let's say you speak English and French, then you can add two voices in the VoiceToggle settings as described below, one with English and the other with French pronunciation. Subsequently, you will be able to switch between these two voices using only the simple and convenient key combination NVDA + Alt + V, instead of fiddling with the NVDA Synth settings ring, the NVDA Synthesizer selection dialog, or the NVDA Settings dialog in the Speech category.
Adding voices occurs in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Voice Switcher.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous section for the Switch to next voice shortcut.
You can always find a step-by-step guide to setting up your add-on in the add-on help.

snippetsForNVDA.description:
The SnippetsForNVDA add-on provides NVDA functionality for working with text snippets, including snippet memory locations and more.
You can use 10 memory locations to copy and paste text between applications.
To use the fragment memorization feature, follow these steps:
Select some text.
Press NVDA+CONTROL+Number key to copy the selected text to the memory location.
If there is already data in the selected memory location, it will be overwritten by your selected text, otherwise the text will be copied to that location.
Press NVDA+CONTROL+SHIFT+Number key once to listen to the contents of that memory location.
Press NVDA+CONTROL+SHIFT+Number key twice quickly to paste the contents of this memory location into the active application.
Press NVDA+ALT+S to save the fragments to disk.
Press NVDA+ALT+L to load previously saved fragments from disk.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Miscellaneous” category.

keyRemapper.description:
The Key Remapper add-on allows you to remap any keys or key combinations to any other keys.
This is useful for compact laptops where the function keys of the arrow keys Insert Applications numeric keypad or multimedia keys are missing.
You can assign a key that you have to generate the one that is missing.
• Basic add-on gestures: NVDA+Shift+X to create a destination.
• When you single press this gesture, you need to press the source key and then the target key.
• By double-clicking, you can select the target key from a list dialog.
• The NVDA+X gesture is used to execute the assigned key.
• By pressing NVDA+X twice, you can open a dialog and send any known key directly.
All created assignments are saved in the NVDA configuration and are available after restarting the program.
The key selection dialog contains categories and a filter for easy searching of the desired key.
Navigation keys, function keys, numeric keypad, multimedia browser keys, application launch keys, as well as combinations with Alt Control and Windows are supported.

whatsAppNG.description:
The WhatsAppNG add-on brings accessibility improvements to the web version of WhatsApp Desktop, including keyboard shortcuts for navigation, improved messaging experience, and better Narrator support.
Features:
Keyboard shortcuts for navigation (Alt+1, Alt+2, Alt+D).
Play voice messages (Enter).
Access to the context menu (Shift+Enter).
Toggle filtering of phone numbers in chats and messages.
Other features are described in the help.

nao.description:
Nao (NVDA Advanced OCR) improves the standard OCR capabilities of Windows 10 and 11.
• The standard NVDA command uses Windows OCR for screen recognition only.
• Nao can perform OCR on files from your hard drive, USB drive or email attachments.
• Press NVDA+Shift+R to recognize images and PDF files without opening them.
• The recognized document will open in a text window with convenient commands.
• Page Up and Page Down move the cursor between pages of a multi-page document.
• The P key reports the current page number.
• L and Shift+L show the line number on the page or in the entire document.
• G allows you to go to a specific page.
• C copies all text to the clipboard.
• S saves a copy of the document in text format.
• F performs a text search by reading adjacent words.
• Control+S saves the document in nao-document format for easy opening next time.
• NVDA+Shift+Control+R takes a snapshot of the entire screen and recognizes it.
• NVDA+Shift+Control+W recognizes the contents of the current window.
