• The lengthy recognition process can be interrupted with the “Cancel” button in the progress bar window.
• The add-on works in Windows Explorer on the desktop with Total Commander and xplorer².
• Email attachments require Microsoft Outlook 2016 or later.
• Do not use 7-Zip or WinRAR as they are not supported.
• All keyboard shortcuts can be changed in the NVDA Input Gestures dialog.

Synth Dictionary Editor.description:
The SynthDictionaryEditor add-on allows you to view and edit .dic pronunciation dictionary files for IBM TTS and Eloquence synthesizers directly from NVDA.
Unlike the standard NVDA dictionary, this add-on edits low-level files that are read directly by the synthesizer engine.
You can open the editor through the NVDA menu → Tools → Synthesizer Dictionary Editor.
If both synthesizers are installed, the program will prompt you to select which dictionary to edit.
The editor interface contains a list of entries with “Word” and “Pronunciation” columns.
Search by words and pronunciation in real time is available.
You can add, change and delete individual entries.
The variant generator function automatically creates morphological forms of the root word using affixes.
Import supports both single files and batch mode with automatic detection of language and dictionary type.
Export allows you to save all entries of the current dictionary to a file.
After saving changes, the synthesizer reboots automatically without the need to restart NVDA.
Updating the online dictionary from public GitHub repositories is supported.
Pronunciation entries can be set in two ways.
• Spell simple words that the synthesizer already reads naturally.
• SPR phoneme strings in [...] format for precise control of sounds and accents.
The supplement provides a complete table of American English phonemes with vowel symbols, diphthongs, reduced vowels and consonants.
The rules for placing stress are described by markers 1 2 0 to the left of the vowel of the stressed syllable.
Dictionary files follow a strict naming convention: language code (enu eng esp and others) plus type (main root abbr) and extension .dic.

unicodeBrailleInput.description:
The UnicodeBrailleInput add-on provides a text field for digital braille input.
For example, 1345-1236-145-1.
Then converts it to Unicode Braille characters.
You can also convert text according to the currently selected input braille table.
The purpose of this specialized addon is to make it easier to improve liblouis tables and add automated tests for your language.
With the addition of Unicode Braille Tables in NVDA 2017.3, this addition is no longer required because users can choose to input the Braille Table with the new table.
However, this add-on can still help in converting plain text to Unicode Braille according to a specific input table.
The keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+I opens the Unicode input dialog.

nvdaMacroManager.description:
NVDAMacroManager is a high-performance macro recording, editing and playback engine fully integrated into NVDA.
It automates any repetitive task, from complex gaming combinations to everyday office work.
The add-on offers two recording modes: live and hidden (safe).
In stealth mode, keystrokes are intercepted before they reach the operating system.
This prevents files from being accidentally deleted or windows closed while recording.
You can assign custom hotkeys to each macro through NVDA's Input Gestures menu.
The built-in professional macro editor supports a linear workflow by separating keys and delays into independent steps.
Clipboard operations, undo and redo actions are available, as well as dynamic addition of new events without rewriting the macro.
When adding or editing keys, you can either capture an actual keystroke or select a key from a drop-down menu.
The add-on is compatible with games and anti-cheats thanks to the use of hardware codes (ScanCodes).
You can finely adjust the playback speed in 0.1 increments or make it instantaneous.
You can configure the number of repetitions and an endless loop.
Macros can be tied to specific security applications.
Standard keyboard shortcuts include the following:
• NVDA + Windows + R – start or stop live macro recording.
• NVDA + Windows + Shift + R – start or stop secure (hidden) recording.
• NVDA + Windows + P – play the last temporary macro.
• NVDA + Shift + M – open the macro manager interface.
Pressing the play key again instantly stops the running macro.
The IDE's advanced features allow you to manage macros like a professional developer.

SuspiciousAddons.description:
The SuspiciousAddons add-on is designed to analyze the NVDA error log.
It helps identify add-ons that may be causing NVDA instability.
The function is activated using the Alt+Shift+Z gesture.
Once activated, the add-on opens the NVDA log file from the user's temporary folder.
Searches for lines containing the keyword Error.
For each error found, the context of the ten preceding lines is analyzed.
In this context, a mention of a file from the Roaming\nvda\addons folder is searched.
If such a file is found, the add-on folder name is extracted from the full path.
All unique add-on names found are collected into a final list.
At the end of the analysis, a sound signal sounds and a window with a list of suspicious additions is displayed.
The user can copy the received names for further disabling or deleting.
If no errors related to add-ons are found, a corresponding message is displayed.
The results window can be closed with the Escape key.
The add-on does not make changes to system files.
• View only logged errors.
• Does not require additional permissions.
• Works with UTF-8 encoding.
• Ignores errors not related to add-ons.
This tool is especially useful for sudden NVDA crashes.
It helps you quickly identify the culprit of the problem without manually analyzing large log files.
The add-on also makes it easier to find add-ons to disable.

audioManager.description:
AudioManager add-on for managing system audio.
The add-on is designed to help you manage multiple audio devices and effectively optimize audio routing.
The functionality of this add-on can be divided into four main modules:
Playback Device Control: This module allows you to adjust volume, set the default playback device, and switch between mute and mute states.
Recording Device Control: Similar to playback device control, allows you to adjust the volume, set the default recording device in the system, and mute/unmute the sound.
App-Specific Audio Control: This feature allows you to configure playback and recording devices, change volume, and mute/unmute audio for individual audio apps.
Additional Functionality: Along with the above-mentioned functions, there are several practical functions such as locking microphone volume, switching NVDA output devices, etc.

brailleCellIgnorer.description:
The Braille Cell Ignorer add-on allows you to ignore damaged or faulty Braille display cells.
If your display has one or more cells with stuck pins or broken dots, you can continue to use the device without distorted output.
The remaining work cells are automatically shifted and fill in the gaps.
• Ignore certain cells: configure which cells should be considered as non-existent.
• Automatic content shift: Braille content seamlessly wraps around ignored cells.
• Route Key Handling: Pressing a route key on an ignored cell is silently ignored.
• Profiles per display: Settings are saved separately for each model and display size.
Settings are available through the NVDA menu → Options → Preferences → Ignore Braille Display Cells.
Under Display Profile, select the display to configure.
In the “Ignore cells” field, enter cell numbers (numbering starting from 1, separated by commas, for example 1, 5, 40).
The "Delete this configuration" button allows you to delete settings for displays that are no longer used.
Cell numbers start at 1 (first cell = 1, not 0).
Currently only single line displays are supported.
Changes take effect immediately after saving.

tiflotecniaVoices.description:
TiflotecniaVoices driver for Cerence Embedded TTS synthesizer
The driver has the function of auto-switching languages between Latin and non-Latin languages.
To use the driver indefinitely, you must purchase a license, but in order to try it, a seven-day license is offered.
Voices for the driver do not need to be downloaded from the website; the driver has a built-in voice manager through which you can download voices in low, medium, high and highest quality.
More information about the features of the driver, as well as methods for activating a license, can be found in the add-on help.

YandexTranslate.description:
The YandexTranslate add-on translates text using the Yandex Translate web translation service.
The add-on translates a selected piece of text or content from the clipboard; there is an automatic (instant) NVDA speech translation.
If there is a Braille display, the result will be duplicated on it.
The use of proxy servers and configuration profiles is supported.
The add-on can be configured in the NVDA menu, Tools, Yandex Translate Settings.
After installation, go to NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures,
Assign keyboard shortcuts that are convenient for you for YandexTranslate. Or use pre-installed ones (see help).

xPand.description:
xPand is an add-on for NVDA that implements an autocorrect function similar to Microsoft Word.
Allows you to create an unlimited number of abbreviation codes that automatically expand into full words or phrases.
Works in all text editors and input fields of web browsers.
There are hotkeys for use: CTRL+F3 (single press) opens the autocorrect dialog, CTRL+F3 (double press) - settings.
In the settings you can add, edit and delete codes through a convenient interface.
The add-on includes demo code hw for testing functionality.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the XPand category.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the help.

timezone.description:
The TimeZone add-on reads the time and date in selected time zones. Use the settings dialog to set the time zones you want to hear.
After that, press NVDA+ALT+Up or Down Arrow to view the time zone ring and hear the time in the selected time zones.
Useful for those who regularly conduct negotiations, conversations, trade, business with people in other time zones, countries, regions.

updateChannel.description:
The UpdateChannel add-on allows you to download and install the latest version of NVDA
selected type without visiting a web page or using a web browser. This
useful when, for example, you want to test new features in an NVDA snapshot and then revert to the most recent stable version.
If you regularly test NVDA snapshots and usually install them on your computer, you will save a lot of time with this add-on.
If you prefer to test your shots in handheld mode while keeping your installed copy of NVDA intact,
this add-on is also for you.
Usage:
You can change the NVDA update channel by going to the NVDA menu, Options.
Settings, Update channel. Select the desired channel and press OK, wait
next automatic check for updates or go to the NVDA Help menu
and select the Check for updates option.
Available channels: Stable Beta.

searchWith.description:
The SearchWith add-on will help you search for text using various search engines.
Select the text and click the append command.
A dialog will appear with an editing window for entering a search query.
To search using Google, press Enter, to search using other search engines - Tab.
Or highlight the text and press once, a menu will appear with different search engines to choose from.
And when text is highlighted, you can double-tap the gesture to search directly on Google.
The default gesture for this add-on is NVDA+Windows+S.

outlookExtended.description:
The Outlook Extended add-on improves the use of Microsoft Outlook with NVDA screen reader.
It speaks some standard commands and adds new features.
• Alt commands with numbers from 1 to 0 and the “-” and “=” keys read header fields in emails, calendars, and tasks.
• Double-clicking these shortcuts moves the focus to the field, and triple-clicking them copies the contents to the clipboard.
• NVDA+Shift+I or NVDA+Control+Shift+I speaks the information panel and allows you to move to it.
• NVDA+Shift+A or NVDA+Control+Shift+A reports attachments or shows the status of meeting participants.
• NVDA+Shift+M or NVDA+Control+Shift+M moves focus to the body of the message.
• NVDA+Shift+N or NVDA+Control+Shift+N sounds notifications about invalid addresses or auto-replies.
• Control+Q and Control+U mark emails as read or unread.
The add-on also alerts you with sound when Outlook notifications appear and makes them easier to navigate.
In the address book, horizontal navigation through the table columns is available.
All gestures can be reassigned in input gestures, in the "Advanced Outlook" category.

screenWrapping.description:
The ScreenWrapping add-on adds screen wrapping functionality to nvda.
When you press shortcut keys such as h, b, f and others, you will be moved to the next element regardless of your current position on the web page.
If no elements are found below your position, you will be moved to the first element of the requested type accessible from the top of the page, and vice versa when you search upward. this also applies to the nvda search dialog.
You can turn the screen navigation feature on or off using the **nvda+h command.
You can change the command in input gestures, in the subsection Review mode, Activate and deactivate the function of moving around the screen.

instantAccess.description:
The Instant Access add-on allows you to create your own hotkey layer in NVDA to launch applications, insert text, and automate tasks.
Instead of memorizing dozens of complex combinations, activate the mode with one key and press simple gestures.
You can combine multiple actions into one item, turning one combination into a powerful macro.
• Multi-action items: assign a sequence of actions to one gesture.
• Time management: set a delay before each action and an interval between them.
• Application-specific hotkeys: make a gesture global or limit it to a specific application.
• Wide range of actions: launching websites, programs, folders, files, NVDA commands, inserting text fragments.
• Centralized management: settings panel for adding, editing, testing and organizing items.
• Import and Export: Backup and share configuration in JSON format.
• Adjustable detail: Choose between detailed voice feedback or brief beeps.
Built-in hotkeys: NVDA+E enables or disables Instant Access mode.
NVDA+Shift+E reports the name of the application in focus to create dependent gestures.
Two quick presses of NVDA+Shift+E copy the application name to the clipboard.
The Escape key deactivates the mode without executing a command.
You can create steps with a sequence of actions, such as opening multiple websites with pauses or starting a development workflow with one command.
Supports passing command line arguments for advanced automation.
All functions of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

CustomLabels.description:
CustomLabels is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to assign custom text labels to controls in any application.
It solves the problem of inaccessibility of buttons, fields and other interface objects that do not have built-in descriptions or are incorrectly recognized by the screen reader.
With simple hotkeys you can add, change or remove a label for the current item, making navigation clearer and more efficient.
All tags are saved separately for each application, they can be edited, exported and imported through a convenient settings panel.
The add-on supports the main types of elements: buttons, checkboxes, switches, tabs, sliders and others.
CustomLabels significantly improve accessibility in software where standard screen reader support is insufficient.
The functionality is described in more detail in the help.

nvdaComposer.description:
NVDA Composer is a music add-on for NVDA that allows you to create melodies using NVDA synthesizer tones or local audio.
• The selected mode is automatically remembered in NVDA settings.
• The add-on offers an extensive set of hotkeys for creating and editing music.
• You can insert notes and rests of varying durations from whole to 1/32 notes with support for dotted and triplet durations.
• Supports navigation along the timeline, moving the pitch in semitones and octaves, changing the tempo.
• Two note input modes are available: grid and QWERTY, as well as working with scales.
• Implemented functions for selecting, copying, pasting, undoing and repeating actions, transposing selected notes.
• You can create new projects, open existing ones, save and export the results.
• For quick access to functions, use the combination NVDA+Alt+N.
• Complete documentation is opened using the F1 key.
Note: The developer has not implemented the ability to localize the interface.

Access8Math.description:
The Access8Math add-on improves the user experience when reading and writing math content.
Access8Math offers text-to-speech and braille functionality for MathML content. MathML is a standard language for describing mathematical structure and content on the Internet, which allows mathematical content to be visually read through a web browser.
Access8Math can also help you write and convert LaTeX to MathML. LaTex is a typing system that is easy to write and learn. It is widely used to represent mathematical formulas.
With Access8Math's read, write, and convert functions, visually impaired users can read and write math content with ease. Based on MathML and LaTeX, two common mathematical markups, Access8Math significantly reduces the complexity of two-way communication between visually impaired and sighted users.

clipboardHistory.description:
The ClipboardHistory add-on allows you to manage your clipboard history by saving it in a local database, which allows you to save texts even when the system is rebooted.
It adds commands for viewing history, search functions, counting, favorites, backup and item visualization.
In addition to interacting through the command layer with advanced features, those who do not want compromises can use a simple graphical version.
When you first install and run NVDA, a file called “clipboard_history” is created that contains the database. This file is placed at the root of the nvda folder in the user configuration directory.
A listener is also created that intercepts clipboard changes and updates the database when new text content becomes available.
History does not store duplicates to avoid unnecessary database growth.
When you copy existing text, it is copied to the first position in the list, deleting the previous one.
There are 2 functions assigned from the input gestures dialog, clipboard history category. These include.
Enable command layer.
Enable GUI.
Important Note:

The clipboard history may contain sensitive data, so the user must delete its contents before transferring the portable version with a copy of the configuration.

DictionaryDisplayLite.description:
Dictionary Display Lite is your personal speech cleaning tool for NVDA dictionary dialogs.
You know those long ads every time you move through your list of posts?
"Pattern: OBS, Substitution: O B S, Case: Off, Type: Regular Expression"
With Dictionary Display Lite, you'll instantly hear only what you need:
"OBS O B S off Regular Expression"
No more "Pattern:", "Replace:", "case:" or "Type:".
It works quietly in the background, making dictionary browsing faster and more enjoyable.
No setup required: Install the add-on, open any dictionary and focus on a list item.
NVDA will automatically read the shortened version.
Why you'll like it:
If you manage a lot of dictionary entries, you know how tedious full declarations can be.
Dictionary Display Lite leaves only the information you really need: pattern, substitution, case setting and rule type.
It's like having a personal assistant who knows exactly what to say.
Each ad will be clear and to the point.

gestureDuplicate.description:
GestureDuplicate helps identify and resolve conflicting keyboard shortcuts in NVDA.
The add-on also cleans up residual user gestures from removed add-ons in the screen reader configuration.
Over time, after removing add-ons, “ghost” settings remain in the nvda.ini and gestures.ini files.
This may result in unexpected behavior and increased memory consumption.
The add-on includes three main tools for configuration maintenance.
• Duplicate gesture checking detects and lists all conflicting gestures in all contexts.
• Manage my gestures allows you to view and safely delete gestures for already deleted add-ons.
• Configuration Cleanup scans nvda.ini and removes obsolete sections from missing add-ons.
The Windows+Shift+G hotkey uses an intelligent multiple-press system.
A single press opens a dialog for checking duplicate gestures.
Double tapping opens my gesture controls.
A triple click starts clearing the configuration.
All dialog boxes are fully accessible from the keyboard.
The supported keys are Enter to execute, Delete to delete, and Escape to close.
Use my gesture controls after each add-on removal to prevent conflicts.

placeMarkers.description:
The placeMarkers add-on is used to save and search for specific lines of text or marks.
It can be used on web pages or in documents in NVDA view mode.
It can also be used to store or search text strings in multiline controls; in this case, if it is not possible to update the cursor position, the corresponding line will be copied to the clipboard so that it can be found using other tools.
The add-on saves the specified lines and labels into files whose names are based on the title and URL of the current document.
All keyboard shortcuts and other add-on functions are described in the help documentation.

enhancedAnnotations.description:
The EnhancedAnnotations add-on adds the ability to move the cursor to additional details and return to the original element in view mode.
The DAISY Consortium is developing best practices for publishers and authors regarding the provision of long descriptions.
Best practices use an HTML details element following an image, or a link to another file containing a rich description.
Both options require the user to navigate to the detail item or link and activate it.
The ideal option is to have a keyboard shortcut that allows you to move the cursor focus to a link or detailed description.
Our best practices recommend placing both the link and details immediately after the image, and if the link is followed, a link back to the exact location should be provided. This ensures that
the user will not get lost.
However, authors are likely to place an extended (long) description almost anywhere.
In such cases, the user will want to return to the image, so a way to return to the original image is needed.

browserOptions.description:
The BrowserOptions add-on will help you open a URL or search using additional browsers.
Sometimes we have to browse websites using different browsers. This simple add-on detects popular browsers installed on your device, such as Chrome, Firefox and Edge.
How to use the add-on:
Press NVDA+O to open the search dialog.
Enter the URL or value you want to view and press Enter or Tab to click the Find button.
A dialog box will appear allowing you to select one of the installed browsers on your device.
After selecting the desired browser, press Enter and the add-on dialog box will close.
The Favorites function can be opened using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+SHIFT+O.
You can also change the keyboard shortcut in NVDA Settings in the Input Gestures section, Browser Options subsection.

addonStoreLite.description:
addonStoreLite is a lightweight and smart add-on for NVDA that makes it easy to voice items in the Add-on Store.
It removes information noise - status, channel, publisher, email, unnecessary versions - and leaves only the most important: add-on name, version, author, installation date and the “Disabled” mark for disabled add-ons.
Thanks to this, browsing the list of add-ons becomes fast and comfortable: there is no need to listen to long, repeating lines.
The add-on works automatically immediately after installation and does not require configuration.
It supports all Add-on Store tabs (Installed, Available, Updates, Beta and Dev channels) and works correctly with both the classic NVDA 2025.x interface and the new NVDA 2026.x format.
Important: addonStoreLite only changes speech announcements.
Full information about the supplement (status, publication date, requirements, etc.) is always available in the “Other details” section.
The addition only removes unnecessary things from speech, without hiding anything or disrupting the functionality of the store.
This is an ideal tool for those who value their time and want to focus on the main thing when choosing add-ons.

DoctorNVDA.description:
The DoctorNVDA add-on is the ultimate set of tools to keep NVDA running.
Conveniently backup and restore basic settings, search for conflicting add-ons using binary search, view detailed system information, safely restart with disabled add-ons, and check system status - all in one convenient menu.
Let your NVDA run smoothly!
Hotkeys:
ALT+Windows+D: open DoctorNVDA menu.

Autoclip.description:
The NVDA AutoClip add-on automatically reads the contents of the clipboard whenever it is changed. This can be useful if you are playing a game that outputs text to the clipboard and does not support output directly to NVDA.
No external programs are required to use this add-on.
Once you install and enable the add-on using a keyboard shortcut or an option in the tools menu, it will automatically read the contents of your clipboard whenever you change it.
Press NVDA+Control+Shift+K to enable automatic reading of the clipboard.
You can read more about the features of the add-on in the help.

xBlock.description:
xBlock turns NVDA into a powerful tool for working with frequently used texts.
It's your personal text storage: save a snippet once and paste it anywhere instantly.
The add-on was created for users who value efficiency and professional speed.
With it, you can organize a library of response templates, code snippets, or any repeating forms.
To open the xBlock command center, use the Windows hotkey + F11.
Select the "All" category or create a new group by clicking the "New Category" button.
Enter the block name and its contents in the appropriate fields.
Click "Add" to save the fragment.
To insert text, simply select the desired block from the list and press Enter.
The window will close and the content will be instantly pasted into the active application.
Smart categorization makes it easy to manage hundreds of blocks.
• Right-click a block to pin it to the top of the list.
• Use the Move Up or Move Down commands to fine-tune the order.
• Edit content, move blocks between categories, or remove unnecessary items in one motion.
You can change the combination in input gestures, in the “xBlock” category.

winMag.description:
The WinMag add-on improves the use of Windows Magnifier with NVDA with the following features:
Allows you to speak the results of some native screen magnification and color filtering commands.
Reduces the number of times table navigation commands conflict with screen zoom commands.
Adds hotkeys to toggle various native screen magnification options.
Allows you to save and restore screen magnification configuration settings.
Adds additional functionality not found in standard Windows Screen Magnification (eg, moving the mouse into the viewing area, Screen Magnification window not on top of other windows).
You can learn more about WinMag's other features, as well as keyboard shortcuts, in the add-on's help guide.

WeChatEnhancement.description:
The WeChatEnhancement add-on provides advanced features for working with the desktop version of WeChat on the Windows platform.
• WeChat version 4 x and above is supported.
• The add-on automatically notifies you of new messages with a sound or voice message.
• A virtual message queue has been implemented for convenient viewing of chat history.
• The queue is managed using the following keyboard shortcuts.
• Control+Alt+Up Arrow allows you to read the previous message in the current chat.
• Control+Alt+Down Arrow allows you to read the next message in the current chat.
• Control+Alt+Home allows you to read the first message in the current chat.
• Control+Alt+End allows you to read the last message in the current chat.
• The latest message may not be the newest message unless the Go to Latest Message button is clicked.
• When you click this button, the virtual message queue is also updated.
• The mode of notifications about new messages is switched by pressing the F3 key.
• Three notification alert modes are available: only sound, sound and speech are disabled.
• The add-on automatically detects the active chat and synchronizes the virtual queue with the displayed messages.
• As you scroll through the list of messages, the queue is dynamically updated to stay current.
• Implemented intelligent processing of list boundaries for loading previous messages.
• The add-on does not interfere with the standard operation of NVDA and automatically transfers input gestures when necessary.
• Improved stability and performance when working with a large number of messages.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures dialog box.

windowsOfProcess.description:
The WindowsOfProcess add-on allows you to quickly switch between windows with the same process or a different process.
All commands can be changed in the Input Gestures section.
When you open the list of processes in a window, you can hear how many windows and processes are running.

TransIPA.description:
TransIPA add-on for NVDA, which supports reading the International Phonetic Alphabet in dotted Braille.
The key combination NVDA+Shift+P enables/disables phonetic reading.
The command can be changed in input gestures, Speech section.

audacity.description:
The AudaCity add-on adds additional functionality when working with the Audacity audio editor of the same name.
script reporting sound position,
a script that reports the beginning and end of the selection,
automatic report on changes in sound position,
automatic reporting of selection changes (can be disabled),
support for editing using a timer,
using spacebar to press a button,
script for reporting peak playback/recording level,
script for reporting the play/record slider level,
script reporting playback speed,
script for displaying the add-on user manual,
script to display the audacity tutorial written by David Bales.
This version of the addon has been tested with NVDA 2017.4, NVDA 2017.3 and audacity v2.2.1 and v2.2.0.  Previous versions of Audacity are not supported.

universalFocusTracker.description:
Universal Focus Tracker automatically moves the mouse pointer to the center of the element that has NVDA focus.
The add-on works both in regular applications and in browsers with browse mode.
When switching between elements, the mouse instantly follows the focus.
When you move the input cursor, the pointer also moves behind it.
The add-on ignores menu items and pop-ups to prevent conflicts.
Added a panel to enable or disable tracking in NVDA Settings.
The feature is enabled by default after installation.
Also, the add-on option can be disabled or enabled using the keyboard shortcut: NVDA+Windows+T.
You can change the combination in input gestures, in the “Mouse tracking” category.
"Note": The add-on does not work in context menus such as the NVDA menu or the File, System, ATC menu because moving the mouse pointer along with NVDA in these menus causes focus issues.

Hear2ReadNG.description:
Hear2ReadNG is a speech synthesizer for 11 Indian languages ​​and English (with Indian accent) that generates natural human speech.
It is based on work done by the piper TTS team.
The add-on includes a voice manager for installing one or more Indian voices.
Supported languages: Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu.
All steps for downloading voices are described in the help for the add-on.
Or you can do everything yourself by opening the NVDA main menu, Hear2Read Voice Manager.

contactsManager.description:
Contact Manager add-on specifically designed to help visually impaired people manage their contact list more easily and efficiently.
With this add-on, you can add, edit, and delete contacts, and search for names and contact information quickly and easily.
Additionally, the add-on offers the ability to export and import your contact list so you can share it.
Contact Manager for NVDA is easy to use and has an intuitive interface, making it an ideal choice for anyone who needs to manage their contact list efficiently.
You can access Contact Manager for NVDA in two ways:
Using the keyboard shortcut Windows+Alt+L.
Through the NVDA menu (NVDA+N), Tools, Contact Manager.
The add-on is described in great detail in the help.

charInfo.description:
The CharInfo add-on allows you to display various information about characters in a message.
It also allows you to customize the information reported about a symbol when you use the symbol navigation commands using the view cursor or by repeatedly clicking the symbol view command.
Features:
Display detailed information about the symbol, such as Unicode name, number, CLDR, symbol name, etc.
This information can be displayed at either the overview cursor location or the system cursor location.
Customize the information displayed when the numpad2 key is pressed.
Use the same information as you move the browse cursor through the characters.
You can learn more about the add-on's functions and find out the keyboard shortcuts in the add-on's help documentation.

keystrokeQueuing.description:
Keystroke Queuing is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to define named keystroke sequences.
• It can be used to record and execute entire macros with multiple steps.
• Keystrokes, text input, mouse movements, and clicks can be specified in the configuration file.
• Each command is executed with a specified delay in seconds.
• The add-on supports absolute and relative mouse movements.
• You can show pop-up messages while a macro is running.
• To launch the command queue, there is a dialog with a list of all available macros.
• The standard hotkey for calling the dialog is NVDA+Shift+Q.
• The configuration file can be edited manually or through the NVDA settings panel.
• Changes take effect without restarting NVDA.
• It is possible to reload the configuration at any time by pressing NVDA+Control+Shift+Q.
• Keystroke Queuing is especially useful for automating repetitive actions.
• It is suitable for quickly filling out forms, launching applications and navigating the interface.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

BMI.description:
Complements BMI to determine Body Mass Index (BMI), an international indicator used to assess the level of fat in a person's body.
With this add-on, you can easily calculate your BMI by entering your height and weight.
In addition to traditional BMI calculation, this new version offers additional features such as calculating ideal BMI based on height and providing detailed classification according to World Health Organization (WHO) criteria, offering personalized health recommendations. The add-on now also saves the last 10 calculations, which can be quickly accessed using the Alt+H keyboard shortcut.
Note: To correctly interpret BMI, it is important to consider other factors such as body composition, fat distribution, age, gender and general health. It is always recommended to consult a healthcare professional such as a doctor or nutritionist for a more accurate assessment and appropriate health and weight recommendations.
To launch the add-on, press Alt+Windows+I or use the NVDA menu, Tools, Calculate your BMI.

typingSpellingRate.description:
The Typing ' Spelling Rate add-on allows you to set a separate speech rate for typing echo and spelling.
The basic speech rate of the synthesizer does not change.
Many users prefer a comfortable speed for reading and navigation.
When typing or spelling, they need faster speed for quick feedback.
NVDA does not provide this feature out of the box, so this add-on was created.
• In the add-on settings you can enable a separate speed for dialing.
• You can also turn on a separate speed for spelling.
• For typing speed, there is an option to apply also to the words you type.
• The Windows OneCore synthesizer provides additional Boost.
The add-on only adds speed commands to the speech sequence for specific phrases.
It does not change the global settings of the synthesizer, which ensures stability and compatibility.
There are two testing buttons on the settings panel: Typing Test and Spell Test.
Settings are saved for each synthesizer separately.
The settings are located in the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Settings, Typing and Spelling Speed ​​panel.

htmlElementInspector.description:
HTML Element Inspector is a small tool for inspecting web elements.
It is inspired by the Item Information feature in JAWS.
The add-on creates a compact semantic report for the currently focused element.
• For a basic report, use NVDA+Shift+F1.
• For an advanced report, use Control+NVDA+Shift+F1.
The advanced report includes details of the element in focus, landmark context, and exploration of child elements.
Both modes support heading navigation using the H and Shift+H keys.
The add-on only works in NVDA view mode and does not copy anything to the clipboard.
The report is built from the NVDA object model of the IA2 and Web attributes, as well as a short chain of parent elements.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the HTML Element Inspector category.

linksManagement.description:
Links Management is an add-on for NVDA that improves navigation in view mode when screen view is disabled.
It is enabled at the user's request in the settings.
When the add-on is active, each link behaves as a separate row for navigation with up and down arrows.
Trailing punctuation marks are intelligently attached to the reference string.
This avoids the appearance of empty lines or lines consisting only of punctuation marks.
The add-on is inspired by a similar function in JAWS.
• The add-on only affects the behavior of the view mode.
• It is intended for users who prefer structured navigation using links.
• The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu → Options → Settings → “Link Management”.

soat_addoni.description:
The SoatAddoni add-on is a simple talking clock.
When you press the NVDA + I key combination, the current time will be announced in the Uzbek voice of Dilfuza Tokhtakhodzhaeva.
The add-on does not have settings, and there is also no way to change the keyboard shortcut through input gestures.

time.description:
Time - talking clock for NVDA. Announces the exact time by pressing Insert+F12.
Automatically notifies every hour in Persian.
Uses pure WAV files for clear, synth-independent sound.
Easy setup via NVDA menu.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Talking Clock category.

ButtonWithoutRole.description:
ButtonWithoutRole is a small addition for NVDA that removes the “button” role declaration for all interface elements.
The add-on simply clears the text label of the button's role in the NVDA system.
After activating the add-on, the screen reader will stop saying the word “button” when focusing on any buttons.
This can be useful for speeding up work with interfaces where buttons are already obvious.
And also to reduce speech load during frequent interaction with buttons.
The add-on has no settings and works immediately after installation.
To disable it, simply uninstall the add-on or disable it in the add-on store.

CMDPiper.description:
CMD Piper is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to execute Windows command line commands in a fully accessible interface.
Instead of interacting directly with the command line, all input and output is processed through available text fields.
To open the interface, use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+C.
• Command output is displayed in a readable text field.
• Built-in search for output text is available.
• Supports saving output for later use.
• The history of commands is maintained as in a regular terminal.
Interactive programs and TUI applications such as Vim or Nano are not supported.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the "CMD Piper" category.
Note: The add-on interface is not connected for localization.

BeepOnQuotes.description:
BeepOnQuotes is an add-on for NVDA that produces a short beep when quoting quotes.
It helps to visually track the boundaries of quotes and direct speech by ear.
The add-on handles the following types of quotes: “ » “ ” “ » „ “.
If desired, you can also include apostrophe handling in your padding code.
• To enable or disable the signal, use the keyboard shortcut Control+Alt+E (for Russian layout) or Control+Alt+' (for English layout).
• The add-on works in the background and does not affect the normal operation of the speech synthesizer.
• When you say a quotation mark, you will hear a short beep with a frequency of 7040 Hz.
• The signal is sent only when the text is actually spoken and not when navigating by symbols.
• The signal enable state setting is saved in the add-on configuration file.
The supplement is especially useful when reading texts with a lot of dialogue and quotations.
It allows you to better navigate the structure of speech without being distracted from the main content.
The keyboard shortcut for turning it on and off can be changed in input gestures, in the “BeepOnQuotes” category.

markdownNavigator.description:
Markdown Navigator is an add-on for NVDA that makes editing and navigating Markdown documents much easier.
It allows you to use keyboard shortcuts to navigate between different markup elements such as headings, lists, tables, code blocks, links and inline formatting directly in editable text areas (Notepad, VS Code, web editors).
Activated by NVDA+Shift+Spacebar, it provides intuitive controls similar to NVDA's browse mode, but optimized specifically for Markdown.
This saves time and reduces the need to manually move the cursor, making working with complex documents quick and convenient.

layeredCommands.description:
The LayeredCommands add-on for NVDA implements a layered command interface.
It provides alternative access to many of NVDA's keyboard shortcuts.
The main purpose of the add-on is to simplify the transition from JAWS to NVDA.
JAWS users will have access to more familiar keyboard shortcuts.
To activate multi-level command mode, press NVDA + Alt + Spacebar.
When activating and exiting the mode, sound signals are played.
While in multi-level command mode, press one of the available keys to perform an action.
Pressing any other key will exit the mode.
At any level, press the Slash (/) key to open a list of available commands.
• At the first level, commands are available to control the screen curtain for reading the clipboard, muting the sound, speech log, notifications, speech modes, as well as activating the table level and volume.
• The table level allows you to move through cells, rows and columns, read rows and columns, and switch between tables.
• The volume level gives access to the sound separation settings for selecting a sound card, as well as adjusting the volume of NVDA and system sound.
The add-on helps JAWS users quickly get used to NVDA while maintaining familiar control logic.
All functions of the add-on are described in the reference manual.
Note: Lists of available commands cannot currently be localized due to incorrect implementation.

easyTableCopy.description:
EasyTableCopy is an add-on for NVDA designed to solve a common problem: copying tables from the Internet or lists from Windows into documents (Word, Excel, Outlook) without losing formatting, borders or structure.
Key features:
• Two copy modes: “Standard” (preserves the design) and Reconstructed (guarantees the structure).
• Smart selection: copy non-adjacent rows or specific columns.
• Desktop and Explorer support: convert file lists into tables, copy individual columns or combinations thereof.
• Copying the contents of a single cell without the table structure.
• Table Statistics: Instant information about the number of rows and columns in any location.
• Audio feedback: sounds and voice messages about the copying process.
The add-in is automatically disabled in Excel to prevent conflicts and works efficiently with large tables, using smart sampling to quickly calculate statistics.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Easy copying of tables” category.

genesis.description:
Genesis is an add-on for NVDA that makes it easier to create new add-on projects.
It provides a fully accessible graphical interface for defining initial metadata.
The add-on automatically generates the correct project structure based on the official NVDA community template.
If desired, Genesis can create a remote repository on GitHub using the official template.
• Intuitive and accessible interface.
• Automatic completion of basic metadata.
• Ability to include documentation and localization folders.
• Ability to clone the official NVDA repository.
• Optional integration with GitHub for repository publishing.
• Dedicated settings panel in NVDA.
The add-on is intended for beginner developers who want to create their first add-on.
And also for experienced developers who want to speed up the launch of new projects.
Genesis uses the official NVDA template as a base and is compatible with the official build system.
Remote publishing of a repository is optional and requires setting up a GitHub access token.
All metadata is automatically applied to the buildVars.py file.
To activate Genesis, use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Alt+G.
You can read about other features of the add-on in the reference manual.

KoruzBiz_Murcr.description:
KoruzBizMurCr is a fully accessible add-on for the MurCr app.
MurCr is an audio and video trimming, creating and converting application designed for blind users.
This NVDA add-on acts as a bridge between NVDA and MurCr.
It allows you to trim files, split them into equal parts, convert them to different formats, or create a video using any selected image.

stopwatch.description:
The Stopwatch add-on adds stopwatch functionality to NVDA with the following features.
Countdown of progress of seconds: by speech, sound or silently.
Several options for selecting the interval for notification by speech or sound.
Control the stopwatch from virtual mode using single-letter commands or using separate shortcuts.
You can start virtual mode by pressing the key combination NVDA+F7.
All features and functions of the add-on are described in detail in the help.

ProgressIndicatorInterval.description:
ProgressIndicatorInterval is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to configure the progress indicator update interval.
You can control how often NVDA will announce or beep when progress is changing in various operations (downloading files, installing programs, copying data, etc.).
Set the interval to 1%, 2%, 5% or 10% in the settings, or quickly switch between intervals using hotkeys.
Adjust the pitch of the progress beep (from 20 to 1000 Hz).
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+WindowsI - Switch between different progress bar intervals.
NVDA+Control+Windows+I - Show ProgressIndicatorInterval settings
You can change or delete the keyboard shortcut depending on your preferences.
The first shortcut is located in the “Speech” category, the second shortcut in the “Configuration” category.

Pomodoro.description:
Pomodoro is an add-on for NVDA's screen reader that implements the Pomodoro technique to help users manage their work time and breaks effectively.
The Pomodoro technique involves dividing your work time into blocks (traditionally 25 minutes) separated by short breaks.
This add-on is ideal for users who want to increase their productivity and better manage their time when using NVDA.
Once activated, the add-on allows the user to start, pause, resume or stop the Pomodoro timer using special keyboard shortcuts. In addition, it provides audio and speech feedback at the beginning and end of each work or break session.
The add-on automatically manages work and rest cycles, including long breaks after every four completed work cycles.
In the add-on settings, you can choose predefined alternative methods or configure your own.
Keyboard commands must be assigned independently in the Input Gestures settings under the Pomodoro category.

EnteringQuotationMarks.description:
The EnteringQuotationMarks add-on adds input gestures for quickly entering the next quotation marks.
": left quotation mark herringbone.
": right quotation mark herringbone.
“: left double quote.
”: right double quote.
': left single quote.
’: right single quote.
„: left quote foot.
‚: lower single quote.
For entering each character in input gestures, corresponding shortcuts are available in the Typing Quotes category without assigned keyboard shortcuts.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

subtitle_reader.description:
The SubtitleReader add-on supports reading subtitles using NVDA when the focus is on the video player on the site.
Support Netflix, Disney+, Youtube, KKTV and other websites.
Support for common browsers.
Automatically search for CC subtitles on a web page.
Voice and braille output.

TCA-Portapapeles.description:
The TCAPapapeles add-on for NVDA provides voice and audio guidance for operations with the clipboard.
• It announces keystrokes to copy, cut, paste, undo, repeat, and highlight all text.
• Built-in clipboard history allows you to save copied text fragments and files.
• You can assign a gesture to quickly open the history dialog and insert any item from the list.
• The add-on supports statistics of the selected text (number of characters, words, lines and paragraphs).
• Using a special dialog, you can copy individual words or parts of text to the clipboard.
• Game mode automatically translates text copied from the game into the selected language.
• All functions of the add-on can be flexibly configured: enable or disable voice messages and sounds.
Note:
TCAPortapapeles is not compatible with other similar addons such as Fake Clipboard Announcement, Clipspeak and the like.
You can read about all the features of the add-on in the reference manual.

GestorDePomodoros.description:
GestorDePomodoros is an NVDA screen reader add-on that implements the Pomodoro technique to help users manage their work time and breaks effectively.
The Pomodoro technique involves dividing your work time into blocks (traditionally 25 minutes) separated by short breaks.
This add-on is ideal for users who want to increase their productivity and better manage their time when using NVDA.
Once activated, the add-on allows the user to start, pause, resume or stop the Pomodoro timer using special keyboard shortcuts. In addition, it provides audio and speech feedback at the beginning and end of each work or break session.
The add-on automatically manages work and rest cycles, including long breaks after every four completed work cycles.
Keyboard commands must be assigned independently in the Input Gestures option in the NVDA Options menu. Options can be found in the Pomodoro Manager category.

simpleCopy.description:
The SimpleCopy add-on for NVDA expands your ability to capture text, links, and voice messages.
• URL Capture:
A single click copies the address of the current page.
Double-clicking copies the URL of the hyperlink under the cursor.
• Working with text:
A single click copies the selection or adds it to the existing contents of the buffer.
Double tapping clears the clipboard.
• Speech history management:
A single press copies the last message NVDA spoke.
Double-clicking adds the last speech to the buffer.
A triple press copies the entire accumulated speech history.
A quadruple press opens the speech recording file for viewing.
All actions are accompanied by voice confirmation.

tabelaBrasileirao.description:
Tabela Brasileirão is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to view the Brazilian Serie A standings with full accessibility.
The data is obtained from the website www.sentidodabola.com.br.
To open a table, use the standard keyboard shortcut Control+Shift+T.
Inside the table window, a Refresh Table button is available to force the data to refresh.
The add-on uses the cache for 30 minutes, which speeds up opening and saves Internet traffic.
The following hotkeys are available in the list of commands for quickly viewing statistics.
• Up and down arrows move through the list with beeps at the beginning and end.
• The F1 key opens help with a list of all hotkeys.
• V shows the team's number of wins.
• E shows the number of ties.
• D shows the number of lesions.
• S displays the difference between goals scored and goals conceded.
• J shows the number of matches played.
• P displays the number of goals scored.
• C shows the number of goals conceded.
• A displays the percentage of points scored.
You can change the keyboard shortcut to open the add-on in the NVDA menu: Options - Input Gestures - Tabela Brasileirão.

IBMTTS.description:
The IBMTTS add-on is an IBMTTS synthesizer driver for NVDA.
This add-on makes NVDA compatible with the IBMTTS synthesizer.
We cannot distribute IBMTTS libraries. So it's just a driver.
What is the IBMTTS synthesizer?
ViaVoice TTS is a text-to-speech engine developed by IBM that synthesizes the textual representation of human language into speech.
Although this driver is compatible with the Eloquence libraries (since Eloquence has the same api as IBMTTS), using Eloquence with this driver is not recommended due to licensing issues. Before using synthesis libraries with this driver, it is recommended that you first obtain license usage rights.
Everything is described in detail in the documentation for the add-on.

ime_expressive.description:
The ImeExpressive add-on significantly improves the Chinese input experience in NVDA.
It is fully compatible with the habits of blind users and improves typing efficiency.
• Automatic pronunciation of all candidate hieroglyphs.
• Support for explanation of candidate values ​​with depth adjustment.
• Function of entering words by letter for speed dialing.
• Navigate through candidates directly in the editing area.
• Spoken confirmed text after pressing the space bar.
• Simplified voiceover of switching input modes and layouts.
The add-on supports modern versions of Sogou Pinyin, QQ Pinyin, Weasel (RIME), Microsoft Pinyin and Microsoft Wubi input methods.
In the settings, you can flexibly adjust the hieroglyph explanation mode, including full or partial explanation.
You can customize keys to select candidates by letter and to navigate through the list of candidates.
An option is available to spell English words in English input mode.
You can read about other features of the add-on in the help.

RadikTimeAnnouncer.description:
The RadikTimeAnnouncer add-on automatically announces the current time every 30 minutes.
The dubbing takes place using recorded samples in Russian:
Male voice Radik.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation.
Note:
If the sounds being played are too loud for your hearing, try the following:
In the NVDA settings, in the “Audio” panel, disable the option “The volume of NVDA sounds corresponds to the volume of speech” and in the next field “The volume of NVDA sounds” set the desired level, for example 20.

controlTypeBeforeLabel.description:
The ControlTypeBeforeLabel add-on allows you to flexibly customize the order in which controls are declared in NVDA: the element type and its state can be announced before the label.
This is especially useful in dialog boxes with many checkboxes, radio buttons, or menu items, where this sequence improves the efficiency of checking and adjusting options.
You can choose from several ad formats: full (type, state, label), shortened (state and label only), or disable padding for certain element types.
Settings are applied globally or individually for specific application profiles.
The addition also allows you to shorten the standard names of types and states of elements (for example, Checkbox → Flag.) for more compact pronunciation.
Settings are managed through the active profile settings dialog or directly editing the INI file.

jalaliDateAnnouncer.description:
The JalaliDateAnnouncer add-on adds a keyboard shortcut to announce the current solar date to NVDA.
You can listen to the solar date using the keyboard shortcuts NVDA + Control + Shift + F12.
You can change the keyboard shortcut using input gestures, in the subsection Announcing the solar date, Saying the current solar date.

Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA - Engines.summary: Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA Engines
Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA - Engines.description:
AcapelaTTSVoicesForNVDAEngines addon for Acapela TTS voices as NVDA addons.
Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA adds high-quality, high-performance voices to your NVDA screen reader.
High quality and high performance versions of voices available in many languages
Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA includes voices in two versions:
Over 131 high-quality voices in 32 languages: more realistic sound for long reading sessions.
Over 40 Colibri voices in 25 languages: a highly efficient version with high legibility and high reading speed.
Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA comes as an add-on to NVDA and is installed and managed directly from the NVDA interface.
Each license allows you to install Acapela TTS Voices for NVDA on up to three computers.
WHAT IS COLIBRI AND HIGH QUALITY VOICES?
The high-quality version of the voice has a clearer and more pleasant timbre.
Colibri's voice is a bit more robotic, but reads much better at higher speaking speeds.
To use these speech synthesizers, you must purchase a license from the developer at acapela-nvda.com.
The trial version is fully functional and provides access to all voices and functionality for 15 days. Once the license is activated, the trial version will turn into a full version.

Unspoken-ng.description:
The Unspoken NG add-on for NVDA provides spatial audio when navigating the interface.
• It plays 3D sounds as you move focus across controls.
• The add-on helps you navigate the screen without having to rely solely on the narrator's voice.
• A separate “unspoken” category appears in the NVDA settings to control sounds.
• You can turn sound effects on and off as you wish.
• You can also customize the declaration of control types along with sounds.
• Reverb options are available to change the acoustic environment.
The add-on is ideal for users who value auditory feedback when working with a computer.

addonPackager.description:
The AddonPackager add-on adds the following set of features to easily manage NVDA add-ons.
Plugin packer.
Installer for several add-ons.
Removing add-ons.
Enable/disable add-ons.
Changing the manifest, installed and from an uninstalled file.
Create/restore backups of NVDA settings.
Add-on documentation.
All areas are user friendly and time saving compared to NVDA's native add-on store (add-on manager).
Support for the add-on was transferred to another developer, and the name was also changed to AddonsTools.
The add-on called AddonPackager has been discontinued by its original developer.

EnhancedPhoneticReading.description:
The EnhancedPhoneticReading add-on improves NVDA's built-in lazy characterization feature.
It allows you to adjust the delay before pronouncing the phonetic description of the character.
In the speech settings, an input field appears under the “Delayed character description” checkbox.
You can set the delay from 0 to 5000 milliseconds.
If set to 0, NVDA will speak the phonetic description instantly instead of the character itself.
For example, instead of the letter “A” you will immediately hear “Anna”.
This speeds up comprehension when reading text.
With a delay of 1 to 5000 milliseconds, the character itself is spoken first.
Then, after the specified time, its phonetic description is heard.
This delay helps to avoid unnecessary descriptions when quickly moving through the text.
For characters without a phonetic description, standard speech rules apply.
This ensures compatibility with other add-ons.
The delay setting is global for all speech synthesizers.
NVDA configuration profiles can be used for different synthesizers.
All features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

Banking4W.description:
The Banking4W add-on improves the availability of the Banking4 program of the same name.
The addition improves navigation through the portfolio and turnover table.
About the improvements:
The character for "carriage return and line feed" was sometimes displayed in braille, which has been fixed.
The Inventory and Turnover table now displays only the contents of the current table cell when you change cells using the up/down arrows.
These cells now have two new functions:
n displays the column name (amount, purpose, etc.).
z Prints which line you are on and reads the entire line.
In the Help, the developer offers recommendations for optimal display with Braille and speech.

acapelaTTSEditingByAlaqsaVoice.description:
Addition AcapelaTTSEditingByAlaqsaVoice for Acapela TTS speech synthesizers in the form of separately connected Infovox3 voices.
The driver does not support switching languages. Can only work with one selected speech synthesizer.
You can download voices and read detailed connection instructions on the following page:
https://nvda.ru/acapela-infovox3

VoskTTS.description:
VoskTTS driver for standalone speech synthesizer, open source.
Models can be installed as separate add-ons.
The model used by the engine can be selected from the NVDA → Tools → Vosk TTS Settings menu.
In the synthesizer selection dialog it is called “Vosk TTS”.
Voice models require high computing resources.
The driver only works on 64-bit NVDA.
Models can be downloaded from the RuStore add-on store.
Some useful information is collected in the add-on help.

MultiLang.description:
MultiLang is a virtual speech synthesizer.
The add-on works as a driver with various installed types of speech synthesizers.
The driver switches between languages ​​of different types of synthesizers.
The addition is still in development.
More details about the features and settings can be found in the help.
It also answers some questions that early users had.

TonesVolume.description:
The TonesVolume add-on provides the ability to adjust the volume of NVDA tones, such as progress bar sounds, mouse cursor movement, caps, and more.
The corresponding volume slider is located in the Tones Volume category of the NVDA settings dialog.

LaconicExplorer.description:
The LaconicExplorer add-on disables phrases (View items in a list) in Explorer.
By default, NVDA always reports this phrase when opening a folder, whenever you enter or exit a folder to a previous level. Only after this phrase does NVDA report the name of the first object in the folder.
If you work a lot with folders, many times go from other windows to the Explorer window with an open folder, then without the phrase “View items in a list” this will be much more pleasant.
NVDA will immediately report the name of the file or folder that receives focus.
Initially, NVDA does not have an option to disable this phrase.
The following verbosity is disabled.
Phrase: (View list items).
Message of the path from the address bar to the destination folder, if this feature is enabled in Windows settings, in the folder properties. 
Some hints for the buttons on the taskbar.
The add-on does not have settings or input gestures.

potplayer.description:
The PotPlayer add-on adds keyboard shortcuts with which you can find out the elapsed and total time of the track being played.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+E - Reports the elapsed time.
NVDA+Control+T - Reports the total time.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the PotPlayer subsection.
Messages, including subtitles, should be read automatically, unless, of course, they are checked in the Narrator section of the player settings dialog.
To disable/enable automatic reading, use the NVDA command to switch reading dynamic changes (default NVDA+5).

HelperScripts.description:
The HelperScripts add-on is a collection of the following simple helper scripts.
Selects or copies text under the view cursor.
Calls the NVDA log viewer.
Takes a screenshot of the current navigator object.
Copies the last spoken phrase to the clipboard.
Opens a dialog box containing the text of the current window for easy viewing.
Switches speech modes between off and speech. If disabled, NVDA will always be silent. If there is speech, then NVDA will speak as usual.
Switches the punctuation level in the opposite direction.
Shows the speech viewer.
Clicks with the left mouse button at the viewing cursor position.
Reports the selected text. When double-clicked, it reads it character by character.
Reports the value of the current navigator object. When double-clicked, it copies this value to the clipboard.
Reports the name and version of the application. Double clicking copies this information to the clipboard.
Reports the position of an element in a group.
Reports the latest value of the progress bar.
Reports the latest tooltip.
Reports the clipboard text. When double-clicked, it reads it character by character. Triple-clicking opens this text in a separate window.
Reports the number of characters and words in selected text or text from the clipboard. When double clicked, reads this text. A triple click opens it in a separate window.
Windows sleep mode.

TextFragments.description:
The TextFragments add-on provides a set of commands for reading and highlighting various pieces of text around the system caret or the browse mode virtual cursor.
All of these commands can be found in the Text Fragments category of the NVDA (Input Gestures) dialog.
The user must independently assign free keyboard shortcuts to the commands he needs.

DesktopFocus.description:
The DesktopFocus add-on, when NVDA starts, automatically moves system focus to the list of desktop icons.
This add-on also provides a command to quickly go to the desktop from anywhere.
You can assign the desired keyboard shortcut to this command in the “System Focus” category of the NVDA “Input Gestures” dialog.
The add-on does not have any other settings.

MouseLock.description:
The MouseLock add-on locks/unlocks the mouse.
The addon, when enabled, blocks all mouse events unless they were generated by NVDA itself.
The only settings include the Control+Windows+M key combination to temporarily disable the lock.
The combination can be changed in the “Miscellaneous” category of the “Input Gestures” dialog, the “Locks/unlocks the mouse” shortcut.

YandexSpeller.description:
The YandexSpeller add-on checks spelling using the Yandex spell check service.
Before use, you must assign a keyboard shortcut in Input Gestures, Miscellaneous, Spell Check.
After pressing the assigned key combination, the add-on will check the spelling of the selected text.
If there is no selected text, the text being checked will be taken from the clipboard.
If errors are found in the source text, the corrected text will be read and placed on the clipboard.
If you checked the selected text, then using Control+V you can immediately make a replacement.
An Internet connection is required for the add-on to work.

OnlineLibrary.description:
The OnlineLibrary add-on adds convenient reading of the status bar in the OnlineLibrary program of the same name for listening to audiobooks on Windows.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+E - find out the elapsed time of the current fragment.
NVDA+Control+T - find out the total duration of the current fragment.
NVDA+Control+F - find out the number of the current fragment and the total number of fragments in the book.
NVDA+Control+P - find out the percentage of the entire book listened to.
All combinations can be reassigned to your own in the “OnlineLibrary” category of the “Input Gestures” dialog.
Please note that the Input Gestures dialog must be opened from the program window.

ContextGestures.description:
The ContextGestures add-on allows you to view a list of available NVDA gestures for the current context.
• Activate the help layer using the NVDA+H key.
• Press 1 to view commands for the current object, application module, and general NVDA commands.
• Press 2 to view commands specific to the current process or application.
• Press 3 to view all collected commands.
The report opens in a convenient HTML format with grouping by categories and displaying assigned gestures.
The NVDA+H shortcut can be changed in Input Gestures, under the Tools category for the shortcut "Activates the Gesture View Command Layer".

odtwarzaczeksplorer.description:
The Odtwarzacz Eksplorer add-on automatically plays audio and video files in the background when you receive focus on a file in Windows Explorer, standard file selection dialogs or Total Commander.
When focus moves to another file, the previous playback stops.
You can enable continued playback after changing the window in the add-on settings.
The add-on uses the built-in mpv.exe engine, controlled via JSON IPC, and does not require a separate installation of the player.
To open the settings panel, go to the NVDA menu: Options - Settings - Explorer Player.
The default keyboard shortcut to turn background playback on or off is NVDA+Shift+P.
You can change this combination or assign additional commands in the NVDA section: Settings - Input Gestures - Explorer Player.
Additional available commands include play and pause, play and stop, volume up and down, playback fast and slow, forward and backward, and current time message.
In the settings, you can select the default adjustment step, volume and speed, and also adjust the detail of the messages.
All formats that the built-in mpv engine can reproduce are supported.
The add-on also recognizes local playlists with extensions pls, m3u, m3u8, asx and xspf.

SessionTimer.description:
Session Timer is a simple and useful add-on for NVDA that tells you how much time has passed since NVDA Narrator started.
You can find out the exact running time of NVDA in hours, minutes and seconds.
The add-on allows you to get both a full report on the session duration and a short version.
You can also find out the exact startup time of NVDA.
If necessary, you can reset the session timer and the countdown will start again.
All functions are accessible through convenient keyboard shortcuts.
• NVDA+Windows+N reports the full time of the current session.
• NVDA+Windows+Shift+N reports a short session time (for example, “1h 25m 30s”).
• NVDA+Windows+Shift+T reports the startup time of NVDA.
• NVDA+Windows+R resets the session timer.
• NVDA+Windows+I shows information about the add-on version.
In the NVDA menu in the “Tools” section, an “About Session Timer” item has been added, which displays the version, date of last update and information about the author.
Session Timer will help you track NVDA running time and plan your tasks better.

wifiInfo.description:
The WiFiInfo add-on displays detailed information about the current network connection in a separate window.
You can find out the wireless network name (SSID) and its password.
The IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of the computer, the gateway address and the external IP address are also shown.
The add-on performs an Internet connection speed test displaying ping, jitter, packet loss, and download and upload speeds.
The window has a button to copy all information to the clipboard and a close button.
The default keyboard shortcut is NVDA+Alt+N.
It can be changed in the Input Gestures dialog, in the Miscellaneous category for the shortcut Shows network information and performs a speed test.

referenceToneTuner.description:
Reference Tone Tuner is an add-on for NVDA that produces reference tones for tuning your guitar by ear.
The addition does not automatically determine whether a string is above or below the correct tuning.
You listen to the tone, compare it to the sound of your guitar, and manually adjust the tension of each string.
You can open the add-on through the NVDA menu: Tools - Reference Tones Tuner.
The default keyboard shortcut is NVDA+Shift+V.
The following commands are available in the window that opens.
• Keys 1 to 6 play individual strings: 1 - E of the first octave, 2 - B, 3 - G, 4 - D, 5 - A, 6 - E of the large octave.
• The T key plays all strings in a row, starting with the sixth and ending with the first.
• The S key plays a G major chord.
• The M key plays an E major chord.
• The R key turns loop playback on or off.
• The F1 key opens help with all keyboard shortcuts.
• The Escape key stops sound or closes a window.

StudioRecorder.description:
The Studio Recorder add-on adds braille support and additional keyboard shortcuts to American Printing House's Studio Recorder software.
If you have a braille display, the contents of the status bar appear on it in the main application window.
This allows you to see the current time when playing or recording audio and track the position in the audio material.
The add-on shows all the items you have configured to appear in the status bar.
In the Studio Recorder settings (Ctrl+T) on the “Status Bar” tab, it is recommended to check the following items: background progress, message or status, current time, total time and selection length.
The add-on adds the following keyboard shortcuts.
• Ctrl+Delete deletes the entire sound from the beginning to the current position.
• Alt+Delete deletes all audio from the current position to the end.
• J sets the start of the selection.
• K sets the end of the selection.
• Shift+J selects to the beginning.
• Shift+K selects to the end.
• Ctrl+J jumps to the beginning of the selection.
• Ctrl+K jumps to the end of the selection.
• I performs a smooth increase in volume at the beginning (fade in).
• O performs a fade out at the end.
• N normalizes all audio.
If the letter command is also a standard Studio Recorder command, press it twice to perform the original action.
All keyboard shortcuts can be changed in the NVDA Gestures dialog.
Arrow keys are not spoken when pressed to avoid unwanted speech when navigating.

appOn.description:
appOn is a tool for NVDA that allows you to instantly launch applications or switch to already open windows.
The add-on uses intelligent detection of running programs.
If the application is already running, it will be activated and expanded to full screen.
If the application is not running, appOn will automatically find its executable file and open it.
You can assign custom hotkeys for each application via NVDA input gestures.
For quick access, there is a central menu that can be called by the combination Alt+Windows+A.
The menu displays the exact versions of installed applications.
It remains open allowing you to run several programs in a row.
After 30 seconds of inactivity, the menu will automatically close so as not to interfere with work.
Popular programs: office suites, browsers, media editors and system utilities are supported.
Manage your workspace with surgical precision without unnecessary movement or a cluttered desktop.

extendedTotalCMD.description:
The ExtendedTotalCMD add-on improves the accessibility of the Total Commander file manager.
Main features:
More precise definition of the right and left panels.
Sound indication when reaching the boundaries of the list of elements.
Pronounce labels for items in the drive selection window.
Support for working with tabs.
Supports multi-column display mode. (This feature is only available in TC 9+).
Ability to quickly find out the active panel. To do this, press the key combination NVDA + up arrow, or NVDA + TAB.
Full support for 64-bit versions of Total Commander.
Voice actions when selecting elements or canceling them. (This feature is only available in TC 9+).
Ability to find out the number of selected elements. (This feature is only available in TC 9+).
The ability to find out the size of the selected file, or all selected elements. (This feature is only available in TC 9+).
Pronouncing the correct information about the position of an element in a list. For this feature to work, enable the appropriate option in the NVDA settings dialog. (This feature is only available in TC 9+).
It is compatible with all versions starting from TC 7.0, but some functions do not work
only in versions 9.0 and higher.

toastNotificationListener.description:
The ToastNotificationListener add-on for NVDA intercepts Windows system toast notifications.
• Notifications are displayed in a user-friendly interface.
• You can view, read, copy and delete notifications.
• You can save individual notifications or the entire list to text files.
• Configures the format of timestamps in the log.
• Hot keys are provided for quick access.
• Notifications from any Windows application are supported.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the category "Temporary notification interceptor".
NVDA+Shift+Y: Read the last intercepted notification.
NVDA+Shift+L: Open the notification log file (notifications.log) in the default program.
NVDA+Shift+W: Send a test system notification.
NVDA+Shift+T: Opens the notification interceptor interface.
Alternatively, open NVDA's Tools menu and select Temporary Notification Interceptor Pro.
The add-on interface is described in detail in the reference manual.

translateNvdaAddonsWithCrowdin.description:
The purpose of the TranslateNvdaAddonsWithCrowdin addon is to help translators work more efficiently when using the NVDA Addons Translation Project with Crowdin.
• In the options dialog, you can save a Crowdin token and select a directory to store files.
• The main dialog allows you to select the translation language and filter the list of files with the po and md extensions.
• The functions of opening a selected file, downloading a translated file, downloading translations for a selected language or all translations at once are available.
• The download and upload process may take several minutes and is subject to Crowdin token limits.
The features of the add-on are described in the help.

powerTools.description:
Altergo PowerTools is a comprehensive suite of utilities for NVDA users
Version 4 introduces Altergo AI technology
Altergo AI helps identify unnamed controls:
• Element labeling (NVDA+Alt+1) allows you to assign a name to any element in focus.
• Navigator (NVDA+Alt+3) allows you to explore all the controls in the application.
• AI Dictation (NVDA+Alt+7) provides additional interaction capabilities.
The addition greatly simplifies working with applications where interface elements remain unsigned.
Marked items are saved and used in subsequent work sessions.
The navigator allows you to quickly move between elements and obtain detailed information about them.
Altergo PowerTools makes programs more accessible to NVDA users.

LHM_Monitor_Addon.description:
The LHMMonitorAddon for NVDA provides voice access to information about the status of your computer's hardware through Libre Hardware Monitor.
Data is read through a local bridge process without using a web server or network connections.
• Supported sensors:
CPU temperature.
GPU temperature.
GPU load.
Video memory usage.
Rotation speeds of all system fans.
Management:
