NVDA+Shift+9 - Reports CPU and GPU temperatures.
NVDA+Shift+0 - reports the speed of all fans.
NVDA+Shift+- - reports GPU load and video memory usage.
All features of the add-on are described in a detailed reference manual.
It is recommended to read it before use.

IslamicPedia.description:
Islamic Pedia is an add-on for NVDA designed to help blind Muslims.
It provides precise schedules for the five obligatory prayers and optional times (Imsak, Sunrise, Duha) based on the user's location.
• Prayer time notifications with customizable sounds and pre-reminders.
• Information about the direction to Qibla in degrees and cardinal directions.
• Search for the nearest mosques within a 3 km radius with the ability to navigate through Google Maps.
• Islamic calendar (Hijri) with day changes during Maghreb.
• Islamic encyclopedia based on Wikipedia.
• Manual adjustment of the Hijri date to synchronize with visual observation of the moon.
• Selecting a method for calculating prayer times (Kemenag RI, MWL, ISNA and others) and a madhhab for Asr (Shafi'i/Hanafi).
To enter command mode, use the combination NVDA+Shift+I.
Press B or F1 to view all commands.
An Internet connection is required for the add-on to work.
Currently only Indonesia is supported.

winFormsNet48Fixes.description:
The WinFormsNet48Fixes add-on is a prototype and proof of concept.
It restores important accessibility messages for Windows Forms applications on .NET 4.8.
• Fixes navigation in ComboBox: announcing selection changes when using arrow keys in collapsed state.
• Restores the "Checked" and "Unchecked" state declaration for ToolStripMenuItems.
• Returns a declaration of accessibility descriptions for ToolStripMenuItems.
The add-on has no settings.

footballCalendars.description:
The FootballCalendars add-on allows you to view the French football season schedule for Ligue 1 and Ligue 2 using the website "maxifoot.fr".
The add-on adds the “Football Calendars” item to the NVDA “Tools” menu.
When activated, a list of two elements is displayed:
• Ligue 1 Calendars and Tables to view a list of seasons and league table history.
• Ligue 2 Calendars and Tables to view a list of seasons and league table history.
The list of seasons is available starting from the 2010-2011 season and ending with the current season, which is selected by default.
Select a season title to view scheduled matches or a table title to view the standings for the selected season.
For the current season, both played and upcoming matches are displayed.
The current season table is updated to the last played round.
For completed seasons, the final standings are displayed.
There are three display modes available in the settings panel:
• Display in HTML message to display the results in a viewable HTML message.
• Display in a simple message to output results without HTML formatting.
• Default browser display for opening results in a web browser.
By default, the keyboard shortcut “control+shift+f8” is assigned to display season calendars and tournament table history.
You can assign new gestures to launch scripts in the Input Gestures menu in the Football Calendars category.

invisible.description:
The Invisible add-on allows you to mute or change any word, phrase, or pattern that NVDA normally speaks—without changing the web page itself.

Ideal for skipping repetitive text, advertisements, spoilers, profanity, or anything that distracts your attention.
Features:
Hide words completely (NVDA skips them).
Replace words with something else (for example, “Advertising” → “pass”).
Replace obscene language with “***” or any preferred text.
Rules can apply to a single page or to an entire domain.
Full support for regular expressions (regex) for advanced users.
Each site has its own settings - easy to manage and share.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+W - Open Invisible settings from any web page.
The help describes all the functionality of the add-on.

UniversalDownloader.description:
UniversalDownloader add-on for NVDA that allows you to easily download media content (audio and video) from various sites using yt-dlp.
For example, with RuTube, Vk-video, Ok-video, MyMail-video, YouTube, peertube-video and many others.
Features of the add-on:
Support for downloading content from the browser or clipboard.
Supports formats (MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG, MP4).
Flexible notification system (sounds, speech, signals).
Ability to save metadata (description, cover).
Keeping a log of operations.
Automatic or manual checking for yt-dlp updates.
Display download progress.
Ability to interrupt the current download.
View a list of extractors supported by YT-DLP.
In the add-on settings, you can flexibly configure the types of notifications: off, sound, speech, beep.
In input gestures, in the "UniversalDownloader" category, the following shortcuts are available without assigned keyboard shortcuts:
Save from clipboard.
Save from browser.
Copy the list of extractors to the clipboard.
Check for yt-dlp updates.
Abort the current download.
Get download status.
Open the results folder.
By default it is saved in MP3, you can change the format in the add-on settings.
The functionality is described in more detail in the reference manual.

SelectedElements.description:
The SelectedElements add-on reads the selected elements in the current list and allows you to copy the selected text to the clipboard.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+L - Reports the selected items and their number in the current list. Double click will copy the text to the clipboard.
NVDA+Control+Shift+L - Copies the last text read to the clipboard.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Selected Items” category.
If the system focus is not in the list, NVDA will be able to read or copy the last processed text using the add-on; for this, in the add-on submenu there is an item “Copy last read text to clipboard” - this item performs the same function as a shortcut with a keyboard shortcut.
You can select a position for the number of selected elements (Before selected or After selected) in the add-on settings, using the following path:
NVDA Menu, Submenu Options, Selected Submenu Items, Selected Items Settings.

BackupManager.description:
The BackupManager add-on adds functionality for creating and restoring backup copies of configuration files and some directories.
A special feature of the add-on is the function of quickly creating a backup copy of all directories and configuration files directly to the default folder.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+B - Quickly create a backup.
NVDA+Windows+B - Open the backup recovery panel in the manager.
NVDA+Control+Shift+B - Open the backup panel in the manager.
NVDA+Alt+B - Open the backup folder.
All keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the Backup Manager category.
You can read more about the add-on's functions in the help.

AppendText.description:
The AppendText add-on is designed to copy text, but copying occurs by accumulation through the text piggy bank.
That is, you copied a line or a selected area, then you read and move through the text and you also need to copy a fragment of text, in general you copy fragments,
and then in the right place you paste in one fell swoop what is in the text box, and your individual fragments are pasted into the place you have chosen, with each individual fragment you copied will be separated by an empty line.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+C - Copy the selected text to the piggy bank, double-clicking will copy the last text from the system clipboard to the piggy bank.
NVDA+Shift+V - Insert accumulated fragments from the piggy bank.
NVDA+Shift+X - Delete the last added fragment, and double-clicking will immediately clear the entire contents of the piggy bank.
NVDA+Shift+Z - Listen to the accumulated fragments in the piggy bank, if the text is more than 1024 characters, then the number of characters in the piggy bank will simply be reported.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures in the Stacked text copying section.

AddonsHistory.description:
AddonsHistory is an add-on for NVDA that tracks the history of changes to installed add-ons.
Main functions:
Automatically maintains the history of installation and removal of add-ons.
Data retention even after add-ons are removed.
Flexible display settings.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+control+shift+f12 to open the history window.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Add-ons history” category.

Calendar.description:
The Calendar add-on is designed to quickly obtain information about any day of any year, copying it to the clipboard for later use.
To open and close the virtual calendar layer, use the key combination NVDA+` (back apostrophe), also known as the letter (е) in the Russian keyboard.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in the Input Gestures settings, in the Calendar category, for the shortcut Turn on or off the calendar layer.
Commands available in the virtual calendar layer:
Up Arrow or Down Arrow: Increases or decreases the current date by one day.
Left Arrow or Right Arrow: Increases or decreases the current date by one week.
Page up or Page down: Increases or decreases the current date by one month.
Home or End: Increase or decrease the current date by 1 year.
C: Copy the selected date to the clipboard.
T: Return to current date.

AddonsCommands.description:
The AddonsCommands add-on displays a list of all active add-on commands.
Allows you to quickly view assigned gestures and function descriptions.
Features:
Shows a list of all installed and active add-on commands.
Displays the assigned input gestures for each command.
Easy control via menu or keyboard shortcut.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+Shift+H - open a list of active add-on commands.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Tools” category, for the shortcut “Displays a list of commands for active add-ons.”

experimentalBrailleTables.description:
The goal of the ExperimentalBrailleTables add-on is to provide a solution that allows you to quickly view the performance of various braille tables in NVDA without having to overwrite those already included in the kernel.
This way you can make changes to the table, easily check the result and, if necessary, propose changes to the Liblouis repository.
How to use:
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or a graphical interface.
Once installed, go to NVDA menu, Settings, Options, Braille and select one of the experimental tables in the Output Table and Input Table combo boxes.
Next, work with Braille as usual and evaluate the behavior of the selected table.
Unless otherwise noted, all tables provided support input and output.
You can find out about other features in the detailed help.

deltaTalk.description:
DeltaTalk is the first high-quality speech synthesizer for the Portuguese language.
It was created by the Brazilian company MicroPower Software specifically for the Virtual Vision screen reader in 1997.
This add-on is an early-stage prototype that makes NVDA compatible with this synthesizer.
Features:
Support voice, speed, tone and volume settings.
Support for changing the tone percentage for capital letters.
Very light and responsive.
Provides better control over voice parameters such as speed and tone compared to the Sapi 4 version.
Reading is more accurate, without glitches, slowdowns or interruptions.
Installation and use are described in detail in the add-on help file.

RHVoice.description:
The RHVoice add-on is the main module (driver) required for the operation of RHVoice speech synthesizers.
Driver supporting 64-86 bit NVDA.
Without this engine, installed voices will not work in NVDA.
After installing the driver and at least one voice, RHVoice will be available for selection in the list of synthesizers NVDA+Control+S.

todoistNvda.description:
Todoist for NVDA is an add-on that adds the Todoist global task manager to NVDA's screen reader.
• Opening the main window from the Tools menu or using the NVDA+Windows+T gesture.
• View Todoist projects and active tasks.
• Search the current task list.
• Add, complete, reopen, edit and delete tasks.
• Create projects from the main window.
• Opening nested subtasks and adding new subtasks.
• Manage tags using checkboxes and create new tags directly from the task editor.
• View completed tasks and reopen them.
• Receive a reminder dialog when a due date is due.
• Daily summary of today's pending tasks at a configured time.
For the add-on to work, you must specify the Todoist API key in NVDA settings.

hangulBlockSplitter.description:
The Hangul Block Splitter add-on for NVDA splits Hangul syllabic blocks into their component parts (Jamo).
• Allows you to quickly read, describe or copy the parsing result.
• Processes the selected text first, then the current line or character under the cursor.
• Accepts only Hangul characters, non-Hangul characters are ignored.
• Supports splitting of complex letters (ㅘ → ㅗㅏ, ㄳ → ㄱㅅ).
• You can enable or disable inserting spaces between parsed elements.
• Contains a parsing dialog with an input field and an output area.
• Closing the dialog using the Escape key.
• Available through the Tools menu to open without a gesture.
• All commands can be reassigned in the input gestures dialog.
Standard gestures: NVDA+alt+H — speak out the parsed text (double-click copies it to the buffer), NVDA+shift+H — open the parsing dialog.
The add-on settings are located in the “Hangul Block Parser” category of the NVDA settings window.

ToggleNumbersSpeech.description:
Add-on ToggleNumbersSpeech for quickly switching between pronunciation of numbers in full or one digit at a time.
Switch command: NVDA+Shift+8.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in Input Gestures, Speech category, for the shortcut "Switch between reading numbers digit by digit or in full."

spellBox.description:
SpellBox is an add-on for NVDA designed to quickly correct typos while typing.
• It can automatically replace words using user-specified aliases.
• For example, if you set the alias “teh the”, then when you enter “teh” with a space, the word will automatically be replaced with “the”.
• The add-on also supports working with offline Hunspell-style dictionaries.
• When this feature is enabled, unknown words will be highlighted with an NVDA spelling error tone.
• For the last unknown word, you can open a menu with correction options.
• Control is carried out by two commands: NVDA+apostrophe to enable or disable the addition and NVDA+semicolon to show correction options.
• In the settings you can select the language of the dictionary, install or update it, and also configure the list of aliases.
• The padding uses a safe word boundary replacement mechanism and restores the delimiter character after replacement.
• Behavior may vary slightly between applications due to the implementation of editable fields.
• For problematic cases, an alternative method of pasting via the clipboard is provided.
Note: The add-on is still in development, so it does not include the possibility of localization.

TikTokLiveReader.description:
TikTok Live Reader allows you to connect to TikTok live streams and extract data from them in real time.
The add-on records comments, new subscribers, gifts, likes, reposts and visitors to text files that are saved in the Documents\TikTok live folder.
For ease of tracking, separate files are created for each type of event, as well as a general event file, leaderboards among donors and viewers who have given the most likes, and a file with broadcast statistics (current viewers, new subscribers, collected diamonds, etc.).
In the settings, you can select events that will be accompanied by sound notifications, and also enable the function of automatically pronouncing new events.
Navigation through the collected data is carried out using convenient keyboard commands.
The add-on is intended for both presenters and viewers who want to analyze on-air activity without using third-party services.

KeyboardSounds.description:
The KeyboardSounds add-on adds sounds when you press certain keyboard keys.
The add-on plays the following sounds along with pressing a series of keys on the keyboard, such as:
Enter key.
Space key.
Tab key and others.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.
The sound files are located in the add-on folder.

nvSpeechPlayer.description:
The NVSpeechPlayer add-on is a free and open source speech synthesizer prototype that can be used by NVDA.
It generates speech using Klatt synthesis, making it somewhat similar to speech synthesizers like Dectalk and Eloquence.
The synthesizer only supports English, and the following voices are available for selection: Adam, Benjamin, Caleb, David, Robert, Beth, Bobby.
The speech synthesizer is described in more detail in the reference manual.

symbols.description:
The Symbols add-on adds the ability to insert symbols.
Show a dialog for inserting a symbol - keyboard, all layouts: NVDA+control+4.
After opening the list of symbols, press the Enter key and copy the desired symbol to the clipboard. We close the window with the Escape key, because after copying a symbol, the window with symbols does not automatically close.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, section Tools.

minuter.description:
The Minuter add-on provides audio cues during operation: ticking every second, low beeps every second, chime at the beginning of every minute, warning beeps at 55-59 seconds, and audible seconds.
The add-on supports replacing standard sound files with custom ones.
All functions are controlled from a single settings dialog, called by the combination NVDA+Windows+Backspace.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “ Minuter” category.

TCA_SystemUtilities.description:
TCA SystemUtilities is a small add-on for quickly performing various Windows actions using hotkeys or through the NVDA menu.
Allows you to manage power (shutdown, reboot, hibernate, suspend) with the ability to cancel, enter BIOS-UEFI and safe mode with networking support.
Includes system recovery (SFC, DISM), disk cleanup, DNS cache, reserved storage and power management features.
Works with the clipboard: copies paths, file lists, information about the system and sound devices.
Able to hide and show files/folders, restart Explorer, terminate processes, close unresponsive tasks.
Interacts with firewalls and UAC settings.
Integrates with Windows antivirus (quick/full scan, download scan, quarantine).
Contains utilities for quick access to the resource monitor, symbol table, speech and sound parameters, credential manager, file transfer via Bluetooth and other system elements.
Also includes a console launcher (CMD, PowerShell, Terminal, Git Bash) in the current folder with the ability to select administrator rights.
You can read more about all the functions of the add-on in the help.

zUtilidades.description:
ZUtilidades is a set of small but useful tools for NVDA that improve your productivity. Includes two main modules:
Launch applications: Quickly access programs from anywhere. Allows you to add applications (including portable ones), CMD commands, folder shortcuts and installed programs, organizing them into categories. Running as administrator and sorting items is supported.
Quick Notes: Easily create and manage text notes right in NVDA. Notes can be added by capturing the window title or selected text, viewed, copied to the clipboard, and pasted into other applications using hotkeys.
Both modules are equipped with convenient virtual menus for quick navigation and support the creation of data backups. Gestures are controlled through the standard NVDA dialog.
More details about the functionality can be found in the reference manual.

Cuckoo.description:
Cuckoo is an add-on for NVDA that provides regular notifications about the current time.
Flexible interval settings (from a minute to an hour), 6 types of alerts (sound, speech, combinations), 18 different sounds, a quiet hour function and custom phrases.
Accurate synchronization with system time, automatic pause of speech during notifications, support for input gestures.
Cuckoo speech alerts do not interrupt long remarks or reading in the “Say All” mode, but pause and then resume again from the interrupted point.
Ideal for time management and monitoring time throughout the day without having to constantly check the clock.
You can read more about all the features in the help.

zEmoticonos.description:
The ZEmoticonos add-on displays all emoticons and symbols supported by NVDA, allowing you to search for the desired symbols and emoticons, and then copy or paste them directly into the desired location.
You can:
Search for emoticons and symbols in a large list,
Paste to clipboard,
Insert immediately into focus outside of the addition,
,You can write a message in the text field, add symbols or emoticons to it, and find out how many characters are in this field.
Add frequently used symbols or emoticons to your favorites list for quick use, as well as remove from favorites.
Keyboard shortcut:
Unassigned: Displays the zEmoticonos main window.
Unassigned: Displays the zEmoticon favorites window.
Keyboard shortcuts can be assigned in input gestures, in the “Z-Emoji” category.

escritoriosVirtuales.description:
EscritoriosVirtuales add-on for NVDA, providing full and accessible support for virtual desktops on Windows 10 and 11.
Key features:
• Accessible navigation between desktops with voice information
• Creating and deleting desktops (including deleting a specific desktop)
• Moving windows between tables (step by step or to a specified table)
• Pin/unpin windows to display on all tables
• Counting windows on the current table (regular and docked)
• Detailed information about the current window
• Full NVDA integration, easy keyboard control
The add-on uses native Windows APIs for reliable operation and does not require the installation of additional components.
All functionality of the add-on is described in the reference manual.

laprdus.description:
Laprdus is a speech synthesizer (TTS - Text-to-Speech) for Croatian and Serbian languages. It uses concatenative synthesis technology, combining pre-recorded phonemes to create speech. Although it does not reach the quality of modern TTS neural network systems, Laprdus offers high performance and minimal memory consumption.
Laprdus is not for everyone. This is a good choice for those who enjoy the nostalgic sound of retro speech synthesizers from the 1980s and 1990s.
It may not be suitable for users who are accustomed to the high quality voices of modern synthesizers that use artificial intelligence and neural networks. However, Laprdus may be ideal for those who value performance and minimal resource consumption over voice quality.
In short: modern synthesizers offer quality at the cost of resources; Laprdus offers performance at the price of quality.
Note: The speech synthesizer is described in detail in the reference manual.

browsernav.description:
The BrowserNav add-on provides NVDA users with powerful navigation commands in Browse mode. It works in web browsers, as well as any other applications that support NVDA's browse mode, such as Word documents and email clients.
BrowserNav can be used to navigate by horizontal offset from the left edge of the screen, by font size, or by font style.
When you navigate by horizontal offset, you can easily find vertically aligned paragraphs on the page.
Specifically, you can press NVDA+Alt+Down Arrow or Up Arrow to move to the next or previous paragraph at the same offset.
For example, this can be useful when browsing hierarchical comment trees (such as on reddit.com) to navigate between first-level comments and skip all higher-level comments.
When you navigate by font size, you can easily find paragraphs written in the same font size or smaller/larger font size.
You can also target by font size with a limit to the same font style.
To switch between these options, use the BrowserNav rotor. Depending on the setting of this rotor, BrowserNav will signal either the horizontal offset or the font size of the currently selected element. Additionally, BrowserNav will make a short sound when performing Quick Nav commands to show how much text has been skipped (this feature is only available in Google Chrome and Firefox).
BrowserNav works in any browser supported by NVDA. Although some features may not be available in all browsers. BrowserNav also works in other applications that support NVDA's browse mode, such as Word documents and email clients.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

tonysEnhancements.description:
The TonysEnhancements add-on adds the following NVDA enhancements:
Improved table navigation commands.
Copying tables to the clipboard.
Automatic language switching.
Suppress the unwanted "Not Selected" phrase in NVDA.
Dynamic keystrokes.
Beep when NVDA is busy.
Mute the microphone.
Improved mouse features.
Determining the insertion mode in text editors.
Blocks double pressing of the Encert key.
Blocks double pressing of the Caps Lock key.
System priority of the NVDA process.

SentenceNav.description:
The SentenceNav add-on allows you to read text by sentences, rather than by paragraphs or words.
Alt + Down Arrow: Move to next sentence.
Alt + Up Arrow: Go to previous sentence.
NVDA + Alt + S: Speak the current sentence.
Alt + Windows + Down Arrow: Move to next phrase.
Alt + Windows + Up Arrow: Go to previous phrase.
All functionality of the add-on is described in the reference manual.

consoleToolkit.description:
The Console Toolkit add-on improves the accessibility of the Windows console, also known as the Command Prompt. It also works well in Windows PowerShell.
Some features may work in alternative terminals such as Cygwin, PuTTY and Windows Terminal, however the add-on has only been thoroughly tested with the default Windows console.
SSH users may find this add-on especially useful.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

googleDocs.description:
The Google Docs add-on improves compatibility with the Google Docs web service.
The add-on works in overview mode, ensuring the correct operation of quick navigation commands and cursor movement commands.
For example, if you're using Google Docs without this add-on, pressing H will take you to the next heading, but only among those visible on the screen.
This addition corrects this behavior and the H command will now jump to all headings in the document.
For this add-on to work correctly, you must disable the standard NVDA keyboard shortcut, enable Narrator mode, and enable Braille mode.
Everything is described in detail in the add-on help.

taskSwitcher.description:
The Task Switcher add-on provides customizable keys for switching between applications.
Getting started:
Switch to the desired application.
Press NVDA+Control+F12.
From the pop-up menu, select Create a new entry for this app.
Navigate to the Keystroke button.
Click the button and then press the desired keyboard shortcut. For inspiration, try windows+z.
Click OK.
Now try pressing Windows+Z and it will switch you to that application.
All functionality of the add-on is described in the help.

IndentNav.description:
The IndentNav add-on allows NVDA users to navigate by line indentation level.
When editing source code in many programming languages, it allows you to jump between lines with the same indentation level, and also quickly find lines with more or less indentation levels.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

pravka.description:
The Pravka TTS add-on allows you to automatically switch voices and speech synthesizers depending on the type of text: Latin, Cyrillic, numbers, emoji and others.
It is possible to create rules for switching based on marker characters (for example, for text in brackets or quotes).
Works with any SAPI5 and OneCore voices, as well as third-party synthesizers.
Ideal for multilingual users and working with specialized texts.
The functionality is described in more detail in the reference manual.
Note: The developer of the PairSynthesizer add-on has changed the name and concept of the add-on, so it is now called PravkaTTS. Before using the new add-on, the previous PairSynthesizer must be removed.

CloudVision.description:
CloudVision add-on for image description using the latest advances in artificial intelligence technologies.
It works through Google Chrome OCR, PiccyBot and Mathpix to recognize mathematical formulas and equations.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+CTRL+I - get a description of the navigator object or jpg/png file if it is in focus in Windows Explorer. If you double-click quickly, the result will appear in a virtual viewer window, you can read with arrows, highlight, copy, and so on.
NVDA+ALT+F - Recognize the entire screen.
NVDA+ALT+C - Recognize an image from the clipboard.
NVDA+ALT+A - ask the bot a question about the last recognized image.
Analyze an object using Mathpix (for mathematical formulas) - the combination is not assigned, you can assign it yourself using input gestures.
Copy the last recognized result to the clipboard - the combination is not assigned, you can assign it yourself using input gestures.
NVDA+ALT+P - switching prompts (briefly, in detail, your own).
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the add-ons category.
How to use the Mathpix service is described in the help.

pad2.description:
Pad2 expands NVDA's character-speaking capabilities.
Five modes are available using one key (NumPad2 or NVDA+.):
One press speaks the symbol.
Double - gives a description of the symbol (support for Chinese zh_TW).
Triple - Shows Unicode decimal and hexadecimal codes.
Four clicks - a template for a dictionary (not implemented).
Five clicks for the thesaurus (Not implemented).
Automatic braille API detection, localization support, and robust error handling.
Ideal for language learners, technicians, and anyone who needs detailed information about symbols.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Text View category for the shortcut Reports the character under the review cursor. One press - the symbol is spoken, two - a description of the symbol, three - the symbol code, four - a search in the dictionary, five - a search in the thesaurus.”

net_speed_counter.description:
The NetSpeedCounter add-on allows you to measure your download, upload, and internet latency with just one click.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+X - Report Internet speed.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Internet speed test” section.
In the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Settings, “Internet Speed ​​Test” panel, you can select a server to test or Update the list of servers, and also select what information to display: Download, Upload, Ping.

UiNavSoundsExtended.description:
UiNavSoundsExtended is a comprehensive add-on for NVDA that adds sound effects for the keyboard and navigation.
Includes unique sounds for letters, numbers, special keys (Enter, Space, Backspace), arrows and interface elements.
Automatically reduces the volume when NVDA speaks.
Flexible settings allow you to turn on/off individual sound categories and adjust the overall volume.
Does not work on protected screens, does not slow down the system.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the help.

verbs.description:
The Verbs add-on gives NVDA users quick access to French verb conjugations and a list of irregular English verbs via capeutservir.com.
It adds a Verbs submenu to NVDA's Tools menu with two main functions.
The “Conjugation” item opens a dialog for entering a French verb.
After clicking "OK", the add-on displays the complete verb conjugation table in all tenses.
The “Irregular English verbs” item displays a complete list of irregular verbs, indicating the infinitive, past tense forms, past participle and French translation.
In the add-on settings, you can choose how to display the results: in an interactive HTML message, in a simple NVDA interactive message, or in the default browser.
By default, the combination Control+F5 is assigned to call the conjugation dialog, and Control+Shift+F5 is assigned to the list of irregular verbs.
The user can reassign these gestures through the Input Gestures menu in the Verbs category.

StayAwake.description:
A small StayAwake add-on for NVDA that prevents Windows from automatically locking or going to sleep.
Uses a secure Windows API and does not simulate mouse movement or keystrokes.
Simple operation: enable, disable and check status.
Does not affect normal NVDA or system operation.
Automatically turns off when NVDA shuts down.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+shift+control+i: Enables or disables StayAwake mode.
NVDA+shift+control+a: Tells whether StayAwake mode is currently enabled.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Wake up to sleep” category.

Open_Bible.description:
The Open Bible add-on for NVDA allows you to read the Holy Scriptures in various translations (JSON format).
Provides quick navigation through books, chapters and verses, text search, creation of favorites and notes, copying verses to the clipboard.
Basic keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+B.
Translations are placed in the biblias/ folder.
Note: Includes Catholic scriptures in Portuguese.
The author did not implement the ability to localize the interface.

unmute.description:
The Unmute add-on checks the status of the Windows sound system when NVDA starts.
And, if it turns out that the sound is turned off or very muffled, the application forcibly turns it on.
At the same time, the volume level set separately for the NVDA process is checked.
The add-on also checks the status of the speech synthesizer. If there are problems with its initialization, attempts are made to start the synthesizer, which is specified in the NVDA settings.
There is an additional option to check which audio device NVDA audio is output to. And, if this device is different from the default device, the output automatically switches to the audio device installed in the system as the main one.

browserHistoryRemover.description:
Browser History Remover is a handy add-on for NVDA that allows you to quickly and efficiently manage your browsing history across multiple browsers right from the NVDA interface.
Instead of manually opening each browser and searching for cleaning settings, you can select the desired browser from the list and delete its local history in a few clicks.
The add-on supports popular browsers based on Chromium (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera, Brave, Vivaldi) and Firefox (Mozilla Firefox, Waterfox, Pale Moon), as well as SeaMonkey.
Version 2 offers advanced features such as customizable options, saving history backup before deleting, choosing a default browser for instant clearing using the NVDA+Alt+D hotkey, and improved keyboard navigation.
All settings are saved between NVDA sessions.
The add-on checks whether the browser is running and warns the user to close it before cleaning it.
This is a reliable tool for those who value privacy and want to keep their data organized without any extra effort.

InternetUsageMonitor.description:
The InternetUsageMonitor add-on allows users to monitor the usage of their Internet connection in terms of data sent and received.
This tool is especially useful for people who need to track their data consumption over time, whether for bandwidth management or just out of personal curiosity.
Once enabled, InternetUsageMonitor begins tracking the user's Internet connection data usage.
Monitoring is started or stopped using a special keyboard shortcut (Alt + NVDA + W) configured in the input gestures in the InternetUsageMonitor category.
When you start monitoring, you can press the same key combination and it will show the amount of internet used and the time (without stopping the timer): pressing twice quickly will show the data and stop the monitoring.

goldenCursor.description:
The GoldenCursor add-on allows you to move the mouse using the keyboard and save the mouse position for applications.
Control+NVDA+L: View saved mouse positions for the application, if any.
Shift+NVDA+l: Save a label or shortcut for the current mouse position in the currently focused application.
Windows+NVDA+C: Changes the mouse movement units.
Windows+NVDA+R: Toggle mouse limitation.
Windows+NVDA+S: Toggle mouse position message in pixels.
Windows+NVDA+J: Move the mouse to a specific x and y position.
Windows+NVDA+P: Report mouse position.
Windows+NVDA+M: Turn mouse arrows on or off.
Windows+NVDA+arrows (or just arrows if mouse arrows are enabled): Move the mouse.
Note: These gestures can be reassigned through the NVDA Input Gestures dialog in the Golden Cursor category.

sibiac_ocr.description:
The SibiacOcr add-on is a module for the LBL add-on.
The module allows you to use text recognition with the LBL addition.
This module contains TesseractOCR for offline operation.
Must be installed together with the LBL add-on.

Fifteen.description:
Add-on Fifteen - Classic puzzle game "Tag" for NVDA with fully accessible controls.
Includes sound effects, game save system, detailed statistics.
Control from the keyboard and through the context menu.
Tracking time and number of moves.
Autosave when paused.
Ideal for developing logical thinking and entertainment.

contentFirstBrowse.description:
ContentFirstBrowse changes the order of speech in NVDA view mode: content first, then element role.
Easier to read without unnecessary pauses.
In view mode, navigate using the arrows (or other reading commands) to hear the content before the item description.
The add-on does not have hotkeys or settings panel.
It works automatically after installing and restarting NVDA.

LBL.description:
Introducing the LBL add-on for NVDA, developed by ReaperAccessible and offered free to the community.
We have integrated the Sibiac code into LBL.
LBL supports the same plugins as Sibiac, as well as Kontakt full version 6 or 7.
How to use LBL:
Insert the plugin onto the track in Reaper.
In the FX window, select the VST and press F6 to give LBL focus to the plugin.
Use the LBL keyboard shortcuts assigned to this plugin.

In some cases, such as with Native Instruments - Kontakt, if you load an instrument, LBL loses plugin focus after loading. Simply press Alt+Tab, go back to the FX window Alt+Tab again, and LBL will restore control of the plugin.
Keyboard shortcuts for Kontakt 6:
I - Says the name of the loaded instrument.
Delete - Unloads a loaded tool.
O - Sets MIDI to Omni mode.
M - Speaks the active MIDI channel.
N - Loads the next .nki in the folder.
P - Loads the previous .nki in the folder.
Keyboard shortcuts for Kontakt 7:
Delete - Unloads a loaded tool.
Read about the features of the add-on in the add-on help.

winExplore.description:
The WinExplore add-on for NVDA provides convenient tools for exploring and navigating elements of application windows in Windows.
It allows you to quickly find objects (buttons, links, checkboxes, etc.) through a dialog box, explore the contents of Microsoft Office and Explorer ribbons, manage icons on the taskbar, and use alternative navigation through objects - both in classic and scanning mode.
With customizable hotkeys, the user can left-click or right-click items, move taskbar icons, and activate inactive windows.
This add-on can be used on Windows 7-11 operating systems.
Other features of the add-on are described in the reference manual.

proxy.description:
The Proxy add-on allows NVDA to connect to the Internet via
one or more proxy servers.
To make this possible, it applies various fixes to the Python standard library or changes certain variables
environment, depending on the selected configuration.
You'll be able to automatically update NVDA and its add-ons from your corporate environment, and even run remote sessions, as long as your organization's proxy server allows it.

inputLock.description:
With the InputLock add-on, you can lock any input device using just one gesture or key combination.
These gestures can be changed in the Input Gestures dialog.
Do you have children or pets at home?
Do you have a cat and she loves to climb on the table and walk on the keyboard?
Do you accidentally move your mouse to random places on the screen while using your laptop?
Then InputLock is what you need! You can safely leave your computer on.
By installing the add-on, you can lock your keyboard, mouse, touchpad, touchscreen, and braille display.

OBS-Studio.description:
OBSStudio add-on, designed to facilitate interaction with some functions of the OBS-Studio program of the same name, by adding keyboard shortcuts, focusing elements and reading status.
Control + N: Opens a context menu for creating a new scene.
Control + numbers 1 to 9: Focus and report the scene name according to its position.
Control + Shift + numbers 1 to 9: Focuses and reports audio devices according to their position.
Control + R: Starts and stops recording.
Control + T: Starts and stops the broadcast.
Control + P: Pause and resume recording.
Control + A: Open Program Settings.
Control + Shift + R: Reports the recording duration and status.
Control + Shift + T: Reports the duration and status of the broadcast.
F4: Open the folder with the recorded files in Explorer.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the OBS Studio subsection.
Compatible with OBSStudio version 30.2.0.
You can also read about some features in the add-on help.

deviceMonitoring.description:
deviceMonitoring add-on for monitoring system status in real time. Allows you to quickly obtain information about network connections, battery, resource usage and other system parameters directly through NVDA.
Monitoring functions:
Network - connection status, network name, Wi-Fi signal strength.
Battery - charge level, charging status, remaining time.
Memory - total capacity, usage, available memory.
Processor - current load in percentage.
Storage - using the C: drive.
Processes - top 5 processes by resource use.
USB - list of connected USB devices.
Updates - available Windows updates.
System - detailed configuration information.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+I - open the monitoring menu.
NVDA+Shift+1 - check the network.
NVDA+Shift+2 - check the battery.
NVDA+Shift+3 - check storage.
NVDA+Shift+4 - check memory.
NVDA+Shift+5 - check the processor.
NVDA+Shift+6 - show background processes.
NVDA+Shift+7 - check USB devices.
NVDA+Shift+8 - check Windows updates.
NVDA+Shift+9 - show system information.
NVDA+Shift+0 - show NVDA version.
Changing keyboard shortcuts: NVDA Settings → Input Gestures → “Device Monitoring” category.
Note: The supplement is for informational purposes only. To accurately diagnose the system, it is recommended to use specialized tools.

continuousClock.description:
Continuous Clock is an add-on for NVDA that provides automatic voice announcement of the current time at a specified interval (from 1 to 60 minutes).
At the beginning of each minute, you can turn on a short sound signal (“tick”).
Manual time request using a user-assigned hotkey is supported.
Settings are available through the NVDA “Tools” menu or the context menu of the tray icon.
Keyboard shortcut:
Not assigned: Reports the current time when requested.
Can be changed in input gestures, in the "Continuous clock" category.

phoneticPunctuation.description:
EarconsAndSpeechRules is an add-on to NVDA that allows you to play sounds (earcons) as well as other speech effects such as prosody changes.
Previously, this add-on was called “Phonetic Punctuation - Phonetic Punctuation”.
This add-on also includes almost all the features of the Unspoken add-on.
Usage:
Make sure the Sounds and Pronunciation add-on is turned on. Press the key combination NVDA+Alt+P to enable.
Rules can be configured through a dialog box in the NVDA settings menu.
By default, you will have a set of predefined audio rules. However, only a few of them are enabled by default. You can enable other rules and also add new rules in the settings dialog.
The rules are saved in a file called earconsAndSpeechRules.json in the NVDA user configuration directory.
Not all synthesizers support all settings. In fact, there are many synthesizers that do not support many parameters. For more information, see Supported Voice Synthesizers.
Rules can be configured in NVDA settings, in the Sounds and Pronunciation Rules section.
Before using the add-on, review the detailed help documentation for other features and functionality.

BestSpeech.description:
The BestSpeech add-on adds a set of robotic speech synthesizers to NVDA.
The following voices are available in the list:
Fred.
Sara.
Hary.
Wendy.
Dexter.
Alien.
Kit.
Bruno.
Ghost.
Peeper.
Dracula.
Granny.
Martha.
Tim.
Software from Keynote Gold (BeStSpeech).

pair_synthesizer.description:
Pair Synthesizer is a smart engine for NVDA that automatically switches speech synthesizers depending on the type of text: Latin, Cyrillic, numbers, emoji, formatting.
Set up different voices for different languages ​​and contexts.
Complete speech sequence without overdubs.
Supports conditional rules and global speed/tone settings.
Ideal for multilingual users and technical texts.

scintillaIMECaretFix.description:
The Scintilla IME Composition Caret Fix fixes a critical issue in NVDA that occurs when entering text using the Input Method Editor (IME) in Scintilla-based applications such as Notepad++.
Starting with NVDA 2022.1, these editors did not provide correct feedback when typing hieroglyphic characters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean): NVDA did not display the composition line on the braille display and declared “empty” when moving the cursor within uncompleted input.
This add-on intercepts arrow keystrokes, tracks cursor position within the IME composition line, and ensures each character is spoken correctly through the speech synthesizer and braille display, restoring full accessibility to IME users.

quickNotetaker.description:
The Quick Notetaker add-on for NVDA lets you quickly create and manage notes directly from any application.
To instantly create a recording, use the combination NVDA+Alt+N - a convenient window will appear in the upper left corner of the screen.
Notes can automatically retrieve the title of the active window for context.
The built-in editor supports Markdown, HTML preview, and code copying.
Notes Manager (NVDA+Alt+V) provides a tabular list of all notes with the ability to view, edit, delete and export.
The add-on can automatically create and update relevant Microsoft Word documents, saving them to the selected folder.
Flexible settings allow you to control window behavior, text alignment (including RTL languages) and much more.
The ideal tool for taking quick notes while watching videos, participating in online meetings, or everyday work.

nvdaDevTestToolbox.description:
The NvdaDevTestToolbox add-on adds a set of tools for NVDA developers and testers.
Features:
Improved restart dialog to specify additional options when restarting NVDA.
Various functions related to logged errors.
Researcher of object properties.
Tools for working with scripts: advanced script description mode and script opener.
Commands for easy reading and analysis of logs.
Backups of old logs.
In the Python console workspace, a function for opening the source code of an object.
Custom startup script for the Python console.
Command to log the stack trace of the speech.speak function.
Command for reverse translation of interface elements.
You can read more about each function and keyboard shortcuts in the add-on manual.

AppleDeviceInfo.description:
The Apple Devices Info add-on for NVDA allows visually impaired users to quickly obtain information about connected Apple devices.
It scans the current app's interface, finds iPhone data strings, and provides convenient voice commands to access model information, total storage, and available space.
Three hotkeys: NVDA+Alt+D - device summary, NVDA+Alt+S - storage details, NVDA+Alt+R - update data.
Works automatically if information is available in a supported format.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Alt+D: Speaks a summary of the first Apple device found.
NVDA+Alt+S: Speaks detailed storage information about the first device.
NVDA+Alt+R: Updates the device information cache.

RoleSpeechControl.description:
RoleSpeechControl is an add-on for NVDA for selective control of the voicing of object roles.
Allows you to disable speech for certain types of elements (buttons, fields, text, etc.).
In the settings: buttons Select all, Clear all, Invert selection and Select frequently used for convenient management.
Hotkey NVDA+Shift+Delete for quick on/off.
Reduces information noise and adjusts comfortable work in various applications.
The add-on is described in detail in the help.

readLater.description:
The Read Later add-on for NVDA allows you to save web articles for later offline reading.
You can create a personal, searchable library of articles, browse them, and export them in a variety of formats.
Articles are saved locally in the NVDA configuration folder.
Control is carried out through the NVDA menu or using hot keys (NVDA+Alt+D to save the current article, NVDA+J to open the library).
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Delayed reading” category.
Access to the add-on functions is available from the NVDA menu, Tools submenu, “Lazy Reading”.

tussimulatoru.description:
The tussimulatoru add-on is an intelligent navigation key simulator for NVDA.
Automatically detects operating mode (overview or focus) and uses the optimal navigation method.
In review mode, it uses virtual buffer commands for precise movement; in focus mode, it uses standard system keys.
Includes going to the beginning/end of the document, scrolling pages with audio indication.
Simplifies navigation in browsers, office applications and text editors.
You can assign a keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Advanced Key Simulator” category.
The addition is described in more detail in the help.

AudioToggles.description:
AudioToggles is an add-on for NVDA that provides convenient hotkeys for controlling audio.
Allows you to quickly turn on/off system speakers (NVDA+Ctrl+Shift+M) and microphone (NVDA+Ctrl+Shift+U).
All actions are accompanied by voice confirmation.
Ideal for users who often need to quickly mute the sound or microphone while working, calling or gaming.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the Audio Switches category.

speechPacer.description:
Speech Pacer is an add-on for NVDA that structures focus announcements to make navigation clearer.
It replaces the old method of punctuation with actual synth pauses between blocks of information: name, type, state, keyboard shortcut, value, and description of the control.
Offers granularity presets (Short, Medium, Long) and a flexible user profile to fine-tune the details being announced.
The add-on is aware of tables, declaring headers and coordinates, and also handles selected text and element states correctly.
Speech Pacer does not disrupt speech history, braille, or other add-ons.
Settings in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, SpeechPacer “Speech Controller”.
The command NVDA+Shift+P turns the speech control on and off. The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Speech Control category.
Note: The developer did not include all the lines for interface localization.
The add-on is described in detail in the help.

SanamLuang.description:
SanamLuang is an add-on for NVDA Screen Reader designed to automatically correct common reading errors in Thai text.
It helps the speech synthesizer correctly pronounce words distorted due to typos, voice input errors, auto-correction, or incorrect placement of diacritics (vowels and tone markers) after OCR scanning.
The add-on runs in the background using a built-in dictionary and allows users to add their own misspellings.
Using hotkeys, you can quickly correct selected text, enable or disable error reading mode, and also open the settings window.
SanamLuang is especially useful when working with scanned documents and texts from social networks, where deliberately distorted words are often found.
It automatically normalizes spelling, saving time and greatly improving the synthesizer's accuracy and speech intelligibility when reading modern Thai content.
Note: The developer has not implemented the ability to localize the add-on interface.

virtualKeyboard.description:
The VirtualKeyboard add-on emulates a variety of keyboards, including numeric keyboards, rich keyboards, and multimedia keyboards.
NVDA+- (minus sign), toggles the virtual keyboard. Please do not change the keyboard shortcuts as you wish to avoid conflicts with the virtual keyboard keys.
Left square bracket, with the virtual keyboard enabled, switch to the previous mode.
The right square bracket indicates the transition to the next mode when the virtual keyboard is enabled.
The recommended fingering method is to place the right thumb on the m key, the index, middle and ring fingers on the u, i and o keys, and the little finger on the p key.
According to the fingering method described above, operating the virtual keyboard can be easily performed with one hand.
When the virtual keyboard is enabled, you can press the Right Control key at any time to pause or resume the virtual keyboard. Once the virtual keyboard is paused, except for the Right Control key, all other keys are in a resumed state.
For more information, please refer to the help file.

simpleMediaPlayer.description:
Simple Media Player is an add-on for NVDA that provides a user-friendly audio player with a graphical interface.
Allows you to play MP3, WAV, OGG files, control the playlist, volume, rewind, and also set up repeat and shuffle tracks.
There are functions to display the album cover, copy music to the add-on folder, save the last folder and settings.
Control is carried out with the mouse, interface buttons or hot keys.
Suitable for listening to music or audio files directly from NVDA.
Global keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, under the [Simple Media Player] category.
Internal media player control commands are described in the help.
The help is based on the code.

superplusContacts.description:
SuperPlusContacts add-on - allows you to create, store and manage contacts with a convenient graphical interface.
Supports import and export to CSV format (compatible with Google Contacts and Outlook).
All data is stored locally.
Ideal for NVDA users who want a simple and effective way to manage contact information without using third-party applications.
Easy installation and intuitive operation.
The functionality of the add-on is described in more detail in the help.

superCalculator.description:
Super Calculator is a handy add-on for NVDA that lets you perform math calculations right from the system tray.
Supports basic arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and others.
The result is announced by voice and displayed as a message.
The add-on adds a menu item to NVDA and safe computing mode.
A simple, fast and useful tool for everyday calculations.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Super Calculator” category.

WhatsAppAccessibility.description:
WhatsAppAccessibility is a special add-on for NVDA designed to significantly improve the accessibility of the WhatsApp messenger for blind and visually impaired users.
The main goal of the add-on is to make navigation and communication on WhatsApp more convenient and efficient.
Key features include enhanced navigation capabilities with hotkeys: instantly jump to the latest message, chat list and input field.
The add-on improves the voiceover of the interface by automatically adding explanations to the number of unread messages (for example, 3 unread messages).
There are also settings to automatically read new messages and announce chat activity.
The add-on offers a convenient settings menu and supports both major accessibility technologies (IAccessible and UIA), ensuring compatibility with different versions of WhatsApp.
Note: The functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual compiled based on the code.

stateBeforeCaption.description:
The StateBeforeCaption addition makes NVDA interface navigation more efficient by prefacing the declaration of an element's name with information about its type and state.
For example, instead of hearing long label text first, you'll first hear "Checked" or "Toggle selected" and then a description of the radio button.
This is especially useful in dialog boxes with many checkboxes, radio buttons, and menu items where it is important to quickly assess their status.
The add-on is highly customizable: you can choose the declaration format (type and state, state only, or standard NVDA behavior) separately for checkboxes, radio buttons, and menu items.
Settings can be applied globally or individually for different application profiles.
It also supports abbreviation of standard type and state names (for example, "Checkbox" to "Flag") for more concise messages.
Management is carried out through convenient keyboard shortcuts: one opens settings for the active profile, the other allows you to edit a file with the names of states and roles in Notepad.

quickReply.description:
Quick Reply is a convenient add-on for NVDA that allows you to create and use text templates for quick insertion.
Save frequently used phrases, replies or messages and paste them into any input field using assigned hotkeys.
Ideal for helpdesk, correspondence or filling out forms.
Simple control interface, reliable copying via Windows API and automatic creation of input gestures.
After adding a template, a restart of NVDA is required to activate the corresponding keyboard shortcut.

codeHelper.description:
CodeHelper addition for speaking the current line in VSCode.
Many people are used to pressing CTRL+G in VSCode to quickly find out the current line number, but a couple of versions ago the developers screwed up the availability of this dialog, and the line number was no longer announced.
But in the penultimate version they fixed it.
And in the latest version they screwed it up again.
Therefore, here is a simple addon that allows you to find out the line number by pressing NVDA+G.

saveLinks.description:
SaveLinks is a convenient link manager for NVDA that allows you to store, quickly open, and paste frequently used URLs.
The add-on opens using the hotkey NVDA+Shift+Ctrl+A, providing a list of saved links with the ability to edit, delete and copy.
A special feature is the function of automatically inserting the selected link into the previous active window (combination V), which saves time when working with mail, instant messengers or documents.
All data is stored locally, and audio notifications of actions are supported.
Ideal for users who regularly work with the same web resources.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Save links” category.

addressBar.description:
The Address Bar add-on for NVDA adds a convenient address bar for quickly opening websites.
When you press the assigned hotkey, a dialog box appears in which you can enter a URL.
If the address is entered without specifying the protocol (http/https), the add-on will automatically add https://.
After confirmation, the site opens in your default browser.
This is a simple and practical solution for NVDA users who often need to quickly open various web pages without having to launch the browser first.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Address Bar category.

quickNote.description:
Quick Note is a handy add-on for NVDA that lets you instantly create text notes.
By pressing the hot keys, a dialog box opens for entering text, which is automatically saved to the Notes.txt file on the Desktop with a date and time stamp.
Supports multiline input and UTF-8 encoding.
Ideal for quickly jotting down thoughts, ideas, tasks or any other information without having to open separate text editors.
Its simple interface and reliable data storage make it a useful tool for daily use.
The keyboard shortcut is not assigned. The command can be assigned in input gestures, in the “Quick Note” category.

nvda_reminder.description:
NVDA Reminder is a handy add-on for NVDA Screen Access that lets you set voice and audio reminders for specific times.
The add-on adds an item to the NVDA menu for creating reminders indicating the message text and trigger time.
When the set time is reached, a beep sounds, a pop-up window appears, and NVDA speaks the reminder text.
All data is stored locally, no internet connection required.
Its simple interface and reliable performance make this add-on a useful time management tool for NVDA users.

EnhancingWindowInspector.description:
EnhancingWindowInspector add-on for NVDA.
Retrieves detailed information about the active window: name, window class, process ID, executable path, coordinates, dimensions, state, parent window, window styles, Z-order, visibility and accessibility.
An indispensable tool for developers and testers.
Controls: NVDA+Control+Shift+D (full information), W (basic), P (process), G (geometry).
Press twice quickly (within 0.5 seconds): copies information to the clipboard.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Enhanced Window Inspector category.
Note: EnhancingWindowInspector is an extended fork of the original WindowInspector add-on, which had one single function that was retained in the fork in the form of voicing basic window information.

gitlabManager.description:
GitLab Manager is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to manage GitLab repositories directly from your screen reader.
Allows you to view a list of your projects, create new repositories with visibility, license and README settings, and quickly open them in a web browser.
A personal GitLab access token with API rights is required to work.
The add-on is ideal for developers who use NVDA and GitLab in their daily work, providing quick access to project management without the need to switch between applications.

nvdaClipBoard.description:
NVDAClipBoard is a powerful add-on for NVDA that extends the capabilities of the standard clipboard.
It provides an extended copy history with a customizable element limit, allows you to work with text that cannot be selected, and automatically copies the last spoken phrases.
The add-on integrates into the NVDA menu, supports notifications about empty text fields and voice copy/cut/paste operations.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, NVDA Clipboard submenu.

googleContactsManager.description:
Google Contacts Manager for NVDA is an add-on that allows you to directly manage your Google contacts through the NVDA interface.
It allows you to add, edit and delete contacts using simple dialog boxes.
To work, you need to configure access to the Google People API via the Google Cloud Console.
The add-on integrates into the NVDA system tray and supports customizing hotkeys.
All data is stored securely and transactions are performed over secure connections.
Ideal for quickly managing contacts without using a web interface.
The setup is described in detail in the help.

QuickNav.description:
The QuickNav add-on for NVDA provides a web navigation experience inspired by the VoiceOver feature in macOS.
It allows you to efficiently navigate through site content using mostly the arrow keys.
Once activated by the combination Ctrl+Minus (Ctrl+-), the left/right arrows move the cursor line by line through the text, and the up/down arrows jump between elements of the selected type (headings by default).
To precisely select the active element, use the combinations Ctrl+Left Arrow and Ctrl+Right Arrow.
The add-on supports navigation across all standard element types, as well as words and symbols, making web browsing more structured and faster.
It's ideal for users who want a familiar, powerful, keyboard-centric way to interact with content without constantly switching modes.
The command to turn Quick Navigation on and off can be changed in the input gestures, under the Quick Navigation category.

IntelliJImproved.description:
The IntelliJImproved add-on improves the accessibility of the IntelliJ program.
Current features:
When you move the cursor to another line, the line in the new position is spoken.
When the selection changes, it is announced.
When the status bar text changes, NVDA beeps and speaks
This includes reading the error description if the cursor stops on it
Configured in the parameters.
Command to read the status line (NVDA + I).
Command to declare the current line number (NVDA + ALT + L).
When the cursor moves to a line with a breakpoint, NVDA beeps
Configured in the parameters.
The keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on help.

showContextMenu.description:
The showContextMenu plugin adds the ability to call context menus for selected elements in Chromium-based browsers.
It works with elements that support calling their own context menu via the IAccessibleAction mechanism.
To open the menu for the item that has NVDA focus, use the keyboard shortcuts NVDA+Shift+F10 or NVDA+Applications.
The plugin supports the following browsers: Yandex Browser, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera, Brave, Vivaldi and others on the Chromium engine.

passwordGenerator.description:
PasswordGenerator Add-on “Password Generator” for NVDA is a convenient tool for creating and managing secure passwords.
Allows you to generate single passwords 8-64 characters long using letters, numbers and special characters.
Also supports bulk creation of up to 1000 passwords at a time.
All generated passwords are automatically saved to history, from where they can be copied, saved to the desktop, or deleted.
The add-on is integrated into the NVDA system menu for quick access.

LocalAI.description:
Local AI Assistant is a full-featured local AI for NVDA that works completely offline without an internet connection.
The add-on provides an intelligent assistant with learning capabilities, a chat system, notes and data analysis tools.
You can train the assistant by asking questions and answers, create personalized notes, analyze the contents of the clipboard, and read text files.
All data is stored locally, ensuring complete confidentiality.
Includes a backup system, assistant character customization, and usage statistics.
Ideal for users who need a personal assistant without depending on cloud services.
Note: The LocaleAI add-on is a fork from one of the first releases of the NvdaYerelYapayZekaHizmetleri add-on developed by a Turkish author.
The add-on code was translated from Turkish into English, the localization feature was correctly implemented, references and descriptions were made, and other technical corrections were made.

say function.description:
The SayFunction add-on for NVDA provides voice confirmation for basic text editing operations.
It speaks the actions “Copy”, “Paste”, “Cut”, “Undo”, “Redo” and “Select All” when you press the appropriate key combinations (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, etc.).
This gives users instant feedback, increases confidence in executing commands, and improves performance across all applications.
The add-on does not conflict with the standard behavior of the system and works quickly and stably.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Voiceover functions.

unicodeBrailleReader.description:
unicodeBrailleReader add-on for reading Unicode braille as plain text.
The add-on allows NVDA to recognize and speak Unicode Braille characters (range U+2800–U+28FF).
When a braille character is detected in text (for example, when checking spelling), the add-on converts it into the corresponding letter, number or special character using the Liblouis library.
Before the character is spoken, a short sound signal (beep) is generated, which helps the user distinguish braille characters from regular text.
The add-on also correctly handles modifiers such as number sign, capital letter sign, and letter sign.
Perhaps it will be useful to someone.
You can’t disable it yet, and you can’t select a separate table either, it picks up the translation table in the NVDA settings.
After installation, you must restart NVDA.

wordpressManager.description:
WordPress Manager is a professional add-on for NVDA that allows blind and visually impaired users to manage WordPress sites through a convenient graphical interface.
The add-on integrates into the Windows system tray and provides a full set of administration tools: creating and publishing posts and pages, managing comments (approval, spam, deletion), setting up basic site parameters.
Supports working with categories, tags, HTML content and provides a secure connection via App Passwords.
An ideal solution for webmasters and WordPress administrators with visual impairments.

WindowInspector.description:
The WindowInspector add-on helps you check window information.
Usage:
Press NVDA+Control+Shift+D to find out the name and class of the current window.
Note: This is a fork of the original addon. It adds the ability to change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Window Inspector category for the shortcut “Speaks information about the current window and window class.”
And also added the ability for localization.

AdvancedExplorer.description:
The AdvancedExplorer add-on adds the following useful features to standard Windows Explorer.
Create a file or multiple files at once using a keyboard shortcut. To do this, press the combination NVDA + Win + F, enter the names of the files you need, each on a separate line. This way you can create at the same time, for example, ten documents of different formats - text (txt), Word, Python files (py) and others.
Ability to archive the currently selected file or folder using a keyboard shortcut. The default combination is NVDA + Win + Z.
Open the current file in Notepad. The key combination NVDA + Win + N is used.
Open the current file or folder in Visual Studio Code. To do this, use the combination NVDA + Win + C.
Quickly view the contents of the text file. This is done using the combination NVDA + Win + S.
Launch a terminal with the path to the current folder. The combination used is NVDA + Win + T.
Save frequently used folders to favorite locations. Implemented by pressing the combination NVDA + Win + D.
The ability to open your own directory by pressing the Win + E key. To use this functionality, create a folder called “Explorer” on drive D:, place shortcuts to directories that are important to you, and now open it every time, bypassing the standard Explorer start page.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the "Advanced Explorer" category.

smartCaptchaSolver.description:
SmartCaptchaSolver is an add-on for NVDA that helps users complete CAPTCHAs using artificial intelligence.
After setting up your Google Gemini API key, you can press Ctrl+NVDA+H on the captcha page to have the add-on analyze the image and dictate decisions, such as which squares to select.
This makes the web navigation process more accessible.
Note:
Where to get an API key, read the add-on help.
The developer has not implemented the ability to change keyboard shortcuts through input gestures.

visionAccess.description:
VisionAccess is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to obtain detailed descriptions of graphical content on the screen using artificial intelligence.
Users can analyze images, graphs and interface elements using either the local Ollama model or the Google Gemini cloud service.
The add-on supports hotkeys for quickly describing a navigator object or selected element, and also provides notifications about the progress of the process in percentages.
After receiving the basic description, you have the opportunity to ask clarifying questions about the image.
To work with Ollama, you need to install it locally and download a vision-enabled model, while Gemini requires a free API key and an Internet connection.
Provider, model and other settings are easily configured through the NVDA menu.
NVDA+Shift+E - Describe the visual content of a navigation object.
NVDA+Shift+G - Describe the visual content of the object with focus (graphics, image).
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the VisionAccess category.
Note: the developer has implemented the ability to localize the interface, but for some unknown reason the localization connection does not occur. There's probably a bug somewhere in the code.

trackbar_routing.description:
The TrackbarRouting add-on allows you to conveniently control the slider using the braille display routing keys.
You can set the position of the slider by pressing the corresponding routing key on the braille display.
Usage:
Set focus to the slider.
Press the cursor key at the new position.
To set the slider to the minimum value, press the routing key above the first braille module.
To set the slider to 50%, press the routing key above the middle of the braille display.
To set the slider to the maximum value, press the routing key above the last braille module.

unigetui.description:
The UniGetUI add-on improves the availability of the UniGetUI graphical interface of the same name for WinGet and other Windows package managers.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.
Starts working immediately after installation or activation in the add-on store.

PPAWakeUp.description:
PPAWakeUp is a simple and effective add-on for NVDA designed to quickly control the Thai speech synthesizer PPA Tatip.
With just one Windows+P hotkey and a click system, you can instantly perform three basic operations: wake up the synthesizer (one press), open its settings (two presses) or edit the user dictionary (three presses).
This eliminates the need to remember multiple key combinations or search for the right menu items.
The add-on was developed specifically for PPA Tatip users, has a minimalistic design, does not overload the NVDA interface and consumes few system resources.
It's ideal for everyday use, providing quick, seamless access to key synthesizer functions.
To work, you must first install PPA Tatip on your computer.

pcloud.description:
PCloud add-on to improve the accessibility of the PCloud drive program of the same name.
The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

allCapitalTextActions.description:
AllCapitalTextActions is an add-on for NVDA that provides a powerful tool for working with text.
It can convert case, clear formatting, add timestamps, break text into paragraphs, and play content through a speech synthesizer.
The interface includes functions for copying, pasting and saving text to the desktop.
The add-on is launched using the combination Ctrl+Shift+M.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in Input Gestures, under the Text Processing category for the Opens Text Processing Interface shortcut.

clipSaver.description:
The Clip Saver add-on for NVDA automatically saves everything you copy to the clipboard into text files.
Each time the contents of the buffer are changed, a new file is created with a unique name containing the date, time and beginning of the copied text.
All files are saved in a special Volkan_Clipboard_Records folder in your documents.
The add-on works in the background, checking the clipboard every 500 milliseconds, and notifies you by voice of each successful save.
Does not require any action from the user after installation - just copy the text as usual, and everything will be automatically saved for future use.

tiktokDownloader.description:
The TikTok Downloader add-on for NVDA allows you to download videos from the TikTok platform easily and conveniently.
It is intended primarily for blind and visually impaired users, providing full accessibility using a screen reader.
With it, you can download videos in MP4 format, choose the quality (from 360p to the best available), and try to remove the TikTok watermark if necessary.
The add-on automatically detects links from the clipboard or browser address bar, supports background downloads and queues multiple videos.
During the download process, detailed information is displayed: speed, file size, progress and remaining time.
Settings allow you to set the save folder, enable sound notifications, and configure automatic retry in case of errors.
Control is carried out through a clear dialogue or using shortcut keys.
Keyboard shortcuts are described in the reference guide.

youtubeDownloader.description:
YouTube Downloader is a powerful and fully accessible add-on for NVDA that allows you to directly download videos and audio from YouTube.
With it, you can download content in MP3 (for audio) or MP4 (for video) formats with a choice of quality: from 320 kbps for audio to 1080p and higher for video.
The add-on supports cutting fragments by time, intelligent work with playlists (including selecting individual videos), as well as background loading, which does not interfere with NVDA.
Control is carried out through the main window, called by the combination NVDA+Shift+Y or through the NVDA menu.
The link is automatically picked up from the clipboard.
You can add multiple tasks to the queue, stop and retry failed downloads.
For playlists, a convenient selection of specific videos is available.
All downloaded files are saved to the folder you specify.
Note: The author of the add-on has not fully implemented the ability to localize the interface.

googleQuickSearch.description:
The GoogleQuickSearch add-on allows you to instantly perform Google searches directly from NVDA.
When you activate the script (key combination NVDA+G by default), a dialog box opens with a field for entering a request.
When you click the Search button or press Enter, the query automatically opens in your default browser to the Google search page.
The add-on also speaks the entered request before opening the browser for confirmation.
The dialog box provides buttons to start a search, close the window, and go to the developer's support page (Donate).
A simple and fast tool for finding information every day without having to switch to the browser to enter a query.

nvTube.description:
NVTube is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to quickly search for videos on YouTube and automatically open the first video found for playback.
Just enter a query in the dialog box and the add-on will search, extract the ID of the first video and open it in the browser with autoplay.
Works in the background without blocking NVDA, with audible search status and clear error messages.
Supports assigning hotkeys for quick access.

nvLogs.description:
NVLogs is a simple and convenient add-on for NVDA that allows you to view the program's event log in a graphical window.
It adds the “Show NVDA Log” command (the gesture can be assigned manually), which, when called, opens a dialog with the full contents of the log.
The log is displayed in a scrollable, multi-line text box.
If the log is empty, the user will receive a corresponding voice message.
The add-on does not require complex configuration and is useful for diagnosing problems, monitoring events and debugging.
The shortcut for assigning a gesture is located in input gestures, in the NVDA Logs category.

indirTube.description:
IndirTube is an NVDA add-on for downloading video and audio from YouTube.
Allows you to select MP3 or MP4 format via a dialog box using a link from the clipboard or the web browser's address bar.
Launched with a hotkey, runs in the background using yt-dlp and ffmpeg.
The result is saved to the standard downloads folder.
