Before use, you must independently assign a keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “YouTube Downloader” category for the shortcut “Opens the indirTube download dialog.”

shortcutLauncher.description:
The Shortcut Launcher add-on for NVDA lets you quickly launch programs, open folders, and open web pages using customizable keyboard shortcuts.
You can create, edit, delete and organize your shortcuts by grouping them by type: programs, folders or URLs.
For work, a convenient dialog box is provided, called by the combination NVDA+Shift+H, where you can filter the list, launch the selected element, or manage settings.
In the add-on settings, you can select the default browser for opening links, specify the path to the user's browser, and also view the total number of saved shortcuts.
All data is stored in a separate JSON file, which ensures reliability and backup capabilities.

chargingNotifier.description:
The ChargingNotifier add-on is a convenient tool for replacing standard NVDA voice announcements about power status with customizable audio notifications.
It allows you to instantly and intuitively understand whether the device is connected to the network or running on battery power, using clear audio signals.
This is especially useful in noisy environments or when it is important not to be distracted by voice messages.
You can flexibly configure the type of notification: only sound, only voice, or both options together.
All options are easily accessible in a separate "Charging Notification" category of NVDA settings, making management quick and easy.

quickAccess.description:
QuickAccess is a powerful add-on for NVDA that provides quick and easy access to frequently used programs, links, folders, and system functions through a multi-level hotkey system.
The main feature is the shortcut layer (F8 by default), allowing you to instantly launch dozens of preset and custom actions without having to remember complex keyboard shortcuts.
The add-on includes a full-featured control center with search, filtering by type and category, as well as the ability to add, edit and delete items.
Four types of elements are supported: links to web resources, programs and applications, folder paths, and custom commands.
You can organize items into categories, assign custom hotkeys, and even import/export settings for backup.
QuickAccess integrates with system folders (Downloads, Documents, Desktop), provides quick access to disks, popular online services (Google, Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram) and Windows system utilities.
Additional features include a smart welcome message, internet connection monitoring, smart clipboard search, and customizable sound notifications.
Ideal for users who want to optimize their daily computer work and reduce time for routine operations.

enhancedLanguageDetection.description:
Enhanced Language Detection for NVDA automatically detects the language of text before it is spoken and uses NVDA's built-in feature to automatically switch speech synthesis language.
This allows you to correctly voice multilingual content without manually selecting a voice.
The add-on supports two language detection libraries: lingua (recommended, faster and more accurate) and langdetect.
In the settings, you can choose the interpretation mode: always detect the language, do it only if there are no explicit instructions in the text, or disable detection completely (NVDA's default behavior).
The option to detect multiple languages ​​in one piece of text and select specific languages ​​for interpretation from a list is also available.
The add-on is optimized for performance and does not perform analysis if automatic language switching is disabled in NVDA settings.

siamSquare.description:
SiamSquare is an NVDA add-on that provides access to an extensive database of Thai words with definitions of approximately 30,000 terms.
The main functionality includes searching for definitions, checking spelling, selecting similar words, and auto-correcting incorrectly spelled words.
It works through a multi-level mode (Ctrl+F1): after selecting a word, you can get its definition (1), find similar spellings (2), check spelling (3) or open the full Siam Center dictionary interface (4).
The add-on supports adding custom words, editing existing entries, copying words and definitions.
A special feature is an intelligent system of hints when a word is entered incompletely and automatic replacement with the correct option.
Works completely offline, ideal for students, writers and blind users who need precision when working with the Thai language.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, in the Siam Square Thai Dictionary category for the Siam Square Mode shortcut.
The functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

HearthstoneCardLookup.description:
HearthstoneCardLookup add-on for NVDA, which allows users to quickly search for information about a specific Hearthstone card by its name.
Usage:
Highlight the card name text or copy it to the clipboard, then press NVDA + H and the add-on will try to find the card information and display it in a previewable pop-up window.
You can also press NVDA + shift + H, which will bring up a dialog where you can enter the name of the map to search for.

textTranslator.description:
Text Translator is an available add-on for NVDA that provides a user-friendly GUI for translating text and text files using Google Translate.
It allows NVDA users to quickly translate text between more than 130 languages ​​directly within their screen reader environment.
The add-on can be opened by pressing NVDA+Alt+T or from the NVDA menu in the system tray.
The user can enter text manually, paste from the clipboard, or load from a text file.
Automatic detection of the source language and selection of the target language from a complete list is supported, including both common (English, Spanish, Chinese) and regional languages ​​(Kurdish Sorani, Odia, Santali).
After translation, the result can be saved to a file.
Text Translator is designed with accessibility in mind and is fully integrated into NVDA, making the translation process simple and effective for blind and visually impaired users.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Tools” category for the “Opens text translation dialog” shortcut.

GroqSpellChecker.description:
Groq Spell Checker is a professional add-on for NVDA that uses Groq's artificial intelligence to check spelling, punctuation and voice input.
It corrects only obvious errors in the text, without changing the word order and meaning, which makes it a strict proofreader.
The add-on works with selected text in any application and supports the choice of several AI models for speech processing and recognition.
Requires an API key from Groq (free plan available) and a stable Internet connection.
Main functions: spell checking (hotkey NVDA+Shift+S) and voice input (NVDA+Shift+V) with support for 13 languages.
You can configure the model, strict mode, and microphone parameters in a separate NVDA settings panel.
The maximum text length for verification is 5000 characters.
The add-on is intended for users who value accurate editing without changing the content.
The functionality of the add-on is described in more detail in the reference manual.

logViewer.description:
The LogViewer add-on extends NVDA's built-in log viewer, providing advanced log analysis tools for developers and power users.
It adds powerful search with regular expression support, case sensitivity, query history, and results looping.
Navigation through the found matches is carried out using the F3 (forward) and Shift+F3 (back) keys.
The bookmark system allows you to mark important places in the log using Control+F2 and move between them using the F2 keys.
A special feature of the add-on is the automatic backup of logs to the file oldLog.txt with rotation, daily reset and saving of records of previous sessions, which is critical for failure analysis.
After NVDA crashes, the oldLog.txt file can be opened using the combination NVDA+Ctrl+L.
The add-on works regardless of the interface language, identifying the log viewer window by its system descriptor.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Advanced Log Viewer category.

ollamaTranslator.description:
NVDA's Ollama Translator add-on enables fast, private text translation using Ollama's locally running AI models.
It works completely offline after downloading the selected model, which guarantees data security and privacy.
The add-on automatically detects Ollama models installed on the system and supports translation between more than 20 languages.
Key features include instant translation of selected text or an object in focus using the NVDA+Shift+T hotkey, as well as translation of large fragments between set markers (NVDA+Shift+K for start and NVDA+Shift+L for end).
The result is voiced by a speech synthesizer and displayed in a convenient virtual viewer window for verification.
In the settings, you can select a specific model, source and target languages, and configure keyboard shortcuts.
The add-on is ideal for users who need to frequently translate content without using cloud services.

betimleyici.description:
Betimleyici (Describer) is an add-on for NVDA designed to help users with visual impairments.
It uses Google Gemini artificial intelligence to describe visual content.
With it, you can get a detailed description of photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) and video files (MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV), including objects, people, colors, environments and text.
The add-on also automatically finds, recognizes and copies verification codes (CAPTCHA) on web pages to the clipboard.
Supports multiple languages ​​(Turkish, English, German, French, Italian, Spanish) and automatically switches according to NVDA language.
A free Google Gemini API key is required to work.
Basic keyboard shortcuts: NVDA+Control+Shift+X - open the main add-on window for file descriptions, NVDA+Control+Shift+C - quickly solve CAPTCHA on the active screen.
The analysis results are announced and automatically copied to the clipboard.

Format Bilgisi.description:
The FormatBilgisi (Windows Installation Information) add-on for NVDA allows the user to quickly find out the date and time of the initial installation or last reinstallation of the Windows operating system on the current computer.
It reads data from the system registry, extracts the installation timestamp and displays it in a human-readable format in a dialog box.
After launching the add-on from the NVDA Tools menu, a window with information opens.
The user can copy this information to the clipboard for pasting into documents, or save it to a text file on the desktop for later use.
This can be useful for system administrators, technical support specialists, or ordinary users who need to track the history of a system installation, for example, when diagnosing problems, checking that an installation is up to date, or maintaining equipment records.
The add-on does not require an Internet connection and is completely local.

Windows Update Info.description:
The Windows Update Info add-on for NVDA allows you to quickly obtain and view information about the latest Windows update installed on your computer.
Once activated, it displays the update details in a convenient dialog box, including its name, version number, installation date, and other available metadata.
Users can copy this information to the clipboard for later use or save it to a text file on their desktop.
This add-on is useful for users who need to monitor the status of system updates, for example to diagnose problems, generate reports, or check that protection is up to date.
It works locally, requesting data from the Windows registry, and does not require an Internet connection.
The add-on's interface is fully accessible to screen readers and supports keyboard navigation.

MW-word-lexicon.description:
MW Word Lexicon is an add-on for NVDA that provides instant access to the Merriam-Webster dictionary and thesaurus.
Allows you to get definitions, synonyms and antonyms for any selected word directly from the running application without switching to the browser.
Includes a Word of the Day feature to expand your vocabulary, search history, and flexible results display modes.
Supports interactive dialogues with word pronunciation and audio settings.
Works through the official API with a limit of 1000 requests per day.
Ideal for students, writers and anyone who works with texts.
The add-on settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, “MwWordLexicon” panel.
To use the main add-on keyboard shortcuts, you must first press Control+Shift+D to enter the main add-on layer.
While you're inside this layer, tap one letter to perform an action such as getting a definition, showing synonyms, getting the Word of the Day, moving through history, and more.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the help.
Note: The developer has not implemented the ability to localize the add-on interface.

youtube_indirici_pro.description:
YoutubeIndiriciPro add-on for NVDA makes working with YouTube easy.
You can search for videos, process video links and playlists, play content and download it in MP3 or MP4 formats.
A convenient playlist manager is available to organize your media library.
All operations are performed using the keyboard: fast loading using F1/F2, preview using Enter, managing playlists.
Flexible settings allow you to choose video and audio quality, download folder.
Downloads are performed in the background without interfering with your work.
The functionality of the add-on is described in more detail in the help.

game.description:
The Game add-on opens up a world of entertainment for NVDA users.
These are exclusive games designed specifically for the blind and visually impaired, allowing you to enjoy the gaming process without restrictions.
Available games:
Snakes and Ladders (100 cells).
A classic board game where you compete with a robot. Roll the dice, move the piece and be careful of the snakes that can throw you back and the ladders that help you climb forward.
Guess the number.
An exciting puzzle game where you need to guess a hidden number from 1 to 100. The robot will tell you more or less. Test your intuition and logic!
You can launch games from the NVDA menu, Games submenu.
Game of Snakes and Ladders.
Game Guess the number.
Note: The game has wav audio files in Persian.

YouTubeTranscripts.description:
The YouTubeTranscripts add-on for NVDA allows you to receive and read text transcripts from YouTube videos directly in the non-visual access program.
Using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Ctrl+T opens a dialog box where you can paste a link to the video and get the available subtitles.
Functionality includes copying text to the clipboard, exporting transcripts to text files for offline use, and quickly linking to the YouTube website.
This solution greatly simplifies access to educational and informational content on YouTube for blind and visually impaired users, allowing them to work with text versions of videos without having to watch them.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the YouTube Transcripts category.

ktts.description:
A giant Kurdish Text-to-Speech Synthesizer (KTTS) driver.
The driver adds a Kurdish Sorani speech synthesizer.

seros.description:
Seros is an NVDA exclusive add-on with natural Persian and English voices powered by artificial intelligence.
Automatically switches between Ahmad Ganji's Persian voice and Emily's English voice for high-quality narration.
Key features: full control of speed and pitch, built-in dictionary to correct incorrect pronunciations, creation of audiobooks in WAV format from any text.
The add-on makes it easy to manage voice profiles, import new voices, and configure speech settings separately for each language.
An ideal solution for comfortable work with multilingual content.
The add-on is based on the SonataNeuralVoices add-on.

pdfReader.description:
The PDF Reader add-on for NVDA provides accessible PDF reading capabilities for blind and visually impaired users.
This add-on allows users to open PDF files, extract text content, and navigate pages efficiently using keyboard shortcuts and an intuitive interface.
Features:
PDF Import: Open and process PDF files through a simple file selection dialog.
Text Extraction: Automatically extract text from PDF pages for access using Narrator.
Page Navigation: Navigate through PDF pages using the Back/Forward buttons or keyboard shortcuts.
Quick Page Access: Navigate to specific pages using a drop-down list.
Accessible Interface: Fully accessible dialog boxes designed for screen reader users.
Keyboard shortcuts: Full keyboard support for all functions.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Alt+P - Open PDF Reader.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “PDF Reader” category.

ml-shortener.description:
The MlShortener add-on for NVDA allows you to quickly shorten URLs (web links) using the “Marco-ml.com” service.
Shortened links become more convenient for sharing.
In addition, the add-on saves a history of all the links you shorten for reuse in the future.
Features:
Simple URL shortening: Open a dialog, paste a long URL and get a short link.
Custom Names: You can optionally provide a custom name or nickname for your shortened link.
Automatic Copy: Once shortened, the link is automatically copied to the clipboard, ready for pasting.
Link history: All links you shorten are saved in history.
Manage your history: You can view your history, re-copy a shortened link, or delete unnecessary entries at any time.
NVDA Integration: Adds a new MarcoML Shortener menu sub-item to the NVDA Tools menu for quick access.
Hotkeys: You can assign your own keyboard shortcuts to open the shortcut dialog and view history.

WebDataSSML.description:
WebDataSSML is an NVDA add-on for improving the presentation of web content via SSML markup.
Automatically handles special data-ssml attributes on pages, supporting phonetic pronunciation, pauses, letter-by-letter reading, and text replacement.
The settings are located in the NVDA menu → Options → Settings → “Data-SSML” section.
Braille logging, profiling and hotkey options are available.
When enabled, the keyboard shortcut becomes available NVDA+Ctrl+Alt+N to quickly switch between speech synthesizers.
Compatible with OneCore, SAPI5, eSpeak.
For diagnostics, use the NVDA log (entries with the prefix “data-ssml”).
Requires appropriate JavaScript markup on web pages for full functionality.
Note: The developer has not implemented the localization feature for the interface.

dictionaryCleaner.description:
Dictionary Cleaner is an add-on for NVDA designed to safely remove custom pronunciation dictionaries.
Allows you to clear all dictionary files (.dic) from the NVDA folder with the option of prior backup.
Before deleting, it shows a list of found files and asks for confirmation.
Creates a ZIP archive with a backup copy on the desktop and keeps a detailed log of operations.
Access via the NVDA menu → Tools → Dictionary Cleaner.
It is recommended to always use a backup, since deleting dictionaries is irreversible.
The functionality is described in more detail in the help.

Whatsapp_simple.description:
The WhatsAppSimple add-on for NVDA provides convenient hotkeys for working with WhatsApp Desktop.
Main functions: navigation between chats and messages (Alt+Arrows), managing messages (Alt+Delete - delete, Alt+E - edit, Alt+C - view original), recording voice messages (Ctrl+R) and getting information about the chat (Ctrl+Shift+T - name, Alt+I - information).
The add-on automatically clears phone numbers from chat titles and marks forwarded messages.
All functions only work when WhatsApp is active.
Note: The add-on will only work on the native version of WhatsApp Desktop (Latest native version 2.2543.1 dated October 30, 2025).
In a newer web app using Microsoft Edge, WebView2 will not work.

Virtual_explorer.description:
Virtual Explorer is a powerful add-on for NVDA that turns your screen reader into a full-featured virtual file manager.
It lets you create and organize your favorite folder and file paths into convenient categories, giving you quick access to frequently used locations without having to open Windows Explorer.
With intuitive keyboard shortcuts, you can instantly jump between saved paths, explore the contents of folders, perform basic file operations (copy, cut, paste), and even use special shortcuts to quickly access system folders like the Desktop or Downloads.
The add-on supports the creation of custom categories for optimal organization, pinning of important paths and a context menu of actions for efficient work with files.
Virtual Explorer is ideal for users who need quick and easy access to their file system without switching between applications.
All control is carried out directly from NVDA, which makes file navigation as efficient and accessible as possible for blind and visually impaired users.

RayoAI_connector_for_NVDA.description:
The RayoAI Connector add-on for NVDA allows you to quickly send images of interface elements to the RayoAI desktop application for their description and analysis.
Working through NVDA's Object Explorer, the add-on captures the visible area of ​​any element on the screen and passes the path to a temporary file to RayoAI over a local TCP connection.
To use it, just install both applications, launch RayoAI and press NVDA+Shift+K while on the desired element in the object browser.
The add-on will automatically take a screenshot of the screen area and send it to RayoAI.
All interaction occurs locally on your computer via port 16180 (configurable), which guarantees data confidentiality - only paths to temporary files are transferred, and not the image pixels themselves.
The ideal solution for quickly analyzing interfaces, describing images and obtaining information about visual elements directly through the powerful artificial intelligence RayoAI.
Simple integration, complete locality of work and instant results make this add-on an indispensable tool for blind users working with graphical interfaces.

youtubeDownloadHelper.description:
The YoutubeDownloadHelper add-on helps you download videos from YouTube using the Savefrom.net website.
Just go to the page of the video you want to download and press the key combination NVDA+Alt+D.
You will be redirected to the Savefrom.net page where you will find a download link.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the "Youtube Download Assistant" section.
The help describes some recommendations from the developer.
The add-on has no settings.

AddonsManager.description:
The AddonsManager add-on will help return the old functionality for managing add-ons to the new NVDA interface.
As of NVDA 2023.2, the “Add-on Manager” has been removed and replaced with the “Add-on Store”.
Someone might want to remember the interface of this add-on on NVDA 2025 and newer versions of NVDA.
You can open the Add-on Manager dialog box through the NVDA menu, Tools submenu, Add-on Manager.
In the input gesture settings, in the “Tools” category, there is a shortcut “Activates the NVDA Add-on Manager for installing and uninstalling add-on packages for NVDA
 without a designated combination.
For the “AddonsManager” add-on, the code was taken from the NVDA 2023.1 sources.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

CerenceTTS.description:
The CerenceTTS add-on is an updated driver for the Vocalizer Expressive V2 synthesizer, renamed Cerence TTS.
This is the same synthesizer used in recent versions of JAWS, and provides access to some new Vocalizer voices not available through the older Vocalizer-Expressive2 driver.
The functionality and settings here are exactly the same as in the old driver.
In the same way, you can enable automatic language switching and set the speed, pitch and volume for each voice individually.
The settings are located in the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, “Cerence TTS Automatic Language Switching Settings“.
This driver can also use the same Vocalizer-Expressive2 voices installed in JAWS or as add-ons.
Note: This driver can be installed alongside the VocalizerExpressive2 driver.

dual_voice.description:
The DualVoice add-on will allow you to use two different voices (currently both voices must support the SAPI5 standard) to read two languages, one written in Latin and the other in non-Latin script.
For example, a user may select a voice to read English as a Latin script language and select a voice to read Persian as a non-Roman script language.
Some languages with Latin script - English, Czech, Croatian, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese,
Slovenian, Spanish and Turkish.
On the other hand, some languages with non-Latin script are Arabic, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Chinese, Greek, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, Persian,
Russian and Ukrainian.
Note: The driver is adapted to work with X64-bit NVDA.

codeFactoryOnlineTTS.description:
Code Factory Online TTS - NVDA add-on for online speech synthesis with Turkish Vocalizer voices Cem and Yelda with saving to MP3.
Feature - automatic addition of background music to audio files.
Ideal for YouTube content creators, students for projects and business presentations.
A simple interface allows you to configure speech parameters and get a ready-made voice-over video with music in a few steps.
The add-on dialog can be opened from the NVDA submenu, Tools submenu, Vocalizer TTS.

voz_do_tempo.description:
VozDoTempo (Voice Time) is an NVDA add-on for telling the time with voice clips and sound effects.
Provides manual time request via Ctrl+Shift+V and automatic announcements every hour or half hour.
Supports 24-hour and 12-hour formats with correct declension of numerals.
Includes greetings based on the time of day, a silent mode to disable automatic announcements at night, and sound signals before announcements.
Features: special phrases for midnight and noon, option (and half) instead of (thirty), shortened mode for 12-hour format.
Ideal for users who need accurate voice information about the time.
Note: The add-on tells the time in Brazilian Portuguese.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the Time by Voice category for the shortcut “Speak the current time with sound effects and voice clips.”
The settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Voice Time.
All functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the help.

SpeakDecoratedText.description:
The SpeakDecoratedText add-on provides powerful text processing features including:
Convert decorated or special text with Unicode characters to plain ASCII for easier reading.
Cleaning up Arabic text into a normalized form.
Support for a small history of processed texts with the ability to restore previous transformations.
The add-on provides convenient keyboard shortcuts to access these functions, improving accessibility and usability for NVDA users.
NVDA+shift+h - Restoration of previously processed texts. Press several times to go back.NVDA+shift+a - Clear Arabic text and copy to clipboard.
NVDA+shift+z - Convert the current text to ASCII or copy it if it has already been converted.

speechViewer.description:
Speech Viewer add-on - using a hotkey, opens the NVDA message history viewer in a multi-line editor for reading.
The command to call the viewer is assigned using the Input Gestures dialog, in the Speech category,
shortcut Shows the speech viewer.
By default, the command is NVDA+Control+H (from the word History).
Replicas in the viewer window are displayed from top to bottom, messages can be selected and copied in the usual way, including several replicas at once.
Selecting from the start to the end point also works, just like in a standard reading editor.
You can close the viewer window using the Escape key.
Attention! SpeechViewer stores the 100 most recent speech messages. After restarting NVDA, the list of messages is not restored.

VoskSTT.description:
The VoskSTT add-on is a standalone, open-source speech recognition tool.
For this engine to work, you need to install the offline voice model as a separate add-on.
In the “Input Gestures” dialog, in the Vosk STT subcategory, assign a free keyboard shortcut for the “Start or stop speech recognition” command.
Now, after calling this command for the first time, you need to say something into the default microphone, and then call it again to stop recording.
NVDA will speak the recognized text and place it on the clipboard.
The settings dialog can be opened through the menu NVDA, SERVICE, Vosk STT Settings.
There you can select the recognition model, the microphone used and enable/disable the sound signal at the beginning of recording.

uTubeDownload.description:
The uTubeDownload add-on is a YouTube video hosting downloader with queue, resume, download section, as well as trimming and screenshot systems.
Features:
uTubeDownload:
Ability to select downloads in MP3 or MP4 format, either a single file or a playlist.
Equipped with a background system to ensure efficient loading.
Queue Manager: Organizes downloads one at a time to prevent high CPU and RAM load (supports smooth downloading of large number of files at the same time).
Resume System: Supports continued downloading after interruptions caused by restarting NVDA or shutting down/on Windows (can resume downloading remaining files the next day or when NVDA is restarted). A resume window will appear asking: If you select Yes, it will resume from pending files; if you select No, it will delete the remaining download history.
Automatic file recovery: Automatically repairs damaged files caused by incomplete downloads.
Checking uploaded files: Skips already uploaded files to prevent duplication.
Multi-Part Section Upload: Can split a file into up to 16 parts to increase download speed by 50%.
All of the above background systems can be enabled or disabled in NVDA Settings / uTubeDownload.
uTubeTrim:
A function to trim YouTube videos by setting the start and end time (a specific segment of the clip).
Possibility to select MP3 format with Quality 128–320 kbps and MP4 H.265.
Includes a preview button to test the selected starting point before loading.
When you are on the YouTube page you want to trim, press NVDA+ALT+Y to open the uTubeTrim settings window.
uTubeSnapshot:
Can capture static images from YouTube videos in .jpg format using the keyboard shortcut Control+Shift+Y.
Keyboard shortcuts:
NVDA+Y - Download as MP3 (single press).
NVDA+Y twice - Download as MP4 (double press).
NVDA+Shift+Y - Switch playlist mode.
NVDA+Ctrl+Y - Open the downloads folder.
NVDA+ALT+Y - Open uTubeTrim settings.
Control+Shift+Y - Automatic snapshot.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, in the category "UBBDownload".

contador.description:
The Contador add-on allows NVDA users to count the number of characters and words of text copied
to the clipboard, providing results using keyboard shortcuts.
Character Count: Use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+shift+C to declare the number of characters in the clipboard text.
Word Count: Use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+shift+W to declare the word count in the clipboard text.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the subsection Counting the number of characters and words.

geminiSpellChecker.description:
Gemini Spell Checker is a powerful add-on for NVDA that uses artificial intelligence to check spelling, grammar and text translation.
Supports two services: Google Gemini and Groq API.
Checks and corrects errors in the text, translates into more than 40 languages.
Works with selected text and clipboard.
Automatically switches between models when errors occur.
Includes the option to add emoticons to the corrected text.
Easy to use: highlight text and press hotkeys to check or translate.
Requires API keys from the selected service.
Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the Spell Checker category.
The functionality of the add-on is described in detail in the reference manual.

SMB.description:
The SMB add-on improves the availability of Sao Mai Braille for NVDA users.
Addition denotes unsigned elements in a program.
Sao Mai Braille (SMB) is a free text editing and braille translation program for Windows developed by the Sao Mai Center for the Blind.
Keyboard shortcut:
Ctrl+Shift+Q: Equalization insert dialog.
Ctrl+Shift+G: Image insert dialog.
Ctrl+Shift+M: Dialogue for inserting musical notation.
Keyboard shortcuts can be configured in input gestures, in the "SMB" category.

uTubeMiniDL.description:
UTubeMiniDL add-on for those who have problems using uTubeDownload,
please uninstall it and install uTubeMini to solve the download errors issue.
Features:
You can easily download your favorite YouTube videos in MP3, MP4 or WAV format.
Intelligent queue management.
Resume interrupted downloads after a restart.
Playlist support.
Customizable audio quality (128 kbps - 320 kbps).
Hotkeys:
NVDA+Y single press - Download as MP3

NVDA+Y double press - Download as MP4

NVDA+Y triple press - Download as WAV

ALT+Windows+Y - Switch MP3 quality

NVDA+Shift+Y - Switch playlist mode

NVDA+Ctrl+Y - Open the downloads folder.
Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the category " UTubeMiniDL ".

morse_synthesizer.description:
MorseSynthesizer add-on for NVDA screen reader that outputs Morse code instead of spoken text.
This allows users to practice “reading by ear” using everyday messages and notifications from screen reader - making the process of learning Morse code part of their digital routine.
Additionally, Morse output can also be displayed on a braille device, facilitating both listening and reading training.
Converts NVDA speech output to audible Morse code instead of synthesized voice.
Dialog for setting speed in WPM, tone frequency and Farnsworth coefficient.
Designed to practice listening to Morse code using real screen reader messages.
Dialogue for converting text from the clipboard into Morse with a copy-back function.
For what?
Learning Morse code is difficult without authentic use cases.
This add-on helps you practice with the texts and system messages you encounter every day—turning NVDA speech into a training ground for Morse.
By listening or reading Morse for messages whose context you already know, you improve your decoding and listening skills faster and with more motivation.

bpmfbrl.description:
The BpmfBrl add-on aims to provide screen reader users in Taiwan with the most convenient, simple and intuitive way to test and familiarize themselves with the upcoming version of the Chinese Zhuyin Braille system for Taiwan.
Each release will include three components:
bpmfbrl add-on for NVDA: After installing NVDA version 2024.3 or higher, you can experience the effect of reading the developing Chinese Zhuyin braille system for Taiwan by touch.
YAML file for testing: In addition to the need to load the developing Chinese Zhuyin braille system for Taiwan into liblouis, this file can also serve as a human-readable document for a dictionary of polyphonemic characters.
List of Revision Decisions and Other Files: Explains what decisions have currently been made to revise the Zhuyin braille characters for each Chinese character.

TimeWithSeconds.description:
The TimeWithSeconds add-on simply reports the current time with seconds and the current date.
An example message looks like this:
12:03:12
10/15/2025
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+F12 - When pressed once, the current time with seconds is reported. When pressed twice, the current date is reported.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the System Status category.

zRadio.description:
ZRadio add-on is an online radio player for NVDA.
To open the add-on, you need to follow the path: NVDA menu, Service submenu, and there will be a zRadio item.
You can also assign a key command in input gestures, which is not set by default, to open the zRadio main window.
Go to NVDA menu/settings/input gestures and under zRadio: shortcut to show zRadio main window.
In addition, a general catalog of radio stations, a section for favorite stations and a search in the catalog are available, in addition, you can add your own stations.
More details about the functionality of the add-on are described in the help.

speechHistoryExplorer.description:
The SpeechHistoryExplorer add-on allows you to view the last lines spoken by NVDA using NVDA+Shift+F11 and NVDA+Shift+F12 by default. 
Additionally, you can copy any spoken item to the clipboard by pressing NVDA+Control+F12, and show a dialog of all saved spoken items using NVDA+Alt+f12.
Use the add-on's settings panel to increase or decrease the maximum number of saved history entries, and decide whether to trim spaces at the beginning or end of text.
Use the NVDA Input Gestures dialog to change the keystrokes applied.

RuStore.description:
The Ru Store add-on will allow NVDA users to comfortably use the catalog of add-ons from the Russian community.
The add-on provides the following options:
Installing/Removing add-ons.
Updating/reinstalling installed add-ons.
Enable/Disable installed add-ons.
View a short description and other details of the add-on.
Copying the add-on download link to the clipboard.
Search by titles, authors and descriptions of all available add-ons.
View available, installed and updated add-ons.
Enable the display of incompatible add-ons (By default, only those compatible with the version of NVDA you are using are displayed).
Copying a link to the add-on developer's home page.
Filter by date and number of downloads.
To open the RuStore add-on store, follow the path:
NVDA menu, Service submenu, RuStore add-on store.
In input gestures, in the “Service” category, for the “Activates the RuStore add-on store” shortcut, you can assign a keyboard shortcut for quick access to the store interface.
More information about RuStore functionality can be found in the add-on help documentation.

WlanReporter.description:
The WlanReporter add-on provides automatic voice and audio notifications about connecting/disconnecting wireless networks and enabling/disabling wireless network adapters in the system.
This add-on also provides a command to advertise the current wireless connection status for all available network adapters on the system.
The desired keyboard shortcut for this command can be assigned in the “System Status” category of the NVDA Input Gestures dialog.

manifestCreator.description:
The ManifestCreator add-on is a powerful tool that allows NVDA screen reader add-on developers to easily create manifest.ini files and prepare NVDA add-on packages (.nvda-addons).
It creates user-friendly manifest files that define the metadata needed for NVDA add-ons to work correctly (add-on name, version, description, compatibility information, etc.).
It also simplifies developers' work and reduces the risk of errors by automating the add-on packaging process.
This add-on is designed for both new and experienced NVDA add-on developers and is fully compatible with NVDA's accessibility features.
You can read more about the functionality of the add-on in the help.

audio_themes_NG.description:
The AudioThemesNG add-on adds immersive sound effects for NVDA screen reader users by playing sounds for various UI events.
Sound Effects: Plays sounds for UI events such as control focus, list navigation, and more.
3D Audio: Uses Steam Audio to provide positional 3D audio, creating a sense of where controls are positioned on the screen.
Reverb: Adds reverb effects to the sound for deeper immersion.
Custom Themes: Allows users to create, install and switch between different sound themes.
Sound Theme Studio: Built-in tool for creating new sound themes or editing existing ones.
Configuration: Provides a settings panel to enable/disable features, adjust volume, and configure 3D audio and reverb settings.
Detailed guidance is described in the help.

vocalizer_expressive2_driver.description:
Driver and interface for Nuance Vocalizer expressive version 2.2.
This driver does not require a license, but to use it you must install at least one voice downloaded from the site https://nvda.ru/sintezatory-rechi-vocalizer-expressive2-dlja-nvda
or
https://nvda-addons.ru/subcat.php?id=ve22
You can also use synthesizers installed for JAWS.
Adaptation of the driver with 64 and 86 bit NVDA from Quark.

vocalizer_expressive1_driver.description:
Driver and interface for Nuance Vocalizer expressive version 1.1.
This driver does not require a license, but to use it you must install at least one voice downloaded from the site https://nvda.ru/sintezatory-rechi-vocalizer-expresive-dlja-nvda
or
https://nvda-addons.ru/subcat.php?id=ve11
You can also use synthesizers installed for JAWS.
Adaptation of the driver with 64 and 86 bit NVDA from Quark.

LangReporter.description:
The LangReporter add-on allows you to configure the way in which information about changing the input language and keyboard layout is reported.
In the settings you can select the following input language representation:
Full localized name of the language.
Abbreviated name of the language.
Native name of the language.
Localized name of the language.
Two-letter language name from ISO 639.
Three-letter language name from ISO 639-2.
Lang Reporter also provides a set of commands to quickly switch to the desired keyboard layout using pre-assigned hotkeys.
All these commands are located in the “Keyboard Layouts” category of the NVDA “Input Gestures” dialog.
The number of commands corresponds to the number of keyboard layouts available in the system.
The user must independently assign a free keyboard shortcut to the layouts he needs.
If switching through these commands is performed to an already active layout, NVDA will play a short beep notifying this.

RemapKeyAplication.description:
The RemapKeyAplication add-on simulates the Aplication key (context menu).
If your keyboard device does not have such a key or the Shift+F10 system command does not suit you.
We will need to independently assign the desired key or key combination,
to get the Applications key again.
In order to assign the desired command: Open the NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures, section Reassign the Aplication key.

zPortapapeles.description:
With the help of the ZPortapapeles- (Z-Clipboard) add-on, we will be able to hear messages about operations: copied, pasted, Canceled, cut and selected everything.
The addition includes the ability to activate or deactivate beeps or voice messages, as well as saving a history that can be copied to the cursor focus.
When the history function is enabled, a tracking monitor becomes available with a choice of time interval, as well as an option to notify with sound if something is added to the history.
When adding text to a story, a check is made for the presence of identical fragments. If such a fragment already exists, it will not be added to the history list.

zKeybase.description:
The ZKeybase add-on is a Keybase link generator for exchanging both directories and files.
This little add-on does not come with a designated keyboard shortcut to launch, you will have to add the command yourself in the input gesture manager and in the zKeybase category.
When we call the zKeybase add-on with the assigned command, a window will open with the structure of our Keybase shared folder.
The list that appears will indicate at the end of each name whether it is a directory using the symbol (D) or a file using the symbol (F).
For more information on how to use it, see the add-on help.

get_file_SHA.description:
The GetFileSHA add-on allows you to calculate and copy the SHA256 value of the selected file.
This will be useful for those who publish NVDA add-ons in the add-on store, since when publishing a file, you must specify the SHA256 amount of the file.
The standard combination for obtaining the SHA256 sum of the selected file is NVDA+ALT+G.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous section.

ffTools.description:
The FFTools add-on provides a set of tools from the ffmpeg program for processing multimedia files.
Conversion, playback, cutting.

reviewCursorFind.description:
The ReviewCursorFind add-on adds a search function for the review cursor, similar to the search function (NVDA+Control+f) in review mode.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+Shift+g: Find text from the current overview cursor position.
NVDA+g: Move the overview cursor to the next occurrence of previously entered text.
NVDA+Shift+g: Move the overview cursor to the previous occurrence of previously entered text.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Search for Overview Cursor category.

EKUP.description:
The Ekup add-on will help you quickly open the Accessible Library website in your default web browser.
Accessible library - provides books in Turkish.
Keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+K - View the latest resources on the website loaded into the database.
You can change it in input gestures, in the category “EKÜP Downloaded available books”.
Note: The library website is no longer available.

whatsAppPlus.description: The WhatsAppPlus add-on adds a variety of hotkeys for quickly moving between main window elements, convenient interaction with chat messages, and also adds many small improvements that make working with WhatsApp more convenient.

VoiceOverSounds.description:
The VoiceOverSounds add-on adds a sound theme with Voice Over sounds.
Sounds can be turned on or off with the command NVDA+Alt+V.
The add-on is based on the ObjSounds add-on.

poeditMadeEasy.description:
The PoeditMadeEasy add-on reports the actions performed when pressing PoEdit hotkeys.
It indicates different categories of messages with a specific sound signal.
In addition, by clicking on the specified keyboard commands, you can find out the original and translated text of the message, as well as switch the sound mode.

officeDesk.description:
The OfficeDesk add-on provides improved support for Microsoft Office applications.
This add-on requires Windows 10 or later and is optimized for Office 2016 and later, including Microsoft 365 subscription versions.
In the control panel, NVDA will announce the number of search results when search results appear.
NVDA will no longer repeatedly announce formatting changes such as bold and italics.
In the Envelopes dialog, NVDA will declare edit field labels.

prayerTime.description:
The PrayerTime add-on will allow you to find out the prayer times in the Islamic religion.
Fajr - morning prayer.
Zuhr - lunchtime prayer.
Asr – afternoon prayer.
Maghrib - evening prayer.
Isha - night prayer.
Keyboard shortcut:
Just press Control+Shift+Spacebar to open or close the virtual shortcut layer.
You can press H in the virtual layer to view all commands and Escape to close the command help window.
You can change the keyboard shortcuts in input gestures, in the prayer time subsection.
Virtual layer commands cannot be changed.

YoutubeChannelManager.description:
The YoutubeChannelManager add-on allows you to manage your favorite Youtube channels through an invisible and simple interface.
Not assigned; Enables or disables the invisible interface.
To turn the invisible interface on or off, first assign your own keyboard shortcut using the Input Gestures dialog.
Commands available in the invisible interface:
Escape: Closes the virtual interface and returns keyboard commands to their default functions.
Right Arrow: Move to next channel.
Left Arrow: Go to previous channel.
Down Arrow: Move to the next video in the channel.
Up Arrow: Go to the previous video in the channel.
Home: Goes to the first video in the channel.
End: Reports the position, channel name and number of views of the video.
N: Opens a dialog for adding a new channel.
O: Opens the video link in the default browser.
R: Opens the audio link in the custom web player.
control + c: Opens a link to the clipboard in the custom web player.
C: Copies the video link to the clipboard.
T: Copies the video title to the clipboard.
D: Receives video data and displays it in the NVDA window.
Control + D: Downloads the video in its original format to the youtubeDL folder in the current user's root.
control + shift + d: Loads the video from the clipboard in its original format into the current user's YoutubeDL folder.
B: Enables the database search dialog.
Control + B: Enables the general search dialog.
F5: Looks for new videos in the channel.
S: Enables the channel parameters window.
G: Enables the general settings window.
Delete: Deletes the channel under the cursor focus, and in the results window deletes the column and returns to the channel list.
Control + Shift + Delete: Deletes a database.
F1: Enables command help.
A detailed description of all add-on functions is located in the add-on help.

content_priority_reading.description:
The ContentPriorityReading add-on ensures that text content is read before control information, providing a better reading experience. Fully dependent on NVDA Localization API, supports all languages.
Features:
Smart speech repositioning: Automatically places text content before control type information.
Multi-language support: Implemented purely via API, supports all languages ​​that NVDA supports.
Real-time switching: turn on/off the function with one key.
Debug mode: Detailed log output, convenient for developers.
Diagnostic Tools: Built-in various diagnostic and testing functions.
Keyboard shortcuts:.
NVDA+Ctrl+Shift+Y: toggle the priority content reading function.
Unassigned: Toggle debug mode: View detailed information about the processing of speech sequences.
Not assigned: Testing the reversal function: demonstrating the effect of reversing speech.
Unassigned: Show add-on status: View current settings and last processed sequence.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Priority reading of content” category.
Main Use:
Press NVDA+Ctrl+Shift+Y - to enable the function.
Generally browse the web or apps.
Note the change in speech order: the content will be read before the control type.
Examples of effect:
Before turning on: “OK button”.
After turning on: “OK Button”.
Before turning on: “Link Home”.
After switching on: “Main Link”.

developerToolkit.description:
The Developer toolkit (DTK) is an add-on for NVDA that helps blind and visually impaired developers independently create visually appealing user interfaces and web content.
It provides gestures that allow you to move around objects and get information about them, such as their size, position, and characteristics.
To start using DTK, set focus to the control, then press ALT+WINDOWS+K.
To disable it, press ALT+WINDOWS+K again.
When on the web, press NVDA+SPACEBAR to put NVDA in focus mode, and press NVDA+SHIFT+SPACEBAR to turn off single-letter navigation.
All keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on reference guide.
You can change commands in input gestures, in the “Developer Tools” category.

KeyboardEvents.description:
The KeyboardEvents add-on is a “Audicator of completed actions”, it provides sound and voice notifications when you press standard and alternative keyboard commands (Copy, Paste, Cut, Undo, Redo, Select all, Print screen).
Features:
Different types of notifications for each command:
Voice message.
Sound signal (WAV file).
Horn with customizable parameters.
No notice. You can also turn off command speaking in certain applications.
Basic command support:
Copy (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Insert (twice)).
Insert (Ctrl+V, Shift+Insert (twice)).
Cutting (Ctrl+X, Shift+Delete).
Cancel (Ctrl+Z).
Repeat (Ctrl+Y).
Select all (Ctrl+A).
Screenshot (Print Screen).
Flexible settings for beep parameters.
Once installed, the KeyboardEvents add-on works automatically.
When you run supported commands, you will receive the selected type of notification.
To configure the add-on, open NVDA → Menu → Options → Settings → KeyboardEvents.
Detailed guidance is described in the add-on help.

KeyboardShortcutsAutocompletePro.description:
KeyboardShortcutsAutocompletePro is a professional add-on for NVDA that allows you to create text shortcuts and automatically expand them into full text.
Features:
Create custom abbreviations and expand them.
Expanding abbreviations using NVDA+E.
Convenient abbreviation manager with search, import and export.
Supports multiple languages, including Arabic.
Cancel last expansion.
Real-time input hints.
Reliable and thread-safe operation.
Ideal for:
Email addresses and signatures.
Frequently used phrases and greetings.
Technical terms and jargon.
Multilingual text disclosure.
Increased productivity.
Keyboard shortcut:
Expand abbreviation - NVDA+E - Expands the abbreviation at the cursor position.
Open manager - NVDA+Shift+K - Opens the abbreviation management dialog.
Enable/disable add-on - NVDA+Alt+Shift+K - Enables or disables add-on.
Cancel autocompletion - NVDA+Shift+E - Cancels the last autocompletion of text.
Show abbreviation information - NVDA+Shift+S - Checks whether the word under the cursor is an abbreviation.
List of all abbreviations - NVDA+Shift+L - Displays a quick list of all abbreviations.
Other keyboard shortcuts that work in the add-on interface are described in the detailed manual.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures:
In the Configuration category for shortcuts:
Turn abbreviation on or off.
Open abbreviation manager.
List of all abbreviations.
In the Text Editing category for shortcuts:
Show abbreviation under cursor.
Expand the entered abbreviation.
Supported applications:.
Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel).
Web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge).
Text editors (Notepad++, VS Code).
Mail clients.
Social networking applications.
Messengers.

Keymirror.description:
The KeyMirror add-on translates the last spoken text into English (NVDA+Alt+E) or Russian (NVDA+Alt+R) layout.
It can be useful on glitchy keyboards, when you periodically get into a situation like Punto Switcher, but you’re too lazy to go into the online converter.
The script, alas, does not work flawlessly (on conflicting characters that intersect in neighboring layouts), but in principle it works - the result is immediately copied to the clipboard.

accentManager.description:
The Accent Manager add-on for NVDA provides a convenient way to enter accented characters without using the international Windows layout, which can be inconvenient and result in accidental layout changes.
This add-on is especially useful for entering names and accented words in various languages.
Features:
Inserting accented characters (acute, tilde, gravis) for common vowels and the letter n.
Switch between accent types using hotkeys.
Switch between uppercase and lowercase characters with accents.
Multi-level input: Select an accent type, then enter a character to add the accent.
Feedback via NVDA speech for actions and errors.
Buffering: Creates a string of accented characters before sending.
Removes the last character from the buffer.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+/ (Slash) - Inserts characters with accents.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Accent Manager category.
The instructions for use are described in detail in the add-on help.
Note: Addition only for Latin letters.

perky.description:
This add-on is designed to improve your reading experience using the Perky Duck app.
Features:
Allows NVDA to detect changes in selection when UI automation is disabled in Perky Duck. Without this add-on, NVDA only detects these changes when UI Automation is enabled.
Added the ability to use NVDA's character recognition feature in Perky Duck documents.
Keyboard shortcut:
The following commands can be assigned from the NVDA menu, Options submenu, Input Gesture dialog, Perky Duck category. They will be available in the Perky Duck documents application window.
Opens a dialog for reading characters typed in Perky. In this dialog you can save and select symbol dictionaries.
Shows selected text converted to braille using characters from the current language.
Shows selected text in review mode.

ChatKill.description:
ChatKill add-on - replaces NVDA pronunciation of phrases like:
Left, Right, Top, Bottom, No previous, No next, No containing object, No objects inside.
The add-on was created to replace voice messages about boundaries in object navigation mode with sound signals.
The functionality of the add-on can be turned on and off using the “Turns on or off ChatKill” shortcut.
The keyboard shortcut must be assigned independently in input gestures, in the category “Replaces boundary messages with sound signals”.
Note: The developer originally released an add-on called "ChatterKiller", but then changed it to "ChatKill".

Unspoken.description:
Unspoken is an add-on originally created by Austin Hicks (Camlorn) that plays sounds in 3D to represent controls on the screen instead of having to speak the types of controls using speech.
Note:
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

documentFormattingRotor.description:
DocumentFormattingRotor is an add-on for NVDA that allows users to quickly change document formatting options without having to open the settings menu or remember multiple keystrokes.
With this add-on, users can easily navigate and change various document formatting options, making the process of making changes easier.
NVDA+G - Open the document formatting rotor menu.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures. in the subsection Document Formatting Rotor.
You can familiarize yourself with all the keyboard shortcuts for navigating the router, as well as other features of the add-on, in the detailed help.

unspokenPy3.description:
The Unspoken add-on removes the label with the name of objects. Instead of these names, other sounds are played.
This add-on will help you use your computer more dynamically and faster.
Keyboard shortcut Control+Shift+U - Enables/Disables Unspoken.
You can change the command in input gestures, in the Unspoken Sound Theme subsection.
You can use profiles to disable Unspoken in some applications.
The profile can be found in the NVDA menu, Configuration Profiles.

showWinKey.description:
ShowWinKey Add-on - designed for NVDA Narrator and provides quick and accessible access to the following information about Windows:
Show Windows License Key: Gets your system's license key, allowing you to copy it, save it to your desktop, or clear your buffer.
Show General Windows Information: Opens the version details window (winver) or displays version details via PowerShell.
Windows Type and Build Information: Shows your Windows type (e.g. Home, Pro, Enterprise) and build number.
Windows Disk Usage: Displays the disk space used by Windows in GB.
Windows Folder Created Date: Shows the date the Windows folder was created (usually C:\Windows).
Windows Install Date: Displays the installation date of the Windows system.
Get local IP address of computer: Receives the computer's IP address as a text file on the desktop or copies it to the clipboard.
Get network gateway IP address: Receives the IP key of the Wi-Fi you are using as a text file on your desktop or copies it to the clipboard.
These functions are accessible through the NVDA menu: Tools, Windows Information.
Disclaimer: This add-on is only for easy display of Windows license key and other system information. It does not change, corrupt, or back up the license key or affect the licensing status of Windows. Users are responsible for securing and backing up their license keys. The developer is not responsible for loss, misuse of the key or other problems.
Note: The license key may not be available if the system is not licensed or is in demo mode. Disk usage and dates vary depending on access rights.

readonlyProfiles.description:
When the ReadonlyProfiles add-on is enabled, configuration profiles will not be saved automatically.
Press NVDA+shift+p to save the current configuration to the most recent profile.
This command can be changed from the NVDA menu, options submenu, dialog
input gestures, in the "Configurations" category for the "Saves the current configuration to the most recent profile" shortcut.

dictionaryBackup.description:
The DictionaryBackup add-on is designed for convenient and secure backup and restoration of user speech dictionaries.
The add-on automatically creates a backup copy of all custom pronunciation dictionaries located in the “speechDicts” folder.
Functionality:
Saves all dictionaries (.dic files) in a zip archive, including subfolders.
The user can choose where to save the backup.
Can also restore dictionaries from a zip file.
When creating a backup, it can automatically save the contents of dictionaries as a text file on the desktop.
The control panel allows you to enable or disable the log file, and also specify whether to include time, minutes and seconds in the file name.
The interface is available in the NVDA Tools menu under the name “Dictionary Backup”.

internetStatus.description:
The InternetStatus add-on announces the Internet status or opens the Internet system tray menu.
In addition, you can check the download and upload speed.
Keyboard shortcut: NVDA+Alt+I - when pressed once, the Internet connection status is displayed. When pressed twice, opens the Internet context menu by clicking on its icon in the system tray.
NVDA+Alt+U - Check the upload speed to the Internet.
NVDA+Alt+O - Check download speed from the Internet.
You can change commands in input gestures, subsection Internet Status.
Note:
The add-on searches for the network icon in the system tray, and one of the search criteria is the presence of the substrings “internet access”, “not connected - no connections are available” or “not connected - connections are available” in the text label of this icon.
Accordingly, it will only work in a system with an English interface language.

Sound Converter.description:
This add-on allows you to batch convert audio to NVDA.
Enriched with advanced sound simulations including 3D/8D effects, directional and vertical ball jumps/bounces, passing cars, glass breaking, noise direction, neighbor effects and window openings.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+S - Enable/disable the Audio Converter add-on.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Audio Converter category.
You can also open the add-on interface through the Service submenu.

NVDASpeedTest.description:
NVDA SpeedTest is an open source add-on for NVDA that allows you to run internet speed tests (upload, upload and ping) in a fully accessible format, with results read out and built-in history.
Features:
Speed test (download, upload and ping) with automatic reading of results.
Test history including date and summary.
Detailed data: server, jitter, packet loss and IP address.
Button to cancel a test in progress.
Customizable hotkey (default: NVDA+Shift+L).
Multi-language support.
Open the add-on using the default hotkey (NVDA+Shift+L) or through the NVDA menu: Tools, Internet Speed ​​Test.
To change the hotkey, go to Settings, Input Gestures and find “Internet Speed ​​Test”.
You can read about other features of the add-on in the help documentation.

YouTubeAdSkipper.description:
The YouTubeAdSkipper add-on allows NVDA to automatically skip ads on YouTube.
In the “Tools” submenu there is an item “YouTube Ad Skipper Settings...”.
In the settings you can set the scanning frequency in seconds.
Create a dictionary of button names.
Edit the dictionary of button names.
Import and export a dictionary of button names.
In advanced settings, you can disable ad skipping enhancement.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+Alt+W - Manually click on the ad skip button.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous category.

MetaTrader.description:
The MetaTrader add-on improves the accessibility of the MetaTrader trading terminal for Windows.
The add-on improves navigation between options in MetaTrader 5.
The add-on also adds keyboard shortcuts for ease of use of the MetaTrader terminal.
The entire list of keyboard shortcuts can be found in the help.

enterKeySpeak.description:
EnterKeySpeak add-on, which causes NVDA to speak the Enter key under any circumstances, calling it “Enter”.
Go to the NVDA menu: Options → Preferences → Enter key narration settings to enable or disable narration.
By default this option is enabled...

addonReporter.description:
The AddonReporter add-on collects information about installed add-ons, including folder creation dates, presence of Help files, installation source, and additional date information.
Updates the list of add-ons, saves a detailed or simple report, reports events in detail.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+R - Opens the add-on reporting interface.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Add-ons Report category.
A dialog box with settings and all functionality of the add-on is located in the Service submenu, “Add-on Report”.

CJKEnhancedUI.description:
The CJKEnhancedUI add-on is modifications and enhancements to speech and braille output designed for CJK localizations.
Speech view mode and Braille view mode can be switched independently using NVDA+0 and NVDA+=(equal) respectively.
When you move the system or review cursor, the description of the first character is automatically spoken for non-English characters.
Pressing numpad2 [or NVDA+.(dot) for laptop] leads to a description of the next symbol.
Pressing Shift+numPad2 or NVDA+Shift+,(comma) for a laptop leads to a description of the previous character.
When you enter text in the input composition window, the description of the first character for single characters is automatically spoken.
Brief description of Braille viewing mode:
There are three modes: “Off”, “On” and "Auto".
Braille View Off: Uses standard braille display behavior.
Braille view mode is enabled: pressing numpad2 [or nvda+.(dot)] displays character descriptions.
Automatic Braille View: Moving the system or overview cursor over the text area automatically displays character descriptions.
In "On" modes and “Auto”, when entering text into the input composition window, character descriptions for individual characters are automatically displayed.

easyTableNavigator.description:
The EasyTableNavigator add-on adds a layer command to use the arrow keys to easily navigate table cells.
When you enable multi-level commands, you can do the following:
Move to the previous or next cell horizontally or vertically using the arrow keys.
Move to the first or last cell of a row or column using the Control+Arrow keys or Home, End, PageUp, and PageDown.
Read an entire row or column without moving the system caret by using Windows+Left Arrow / Windows+Up Arrow.
Read a row or column starting from the current cell using the Windows+Right Arrow / Windows+Down Arrow keys.

tTalk.description:
tTalk Add-on Monitors clipboard content, saves history, and speaks content in English or Thai only.
Features:
Clipboard Monitoring: Monitors copied content.
Language switching: Speaks out clipboard actions and messages in English or Thai.
Speak common clipboard actions: Speaks messages when performing copy, paste, cut, undo, select all, and save operations.
Smart Copy in View Mode: Automatically copies selected text in view mode (such as in web browsers) before reading it out.
Basic commands:
NVDA+Alt+T: Switches the audio language between English and Thai.
Ctrl+C: Voices copy and performs the copy action.
Ctrl+V: Says paste and performs the paste action.
Ctrl+X: Voices cut and performs the cut action.
Ctrl+Z: Voices undo and performs the undo action.
Ctrl+A: Voices select all and performs the action of selecting all.
Ctrl+S: Voices save and performs the save action.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, in the "TTalk" category.

pactos.description: Pactos add-on is Pactos braille display drivers for NoteTaker, Barjastenegar 2, 4.

WindowsMail.author: Unknown
WindowsMail.description:
The WindowsMail add-on adds various commands to make it easier to work with the Windows Mail email client of the same name.
Compatible with Windows 7-10, NVDA 2019.3 and later.
All keyboard shortcuts are described in detail in the add-on help.

Live Internet Speed Tester.description:
The Live Internet Speed ​​Tester add-on allows you to monitor the volume of transmitted and received data in real time.
It functions similar to the network indicators you see on Android smartphones or computer screens, showing the current speed of data being sent and received, rather than the total bandwidth of your connection.
To listen to a message about your current speed, press NVDA + I. The message will sound something like this:
“Download speed: 16.07 MB per second. Upload speed: 20.25 KB per second."
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the category {Real Time Internet Speed ​​Tester}.

pausingInfo.description:
The Pausing Information Add-on for NVDA is an extension that provides more detailed and paused reading of state and control information when focus changes between interface elements.
This feature was inspired by the Brazilian screen reader "Virtual Vision", known for its paused way of announcing information, which improves user comprehension.
This add-on is designed for use with the DeltaTalk synthesizer to provide a full reading experience similar to Virtual Vision, but is fully compatible with any other synthesizer used by NVDA.
Important note: Paused reading is based solely on the character level. Hyphens are added to pause the reading of information. If the character level is set above "some", hyphens will be spoken.
Likewise, if characters (specifically the hyphen) are not set up correctly in the Pronounce Punctuation/Symbols dialog, pauses may not work.
To ensure pauses work correctly, go to the Pronounce Punctuation/Characters dialog and make sure the hyphen is set to be sent to the synthesizer when it is below the character level.
Features:
Declaring Control Types and States: The add-on declares the control type (e.g., checkbox, radio button, menu, input field) and its state (e.g., checked, pressed, unavailable, busy).
The announcement is made with pauses, similar to how it was done in the Virtual Vision screen reader.
You can read about how to use this add-on in the help section.

googleTranslateEnhanced.description:
The GoogleTranslateEnhanced add-on translates the contents of the clipboard or recognized speech via the Google Translate API according to the language set in NVDA.
If you have selected a large amount of text (for example, an entire document), a beep will sound during translation.
If the translation result exceeds 1500 characters, NVDA will report the total number of characters and will only announce the first 1500.
You can use the “Speak out latest translation result” function (double-click copies to clipboard) to paste the full translation into another editor (for example, Notepad).
Keyboard shortcut:
Translation of the current voiced text: NVDA+J.
Translate selected text or clipboard contents: NVDA+Control+J.
Enable/disable automatic translation: NVDA+Shift+Control+J.
Voice the latest translation result: NVDA+Alt+J.
Translation log optimization: NVDA+Windows+J.
Complete clearing of the translation history: NVDA+Shift+Windows+J.
All hotkeys can be changed in input gestures, in the “Enhanced Google Translate” category.
Note: If the language is set to "Default", the translation will be in Chinese. To translate into your language, select a specific NVDA interface language, such as Russian.

audioDuckingEnabler.description:
Addition audioDuckingEnabler, which allows you to use audio ducking ()mute when working with a portable version of NVDA or with UAC disabled.
Install this add-on, restart NVDA, and audio ducking will work.
The standard NVDA command for switching mute is NVDA+Shift+D.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.
The features of the add-on are described in a short help.

Typing Settings.description:
The Typing Settings add-on provides several options for improving the quality of typing on the keyboard.
These include turning on sound effects when typing in text fields, turning on and off character speaking in three modes: off, speaking characters only in text fields, or speaking characters anywhere, including words.
You can also enable or disable the voice of passwords when entering password fields.
Typing settings are accessed through the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Settings, Typing Settings.

noteDiary.description:
The NoteDiary add-on allows you to quickly and efficiently save notes.
Record, open, save and delete notes with just a few keystrokes.
Initially, there is no keyboard shortcut assigned to open the Notes Diary window, but you can assign one in Settings, Input Gestures in the Notes Diary category.
You can also access it through the NVDA menu, submenu Tools, Notes Diary.

BrlIMEHelper.description:
The BrlIMEHelper (Braille IME Helper) add-on allows users to enter Chinese characters directly through a Braille keyboard on a Braille display.
If a physical braille keyboard is not available, the add-on can emulate it using a computer keyboard (for example, QWERTY). By converting Braille input into IME operations, the add-on allows users familiar with Braille rules to enter Chinese characters without having to learn the keyboard layout of the input method they are using.
Currently, the add-on is based on bopomofo braille and Microsoft Phonetic IME (Microsoft Bopomofo), which is common in Taiwan, but the concept may be expanded to other braille systems and IME in the future.
Features:
Enter Chinese characters (including punctuation and math symbols) via the Braille keyboard.
Emulate a Braille keyboard using a computer keyboard.
Support for system hotkeys and NVDA shortcuts.
Different braille composition modes for different windows.
Ability to enter passwords in the browser using a Braille keyboard.
Various settings based on user feedback.

Text Encryptor and Decryptor.description:
TextEncryptorAndDecryptor Add-on for NVDA - Provides a powerful, accessible, and easy-to-use interface for encoding and decoding text using the Base64 algorithm.
Features:
Encode plain text to Base64 with a few keystrokes.
Decoding Base64 strings back into readable text.
Accessible graphical interface with tabs (Encoder and Decoder).
Copying results to the clipboard.
Export results to txt files.
Reset entered data.
ALT-based hotkeys for each control.
Keyboard shortcut:
Press NVDA + Control + J to open Base64 Converter.
Or through the NVDA menu → Tools → Base64 Converter.
The keyboard shortcut for opening the converter window can be changed in input gestures.

GBReader.description:
The GBReader add-on adds news reading in simplified Chinese.
The message is presented in simplified Chinese.
Keyboard shortcut NVDA+G.

EOFbeep.author: Quark unofficial
EOFbeep.description:
The EOFbeep add-on adds the following functionality:
When the cursor reaches the end or beginning of the file, a signal sounds.
Note: Disabled in Unigram.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

rtkuwp.description: The Rtkuwp add-on improves the accessibility of the Realtek audio console for windows 10.

AISummarizer.description:
AI Summarizer allows NVDA users to upload supported file formats and generate tailored summaries based on custom queries.
With an accessible interface, intuitive keyboard shortcuts, and robust functionality, the add-on provides a seamless user experience.
Key features include streaming processing for responsiveness, clipboard and export options, and advanced features such as audio/video transcription and text extraction from images.
Key Features:
AI Summarization: Uses tech visionary AI's vision-pro s3 model to create high-quality, concise content summaries.
Improved Accessibility: Designed to integrate seamlessly with NVDA, providing an inclusive user experience.
Advanced Transcription: Accurate transcription of audio and video content.
Extracting text from images: Expands the accessibility of visual content.
Interactive Refinements: Supports iterative queries to refine or expand summaries.
Keyboard shortcut:
Open the AI Summarizer window using “NVDA+Alt+N” or select AI Summarizer from the NVDA Tools menu.
Detailed instructions for use can be found in the help documentation.

2FAGenerator.description:
2FA Generator is a powerful and affordable add-on for NVDA that allows users to generate secure Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP) for two-factor authentication (2FA).
This tool is specially designed for screen reader users to make it easy to generate OTP, copy to clipboard, save to text file and reset entered data.
Features:
Generation of TOTP (Time-based One-Time Passwords) from a shared secret key.
Copy OTP to clipboard with one click.
Saving OTP to a text file.
Resetting form input fields.
Hotkey to open: NVDA + Alt + G.
Integration into the NVDA Tools menu.
Full accessibility and convenience for screen readers.
Keyboard shortcut:
Press NVDA + Alt + G to immediately open the generator dialog box or go to Tools → 2FA Generator....

baiduTranslation.description:
BaiduTranslation add-on for NVDA, providing translation through the Chinese service baidu.
Translation is implemented only between the following languages: English and Traditional Chinese or Simplified Chinese.
To use, you must have a personal key for the Baidu translation service.
Keyboard shortcuts:
Translate what you just heard: NVDA+W.
Reverse translation of what you just heard: NVDA +SHIFT+W>
Bring the contents of the clipboard forward: NVDA+CONTROL+W>
Reverse translation of the clipboard contents: NVDA+CONTROL+SHIFT+W>
Copy translation and translation results from the clipboard: Double click the above commands.
Switching automatic translation modes (disabled, normal, reverse): NVDA+F8.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures in the section with the name of the add-on.

vocalizer_automotive_driver.description:
The VocalizerAutomotiveDriver add-on is a driver for Nuance Vocalizer 5.5 speech synthesizers.
The driver works indefinitely, but to use it you must install at least one voice:
Nuance Vocalizer 5.5.
Nuance Vocalizer Direct.
You can download them through the Russian-language catalog.
Attention! The driver only works with one voice (auto-switching is not available).

markdown to html converter.description:
Markdown to HTML Converter is a feature-rich add-on for NVDA that allows users to easily convert Markdown (.md) content into clean, well-structured HTML—right from the NVDA screen reader.
This tool is especially useful for blind developers, bloggers, writers, and tech professionals who want to write in Markdown and generate HTML without switching to complex editors or seeing the help of a sighted person.
Main features:
Writing or pasting Markdown directly into a dialog box.
Attaching .md files with instant downloading of their contents.
Live Markdown to HTML conversion using Python's powerful markdown library.
Copy to clipboard, export to .html, or just read the result directly.
After installation, open the converter via:
NVDA menu → Tools → Markdown to HTML Converter or press the key combination: “NVDA + Shift + M” - the key combination can be changed in input gestures.
Step-by-step instructions are described in detail in the documentation.

myCalculator.description: The MyCalculator add-on is a calculator with multiple calculation methods and an improved user interface. Several calculation methods are available: standard, scientific, conversion and others. Press NVDA+Shift+M to open the calculator and enter the calculation you need.
