You can also press NVDA+SHIFT+H to hear the result of the Gregorian to Hijri year conversion. A beep will sound each time you enter a value. Press Enter or Tab to move focus to the result. You can also copy the result to the clipboard or view the calculation history. To close the add-on, press the Escape key. NOTE: By default, when you open the calculator, the Standard calculation method is used. The letter X is allowed to indicate multiplication. The symbol : is allowed for division. Invalid values ​​will be automatically removed from the input field. For detailed explanations of calculations, click the Help button in the main dialog box. The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under My Calculator for the Open My Calculator dialog box shortcut.

QQEnhancement.description:
The QQEnhancement add-on is designed to improve the experience for NVDA users with the PC QQ chat program.
The add-on adds a number of improvements, as well as keyboard shortcuts for quickly navigating the program window or performing certain actions.
All functions and keyboard shortcuts are described in the help for the add-on.
The developer did not implement the possibility of localizing the add-on.

edico.description:
Edico add-on - provides access to the EDICO scientific editor.
Open the Quck profile creation wizard, command NVDA+Alt+R.

synthRingSettingsSelector.description:
The SynthRingSettingsSelector add-on allows the user to select which parameters should appear on the synth's settings ring.
This add-on provides the following features:
Category panel in NVDA settings for selecting parameters that you want to include in the synthesizer settings ring.
Saving specific settings for each profile.
Overrides the default synth driver settings that appear in the synth settings ring.

killNVDA.description:
The KillNVDA add-on is designed to temporarily disable NVDA so that you can recover if it freezes.
When NVDA is dead, press Control Alt Delete, then activate the NVDA menu, Tools, Quit NVDA.
After that, click Cancel.
NVDA will restart and you will be able to use your computer again.

TVRadio.description:
This add-on allows you to listen to many global Muslim online radio stations and channels.
List of Islamic TV and radio stations:
Radio of the Holy Quran.
Radio for readers.
Variety radio.
Tafsir and the science of the Koran.
Radio readings.
Remembrance and prayers.
Radio Morocco.
Radio Algeria.
News channels.
Maghreb channels.,
Sports channels spor.
Islamic channels.
Arabic channels.
Tunisian radio.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Z: To turn TVRadio virtual mode on and off. This mode creates a non-existent virtual window that allows us to use the following keyboard shortcuts while it is activated, and then ends when we exit it by pressing the same keyboard shortcut.
Escape key: To permanently end the currently playing radio or channel when exiting TVRadio mode.
F1: open the help file, also available by default from the add-on management dialog.
Spacebar: To turn playback on and off.
Up and Down Arrows: To adjust the volume.
Left and Right Arrows: To move between radio stations and channels.
Enter key to read the name of the current radio station or channel.
Home key to go to the first radio station or channel in a section.
End key to go to the last radio station or channel in a section.
Control left or right arrow key: To move between sections of radio stations or channels.
Control key with any number from 1 to 0: allows you to add the radio station or channel that we are currently listening to as a favorite and then play it by pressing at any time on the number to which it is set.

keepAwake.description:
The KeepAwake add-on provides a tool to enable or disable power saving and keep your computer awake.
There are two options in the Power Options submenu:
Keep computer awake: Temporarily disables power saving mode and keeps the computer awake while the current instance of NVDA remains active. If NVDA is closed or restarted, the power saving settings will be restored.
Allow the computer to sleep: Restores system settings, allowing the computer to go into power-saving mode.

AccessVPad.description:
AccessVPad is an add-on that provides an accessible, virtual 2D read/write notepad based on a grid concept and equipped with various interactive features controlled from a speech keyboard.
Currently available word processors only allow horizontal editing, which limits the readability and expression of mathematical operations, especially when representing two-dimensional computational procedures in vertical form, making communication and learning ineffective for people with visual impairments.
AccessVPad is designed to overcome the limitations of existing text editors by allowing you to perform calculations that require vertical alignment. For example, when calculating conversions of units or polynomials, AccessVPad allows users to learn and express arithmetic concepts (such as carry) or any other cases where vertical alignment helps convey information more intuitively and efficiently. AccessVPad's GUI is located in the Tools -> AccessVPad menu.
The AccessVPad graphical interface is located in the Tools -> AccessVPad menu.
You can read about the add-on's other features, as well as keyboard shortcuts, in the detailed help.

AutoFocus.description:
The AutoFocus add-on restores the old "move system focus following the overview cursor" behavior and brings back the NVDA+8 keyboard shortcut to toggle it.
In NVDA 2025.1, the functionality of following the system focus behind the browse mode cursor was removed.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+8 - Enables or disables system focus moving following the overview mode cursor.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Browse Mode category.

AIChatbot.description:
The AI ​​Chatbot add-on is a powerful tool designed to improve accessibility for NVDA (NonVisual Desktop Access) Narrator users.
This add-on integrates advanced AI capabilities, allowing you to directly interact with various AI models through the NVDA interface.
📌 Features:
Multiple AI models: Choose between proAI, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, ChatGPT 3.5 and Gemini-1.5-flash.
Input Dialog: User-friendly interface for entering queries, attaching text files, clearing input and sending queries.
Display answers: View answers in a separate dialog box and export them to a text file.
Settings panel: Select your preferred AI model in NVDA settings.
Accessibility Integration: Fully NVDA compatible, hotkey NVDA+Alt+A for quick access.
🤖 Supported AI models:
proAI: A versatile model with reliable performance.
Microsoft Copilot: Intelligent assistant from Microsoft.
ChatGPT: Known for natural language understanding and conversational ability.
Gemini: Optimized for creative and technical needs.
ChatGPT 3.5: Fast and concise version of ChatGPT.
Gemini-1.5-flash: Lightweight model with fast response.
You can open the chatbot window with the command NVDA+Alt+A or go to NVDA Service, Chatbot with artificial intelligence.
You can select the AI ​​model in the add-on settings.

AI image generator.description:
AI Image Generator is an add-on for NVDA that allows users to generate images using artificial intelligence based on text queries. It fully integrates with NVDA, providing an accessible interface for visually impaired users to create and download AI-generated images.
Features:
🎧 Accessible Interface: Fully compatible with NVDA Narrator.
🖼️ Generating images from text: Creating images based on text descriptions.
💾 Image upload: Save generated images in PNG, JPEG or BMP formats.
🛠️Customizable Interface: Includes a cleanup button, About dialog box, and hotkeys for easy navigation.
⚙️ Multi-threaded processing: Prevents the interface from freezing by generating images in the background.
🎨 Theme support: Customizable color scheme for improved visibility.
Keyboard shortcut:
Open generator: NVDA+Shift+A.
Or through the NVDA Menu, Tools, Artificial Intelligence Image Generator.

PerfectCurrencyConverter.description:
The PerfectCurrencyConverter add-on for NVDA is a professional tool designed to make currency conversion more accessible to NonVisual Desktop Access (NVDA) screen reader users.
This add-on provides a user-friendly interface for converting between multiple currencies, optimized for accessibility.
Key features:
Supports conversion between a wide range of world currencies.
Accessible dialog interface for selecting currencies and entering amounts. Customizable default currency pair (for example, USD to NPR).
Integration with NVDA Tools menu and custom hotkey (default: NVDA+Alt+C).
Error handling for incorrect input or network problems during conversion.
Keyboard shortcut:
Open Currency Converter: NVDA+Alt+C.
Or go to the submenu “Service”, “Ideal currency converter”.
An Internet connection is required for the add-on to work.

EasySoundRecorder.description:
Easy Sound Recorder allows you to record sound simultaneously from your sound card and microphone using WASAPI.
This add-on uses the currently active sound card or Bluetooth headset, as well as the active microphone, and allows you to record audio in WAV or MP3 format.
Using Easy Sound Recorder is very simple, just two commands:
Shift+NVDA+R - starts recording, pauses and resumes recording,
Shift+NVDA+T - stops recording and saves the recording V.wav, or file. mp3, depending on settings.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Simple Voice Recorder” category.
In the add-on settings, you can change the recording format from WAV to MP3, change the folder for saving recordings, and turn on a short sound after recording is completed.
You can also configure input and output devices for recording, including speakers and microphone.

ProfileDict.description:
The Profile Dict add-on provides the ability to create separate speech dictionaries for different NVDA configuration profiles.
The speech dictionary dialog box for the active configuration profile can be accessed through NVDA, Options, Speech Dictionaries, Configuration Profile Dictionary.
You can also open this dialog using the corresponding command in the category (Configuration) of the NVDA dialog (Input Gestures).
It is possible to quickly enable/disable the use of the current profile dictionary.
The command for this switch is also located in the same dialog category (Input Gestures).

programResourceReporter.description:
This add-on allows you to monitor the RAM and CPU usage of your current program.
Press NVDA+Shift+9 to see how the current program is using the CPU.
Press NVDA+Shift+0 to see how RAM is being used by the current program.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the subsection (Using program resources) for the following shortcuts:
Report physical RAM usage of the current program.
Report CPU load on the kernel for the current program.
You can also assign a keyboard shortcut to see the average CPU load across all cores.

BluetoothAudioActive.description:
The BluetoothAudioActive add-on keeps the sound card active, which is very important for Bluetooth headphones or speakers.
This is necessary because Bluetooth headphones or speakers may go into sleep mode after a while, resulting in interrupted sound.
The add-on plays silent sound and thus the sound card remains active.
Bluetooth Audio Active can be turned on and off using the key combination Shift+NVDA+L.

Every time you turn Bluetooth Audio Active on or off, the setting will be automatically saved in the Bluetooth Audio Active configuration file.
For example, if you leave Bluetooth Audio Active enabled and restart NVDA, it will remain enabled.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under Miscellaneous, for the Turn Bluetooth Audio feature on/off shortcut.

quickDictionary.description:
The QuickDictionary add-on will allow you to quickly get a dictionary entry with a translation of a word or phrase into the selected language using a keyboard shortcut.
Dictionary entries contain detailed information about a word, such as part of speech, gender, number, translation options, list of meanings, synonyms and detailed examples. Such information will be useful for people studying foreign languages, or seeking to use all the richness and diversity of their own language in communication.

ProfileGestures.description:
ProfileGestures addition for assigning different keyboard shortcuts to the same commands in different configuration profiles.
After installing the add-on, all manipulations in the “Input Gestures” dialog will be saved in a separate file, the name of which depends on the name of the active configuration profile.
And switching profiles will cause an update of all user gestures loaded from this file.
Accordingly, in different configuration profiles it will be possible to assign different keyboard shortcuts to the same commands.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

whatsapp.description:
The Whatsapp Unlabeled Button Labeling Add-on adds keyboard shortcuts for core app functions and a focus feature for a better experience with the Windows store WhatsApp app of the same name.
All keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on help and can also be changed in input gestures.

textnormalizer.description:
The TextNormalizer add-on converts the letters of the jumbled alphabet into normal ones.
Switching the automatic normalization function is the most important: it allows you to quickly turn on and off the conversion in real time;
Replacing the first letter in a word with a capital one, so that speech synthesizers pause in new sentences.
You can set the keyboard shortcut in the NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures, Text Normalizer.

AMRadio.description:
AMRadio add-on for NVDA screen reader that provides tools for radio amateurs.
The AMRadio add-on includes a three-minute timer with audio notifications and a quick call sign search feature on QRZ.com.
It is ideal for users who operate amateur radio using NVDA and need efficient control of transmission times or easy access to call sign information.
Features:
Three-minute timer: Helps users manage transmission time. Plays a warning tone after 2 minutes 40 seconds and a final tone after 3 minutes.
QRZ Call Sign Search: Allows users to enter a ham radio call sign and go directly to the corresponding QRZ.com page.
How it works:
Timer: The timer can be started with a specific gesture. It plays melodies at specified intervals and announces the start of the timer.
Call Sign Search: Users can open a dialog to enter a call sign. Once entered, they will be redirected to the QRZ.com page for that call sign.
UTC Time: Users can check the current GMT time.
Open Brand Meister Hoseline: Opens the home page of the Brand Meister website, where you can listen to talk groups from around the world.
The keyboard shortcut must be assigned by the user themselves using the Input Gestures option in the NVDA settings menu. All features are available in the AM Radio Tools category.

numberProcessing.description:
The NumberProcessing add-on allows you to automatically read, digit by digit, any number of a specified length.
NVDA+shift+l (one time): enable/disable number processing;
NVDA+shift+l (twice): Open a dialog box to change the minimum number of digits processed on the fly.
The gesture can be changed in input gestures, in the Number Processing section.

textInformation.description:
The TextInformation add-on provides information about the selected text. The TextInformation add-on provides users with contextual information suitable for a wide variety of use cases.
For example, it allows you to find out the meaning of a word with one keystroke. Just highlight something, use the assigned keystroke, and wait.
The following features are currently supported:
IP address information. Includes geolocation, identification of provider, VPN/TOR exit node and cellular network.
English dictionary definitions from Princeton Wordnetweb Dictionary. Note: These definitions are not the best and the database does not have definitions for simple words such as could, you, etc.
*ISBN search via google books API.
Checking the credit card type (Mastercard, Visa, Discover, Amex, etc.).
Note: Regular expressions are used to validate data. This means email addresses and card numbers will never leave your computer.
The add-on provides support for identifying phone numbers and email addresses, although no actual information is obtained. This may change once I find a simple API that meets my specifications.
Keystrokes:
NVDA+(semicolon): Provides information based on the selected text.
NVDA+SHIFT+(semicolon): Provides information about text on the clipboard
NVDA+Control+(semicolon): Speaks out the last information reported. Double-click to display it in the dialog you are viewing.
Note: These keyboard shortcuts assume an English keyboard layout and may not work otherwise. If you have a problem, first try changing them in the input gestures dialog.

VoiceRingSelector.description:
The VoiceRingSelector add-on sets the available voices for the settings ring.
In the settings, select the desired languages ​​for which you want to select voices.
If the language of the voice has not been determined, such voices are grouped into the unknown category.
Then in the second list, mark the voices that you want to add to the NVDA settings ring.
Save the settings and restart NVDA, after which only the selected ones will be displayed in the settings ring from the entire variety of installed voices.

virtualCopy.description:
The VirtualCopy add-on provides a method for copying text from the view cursor.
By default, the gesture and keyboard shortcut are not assigned. This can be done in input gestures, in the Virtual copying subsection.
After pressing the assigned command, you can press one of the following keys:
K - copy the word in the browsing cursor.
L - copy a line in the view cursor.
W - copy the object where the view cursor is located.
Home - copy from the beginning of the line to the view cursor.
End - copy from the view cursor to the end of the line.

clipManager.description:
The ClipManager add-on for NVDA provides improved clipboard management by allowing you to access a history of your recent clipboard items.
This makes it easy to find and paste previously copied text or content.
You can customize the clipboard size, pin/undock items, and much more.
The settings are located in the NVDA settings section, Options submenu, > Preferences, > Clipboard History Manager.
There you can choose the saving threshold, history size and symbol display for each item.
You can also view the history in the NVDA menu, Service submenu, “Clipboard history”.
The add-on has one keyboard shortcut to open the interface.
The default is NVDA + V.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the subsection Clipboard History Manager, Show Clipboard History.
Additional options for the currently selected element can be accessed by pressing the context menu key (Applications) on the focused element.
The add-on also allows you to import and export your clipboard history.
The search function with support for regular expressions will allow you to find anything on your clipboard.
To open the search dialog: As usual, most apps use the same keyboard shortcuts as many other apps: Control + F.
Moving between results is done using the commands F3 for the next result and Shift + F3 for the previous result.

wordcraft.description:
A Wordcraft add-on to make it easier to correct spelling and grammatical errors, as well as style in texts.
Wordcraft uses two systems: a simpler one based on AutoCorrect and a more complex one based on LanguageTool.
The first system is based on the AutoCorrect library.
It uses models to check and correct spelling errors. The AutoCorrect library uses natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze text and suggest the most likely corrections.
The second, more complex system is based on the LanguageTool library.
It is used for in-depth checking of both grammatical and spelling errors. This library requires Java and uses a powerful tool for linguistic text analysis.
LanguageTool uses rules and algorithms to detect and correct errors in text. This allows you to not only correct spelling errors, but also correct complex grammatical errors and improve the style of the text.
Note; The following languages ​​are available for testing: English, French, Spanish, Polish, Czech, Ukrainian.
More information about the features of the add-on, as well as all the keyboard shortcuts, can be found in the help documentation.

Weekday.description:
The WeekDay add-on adds the following date and time functions.
Mode Day of the week.
Stopwatch mode.
Countdown mode.
Alarm mode.
Time signal.
List of hotkeys:
All hotkeys are bound to NVDA+W. Different functions depend on the selected mode.
NVDA+ALT+W: switches operating modes.
NVDA+SHIFT+W: In countdown and alarm modes, switches between time measurements (hours, minutes, seconds).
NVDA+SHIFT+W: In time signal mode, changes the signal setting: audio, speech, audio and speech together, or none.
NVDA+SHIFT+W: in day of the week mode, changes the setting of historical facts: historical fact, wikipedia event, wikipedia event and historical fact together or nothing.
NVDA+SHIFT+W: in day of the week, stopwatch and time signal modes, saves the settings of all modes.
It is recommended that you read the add-on help after installation.

Captain.description:
The Captain add-on is a Russian and Ukrainian speech synthesizer based on the Captain synthesizer by Gennady Nefedov.
“Captain” is a free, flexibly configurable compact synthesizer that is focused on providing high-performance work for users of screen access programs due to instant response and a “mechanical” voice that maintains articulate speech at high reading speeds.
Main features:
Speech synthesis in Russian and Ukrainian with adjustment of speed, volume and pitch of the voice (Ukrainian support is implemented on the basis of the Russian phoneme base).
Support for an expanded set of alphabetic characters, including all Cyrillic, Latin and Greek alphabet, including letters with diacritics and variant letter forms.
Support for the function of automatically switching languages ​​on the fly if the text being read contains the appropriate markup.
Customizable option for processing non-Cyrillic text: Russian transliteration of the Latin alphabet, imitation of English pronunciation and redirection to the eSpeak NG speech synthesizer built into NVDA or the SAPI5 standard synthesizer installed in the system.
User replacement dictionaries separate from NVDA, as well as a mechanism for configuring descriptions of letters and non-letter characters, differentiated by language and Latin processing options.
Separately customizable pauses in speech: between words, between parts of sentences and between sentences.
A number of additional settings for pronouncing letters, numbers and other non-alphabetic characters.
More information about the speech synthesizer can be found in the add-on help.

objWatcher.description:
The ObjWatcher add-on monitors changes to navigation object attributes.
The add-on will be useful in the following cases:
View subtitles and lyrics.
Monitoring of subtitles or lyrics objects of certain players, allowing you to automatically report their updates.
Monitor chat activity.
Track items of interest in group chat lists on messaging apps like Unigram or WeChat. Automatic notification of new messages even when running in the background.
Testing and debugging.
Monitor the status bar in apps like Notepad to automatically notify you of changes to rows and columns as you edit.
Observer layer commands:
Press NVDA+Alt+W to enable the observer layer, where you can perform observation actions:
Number keys (0-9): Add the current navigator object to a specific position or report the status of an object already being monitored at that position.
Delete: Click once to delete the last observed object; double click to remove all observed objects.
T: Toggles the viewing state of the current foreground window.
P: Pause or resume all surveillance activities.
Escape: Exit the observer layer.
You can read about other features and keyboard shortcuts in the add-on's detailed help.

bookLibrary.description:
The BookLibrary add-on helps the user organize downloaded books in the form of a library.

In the main library dialog, you can select the library you like and press Enter.

In the library dialog you can read information about books, file size, link and other link if available.

You can open the book library dialog by clicking on the command: NVDA+Control+Windows+B.
As always, you can change this keyboard shortcut by going to: NVDA Menu, Submenu Options, Input Gestures, Book Library.

OpenWithEnhancement.description:
The OpenWithEnhancement add-on in the Open With window puts focus on the first application in the list.
Works on Windows 10, but may not work on Windows 11.
It has no settings or keyboard shortcuts.
Starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

HISS.description:
HISS is an add-on for NVDA that allows you to directly use the "Keiko" and "Takashi" voices from DocumentTalker in NVDA.
HISS uses "FineSpeech Version 2" provided by Animo Co., Ltd. Although newer versions exist, we chose "Version 2" as the most lightweight.
HISS operates as one of NVDA's speech synthesizers rather than through SAPI. It is optimized for reading in NVDA, which ensures minimal delay between keypress and audio playback. Since version 1.1.0, HISS also supports the SAPI5 interface.
HISS directly supports ASIO devices. If you have an audio interface that supports the ASIO protocol, you can output audio directly to that device, further reducing latency.
Most NVDA speech synthesizers support "high-speed reading". Typically this feature is enabled via a checkbox, but in HISS it is implemented as a slider, allowing for more precise speed control. If you set the slider to maximum, you can achieve incredible speeds (though this is not recommended for everyday use).
One of the reasons for developing this add-on was the desire to have a speech synthesizer that could quickly read program code. Therefore, terms that are often found in programming were added to the dictionary. Although they could have been added to the NVDA dictionary, we decided to include them in the synthesizer to improve performance. Our goal is for HISS to be able to read such terms without problems.
Please note that if the Windows language is not set to Japanese, HISS may not work correctly.
HISS is distributed as shareware. By paying for a license, you get access to all functions without restrictions.

streamfab.description:
This add-on improves the accessibility of Streamfab when used with NVDA by adding text descriptions for many previously unlabeled items.
Navigation features have also been slightly improved (see below).
Keyboard shortcuts:
In some elements (for example, virtual documents, tables, or multi-line input fields), standard navigation between elements using Tab and Shift+Tab does not work because these elements handle these keys themselves.
In such cases, you can use Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab to move to the next or previous element.

textRestore.description:
The TextRestore add-on adds the ability to visually decode text, as well as detransliterate it.
You have probably come across text on the Internet more than once where, instead of Russian letters, visually similar Latin ones are used, for example: “hello, said,
Evening, Link” and others.
This add-on will help transform such text into absolutely normal and readable text.
The add-on can also detransliterate text and transliterate it.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+SHIFT+Q: Visual decoding of selected text.
NVDA+CTRL+Q: Visual decoding of text from the clipboard.
NVDA+CTRL+SHIFT+Q: Detransliterate text from the clipboard.
Unassigned: Transliterates the selected text.
Unassigned: Detransliterate selected text
Unassigned: Invert the layout of the selected text.
All keyboard shortcuts can be configured in the “Input Gestures” dialog in the “Text Decoding” category.

GrooveMusicTrackInfo.description:
The GrooveMusicTrackInfo add-on improves the Windows accessibility of the Groove Music media player.
The add-on provides a script to read information about the currently playing track in Groove Music using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+G.
The add-on does not implement changing the keyboard shortcut, and it also does not have settings.
Groove Music is a music player and manager that comes pre-installed in Windows 10.
The main purpose of the application is to play music files stored on the computer. Groove Music supports the following file types: mp3, wma, flac, wav, aac, m4a, 3gp, 3g2, amr, ac3. Also supports CD playback if your computer has a disc drive.
In Groove Music, you can search for artists, albums, and songs, browse your collection filtered by artist, album, or song title, quickly navigate back to recently played albums and playlists, sort playlists, and more.
You do not need a Microsoft account to use the application.

emojiMenu.description:
The EmojiMenu add-on provides an accessible and simple menu for inserting or copying emoji into any text.
It supports filters with different categories, search and remember the last category.
Use the keyboard shortcut NVD + Semicolon to open the emoji menu, select a category and press Enter on the emoji to copy it to the clipboard.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under the Emoji Menu category.
Note: Categories and names of emoji are in English. Their localization has not been implemented.

enhancedControlSupport.description:
The EnhancedControlSupport add-on allows you to work with controls that are not typically supported by NVDA.
You can force NVDA to interpret the element as a different type, for example a panel might be recognized as a checkbox.
This will improve the communication of an element's state, for example allowing NVDA to report checked/unchecked status. In some cases, NVDA will also begin to recognize more controls on its own.
When NVDA encounters an unknown control, it will automatically try to determine its type. If the type is recognized, the element will be spoken as closely as possible to the way NVDA usually pronounces similar elements.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+ALT+C: Open the dialog for changing the element type for the active element.
NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+C: Open a dialog for changing the element type for the element on which the navigator object is located.
NVDA+ALT+R: Speak the type of element under focus (on a single click) or navigator object (on a double click).
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, subsection Advanced control support.
You can read about other features of the add-on in the help.

inputLanguageSwitcher.description:
InputLanguageSwitcher addition, which allows NVDA to assign input language switching to any key combination.
The default keyboard shortcut is Windows+Space.
You can change the combination in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous subsection, for the Switch input language shortcut.

indianNumberSystem.description:
The IndianNumberSystem add-on for NVDA improves screen reader number pronunciation,
especially for Indian users who prefer the "crore/lakh" format instead of the western million/billion format.
Features of the add-on:
Indian Number Mode - Automatically formats numbers with 6 or more digits in Indian style.
Western Mode (NVDA default) - No formatting - NVDA reads numbers as normal.
Digit by Digit Mode - Reads all numbers (with 2 or more digits) one digit at a time.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA + Shift + F: Cycle mode switching.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the "IndianNumberSystem" category for the shortcut "Switches between Indian, Western and telephone number systems".

eastern_armenian_voices.description:
EasternArmenianVoices is a modified version of the Sonata Neural Voices add-on for the Eastern Armenian dialect.
This add-on implements a speech synthesizer driver for NVDA that uses TTS neural models. It supports Piper.
The add-on uses Sonata: A cross-platform Rust engine for neural TTS models, which is developed by Musharraf Omer.

orpheus.description: The Orpheus add-on is a driver for Orpheus from Dolphin.

orpheusLight.description: The OrpheusLight add-on is a lightweight driver for Orpheus from Dolphin.

NotepadPlusPlus.description:
NotepadPlusPlus add-on to enhance the accessibility of the Notepad++ editor
Main features:
Bookmark support: quickly move between marked positions using hotkeys.
Maximum Line Length Announcement: Sound notification when the line length limit is reached.
Jump to matching parenthesis: Reading the context around the matching parenthesis.
Autocomplete: Speaks sentences and supports Braille display.
Step-by-step search: interactive search with results and number of matches announced.
Notification of current position: Get information about row number, column number and allocation size.
Pre/Post Search: Improves the document search experience.
All functions are described in detail in the add-on reference guide.

vocalizer-driver.description:
The VocalizerDriver add-on is a driver for Nuance Vocalizer 5.5 speech synthesizers.
The driver works indefinitely, but to use it you must install at least one voice:
Nuance Vocalizer 5.5.
Nuance Vocalizer Direct.
You can download them through the Russian-language catalog.
Attention! The driver only works with one voice (auto-switching is not available).

EnglishReadingEnhancer.description:
English Reading Enhancer is an add-on for NVDA that improves the quality of reading English text using Japanese speech synthesizers.
NVDA supports many speech synthesizers.

Some have a natural sound, others have a high reading speed, and others have a low load on the system.

Users can choose a synthesizer depending on their preferences.

In addition, you can switch synthesizers depending on the task, for example, reading books or checking documents.
However, when using multiple synthesizers, problems may arise due to differences in their operation.

This is especially true for reading English words, where synthesizers may make mistakes in pronunciation or spell words.
To solve this problem, it was decided to implement internal processing of English words in NVDA, converting them into katakana before passing them to the synthesizer.

This eliminates differences between synthesizers and ensures consistent reading quality.

Similar features are already implemented in JAWS (Japanese version) and ALTAIR, and their purpose is similar.

attribra.description:
The AttriBra add-on provides support for Braille attributes to indicate corresponding text with dots 7 and 8.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+control+A: Edit configuration.* NVDA+control+shift+A: Register fields on hover.

EnhancedFindDialogMod.description:
The EnhancedFindDialogMod add-on brings improvements to the NVDA Find dialog.
The add-on adds the following features:
Search history.
Cyclic search.
Register accounting.
Contextual information of search queries.
Note: The modification disables the error window with a message about a request not found and an error sound.
Instead of this window, the message about the not found request is spoken. This does not interfere with fast searches on Web sites and applications.
If this is not convenient for you, then use the original add-on.
Thanks to Quark for his help and the presented solution in the form of code.

SpeaKey.description:
The SpeaKey add-on adds a key combination (Control+Escape) that toggles the Talking Keys mode.
When Talking Keys mode is active, NVDA will speak any key when pressed once. If you press a key twice, it will be passed to the application.
This add-on is useful for people who are learning the keyboard and are not sure which key to press.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Talking Keys” section.

imazing.description:
IMazing add-on for NVDA, improving the availability of the iMazing program of the same name for Windows.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or settings.
Starts working immediately after installation or switching on.
Note: iMazing is a reliable program for transferring data, music, messages and files between iOS mobile devices and computer.

dokutor_for_nvda.description:
The DokutorForNvda (DFN) add-on is a program for creating medical dictionaries for NVDA.
By installing this add-on on your NVDA, you will be able to read aloud medical terminology that is usually difficult to read.
Functions:
Available when switching the reading dictionary operating mode in the medical department.
There are many terms in scientific terminology that define a particular way of reading certain Japanese characters, and when using a scientific dictionary to read, this will affect normal operation.
Physiotherapy reading dictionaries should only be used when necessary.
To switch to the application state: NVDA+Ctrl+Shift+D.
Attention: Please read the add-on help documentation before use.

UniversalMultilingual.description:
The UniversalMultilingual add-on detects the language NVDA is currently reading and switches between different speech engines depending on the language detected.
Currently it only supports Japanese and non-Japanese identification. We are ready to add definable languages ​​and improve the definition logic based on user input/suggestions.
You can learn about all the features of UML in the add-on help.

AVCRuTube.description:
The AVCRuTube add-on saves and converts RuTube videos in MP3 or MP4 format directly from the browser.
This is a modification based on the original AVC add-on.
Having opened the desired video on RuTube in the browser, click:
NVDA+Y for saving to MP3.
NVDA+Shift+Y to save to MP4.
NVDA+Control+Y open the results folder.
NVDA+Control+Shift+Y Check YT-DLP update manually.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “AVCRuTube (Audio-Video Converter from RuTube)” section.
Note: This modification uses the same keyboard shortcuts as the original AVC add-on. If you installed this add-on along with AVC, be sure to replace the keyboard shortcuts with others.

10dita.description:
The 10Dita add-on improves the accessibility of the 10dita software of the same name.
10dita is software developed in the 90s by Flavio Fogarolo and Franco Frascolla to help blind or visually impaired people master the keyboard. The software is only available in Italian.

TimerForNVDA.description:
The TimerForNVDA add-on offers a fast, functional and simple timer and stopwatch implementation for use with NVDA.
Start a timer or stopwatch using the time units and announcement modes you need.
Choose between features: speech, sound or nothing.
Monitor progress via alerts, settings dialog, or anywhere else using NVDA commands.
Control your timer and stopwatch anywhere with NVDA commands.

decimal2fraction.description:
A simple Decimal2fraction addon to convert decimals to fractions.
For example, 0.5 becomes 1/2.
I created the decimalToFractionConvertor add-on mainly for myself to easily convert decimal results from a windows calculator to fractions since there is no way to do this in the windows calculater application. Keyboard shortcut:
Alt+NVDA+S: Converts the selected number to a fraction.
Alt+NVDA+A: Converts a number on the clipboard to a fraction.
Double-clicking both combinations will copy the result to the clipboard.
All keyboard shortcuts can be configured in the Input Gestures menu.

skype.description:
The Skype add-on improves the availability of the Skype program of the same name for Windows:
Avoids pronouncing names of multiple elements twice (effectively silencing descriptions of duplicate names).
Rejecting words like 2 of 3 in the Conversations list because these position indications are not accurate.
Navigating objects left and right works better for reading user profiles and maybe other things.
View commands work on chat messages in the chat history list, although currently each chat entry appears as one line, even if there is actually more than one line of text.
NVDA-Shift-V specifies the version number of Skype.

deprecatedConfigKeys.description:
The DeprecatedConfigKeys add-on fixes an issue with turning Emoji on and off when using the shortcut "Enables or disables the reading of characters from the Unicode Consortium database, such as Emoji."
After clicking on this shortcut, it was reported that the function was on or off, but in fact the switching did not occur.
This add-on fixes this issue that was discovered in NVDA 2025.1Beta2.

agendaM.description:
The Agenda add-on provides better access to the Agenda program of the same name using NVDA.
Agenda for Windows was developed by Jean-Claude Mortimore.

NVIDIAMonitor.description:
The NVIDIA Monitor add-on allows you to monitor various parameters of NVIDIA video cards, such as name, used memory, available and total memory, power consumption, temperature and others.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA + Alt + g: Declaring the GPU name/model.
NVDA + Alt + u: Declaring the GPU UUID.
NVDA + Alt + v: Announces the driver version.
NVDA + Control + Alt + v: Announces the BIOS version.
NVDA + Alt + 1: Reports GPU load.
NVDA + Alt + 2: Reports memory load.
NVDA + Alt + 3: Reports available memory.
NVDA + Alt + 4: Reports memory used.
NVDA + Alt + 5: Displays the total amount of memory.
NVDA + Alt + 6: Displays GPU temperature.
NVDA + Alt + 7: Shows power consumption.
NVDA + Alt + 8: Announces the power limit.
NVDA + Alt + 9: Announces the number of CUDA processes.
NVDA + Alt + 0: Reports the amount of memory used by processes.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 1: Reports fan speed.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 2: Reports the GPU clock speed.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 3: Announces the maximum GPU clock speed.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 4: Announces the SM clock speed.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 5: Declares the maximum frequency of the SM clock.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 6: Declares the memory clock speed.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 7: Declares the maximum memory clock frequency.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 8: Advertise TX Bandwidth.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 9: Announces RX throughput.
NVDA + Control + Alt + 0: Reports power status.
Double clicks copy information to the clipboard.
Note: All of the following keyboard shortcuts can be configured in the Input Gestures category, under NVIDIA Monitor.

addonUpdater.description:
AddonUpdater add-on - for automatic or manual updating of installed add-ons.
To check for updates after installing the AddonUpdater, go to NVDA/Tools/Check for Addon Updates (if NVDA detects updates, the menu item will say (View Addon Updates), followed by the number of updates). If updates are available, a list of add-on updates will be shown, each entry consisting of the add-on name, current version, new version, and update channel. Select Update and NVDA will download and apply the updates in sequence and prompt you to restart NVDA.
Starting with NVDA 2023.2, the program menu has integrated the function of checking for add-on updates through the add-on store, so this add-on will only be useful to those who are still using NVDA 2023.1 and older.
Note:
In April 2025, add-on developer Joseph Lee officially announced the end of support for this add-on.
Almost all add-on features have been implemented in NVDA 2025.1.

numLockManager.description:
The NumLockManager add-on is used to control the state of the numLock key.
NumLock Manager Settings: This dialog, located in the NVDA menu, Options submenu, provides the following options to automatically set the state of the NumLock key when loading an add-on or when NVDA switches to a different configuration profile:
Off: The NumLock key will be automatically turned off.
On: The NumLock key will be automatically enabled.
Not changed: will remain in its current state.
Note: You can assign a keyboard shortcut to open this dialog from the NVDA menu, Options submenu, Input Gestures dialog, Configuration category, to the shortcut Displays the NumLock Manager settings dialog.

HookManager.description:
The HookManager add-on allows you to lock the keyboard and mouse.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA + SHIFT + K: Lock.
NVDA + SHIFT + O: Unlock.
When pressing commands, short sounds are played indicating locking and unlocking.
Changing the keyboard shortcut was not implemented.
The add-on has no settings.

crypto_info.description:
The CryptoInfo add-on receives information about cryptocurrencies. nvda+Alt+K - Show list of cryptocurrencies nvda+Alt+0-9 - Listen to information about the selected cryptocurrency in positions from 0 to 9
That is, nvda+Alt+0, nvda+Alt+1, nvda+Alt+2 and so on. Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the “CryptoInfo” category.

ListView.description:
The ListView add-on adds the ability to find out various information in Explorer by pressing keyboard commands.
Press Incert+Control+Shift+numbers 1 to 0 - to find out the explorer column information.
In this way, you can quickly hear information about the file size, modification date of the file or folder, and other information according to the file type.
Attention! To work, you must use the folder type: Table or Tile.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the List View category.

whatsappImageDescriber.description:
WhatsappImageDescriber is a handy add-on for NVDA designed to retrieve image descriptions in WhatsApp messages using artificial intelligence.
It supports both the desktop version of WhatsApp and the version from the Microsoft Store.
With it, you can get detailed descriptions of images using popular AI services such as OpenAI (GPT-4 Vision), Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude.
The add-on allows you to customize the response length and description language, which makes it a flexible tool for users.
To use the feature, just open WhatsApp, go to the message with the image and press ALT+I - the description will appear in an easy-to-read window where you can take your time reading it.
To use, you must have an API key for one of the supported AI services.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Image descriptions for WhatsApp” category.

TabReporter.description:
The TabReporter add-on adds sounds when you press the Tab and Shift+Tab keys.
This works when moving around objects in any location.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

jumpToWindow.description:
First developed in 2015, the JumpToWindow add-on allows NVDA users to quickly jump to windows by searching for text in their title bars or console content.
Features:
Quickly focus on windows by searching for text in their titles.
Search console windows for specific text content.
Support for regular expressions in search.
Usage:
Press NVDA+\ (backslash) to open the search dialog.
Enter text or regular expression to search.
Press Enter to search.
If a suitable window is found, it will be brought to the front and focused.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the “Go to window” section.

Prueba_de_velocidad_de_internet.description:
PruebaDeVelocidadDeInternet add-on for quick and easy Internet speed testing.
Under NVDA, Settings, Input Gestures, there is a category called “Internet Speed ​​Test” where you can assign a key combination to run the test.
Using the add-on:
Once you have successfully assigned the desired keyboard shortcut, you can use it to run the test.
During the test, you will hear an increasing beep.
Information messages will also be displayed.
Once the test is completed, the results will appear on your clipboard and you can share them or simply analyze them.

compartir_archivos.description:
The CompartirArchivos add-on allows you to upload files to the marco-ml.com server to create links that you can share later.
Features:
Upload files to the server with a maximum size of 1024 MB (1 GB).
Set the expiration time in hour format, with a maximum limit of 168 hours (7 days). If not specified, the default value of 24 hours will be applied.
Assign a custom name for the link. If not specified, the automatically generated identifier will be used.
Access the history of shared links, where you can manage them. History is stored locally, so some links may have expired or may have been opened previously.
All keyboard shortcuts are not assigned. You can configure them in the Input Gestures section, under the File Sharing category.
Some other details are described in the add-on help.

duckingFix.description:
Addition duckingFix - fixes the delay when muting the sound.
In the latest alphas of NVDA 2025.1, something was broken in the muting of speech, which is why strong lags appear when we turn on muting.
I'm sure this will be fixed, but for now it's a temporary solution.
If you are not testing the alpha version of NVDA, do not install this temporary add-on.

whatsapp-normalizer.description:
The purpose of the WhatsappNormalizer add-on is to convert Unicode characters to their normal form in the WhatsApp Desktop application.
It was designed to work around an accessibility bug in the WhatsApp Desktop app where characters with diacritics are converted to Unicode, making speech synthesizers very difficult to read.
After installation, no actions or settings are required. Just use WhatsApp as usual and forget about this error.

balloonHistory.description:
The BalloonHistory add-on allows you to Enable automatic registration of tooltips, as well as view registered tooltips in a separate dialog box.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Shift+F11: Tooltip recorder switch.
NVDA+Control+F11: Open tooltip history.
NVDA+Alt+F11: Clear tooltip history.
NVDA+Windows+F11: Toggle sound about new tooltips.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in “input gestures”, in the “Tooltip history” category.
The add-on settings are located in the following path:
NVDA Menu, Submenu Options, Settings, Tooltip History panel.
Everything is described in detail in the add-on help.

CopyingLinksFromBrowser.description:
The CopyingLinksFromBrowser add-on allows you to quickly listen to or copy link attributes, graphic element attributes, and page address attributes from the browser to the clipboard using keyboard shortcuts.
The following browsers are supported:
Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Chromium, Atom Internet Browser, Opera Internet Browser, SeaMonkey, Yandex browser.
In the add-on settings, you can add other browsers yourself (How to do this is described in detail in the help).
The default keyboard shortcut is not set.
Before using the add-on, read the help documentation.

autoSayTextClipBoardMod.summary: Auto Say Text Clip Board Mod
autoSayTextClipBoardMod.description:
The AutoSayTextClipBoardMod add-on simply automatically reads any new text that enters the clipboard.
You can select text using the keyboard or mouse.
If reading the text is suddenly interrupted, you can repeat it without selecting the text again, but simply press the F1 key.
When new text is detected on the clipboard, the add-on will read the text after two seconds, which will allow you to remove your hand from the mouse pad.
The add-on is specially designed for people who have difficulty using the keyboard with both hands (For people with cerebral palsy).
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

IgnoreSelectionSpeak.description:
The IgnoreSelectionSpeak add-on adds the current selection to a temporary dictionary, replacing it with an empty string.
This way, the selected text will be skipped when read aloud.
Useful for reading texts with repeated or unnecessary words/lines.
Added entries will be removed when NVDA is restarted or when entries are deleted from the temporary dictionary.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Alt+I: Add the currently selected text to a temporary dictionary, replacing it with an empty string.
NVDA+Alt+R: This script removes the last line added to the temporary dictionary by this add-on. So if you add 3 lines and call this script 3 times, the last three lines will be removed in reverse order.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the “Ignore speaking selected text” section.

LibreOfficeAccessEnhancement.description:
The LibreOfficeAccessEnhancement add-on provides additional functionality while working with LibreOffice.
Writer has added the ability to navigate through table cells on a page. If the table is located on several pages, then you can move between table cells only in that part of the table that is on the active page.
Keyboard shortcuts for the Writer module:
CONTROL+ALT+←: Moves the caret to the previous column (on the same line).
CONTROL+ALT+→: Moves the caret to the next column (on the same line).
CONTROL+ALT+↑: Moves the caret to the previous line (in the same column).
CONTROL+ALT+↓: Moves the caret to the next line (in the same column).
CONTROL+ALT+Home: Moves the system caret to the first column (on the same line).
CONTROL+ALT+End: Moves the system caret to the last column (on the same line).
CONTROL+ALT+PageUp: Moves the system caret to the first row (while being on the same column).
CONTROL+ALT+PageDown: Moves the system caret to the last row (on the same column).
The supplement was written for the ANO “I2T Center”.

accessiblePassPrompt.description:
Entering passwords can sometimes be difficult for a number of reasons, such as not knowing your keyboard layout well or using passwords with unusual characters.
The AccessiblePassPrompt add-on provides a special window for entering a password. Every time you need to enter text in a field and for some reason an alternative edit field is required, this add-on will come to the rescue.
Its use is very simple: while in the text field, press NVDA + Windows + P, enter your password and press Enter. The password will be written into the active field.
If for some reason the focus is different from what it was before this add-on's password window opened, the password will not be recorded for security reasons.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the System focus section for the shortcut shows a dialog box for entering a password, this password will be entered in the password field.

Blind Games.description:
Blind Game Accessibility is a gaming add-on for NVDA that offers an interactive experience with accessible games using audio features and clear dialogue. Ideal for entertainment and cognitive development, the add-on allows the user to select their favorite game and immerse themselves in an accessible and intuitive experience.
The following games are available:
"Even or Odd" in which the user makes a choice and tries to guess whether the total number will be even or odd.
"Guess the Number" in which the user tries to guess a secret number within a limited number of attempts.
Launch the add-on using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+J.
Wait for the audio intro and select the game from the menu.
Each game will feature special sounds and messages, making the game completely accessible.

NVDA Theems Manager.description:
NVDATheemsManager is simply an add-on for NVDA that adds audio themes functionality to NVDA.
By default, the add-on comes with one standard theme.
There is also an option “No theme”, which will disable the add-on.
After successfully installing the add-on and restarting nvda, press the hotkey: NVDA+Shift+M to open the NTM window, from this window you can do the following:
Use: Clicking this button will activate the selected theme, after clicking the Yes button, the selected theme will become active. You can also navigate through the list of available themes, and when you are interested in one, you can press Enter to activate it.
Add: This button allows you to add an audio theme to the list of installed themes, once added, you can use it immediately. Just select a topic from your file system and click OK to get it. The theme must meet the specifications listed in the add your own theme section.
Delete: As you'd expect, this will remove the selected topic from the list; note that deleted topics cannot be recovered.
Help: Click this button to open a help document, alternatively you can press f1 to do the same.
Other features are described in the help document.
In addition, there is a built-in utility for managing and creating themes, the interface of which cannot be localized.

nibynumpad.description:
The NibyNumpad add-on solves the problem of your computer not having a port (emulating a numeric keypad with the FN key, unnecessarily) to teach Sid the unintuitive NVDA laptop keys.
You can read the help for detailed keyboard shortcut mappings.
The add-on works regardless of the NVDA keyboard layout you're using: laptop or desktop, and can be used on larger keyboards as well - it may be easier than using these mappings instead of moving your hands from the main keyboard block to the number pad.

enpass.description:
The Enpass add-on improves the accessibility of the Enpass password manager of the same name.
Keyboard commands:
F10: Moves focus to the menu bar.
F6: If Settings is open, F6 brings focus to the tab bar.
Enter key or Spacebar: Switches to the tab bar selected in Settings.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under the Improving Enpass accessibility category.

dictionariesAlmaany.description:
The DictionariesAlmaany add-on helps you find out the meaning of individual words from the site www.almaany.com.
Press nvda+windows+d, a dialog box with dictionaries will appear on the screen, and you will find yourself in the editing field.
If you were standing on the highlighted word when you pressed this command, the translation result will be available directly from the default dictionary.
You can change the default dictionary used by the addon from the addon settings panel through the settings menu.
Otherwise, enter the word you need in the edit field, select the desired dictionary on the tab and press Enter.
The meaning of the word will be displayed in a separate window with the ability to view it.

devHelper.description:
The purpose of the DevHelper add-on is to make debugging easier in NVDA.
Current feature: Add marked lines to the log to make debugging easier.
Key Combination:
NVDA+Shift+F1: Inserts a line with a flag into the NVDA log.
When you press the command key, the add-on will insert into the NVDA log (at the information level) the line, Flag 1, and will also announce: "Mark 1 logged!".
If you press the key again, the line, Mark 2, will be inserted, and the message: "Mark 2 logged" will be spoken.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under Debugging Assistant.
In the NVDA settings, in the Debugging Assistant panel, you can specify the number of empty lines before and after the line with the mark.
You can read about other features of the add-on in the help.

jieshuoSounds.description:
The JieshuoSounds add-on adds a sound theme with sounds from the Jieshuo screen reader.
Keyboard shortcuts to disable and enable sounds are NVDA +Alt+J.

command_palette.description:
The CommandPalette add-on provides an NVDA-specific and system-wide command palette.
After the command search dialog opens, a selection of commands from a list will be available in the window, as well as a search editor in which you need to enter a search phrase.
If the search phrase is not found, there will be a message about this.
To view the found commands, go to the first list.
When the commands dialog opens, the list of commands displays all available commands from add-ons, as well as NVDA.
To execute a command, simply press Enter on the command.
By default, the key command for opening the search dialog is Incert+Shift-P, which can be changed in input gestures.

nvda-json.description:
The NVDAJson add-on adds functionality for formatting JSON in NVDA.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+J: If text is selected, takes the selected JSON text and displays it formatted in the NVDA preview dialog. If no text is selected, displays a Json text formatting dialog, retrieving Json data from the clipboard.
NVDA+Shift+J: formats multiple JSONS in one text.
NVDA+Control+J: Convert strings using JSONPointer.
This addon allows you to filter/transform JSON using JQ or JSONPath.
The default is JQ, but you can change this in the NVDA settings panel.
JQ is like a programming language for filtering and transforming JSON data.
Because of this flexibility, this query mechanism is used by default in the add-on.
JSONPath is a syntax that allows you to filter JSON elements.
Examples of use are given in the help.
The keyboard shortcut cannot be changed - this feature is not implemented by the developer.

vocalizer_expressive2_driver_ByDroidApps.summary: Vocalizer Expressive 2 Driver By Droid Apps
vocalizer_expressive2_driver_ByDroidApps.description:
The vocalizer_expressive2_driver add-on is a driver and interface for Nuance Vocalizer expressive speech synthesizers version 2.2.
This driver does not require a license, but to use it you must install at least one voice downloaded from the site https://nvda.ru/sintezatory-rechi-vocalizer-expressive2-dlja-nvda
or
https://nvda-addons.ru/subcat.php?id=ve22
Attention! To avoid losing free use, we do not update the driver through the add-on store or the Spanish store.
Modified by the DroidApps Telegram channel.

VSU.description:
The VSU add-on is a driver for the Japanese speech synthesizer Voicevox.
Voicevox Japanese speech synthesizer driver for NVDA.
VoiceVox spells out all English words.
For this reason, it is recommended to use it in conjunction with the NVDA add-on ERE (EnglishReadingEnhancer), which converts English words into katakana before reading them.
By default, Voicevox runs on the CPU, even if you download the GPU version.
If you want to use the GPU version, please change the settings first.
After installing VSU, the VSU item is added to the NVDA menu.
Currently, it allows you to enable/disable automatic version update checking and perform manual checking.
All driver features and settings are described by the developer in the add-on help documentation.
Note: Japanese speech synthesizers are available at a cost.

BFDown.description:
The BFDown add-on converts the Markdown text you copied to the clipboard into HTML and displays it on a virtual screen.
After copying the text with Markdown markup to the clipboard, press the key combination - NVDA+CONTROL+SHIFT+M.
After this, the converted text with HTML markup will be copied to the clipboard, in addition, the result with html will be opened in a virtual viewer window. The result window can be closed with the Escape key.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the subsection (Converting Markdown from the clipboard to HTML).

EnableMicrophone.description:
The EnableMicrophone add-on allows you to turn on your microphone for ten seconds, record audio, turn it off, and then play back the recorded data.
Press the keyboard shortcut Control+Shift+Backslash to do this.
The ability to change keyboard shortcuts in the add-on is not implemented.

DLEChecker.description:
The DLEChecker add-on looks up the definition of the selected word in the dictionary of the Royal Spanish Academy.
It is the highest advisory body on matters of spelling and grammar and is responsible for ensuring a uniform standard and ensuring that the changes it undergoes do not disrupt the essential unity that it maintains throughout the Spanish-speaking world.
You can also find out synonyms and antonyms of the term you are looking for thanks to the Wordreference thesaurus.
The only keyboard shortcut currently available in this add-on is NVDA + Shift + C. It is responsible for displaying an input dialog box for entering a search term, as well as for querying the Diccionario de la Lengua Española de la RAE (RAE Spanish Dictionary) web page.
The NVDA + Shift + C keyboard shortcut can be configured through the Input Gestures dialog in the NVDA Settings option in the DLEChecker (Spanish Language Dictionary Checker) category.

kgsbraille.description:
The KGSBraille add-on is a Driver for KGS Braille Memo devices.
KGS Driver supporting BM Smart, Braille Memo, Braille Memo Pocket and Braille Tender series.

lambda.description:
The Lambda add-on provides access to the Lambda math editor of the same name with support for Braille and speech.
This project is an app module for LAMBDA software. It was influenced by the work of Peter Leckie at Comenius University. 
LAMBDA (Linear Access to Mathematic for Braille Device and Audio-synthesis) Linear access to mathematics for Braille device and audio synthesis.
This is software that helps blind people read and write mathematical calculations using a braille display and/or a speech synthesizer.
LAMBDA is the result of an EU project. More information about LAMBDA can be found at LambdaProject.org.
The current version of the add-on includes braille tables for Italian and Spanish, and its interface is available in most official NVDA languages ​​as it has been translated by the NVDA translator community.

seikamini.description:
The SeikaMini add-on is a driver for Seika Notetakers braille devices.
Driver repackaging by Accessolutions
supplied by the manufacturer as an add-on to NVDA.

TreeNav.description:
The TreeNav add-on adds convenient navigation through the tree view.
Currently only Thunderbird email chain is supported.
Teams:
NVDA+Control+up/down arrow Allows you to move to the previous/next element at the same level.
NVDA+Control+Right Arrow Move to first child element.
NVDA+Control+Left Arrow Move to parent element.
Note: The add-on is still in development and is an alpha version.

espeak_ng_custom.description:
The ESpeakNGCustom add-on is a multilingual speech synthesizer eSpeak NG, repackaged as an add-on by Beka Gozalishvili.
With dictionary corrections from Kirill.

audiocinemateca.description:
The Audiocinemateca add-on offers us the possibility of having an Audiocinemateca page in our NVDA.
Audiocinemateca is a site created in 2015 that maintains and updates a collection of films, series, documentaries and short films in audio format with audio description for blind people, completely free and in Spanish.
This add-on allows you to access web content from a native Windows interface, simple with keyboard shortcuts and without having to open an additional program, with all its features integrated into NVDA.
What the add-on offers:
The add-on will allow you to watch, play and download any movie, series, documentary or short film in the Audio Cinema.
You will be able to view a file with the same data as on the web page.
We can play movies, TV series (with season and episode selection), documentaries or short films in a simple player.
We will also be able to download any movie, series (by selecting a season and episode), documentary or short film.
In the case of movies, some of them may contain several parts, so we will be able to choose which part of the movie we want to play or download.
In the case of TV series, we will need to select a season (if there are several of them) and an episode both when playing and when downloading.
The add-on is managed through an interface that allows you to make requests, as well as play and download.
In addition, during playback we will be able to control the entire playback process from anywhere in Windows.
The add-on can be launched from the Tools menu, Audiocinemateca, or by assigning the appropriate keys in Input Gestures, Audiocinemateca.
The add-on does not come with assigned keys, so you will have to assign them yourself.
The add-on requires a valid Audio cinematic username and password.
The most detailed guidance on the add-on can be found in the help.

say-nvda-version.description:
The SayNVDAVersion add-on will add one simple function that will allow you to listen to the current version of NVDA by pressing a key combination.
Press the keyboard shortcut: NVDA+Control+Shift+V to hear your version of nvda.
The keyboard shortcut cannot be changed in input gestures - this was not implemented by the developer.

nvda-for-vs-code.description:
The NVDAForVSCode NVDA add-on contains fixes and improvements primarily for the Microsoft Visual Studio Code editor component.
Please note that Microsoft Visual Studio Code is not a Microsoft Visual Studio IDE.
This is a lightweight code editor.
Features of this add-on:
The add-on supports all editions, including: stable, insider or local development.
Provides filtering for conditions that make speech output excessively verbose.
Cancel reading the entire line from the beginning after attempting to complete, subject to some limitations.
Additional notes and issues are described by the developer in the help.

closingTools.description:
The ClosingTools add-on will add the following keyboard shortcuts to NVDA:
Not assigned, Close the active tab by sending Control+F4
Control+Pause, Close the active tab by sending Control+W.
Alt+Pause, Close all windows.
Pause, Close the focused window by sending Alt+F4.
Not assigned, Show desktop by sending Windows+D.
Not assigned, Allows you to open the closingTools add-on settings dialog.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Close Tools section.

HotkeysPlus.description:
The HotkeysPlus add-on will add the following keyboard shortcuts to NVDA:
Pause key: close the active window, similar to the Alt+F4 command.
Control+Pause: close the active tab, similar to the control+w command.
Command not assigned: close the active tab, similar to control+F4.
Alt+Pause: close all windows.
Command not assigned: Show desktop, similar to the windows+d command.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Keyboard shortcuts Plus section.

read_insta_message.description:
The ReadInstaMessage add-on allows you to read Instagram messages on the web.
Simply enable the feature to automatically set system focus to focusable elements by pressing nvda+7, and you can disable it after finishing the conversation.
You can move between messages using b and shift+b, that is, move between buttons because a message appears.
I created this add-on a long time ago, and now I’m sharing it with you after I saw that some people really needed it.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.
Starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

inputLayoutToggler.description:
The InputLayoutToggler add-on adds functionality for quickly switching between available keyboard layouts using the Alt+Shift+1-0 keyboard shortcuts.
The add-on does not have the ability to change the keyboard shortcut, and there are no settings.
The add-on starts working immediately after installation or activation.

ObjLocSound.description:
The ObjLocSound add-on shows the size and location of objects using stereo sound and pitch.
When viewing window objects, NVDA will use stereo and pitch to indicate the coordinate location of the object's center point on the screen based on the object currently being viewed.
Keyboard shortcut:
Enable or disable sound effects for object location coordinates. The default keyboard shortcut is NVDA+L.
Play sound effects of the coordinates of the top left and bottom right corners of the current object, double tap will give detailed information. The default keyboard shortcut is NVDA+A.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the subsection Sound detection of object location.

txtReader.description:
The TxtReader add-on for NVDA is a program for reading text files without an interface.
When you open a text file, the add-on copies its contents to memory and closes the file, allowing you to read it using keyboard shortcuts.
The content is sent to the reader so it can be read without being displayed on the screen.
NVDA+Alt+F: Displays a dialog to open a file.
NVDA+Alt+Down Arrow: Move to the next line of text.
NVDA+Alt+Up Arrow: Move to the previous line of text.
NVDA+Alt+space: Read the current line.
NVDA+Alt+Home or End: Go to the beginning or end of the text.
NVDA+Alt+Right Arrow: If multiple files were open, move to the next text in the list.
NVDA+Alt+Left Arrow: If multiple files were open, move to the previous text in the list.
NVDA+Alt+Backspace: Remove current text from the list.
NVDA+Alt+T: Read file header.
NVDA+Alt+C: Copy the current line to the clipboard.
NVDA+Alt+L: If one or more files were opened previously, clears the list of texts.
NVDA+Alt+G: Displays a dialog to jump to a specific line.
NVDA+Alt+B: Displays a dialog for searching the current text.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, TXT Reader.

Vscode-line-numbers.description:
The VsCodeLineNumbers add-on makes it easy to find out about the current line in VsCode.
You can also listen to which column (which character in the line) has the cursor focus.
You can obtain this information using the following keyboard shortcuts:
NVDA+SHIFT+W: report column (character number in line).
NVDA+W: report line number.
If desired, you can change the keyboard shortcut in the NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures, VsCode Line Numbers.

jumpToLine.description:
The JumpToLine add-on allows you to jump to any line in the text by pressing a key combination.
The following keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+J allows you to access a specific line in the document.
A dialog box prompting you to enter a line number displays the line number, which makes the default initialization with the current line number.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous subsection, for the Go to line shortcut.

rastreiosCorreio.description:
The RastreiosCorreio add-on tracks orders on the correio do brasil website using the order code.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+E: Get latest tracking code status.
NVDA+Control+E: Get all statuses by tracking code.
NVDA+Shift+Control+E: Get the status for the user-entered tracking code.
You can change the combination in input gestures, in the RastreioCorreios section.

displayAddonsChangelog.description:
DisplayAddonsChangelog add-on to display information about changes when updating add-ons when installing them.
If the add-on developer has included a changelog.txt file, its contents will be displayed during installation if you are upgrading from a previous version.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation or activation.
Add-on developers only need to include a file called changelog.txt with this information.
It is advisable that the file be encoded in UTF-8 and not be too long to be viewed in the dialog box.
There may be translations of the changelog.txt file in the corresponding documentation language folders: the one that matches the NVDA language will be displayed.

unicornNVDA.description:
UnicornNVDA is an add-on that facilitates communication between NVDA and the Unicorn external library.
The add-on enables information exchange between local and remote NVDA instances, such as braille/speech input as well as data output.
The add-on provides an easy way to use the UnicornDVC library.

ifInterpreters.description:
The IFInterpreters add-on provides automatic speech output for interactive fiction interpreters.
Supported Windows interpreters:
AdvSys (GLK), for games in the AdvSys format.
AGiliTy, for games in the Adventure Game Toolkit format.
Frotz, for games in Z-Code format.
Git and Glulxe (GLK), for games in the Glulxe format.
HTML Tads Player Kit, for games in Tads2 and Tads3 format.
Hugo (GLK), for games in the Hugo format.
Level 9, for games in A-Code format.
Magnetic, for games in the Magnetic Scrolls format.
Nitfol (GLK), for games in Z-Code format.
Scare (GLK), for games in the Adrift format.
WinARun (GLK), for games in Alan format.
WinARun3 (GLK), for games in Alan 3 format.
If you previously installed an add-on for any of these programs, you must remove it before installing this add-on.
Other details are described in the help.
Noelia (nvdaes), the publisher of this add-on, has tested it with WinGlulxe, but not with other interpreters.

CurrencyConverter.description:
CurrencyConverter add-on for converting currencies using Google server:
Keyboard shortcut NVDA+Alt+C.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the Currency Converter subsection for the shortcut to open the currency converter dialog.
An Internet connection is required to operate.

Biblos.description:
Biblos add-on to improve accessibility of the Biblos Braille Word Processor.
For version 5.70.
You can download the program installer from the Digrande.it website.

UltraEloquence.description:
The UltraEloquence add-on is an eloquence synthesizer for NVDA with support for automatic language switching.
This add-on also includes Chinese, Japanese and Korean languages.
Please note that this is a modification.

FirefoxSupport.description:
The FirefoxSupport add-on adds enhanced support for the Mozilla Firefox web browser.
Read the status bar and copy the status bar to the clipboard.
Go to the tab bar.
Go to the address bar, as well as read and copy the address bar.

RHVoicePremium.description:
The RHVoice add-on is the main module (driver) required for the operation of RHVoice speech synthesizers.
The presented driver works with free and paid (Premium) voices.
Do not install or enable it at the same time as the original RHVoice, there will be a conflict and one of them will not work.
Without this engine, installed voices will not work in NVDA.
After installing the driver and at least one voice, RHVoice will be available for selection in the list of synthesizers NVDA+Control+S.

IBMTTS By Ashraf Helal.description:
The IBMTTSByAshrafHelal add-on is an IBMTTS synthesizer driver for NVDA with an added ECI library.
Please note that this is a modification. This add-on makes NVDA compatible with the IBMTTS synthesizer.
modification author Ashraf Helal.
This add-on makes NVDA compatible with the IBMTTS synthesizer.
What is the IBMTTS synthesizer?
ViaVoice TTS is a text-to-speech engine developed by IBM that synthesizes the textual representation of human language into speech.
Although this driver is compatible with the Eloquence libraries (since Eloquence has the same api as IBMTTS), using Eloquence with this driver is not recommended due to licensing issues. Before using synthesis libraries with this driver, it is recommended that you first obtain license usage rights.

IBMTTS With Serbian Cyrillic Support.description:
The IBMTTSSerbian add-on is an IBMTTS synthesizer driver with Serbian Cyrillic support prepared by Darko Milosevic.
Please note that this is a modification.
This add-on makes NVDA compatible with the IBMTTS synthesizer.
What is the IBMTTS synthesizer?
ViaVoice TTS is a text-to-speech engine developed by IBM that synthesizes the textual representation of human language into speech.
Although this driver is compatible with the Eloquence libraries (since Eloquence has the same api as IBMTTS), using Eloquence with this driver is not recommended due to licensing issues. Before using synthesis libraries with this driver, it is recommended that you first obtain license usage rights.

TeamTalk.description:
The TeamTalk add-on improves the availability of the program of the same name as follows:
Gives names to channel messages and input edit fields on the main screen.
Names the toolbar items for those viewing it using the navigator.
Provides the Control+Shift+S keyboard shortcut to check the status of voice activation, push-to-talk, video, audio save, and more.
The names of controls in the Banned Users dialog and other places where buttons for adding and deleting lists are located have been improved.
Silences the progress indicator showing real-time microphone volume.
Prevents NVDA from displaying a 1 of 1 message for all channel tree elements.

dutchBiblicalStudies.description:
The DutchBiblicalStudies add-on adds the grc-international-nl braille table.
