With this braille chart you can view resources for learning ancient biblical languages ​​for Dutch users.
Note: The add-on is under development, so the developer has added an unfinished table that does not contain anything yet.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

JGT.description:
The JGT (Japanese Games Translator) add-on allows you to translate text during gameplay from Japanese to English in some Japanese audio games.
JGT is focused on two things:
Firstly, to give those new to Japanese games the easiest experience possible to start playing and enjoying them.
That is, it requires less software to install and configure than other solutions, and gives you step-by-step instructions to get started.
Second, to provide more automatic and seamless translation than what other toolkits currently support.
For example, with auto-translation of the last words turned on, you can navigate through the menu and immediately hear the English version of each menu item without pressing an additional hotkey.
Translator's note: You can view the supported list of Japanese games in the detailed user manual.

objEnhancer.description:
The Object Enhancer add-on allows you to change the way NVDA objects appear on the screen using an intuitive interface.
It can be used to change the label of an object, but depending on how you use it, it has the functionality to change almost any property of an object.
Keyboard shortcut:
Copy the base64 encoded SHA1 hash of the navigator object bitmap to the clipboard - NVDA+control+alt+h.
Setting the properties of the navigator object - NVDA+control+shift+tab.
Open the Object Enhancer Definitions dialog box - NVDA+control+shift+tab.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Object Amplifier subsection.

objInspector.description:
The ObjInspector add-on shows a list of all objects visible in the active window.
It also shows information about them that is useful for add-on developers.
Objects can be filtered and added to favorites to make them easier to find.
Keyboard shortcut:
Show a list of objects in the active window - NVDA+F4.
You can change the command in input gestures, in the objInspector subsection.

XPoseImage Captioner.description:
The XPoseImageCaptioner add-on allows you to create AI descriptions for JPEG and PNG images from Windows File Explorer, Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome and Firefox.
It does all the inferences on the user's local machine, rather than relying on a remote server to create the image description. 
To use, first select an image using the navigation cursor, then press NVDA+x to launch the add-on.
The add-on will display the message “I’m describing, please wait” while the artificial intelligence creates captions for the image.
This process will take between one and five seconds depending on the speed of your machine's processor. Once the AI ​​has finished creating the caption, a window will open showing the description text and the description text will be read. The window with the inscription can be closed by pressing Escape.
To create descriptions, the BLIP Local Neural Network is used.
Works without an Internet connection. Description is provided in English.
Note: In the localized version, you can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the section Describe XPose images, Describe image with.

WikiChecker.description:
The WikiChecker add-on for NVDA allows users to quickly and easily view any article about a specific term on Wikipedia.
WikiChecker is very easy to use. Just follow these three steps:
Click the assigned hotkey that you previously configured in the Input Gestures dialog box under the WikiChecker category.
Enter the desired search query in the edit field provided and complete it by pressing ENTER or the “Search” button.
Select the result you are interested in and press ENTER on it, or click the “Read Article” button.
After completing these three steps, the article will open in your default browser window.
There are no pre-assigned keyboard shortcuts to launch the add-on, so each user can configure the ones that work best for them in each case, so as not to interfere with other add-ons.
To assign them, the user must go to the NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures, and there find the WikiChecker category and assign the combination that interests him most.

Elecgeste braille driver.description:
ElecgesteBrailleDriver add-on to support Elecgeste BD 40 001 pro L PB braille displays.
Driver for nvda, made from super brl driver.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

everything.description:
The Everything add-on improves the accessibility of the Everything program of the same name.
The add-on allows you to change the order of columns declared by NVDA, as well as enable or disable the declaration of column names in the Everything program.
After installing this add-on, by default, columns are declared as follows: name, date, size, path.
To change the column order, go to the NVDA settings menu and scroll down to the Everything section.
This section contains a checkbox that allows you to enable or disable the declaration of column names.
Next there are 3 lists in which you can select each time the element that you want to display in order.
After these lists there is also a button that allows you to return to the default settings.
Keyboard shortcut:
When Everything is open, the keyboard shortcut Control+Shift+O allows you to directly open the add-on's settings panel. Make your changes and click OK to confirm. The changes will take effect immediately.

realTesseractOCR.description:
The RealTesseractOCR add-on recognizes text from images using tesseract machine learning.
List of hotkeys:
NVDA+ALT+I: change recognition language.
NVDA+I: text recognition on images. Copies the text to the clipboard and speaks it.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, in the realTesseractOCR subsection.
Before starting work, you must independently specify the Path to the installed Tesseract-OCR in the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Settings, Categories: RealTesseractOCR.

objsounds.description:
The ObjSounds add-on plays sounds based on objects when you move towards them.
You can turn sounds on or off using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+Delete.
You can change the command in input gestures, section Tools, Turn object sounds on or off. 
The addition is a sound theme.
Please note that this is not an official version, as the developer stopped supporting this add-on a long time ago.

NV-Braille2Speech.description:
NVBraille2Speech software combines electronic braille and artificial intelligence technology to realize electronic braille. The system includes Braille input method, text output, voice output and Chinese characters to Braille translation modules.
The goal is to free the ears of visually impaired people and provide application software that can input Braille without interference and can freely convert between Braille, speech and Chinese characters to enable writing and reading.
You can learn more about the features of the add-on, as well as find out about keyboard shortcuts in the help.
In the settings, in the “Braille Input” section, there are two functions: One-handed input and Read dots out loud when typing with one hand.
Keyboard shortcuts:
NVDA+0 - Enable or disable braille input.
NVDA+O - Enable or disable braille to speech translation.
NVDA+X - Convert input Unicode braille to Chinese characters.
Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the Braille section.

mouseEnhancements.description:
The MouseEnhancements add-on contains improvements for working with the mouse in NVDA.
Some features may be moved as separate features in the future.
Features:
Fixing mouse tracking in Electron apps
Electron applications such as VS Code.
Fixed part of the NVIDIA Control Panel where the content of the static text description control was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where some buttons in PDFgear were unable to receive description text.
The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

fixExplorer.description:
The FixExplorer add-on fixes the problem with focus freezing when opening the standard Windows Explorer file manager.
If you do not have such a problem, then you do not need to install this add-on.
The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts.
Starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

keyboardTrainer.description:
The KeyboardTrainer add-on will help you master typing on a keyboard using the ten-finger method.
The simulator supports only English and Ukrainian languages.
You can activate the simulator using the combination NVDA+Shift+K.
You can also disable it using the same combination. The add-on is actively being developed, so expect updates with even more features.

char_silencer.description:
The CharSilencer add-on allows NVDA to disable or enable reading of entered characters in non-editable fields.
For example, in any (Explorer) folder, you don't want to hear the character key press when you click on the first character of the folder, file, or desktop shortcut name. Thus, you can disable the pronunciation of characters in any other programs and applications.
Press NVDA + 9 to turn character pronunciation on or off in non-editable fields.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the CharSilencer section (Silencing entered characters in non-editable fields).
Please do not confuse the functionality of this add-on with the built-in NVDA function, which turns on and off the reading of entered characters in editable fields when you press the NVDA+2 command.

almaanyEnglishDictionaries.description:
The AlmaanyEnglishDictionaries add-on will help you find out the meaning of words or phrases on almaany.com.

To do this, the add-on uses many English-other language dictionaries on the site.

If you didn't find your language among them, I'm sorry, as these are all available dictionaries and we tried to use them.

An Internet connection is required to use this add-on.
Attention: most of the dictionaries used are bilingual, that is, for example, an English-French dictionary translates from English to French and from French to English.
This add-on does not have a default keyboard shortcut. They must be assigned independently in input gestures in the section of the same name.

TalkBackSoundEffectForNVDA.description:
The TalkBackSoundEffectForNVDA add-on adds a sound theme with sounds from the TalkBack screen reader.
Keyboard shortcuts - NVDA +Alt+V.
Pressing once toggles between turning object sounds on and off, and double-pressing toggles between pronunciation and turning off object types.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, under TalkBack Sound Theme.

SilentTyping.description:
SilentTyping is a simple addition that suppresses the declaration of alphanumeric keys in non-editable controls.
For example:
In a text editor or other editors, the spacebar key will be pronounced when pressed, but in the PotPlayer interface
or any sound editor, voice recorder, the pressed key will not be pronounced.
In Explorer, when going through shortcuts, folders, files by the first letter, you will not hear the letter you press, but will immediately hear the name of the folder, file, shortcut.
The addition will also be useful for those who make various audio recordings in voice recorders and sound editors, when it is not necessary for the pronunciation of the keys pressed to be included in the recording.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation and restarting NVDA.

AudioControl.description:
AudioControl add-on for controlling the audio process and audio output devices.
Add-ons to adjust volume, configure mute mode, and toggle NVDA audio output for running applications.
Keyboard shortcuts are described in the help.
Commands can be changed in input gestures, in the Sound Control section.

eclipseEnhance.description:
The EclipseEnhance add-on improves speech and braille support when running in the eclipse IDE, and also adds error and warning messages.
Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the Eclipse section.
You can learn more about the add-on features and keyboard shortcuts in the add-on help.

Copy Append.description:
dAddition CopyAppend for adding selected text to the clipboard.
Allows you to add new text to existing text on the clipboard without replacing it.
Press Control plus shift plus c to add text to the clipboard.
NVDA plus shift plus c to clear clipboard data (Warning: the command to clear the clipboard does not work).

copyLastSpeech.description:
The CopyLastSpeech add-on adds functions for copying the last NVDA speech message to the clipboard, as well as adding speech messages to the clipboard by accumulation.
Additionally, if a link was spoken or copied to the clipboard, it can be opened in your default browser.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+X - Copy the last NVDA voice message to the clipboard.
NVDA+D - add the latest voice message to the clipboard.
NVDA+G - Open in the default browser the URL that was last listened to or copied to the clipboard.
You can also change these commands in the Miscellaneous category in the NVDA Options, Input Gestures dialog box.

NVDATranslate.description:
The Translate add-on uses the DeepL API to translate spoken text into the desired language on the fly.
This add-on requires a DeepL key and an Internet connection.
The keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on reference guide.
You can change commands in input gestures, section Translation using DeepL.
The presented add-on is a modification of the Translate add-on, as well as the TranslateEnhancement add-on.

reportLastProgressBarValue.description:
The ReportLastProgressBarValue add-on will tell you the current progress bar value whenever you need it after pressing a keyboard shortcut.
For example, you have completely disabled automatic notification (Speaking progress bars), but you still need to know the current indicator percentage.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Control+U, which can be changed in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous subsection, for the shortcut Tells the current value of the progress bar.

OpenContextMenu.description:
The OpenContextMenu add-on adds the ability to open a context menu using one of several suggested keyboard shortcuts.
You can select a key combination in the add-on settings, which are located in the NVDA parameters, in the Open context menu tab.
By default, the key combination Ctrl+Right Shift is used to open the context menu.
This add-on will be very useful for those who do not have a separate key to open the context menu on their keyboard.
Keyboard shortcut to open the context menu:
Control+Right Shift.
Right Control.
Control+Right Control.
Alt+Right Control.
Windows+Right Control.
Windows+Left Shift.
Windows+Right Shift.

customSpeakTypedCharacters.description:
The CustomSpeakTypedCharacters add-on allows you to customize how NVDA pronounces typed characters and words.
Users can choose from three modes: off, on, and editable controls only.
Features:
Three voice modes for typed characters and words: off, on, and only in editable controls.
Easily switch between modes using keyboard shortcuts.
Usage:
After installation, you can switch modes by pressing the appropriate keyboard shortcuts:
NVDA+2: Switches the pronunciation of typed characters.
NVDA+3: Switching the pronunciation of typed words.
Modes.
Off: NVDA will not speak the characters or words you type.
Enabled: NVDA will speak all characters or words typed.
On editable controls only: NVDA will only speak the characters or words you type when the focus is on an editable control.

EnhanceTools.description:
The EnhanceTools add-on adds the following utilities to NVDA.
Declaration of the current desktop.
Declaring an empty folder in Windows Explorer.

AutoBeepTextClipBoard.description:
The AutoBeepTextClipBoard add-on simply emits a short beep when any new text is automatically added to the clipboard.
As soon as the selected text is copied to the clipboard using a regular mouse, using the copy command Control+C (Control+Incert pressed twice), the cut command Control+X, or by clicking the copy buttons on the website and the program, you will hear a short signal that will indicate that the copied new text has indeed entered the clipboard.
If such text is already in the buffer, then you will not hear a short sound.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

autoSayTextClipBoard.description:
The AutoSayTextClipBoard add-on simply automatically reads any new text that enters the clipboard.
The add-on is specially designed for people who have difficulty using the keyboard with both hands (for example, for people with cerebral palsy).
As soon as the selected text is copied to the clipboard using a regular mouse, the text from the clipboard will be automatically read out.
The same thing will happen if the text is copied using the usual Control+C command.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

TemplateEngine.description:
The TemplateEngine add-on allows you to save selected text in 10 cells, and then insert text from the selected cell, simulating typing from the keyboard.
Keyboard shortcut:
Control+Alt+Shift+numbers_0-9 - saving the selected text to one of ten slots.
Control+Alt+numbers_0-9 - inserts saved text from the corresponding slot into the current control element.
Text insertion is accomplished by sending each character to the system focus object as if the text were being typed by a human using a keyboard.
Because of this, NVDA speaks every character of the text you paste.
Text fragments in slots are saved to a file on disk, so nothing is lost when NVDA is restarted.
You can change the keyboard shortcuts for inserting text in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous subsection, for the Insert text from slot shortcut.

AppSound.description:
The AppSound add-on adjusts the volume of the app you are in or using.
To decrease the volume, press NVDA+F5, to increase - NVDA+F6.
At the same time, a specific signal or sound signal will be heard confirming your action.

BasicYoutubeDownloader.description:
The BasicYouTubeDownloader add-on is designed to download a single video or an entire YouTube playlist, the link to which you have copied to the clipboard.
You can use the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+Y to start downloading a video or playlist from a link from the clipboard.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in the input gestures settings.
Before starting the download, the add-on prompts you to select a folder and quality. The boot process is accompanied by a sound signal, which can be turned off by pressing the NVDA + less key key combination.
The download process is also described in detail in the help.

tooltipReader.description:
TooltipReader add-on for reading the latest tooltip.
NVDA+O, press once to listen to the tooltip, press twice to copy the tooltip to the clipboard.
NVDA+Alt+O, to turn tooltips on and off if you need to hear them constantly.
The key command can be changed in input gestures, section Reading tooltips.

referenceStyler.description:
Reference Styler is an add-on for NVDA that allows users to manage and insert references in a variety of citation styles.
It supports APA, MLA, Chicago, Vancouver, Harvard, IEEE, AMA and ACS styles.
Features:
Link list management.
Inserting references in different citation styles.
Supports multiple citation styles: APA, MLA, Chicago, Vancouver, Harvard, IEEE, AMA and ACS.
Easy to use interface to add, edit and delete links.
Keyboard shortcut for quickly inserting links.
You can find out how to use the add-on, as well as find out all the keyboard shortcuts, in the help.

aidaMenu.description:
The AidaMenu add-on allows you to open menus in the seventh version of Aida64.
Not everyone needs this, but if, for example, you want to run tests or configure something, this add-on can help you.
To open the menu, the default keyboard shortcut is NVDA+O.
You can change the combination in input gestures, in the Aida Menu subsection, for the Open menu shortcut.

Sight-Free-Talon.description:
The SightFreeTalon add-on creates a command and control server in NVDA that can receive socket messages from Talon.
It allows you to toggle multiple settings in NVDA and execute multiple commands.
Specifically, it can disable speech interruption for typed characters and speak out the words/characters you've typed so that the audio echo that comes back when the Talon types your words is not interrupted by NVDA.
This will temporarily disable the interrupt only during dictation and return it once the dictation is complete.
This will allow you to keep your normal NVDA settings while dictating while still typing with Talon.

qqmusicUWPEnhancement.description:
The QqMusicUWPEnhancement add-on adds accessibility support for the QQ Music UWP app from the Windows Store.
The plugin mainly implements three types of functions, optimizing interface accessibility, quickly focusing on certain controls and performing certain operations, namely:
Adding labels to some controls.
Optimized display of some list items.
Adding automatic reading of lyrics and song titles.
Add shortcut keys to quickly focus on the search box and search results.
Add fast forward, rewind, play and pause keys.
All keyboard shortcuts are described in the help for the add-on.
The developer has not prepared a localization add-on, so the input gestures have shortcuts in Chinese.

promemoria.description:
The ProMemoria add-on notifies you with a message when you start NVDA if there are reminders for the current day.
A reminder will appear every time you start NVDA.
When you select a date for a reminder, you can only select the day and month. It is impossible to select the year, as well as the exact time.
You must manually assign a shortcut from the input gestures to open the reminder dialog box, and then set reminders from the dialog box.
The command shortcut (Show reminder dialog) is located in input gestures, subsection Miscellaneous.

KoreanSpellChecker.description:
The KoreanSpellChecker add-on adds spell checking functionality to NVDA for the Korean language.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+F8 - Check spelling.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures.
The add-on uses an external service, so it requires an Internet connection to work.

KoreanHelper.description:
The KoreanHelper add-on is a Hangul helper.
This is an optional feature that helps you input and output Hangul data, such as adjusting Hangul input settings.
Hangul is the modern Korean alphabet.

swamp.description:
The Swamp add-on improves interaction with the Swamp game of the same name.
Keyboard shortcut:
Space - insert a command.
NVDA+V - Say the current command.
NVDA+A - Autofill switch.

qqPatch.description:
The QQPatch add-on integrates the QQ Input Field patch and the QQ At patch to resolve the conflict between the two patches.
Resolved an issue where the QQ input window could not use the cursor keys to browse and the list of group members would not be read out loud after typing Chinese, as well as support for a list of emojis after typing "/" (slash).
Integration of QQ Input Box and At patch to solve the problem of conflict when installing two patches at the same time.
NVDA can read the list of @ group members by pressing the up and down cursor keys after typing @ in a QQ group chat. And after entering /, it can read the abbreviation of the emoji name, and you can directly select the emoji using the up and down cursor keys.
Also solved the problem that after entering Chinese, when you want to read the text in the edit field with the cursor, you can no longer read it, and you can only shift+tab to move the focus manually to read it again.

xtouchEditor.description:
The X-Touch add-on defines several gestures for the Behringer X-Touch Editor for Windows.
Only switching modes and loading ready-made layouts is supported, but not editing layouts. 
For most of these operations, the editor requests confirmation in a pop-up dialog. Dialogue is not available, but should be spoken by NVDA. Press Enter to confirm and return to the editor.
The following gestures are implemented:
NVDA+Shift+m - switches to MIDI mode, required to load a preset.
NVDA+Shift+l - request to load a preset from a file, after confirming the download of the preset, select the file in the Windows File dialog.
NVDA+Shift+a - load the preset to the device, layout A.
NVDA+Shift+b - load the preset to the device, layout B.
NVDA+Shift+n - switch to Mackie mode, operations with presets will be disabled.

sibiac.description:
The Sibiac add-on allows you to work with predefined graphical and fixed dialogs using only the mouse.
IMPORTANT: Please also install the sibiac_ocr add-on, it contains the necessary OCR library.
All keyboard shortcuts are provided by SIBIAC itself, so normal NVDA rules and settings are ignored.
You can read about the features of the add-on in the attached help.

nvdaKeyMode.description:
The NVDAKeyMode add-on allows you to use any key or key combination as a delayed NVDA key.
For example, imagine that you need to press the key combination NVDA+control+F, where the NVDA key is the Insert key.
If you assign Insert in this add-on, then through the Input Gestures dialog, you can press Insert, and then, in absolute comfort, Control+F.
At this point, the Incert key will be (silently) released.
Caps lock and Num lock keys are also supported (but not recommended).
To designate a key that you usually use as an NVDA key, first uncheck it in the NVDA menu, Settings, Options, Keyboard.
ATTENTION! When you select a key for this add-on, please ensure that your physical keyboard has a regular NVDA key at all times.
For example, use Caps lock as a regular NVDA key (check this in NVDA Options, Keyboard) and Incert as an additional key.
This way, hopefully, you will never encounter a situation where you are unable to execute keyboard commands.
You can assign a key or key combination in input gestures, in the NVDAKeyMode subsection.

nordvpn.description:
The NordVpn add-on increases the availability of the NordVPN client of the same name by signing many elements.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or settings.
It starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

thunderbirdPlus.description:
The ThunderbirdPlus add-on adds commands to the ThunderBird 102.x email client that make it more accessible, efficient, and easy to use.
More information about the features and functionality of the add-on, as well as keyboard shortcuts, can be found in the user manual after installation.

virtualbox.description:
The VirtualBox add-on improves the accessibility of the VirtualBox program of the same name using NVDA.
display the selected list item using nvda - Down Arrow - Up Arrow.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures section of VirtualBox.

TimeCalculator.description:
TimeCalculator add-on for NVDA to calculate time from system time to user-selected time.
Usage example:
Need to know how much time is left before bed?
Launch the add-on, enter the time you are going to sleep and click the calculate button.
The add-on will display a voice message and copy it to the clipboard: 12 hours 57 minutes left.
In the same way, you can find out how much time is left before lunch, dinner, or taking medications.
After installing the add-on, press the NVDA + alt + t key combination or launch it from the Tools menu, and an interface with two combo boxes (hours and minutes) and two buttons Calculate and Exit with their keyboard shortcuts will appear on the screen.
You can change the key combination for opening the add-on window in input gestures, in the Time Calculator subsection.

cyberghostvpn.description:
The CyberGhostVpn add-on improves the availability of the CyberGhost VPN client of the same name.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or settings.
It starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

CharacterDescription.description:
With the CharacterDescription add-on installed, NVDA will extract the phonetic description of a particular character from the Unicode standard (unfortunately only in English).
That is, you point the arrows at the desired symbol, press Numpad2 twice quickly, and if the description of the symbol is not in the current or English locale, then it will be taken from the Unicode standard.
For example: A character with decimal code 8288 in unicode is described as WORD JOINER.
The add-on has no settings.

AirLiveDrive.description:
The AirLiveDrive add-on improves the availability of the Air Live Drive program of the same name for managing cloud drives
The app itself is poorly labeled and very difficult to use, requiring you to resort to object navigation mode.
With this add-on, most program elements are signed, which makes the application much more understandable.
Keyboard commands:
F1: If we press this key in the drive list, it will show us the remaining free size and the total size.
Control+Shift+C: Activate the Account Control Panel.
Control+Shift+O: Activate the Options panel.
Page Down: Moves to the next of 4 possible items
Page Up: Moves to the previous of 4 possible items.
Right arrow: Next.
Left Arrow: Previous.
Spacebar: Press.
S: available space.

firefoxPlus.description:
The FirefoxPlus add-on provides accessibility features for Mozilla Firefox.
It contains commands that make it easier to use the Firefox and Waterfox browsers, and also improves the voiceover when using tabs (in particular, indicating the rank and total number, for example, 2 out of 4).
A list of keyboard shortcuts can be found in the add-on help.
You can change keyboard shortcuts in input gestures, in the Mozilla Firefox and Firefox subsections.

poeditMoreAccessible.description:
The PoeditMoreAccessible add-on reports the actions performed when pressing hot commands in the PoEdit program.
The addition indicates different categories of messages using special sounds or asterics.
Adds commands that allow you to find out the original and translated text of a message, as well as a lot of other useful information.

networkStrenght.description:
A simple NetworkStrenght add-on to determine the strength of a wireless network.
The keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+N will tell you the wireless network strength on your device.
Changing the keyboard shortcuts in the add-on is not implemented.

wlmail.description:
The WLMail add-on improves the accessibility of the WLMail email client.
The add-on reads unread messages and messages with attachments.
It adds various commands such as reading headers and autocompletion of addresses.
A list of commands can be obtained using the keyboard shortcut Control+NVDA+H.

say clipBoard.description:
The SayClipBoard add-on adds functionality to read text on the Windows clipboard.
Press the command NVDA+C:
Read text from the clipboard once.
Open text from the clipboard twice in the virtual preview window.
You can change the command in input gestures, subsection System status, Reports text to the Windows clipboard.

CopyText.description:
The CopyText add-on copies the text of the control that has focus using Control+Shift+Z.
For example, you can quickly copy the name of the file under the cursor (Works in Explorer).

errorSound.description:
The ErrorSound add-on allows you to enable/disable error sound playback regardless of settings and NVDA version.
But most of all, Alpha and Beta images of NVDA are in demand among users.
Keyboard shortcut:
Throw exception: NVDA+Control+Alt+E.
Switch: NVDA+Control+E.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the ErrorSound subsection.

nvdaChatGPT.description:
The NvdaChatGPT add-on provides access to chatGPT. via key bindings, so you can ask for the meaning of any words or ask any questions.

Especially useful for asking difficult words you don't know or asking simple programming questions.

You need an api key (it's free and paid), but I think it's worth the time or money.

voiceOver.description:
The VoiceOver add-on is a sound theme for NVDA with Voice Over sounds.
The add-on plays sounds based on object types as you move around them.
NVDA+Alt+V Pressing once toggles between enabling and disabling object sounds, and double-pressing toggles between reading and disabling object types.
The command can be changed in input gestures, in the subsection Sound theme voice over.

Eloq47.description:
The Eloq47 add-on is the Eloquence 4.7 driver and speech synthesizers for NVDA.
After installing the add-on, you will have access to speech synthesizers in the following languages:
German.
British English.
American English.
Latin American Spanish.
Castilian Spanish.
French.
Italian.

eciLibraries.description:
The EciLibraries add-on provides libraries with Eloquence speech synthesizers for the IBMTTS driver.
Voices for the IBM-TTS driver can be installed using this add-on.
The original IBM-TTS driver does not support Eloquence synthesizers.

EdgeTTSReader.description:
EdgeTTSReader add-on for reading long texts and documents with high quality neural voices Edge TTS from Microsoft.
The add-on uses the Edge TTS repository.
Keyboard shortcut:
Start reading selected text - Incert + Shift + E.
Pause or resume reading - Incert + Shift + P.
Stop reading - Incert + Shift + X.
The settings are located along the following path: NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Settings, EdgeTTS Voice Settings.
In the settings you can select a neural voice.
Check the box to enable multilingual neural voices (experimental).
Set speech speed from -20% to +200%.
The list of neural voices is listed in the help (there are no Russian voices).

dbeaverAutocomplete.description:
The DbeaverAutocomplete add-on provides autocomplete functionality in Windows 11 for Dbeaver and Eclipse.
This addition is temporary to bring back autocomplete in Eclipse on Windows 11.
As soon as the functionality is added to the NVDA core, support for the add-on will be discontinued.

GBMRadioStreaming.description:
The GBMRadioStreaming add-on allows you to easily listen to gbm streaming radio from your browser using the keyboard shortcuts NVDA+SHIFT+G.
After pressing the key combination, the default browser will open, with a page for listening to the radio.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the input gestures, under GBM Streaming Radio, Shortcut for listening to GBM radio streaming from a web browser.
Enjoy listening to our streaming radio!
Greetings from the Gelegar Bangsa Mandiri (GBM) team.

ScreenReaderSounds.description:
The ScreenReaderSounds add-on adds sound themes from Apple VoiceOver, Google TalkBack 5.0.7, Google TalkBack 6+.
To start or stop the add-on, press the key combination NVDA+Alt+O.
To switch between sound themes, press: NVDA+Alt+Z or NVDA+Alt+X.
You must restart NVDA for the changes to take effect.

espeakWitMbrola.description: The ESpeakWitMbrola addon is the old ESpeak speech synthesizer with support for Mbrola voices, ported into an addon for NVDA.

URLPlayer.description:
The URLPlayer add-on is a simple player for playing Internet radio via a stream link.
Control keys can be viewed and configured in the NVDA menu - Options, Input Gestures, URLPlayer.
The settings are located in the NVDA menu, Options, Settings, URLPlayer.

SpellingErrorSound.description:
The SpellingErrorSound add-on plays sound for spelling errors instead of speech.
The textError.wav file with the error sound is included in the add-on and can be easily replaced with your own.
If you do not need the error sound, then in the document formatting settings, uncheck the corresponding box.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or settings. Starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

maagimAraby.description:
The MaagimAraby add-on helps you find out the meaning of Arabic words from several Arabic dictionaries on Almaany.com.
Press nvda+Alt+M, the Maagim Araby dialog will open and you will be in the edit field.
If you were standing on a highlighted word when you pressed this command, that word will be placed in the edit field.
Otherwise, enter the word you need in the edit field, on the an tab, select the dictionary you need and press Enter.
The meaning of the word will be displayed in a separate window, available for viewing.

androidStudio.description:
The AndroidStudio add-on adds accessibility improvements to the Android Studio environment.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+E - read the status bar.
F2 - Move the cursor forward along the line.
Shift+F2 - Move the cursor back along the line.

audibledownloadmanager.description:
The AudibleDownloadManager add-on improves the accessibility of the Audible audio download manager.
Instead of displaying full paths to .adh files, the list of downloaded files displays meta information (such as download status).
Enter - Click on the link.
Numpad Enter - Click on the link.
Shift+F10 - Right click.
Applications - Right click.

SpellingErrorMessageCut.description:
Addition SpellingErrorMessageCut - disables the speech message about a spelling error.
After installing or enabling this add-on, the following occurs:
The phrases (spelling error) and (outside spelling error) are not pronounced when the (Spelling errors) checkbox is enabled in the document formatting settings.
There is an error sound when typing.
Thus, the specified phrases about the beginning and end of a spelling error do not interfere with working with the text; the error is notified by a sound signal.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or settings.

InternetDownloadManager.description:
The InternetDownloadManager add-on provides several shortcuts in the download manager of the same name to find out some information about downloaded files or files that are being downloaded.
In the Downloads menu, when we scroll down, we read the name of the file and information about it, such as the date
upload date, download link, etc.

Now when we hover over file names, we only read the file name and can use the following keyboard shortcuts to view the information.
Keyboard shortcut:
Control+1: To read the download date.
Control+2: Read file size.
Control+3: read file status.
Control+4: Copy download link.
In the download window we can use the following keyboard shortcuts:
Alt+1: To see the progress bar.
Alt+2: to see remaining time.
Alt+3: to check the download speed.
up and down arrows: To read the rest of the information, only on the status tab.

typing_sound.description:
The TypingSound add-on plays sound effects when you type in a text field.
You can turn sounds on and off using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+Shift+T.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in Input Gestures, in the Typing Sound subsection.
In the NVDA menu, Options submenu, Settings, Typing Sound, you can select sounds.

PressApplication.description:
The PressApplication add-on can simulate pressing the Application key using the NVDA+' (apostrophe) keyboard shortcut.
For those NVDA users who do not have an Application key on their keyboard.
Of course, you can manually specify the key that calls this function in the input gestures dialog, subsection Analog system keys, Simulate pressing the Application key.

nvdaHelper.description:
The NvdaHelper add-on is a simple NVDA helper for learning Arabic letters and remembering their location on the keyboard.
This add-on adds built-in Arabic pronunciation help to nvda when the keyboard language is Arabic.
This happens before activating assistance using the well-known keyboard shortcut: NVDA+1.

Note diary for NVDA.description:
The NoteDiaryForNVDA add-on allows you to quickly and efficiently save notes.
Record, open, save and delete notes with just a few keystrokes.
Initially, there is no keyboard shortcut assigned to open the Notes Diary window, but you can assign one in Settings, Input Gestures in the Notes Diary category.
You can also access it through the NVDA menu, submenu Tools, Notes Diary.

directLink.description:
The DirectLink add-on converts Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive links into direct links and opens Whatsapp and Telegram chats with a given number.
A direct link allows you to get the famous save dialog directly when you open the file in the browser, without having to struggle with the hosting company's download page and searching for a download link.
You can also use the direct link to stream the file or view it in some programs, such as media players (if they support the URL).
Likewise, if WhatsApp or Telegram are common in your country, then instead of creating a new contact every time you need to chat with someone, be it a customer or tech support, you can simply select a number or copy it and start chatting immediately.
Moreover, you can share the link of your own WhatsApp number if people usually need to contact you if you work as a freelancer.

codefactory-py3.description:
The Code Factory add-on is a driver for speech synthesizers from Code Factory.
The driver has an interface through which you can install Eloquence and Vocalizer synthesizers.
In order to use the driver and voices in perpetual mode, you must purchase a license for this product.

hijriDate.description:
The NVDA screen reader HijriDate add-on allows you to find out the Hijri date using the NVDA + H keyboard shortcut.
The supplement reports the following dates:
Muharram.
Safar.
Rabi al-awwal.
Rabi al-Thani.
Jumada al-Awwal.
Jumada al-Thani.
Rajab.
Sha'ban.
Ramadan.
Shawwal.
Dhu al-Qi'da.
Dhu al-Hijjah.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures, in the Hijri date section, Say the current Hijri date.

HeadphoneFinder.description:
The HeadphoneFinder add-on has two scenarios - beeping the left or right earphone, which can help you find Bluetooth headphones.
The beep will sound for 5 minutes.
If you need to stop the alarm, press any of the assigned gestures.
If more time is required, run the desired script twice.

mouseWheelScrolling.description:
The MouseWheelScrolling add-on allows you to emulate a mouse wheel to scroll an object under the mouse cursor from the keyboard.
Keyboard shortcut:
nvda+shift+control+w- switches scrolling mode using the mouse wheel.
Left Arrow - Scroll to the left of an object under the mouse cursor.
Right Arrow - Scrolls the object to the right under the mouse cursor.
Up Arrow - Scroll up an object under the mouse cursor.
Down Arrow - Scroll down an object under the mouse cursor.
Page up - Scrolls the object page up under the mouse cursor.
Page down - Scrolls the object page down under the mouse cursor.
Home - Attempts to scroll the object to its maximum point. Especially necessary for sliders that cannot be controlled from the keyboard.
End (End) - Attempts to scroll the object to the minimum point. Especially necessary for sliders that cannot be controlled from the keyboard.

unicodeAscii.description:
The UnicodeAscii add-on aims to solve the problem with mathematical alphanumeric characters, which, among other things, are now used for decorative purposes because they look cool on social networks, in addition to being used for their original purpose.
The add-on converts the characters passed to it into a near-ASCII representation, so it can be used to transliterate any other characters.
Unfortunately, the results will not always be perfect and good because sometimes decorative symbols work on the resemblance to the original symbol rather than on the actual meaning.
Press NVDA+Control+N to decode text from the clipboard or selected text (in that search order), double-click to copy the result to the clipboard.
Press Control+Shift+NVDA+N to decode text from the clipboard or selected text (in the same order) and add them as a pattern and replacement to the default dictionary (useful if you find a string of text frequently).
These keyboard shortcuts can be changed in the input gestures dialog, under the unicodeAscii category.

ZExplorer.description:
The ZExplorer add-on allows you to correctly retrieve the contents of the status bar.
Team:
NVDA+End - Ddesktop keyboard layout.
NVDA+Shift+End - Laptop keyboard layout.
A single press reads the status bar of the current application and moves the navigator to it.
When double-clicked, spells out the information.
When pressed three times, copies the status bar to the clipboard.
If the status bar is not found, you will hear a message indicating this.

AirExplorer.description:
The AirExplorer add-on adds various NVDA improvements to the Air Explorer cloud disk management program of the same name.
The add-on supports AirExplorer version 5.0 and higher.
Keyboard commands:
Open the accounts panel: Control + Shift + C.
Open the options panel: Control + Shift + O.
Find out the status of the latest downloads or downloads depending on their position: Control + numbers from 1 to 9.
Go to the next of 4 possible elements: Page down.
Go to the previous of 4 possible elements: Page up.
Commands available when the toolbar is focused:
S: Report available space.
N: Create a new folder.
Z: download as zip.
Moving between the tab bar and the file list:
Using the page forward and backward we will scroll between the 4 elements while we are on the active cloud tab.
These elements are the tab bar, tree view, toolbar, and file list.
When you reach the beginning or end of the list, the addition will make a sound.
With the Tab and Shift Tab keys we usually scroll between items, the above commands are mainly for navigating between the most frequently used objects.
Program commands:
Close current tab: Control + w.
Go to next tab: Control + Tab.
Go to previous tab: Control + shift + Tab.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in Input Gestures.

PowerRequest.description:
The PowerRequest add-on prevents the splash screen (screensaver) from appearing when the “Read all” mode is active.
The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

FonixTalk.description:
The FonixTalk add-on is FonixTalk speech synthesizers for NVDA.
After installing this add-on, DECtalk 5.1 will be available in the synthesizer selection list “NVDA+Control+S”, and the following list of voices will be available in the speech settings “NVDA+Control+V”:
Perfect Paul.
Beautiful Betty (Beautiful Betty).
Huge Harry (Huge Harry).
Frail Frank (Fragile Frank).
Doctor Dennis (Doctor Dennis).
Kit The Kid.
Uppity Ursula (Restless Ursula).
Rough Rita (Rough Rita).
Whispering Wendy.

CaretBeep.description:
The CaretBeep add-on provides the ability to play a sound when the system caret is unsuccessfully moved in edit fields.
In the NVDA settings, in the “Document Navigation” section, you can enable or disable the function: “Play a sound when the carriage moves unsuccessfully.”
This setting is saved to the active NVDA configuration profile, so you can now enable the corresponding signal only in the profile for a specific application.

showAllSysTrayIcons.description:
The ShowAllSysTrayIcons add-on makes changes to the registry to show all system tray icons in Windows 11.
After installation, pressing the key combination Control+Shift+Alt+NVDA+T will show all existing tray icons at that time.
There is no way back, just change from the settings.
Also, after installing/updating applications, you will have to press this combination again, but this is much easier than using toggle switches in the settings.
Before use, read the explanation from the author of the add-on in the help.

SpeechPauseResume.description:
The SpeechPauseResume add-on changes the function of the Control key.
Pressing the Control key interrupts speech, and when pressed again, it continues from the same place. Same as using the Shift key.
This addition will please those who find it more convenient to pause and resume reading text using the Control key, and interrupt speech without pausing with the Shift key.
SpeechPauseResume has no settings or keyboard shortcuts. Starts working immediately after installation or activation.

MistworldAutoProfession.description:
The MistworldAutoProfession add-on is a small patch for the MMO-RPG MistWorld audio that allows you to use professional skills (herbalism, fishing and mining) in the background.
Automatically leaves Myst-World when life force runs out.
To reduce unnecessary screen reader messages, it automatically closes the game after vitality is depleted.
More details are described in the add-on help.

mouse.description:
The Mouse add-on displays a test message when you press NVDA+Control+0.
What is the point of this addition.
I use this extension to test GitHub and the entire process of working with NVDA add-ons.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures, subsection My Mouse.

skypeIsBack.description:
The SkypeIsBack add-on sets the default browsing mode in the Skype application.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.
Starts working immediately after installation or activation.

improveTypingExperience.description:
The ImproveTypingExperience add-on improves the quality of typing.
On different layouts, when you press keys on the main alphanumeric block of the keyboard, you will hear different beeps.
Currently, the add-on supports only three layouts: English, Georgian and Russian; in other layouts you will not hear sound signals.
The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

textnav.description:
The TextNav add-on allows you to find the text you want to read on a web page with just one keystroke.
More precisely, it adds a keystroke to move to the next or previous text paragraph - a paragraph containing one or more sentences.
This feature can be useful to quickly find the text portion of a web page or skip menus, advertisements, and other unimportant page elements.
Keyboard shortcut:
Alt+Shift+Down Arrow: Move to the next text paragraph.
Alt+Shift+Up Arrow: Move to the previous text paragraph.

ignoreBlanksIndentationReporting.description:
IgnoreBlanksIndentationReporting add-on which changes the order in which indentations are displayed by ignoring blank lines when deciding whether changes to indentation should be reported.
This is best understood by comparing normal behavior with an example (Examples are provided in the add-on help).
Note: As of NVDA 2023.3, this functionality is available natively in NVDA and can be enabled in the Document Formatting settings under "Ignore Blank Lines for Line Indentation Reporting".

numlockDisabler.description:
The NumlockDisabler add-on disables numlock after a specified time.
The addition will be useful for those who, after entering data in various editing fields, forget to turn off Numlock and, after switching to other editors, unnecessary numbers are written.
There is nothing in the add-on except a timer to turn off Numlock; the number of seconds is configured in the NVDA settings, in the Numlock disabler panel.

D4EncodingNormalizer.description:
Normalizes incorrect text encodings when using NVDA TTS output in Diablo IV.
Unfortunately, the Russian language in Diablo IV is a little broken, and it was only possible to play normally with SAPI voices installed in the system.
Text-to-speech output through the NVDA screen reader did not work due to broken encodings.
This add-on is designed to cure this problem and allow you to freely play Diablo IV in Russian and using NVDA.
When you start NVDA, the add-on is inactive by default.
To enable it, the command NVDA+shift+alt+d is assigned, but it can be reassigned to any other one desired.
In addition to normalizing the text encoding, other improvements are planned, for example, removing interfering visual markup tags that for some reason end up in the speech output.
Read more in the add-on help.

WiFiMonitor.description:
WiFiMonitor is an add-on for NVDA screen reader that allows users to monitor their Internet connection usage in terms of data sent and received.
This tool is especially useful for people who need to track their data consumption over time, either for bandwidth management or just out of personal curiosity.
After activating the add-on, WiFiMonitor begins to monitor data usage on the user's Internet connection.
Monitoring is started or stopped using a special keyboard shortcut (Alt + NVDA + W) configured in input gestures in the subcategory Wi-Fi Monitor, shortcut Start or stop Internet usage monitoring.
When you start monitoring, the plugin records the current time and the amount of data sent and received at the moment.
When monitoring stops, it calculates the difference in time and data to determine the total number of megabytes used during the monitoring session and reports this information to the user via NVDA.

prayerTimes.description:
The PrayerTimes add-on will allow you to find out the prayer times in the Islamic religion.
Fajr - morning prayer.
Zuhr - lunchtime prayer.
Asr – afternoon prayer.
Maghrib - evening prayer.
Isha - night prayer.
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+Alt+P - Say prayer times.
NVDA+Shift+P - Say the time of the next prayer.
You can change these keyboard shortcuts in input gestures, in the prayer time subsection.

beepKeyboard.description:
The BeepKeyboard add-on provides the following features that you can use to customize the behavior of your NVDA keyboard:
Beep for capital letters when caps lock is enabled: If this feature is enabled, NVDA will play a beep when you type a capital letter and caps lock is enabled. Don't make any more capitalization mistakes!
Beep when typing while holding down the shift key: When enabled, NVDA will make a beep sound when you type a character while holding down the shift key.
Toggle Key Beep: With this feature, NVDA will emit a higher tone when the toggle key is enabled, and a lower tone when the key switch is disabled.
Switch key change announcement: Only when switch key change beep is turned on. You can enable or disable NVDA to notify you about the status of the switch keys.
Beep for specified symbols: NVDA will play a beep for all symbols that you have set in the advanced settings.
Disable beep for password fields: This feature is enabled by default to avoid security risks. Turn it off if you want to hear beeps in password fields.

AutoWindowMaximizer.description:
The AutoWindowMaximizer add-on automatically maximizes each window to full screen as soon as the user switches to it.
As any experienced screen reader user knows, it usually works best when the program window is maximized. 
This simple add-on designed for Windows 10 tries to maximize each window when the user switches to it.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

Rutas_fav.description: RoutesFavis an add-on for the NVDA screen reader that aims to quickly and easily manage the user's favorite paths, allowing them to be launched, deleted or added new ones in a simple and intuitive way for the user. Below are the commands for using the functions described above (changed through the Input Gestures section in the Favorite Paths category: NVDA+ALT+A: Launches a dialog to enter the required data, such as the absolute path and ID to be displayed in the virtual menu. NVDA+ALT+J: Go to the previous item in the list of saved paths. NVDA+ALT+K: Moves to the next item in the list of saved paths. NVDA+ALT+L: Single click opens the selected path, double click quickly opens it and removes it from the list. More information in the add-on help.

num2words.description:
Num2words addition of numbers to words.
This add-on improves the reading of numbers in words for these cases, it supports large numbers up to 27 numbers and, in addition, the num2Word python library supports many languages.

SoundsKeyboard.description:
The SoundsKeyboard add-on plays sounds during operations with the clipboard - pasting, copying and cutting.
There is also a sound when pressing the print screen key.
It is possible to pronounce information about emerging events, as in the fakeClipboardAnouncement add-on.

customTextFinder.description:
The CustomTextFinder add-on disables the error window when no result is found when using NVDA search.
Without the add-on, the message ("hello" text not found) will be displayed in the dialog box accompanied by an error sound. Such a window can be closed using the Cancel key or a button in the window itself.
With the addition, the same message will be spoken only by speech without an error window.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation or activation.

avp.description: The AVP add-on increases the availability of the Kaspersky Internet Security antivirus program from 2013 to 2021.

rightClickMenu.description:
The RightClickMenu add-on simulates a right-click on the current object.
Keyboard shortcut:
Control+Applications: Move the mouse cursor over the currently focused object and right-click.
Control+Shift+F10: same as above.

translateEnhancement.description:
The TranslateEnhancement add-on uses the Google Translate API to translate spoken text into the desired language on the fly.
This add-on requires an Internet connection.
This add-on is a modification of the Translate add-on, but with some new features and translation services.
The author of the modification is a Spanish developer. This add-on had an identical name to the original Translate add-on, but in order to differentiate the add-ons, the NVDA.RU administrator took the liberty of changing the name.
Do not install together with the original add-on to avoid conflict.
The keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on reference guide.
You can change commands in input gestures, section Improved translation.

microphoneMute.description:
The MicrophoneMute add-on adds a simple function to mute or unmute your microphone.
The keyboard shortcut is NVDA+Alt+Control+Shift+M.
You can change it in input gestures, Mute microphone.

CheckConnection.description:
CheckConnection is a small NVDA add-on that checks your Internet connection and provides a public IP address.
The default gesture is NVDA+SHIFT+G.
You can change it in the Input Gestures dialog box, Miscellaneous section.
Press the key combination twice to display the information on the screen. One click displays information via flash message.

sayexpansion.description:
The SayExpansion add-on will report the file extension under the cursor in Explorer.
If your file extensions are hidden or you are using list or tile view. 
Keyboard shortcut:
NVDA+X - Say file extension in Explorer.
You can change the command in input gestures, Say extension.

WakeSpeaker.description:
The WakeSpeaker add-on emits white noise at low volume to prevent speakers from falling asleep.
This is useful if you have speakers, Bluetooth headphones, or similar devices that go into sleep mode when they stop receiving audio, usually to save power.
When you install this add-on, it will work with default settings.
This add-on has a script to toggle the add-on's state (on or off) without assigning a gesture. You can assign gestures in the Gesture Input dialog box.
If you want to change some settings, go to NVDA menu, Options, Settings, Wake Speaker category, and adjust any of the options.

fiche.description:
The Fiche add-on provides greater access to the Fiche program of the same name using NVDA.
Fiche for Windows was developed by Jean-Claude Mortimore.

Gregor_nvda.description: The Gregor add-on is a Polish Gregor speech synthesizer for NVDA.

svox-pico.description:
The SvoxPico add-on is a small but human-sounding speech synthesizer that supports English, Spanish, French, Italian and German.
SvoxPicoTTS speech synthesizer does not have Russian voices.

documentFormattingHelper.description:
DocumentFormattingHelper add-on, which makes it easier for blind users to know and manage document formatting.
A formatting viewer, invoked using the NVDA+shift+ctrl+o keyboard shortcut, that provides a checkable list of part-specific (i.e. not generic) formatting and an updated, filtered view of the document's contents according to the formatting selected in the previous list.
The checkable list presents the attributes (styles, fonts, colors...) that the user can check and, between brackets, the number of non-consecutive blocks found with a particular attribute.
The default key binding can be configured in the Input Gestures dialog box, DocumentFormattingHelper, Launch Formatting Helper.
More details about the functionality are described in the help.

ELTEN.description:
The Elten add-on improves the accessibility of the Windows client of the Elten social network of the same name for the blind.
Keyboard shortcut:
Laptop layout: NVDA+A and NVDA+L.
Desktop layout: NVDA+Down Arrow and NVDA+Up Arrow.

reportBackgroundProgressBars.description:
The Report Background Progress Bars add-on provides a script to toggle the display of background progress bars.
The keyboard shortcut can be assigned in input gestures, in the Speech subsection for the shortcut Toggles the announcement of background progress bars.

remote.description:
The Remote add-on allows you to carry out remote control sessions between different computers.
It makes no difference whether you are in the next room or on another continent. The connection is simple and there are very few commands that you need to remember.
You can connect to another computer or allow a trusted person to connect to your system to perform maintenance, diagnose a problem, or provide training.

LanguageIdent.description:
The LanguageIdent add-on detects the language of any spoken text and automatically switches to the appropriate language before it is spoken.
This amazing plugin uses an advanced AI model to detect the language of each spoken text and automatically switches the language accordingly.
You can choose which languages ​​are recognized for language detection, providing maximum flexibility. Additionally, the plugin ignores any tags and relies solely on the AI ​​model to accurately detect the language.
For Windows OneCore, IBM-TTS and VocalizerExpressive synthesizers.

SingleLetterNav.description:
The SingleLetterNav add-on improves single-letter quick navigation.
If SingleLetterNav is installed, then disabling/enabling the quick navigation keys (NVDA+Shift+Space) is performed globally for all existing and new documents with browse mode.
For example, if you disable quick navigation on a page in Firefox and then go to a Google Chrome window, then quick navigation there will remain disabled.
Without the addition, the state of this function is set individually for each virtual buffer of the browsing mode and is reset each time the buffer is recreated, for example, when reloading a web page using F5.
The add-on has no settings.

simpleRadio.description:
The SimpleRadio add-on improves the availability of the simpleRadioOnline application of the same name from the Windows store.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

spelling.description:
The Spelling add-on adds a spell checking feature that can be used in any text field.
The keyboard shortcut Control+F7 starts spell checking.
The add-on includes default dictionaries for Portuguese and Brazilian-Portuguese.

spotifySuppressLiveRegions.description:
SpotifySuppressLiveRegions add-on to improve the Spotify program.
The Spotify desktop client has been updated, and the name of the currently playing track is now announced every time a track is switched.
This is a small hack in the form of an add-on to eliminate this ailment.
It has no settings or keyboard shortcuts; it starts working immediately after installation or switching on.

tencent.description:
The Tencent add-on adds Tencent APIs for OCR, translation, and more.
Tencent Cloud API costs money. However, the plugin has the author's SECRETTID and SecretKey, and a number of free translations and text recognition are available
NVDA + CTRL + Y- Translate buffer from English to Chinese.
NVDA + CTRL + SHIFT + Y/ Translate buffer from Chinese to English.
NVDA + CTRL + E- Navigation object for OCR.
NVDA + CTRL + SHIFT + E- Text recognition program window.
NVDA + CTRL + ALT + E- Full screen text recognition.
NVDA + CTRL + N- Screenshot navigation object.
NVDA + CTRL + SHIFT + N- Screenshot program window.
NVDA + CTRL + ALT + N/ Screenshot of the entire screen.

VoiceOverByAnenkov.description:
The VoiceOverByAnenkov add-on adds a sound theme with Voice Over sounds.
Sounds can be turned on or off with the command NVDA+Alt+O.
The add-on is a modification and is based on the VoiceOver add-on.

YYPatch.description:
The YYPatch add-on improves the accessibility of the YY program of the same name, and also adds support for reading aloud the list of channel participants.
YY is a Chinese voice chat and messaging program.

ViewNetworks.description:
The ViewNetworks add-on lists the networks stored on a given system and, if possible, attempts to recover the password.
The add-on does not hack or attempt to crack Wi-Fi passwords.
It recovers or attempts to recover the password saved when you first connected to the network.
Windows+Alt+N: Displays the Save Networks dialog.
Windows+Alt+O: Displays detailed information about the addon.
Windows+Alt+P: Displays the password recovery dialog.
Windows+Alt+J: Opens the add-on's help page.
You can change commands in input gestures.

viyfMirror.description:
The ViyfMirror add-on adds support for NVDA update mirror sources provided by VIYF to speed up downloading of NVDA updates.
The add-on does not have keyboard shortcuts or settings.

VNSwitching.description:
The VNSwitching add-on adds switching between voices of your choice, as well as switching between sapi 5 and the IBM TTS synthesizer using keyboard shortcuts.
There are ten voice switching slots, which means you can switch between ten different voices or use one voice with different settings for different occasions, quickly and easily.
All add-on hotkeys can be changed through the Input Gestures dialog, in the VNS Switching category.

wghelper.description: The WgHelper add-on adds gestures for closing or minimizing a window and switching between windows for a touch screen; you need to assign input gestures yourself in the parameters.

ttAnnouncer.description:
The TTAnnouncer add-on allows you to read chats in the TeamTalk client with a separate tts engine selected in the add-on settings.
The add-on has only one keyboard shortcut - NVDA+Shift+Pause, which when pressed for the first time stops incoming speech from TeamTalk, and a double press toggles the functionality on/off.

sleepBlocker.description:
SleepBlocker add-on to temporarily disable Windows automatic sleep mode.
NVDA+Control+Shift+C - Enables or disables the sleep blocker.
This command can be changed in Input Gestures, in the Miscellaneous subsection, the function Prevent the system from going into sleep mode.
In the NVDA menu, Submenu Options, Settings, Sleep Blocker: The following function is available - Also block the display from going into sleep mode.
This feature is not enabled by default.

shamela.description:
The Shamela add-on improves the accessibility of the Shamela program of the same name.
Press f5 or f6 to read the loaded page during your selection in shamela.

Tooltip.description:
The Tooltip add-on adds a feature to listen to the latest tooltip.
Press the NVDA+E key combination once to listen to the tooltip or press twice to copy the message to the clipboard.
The key command can be changed in input gestures, Miscellaneous section.

soundfile.description:
The SoundFile add-on plays sounds when navigating in the file manager, depending on file extensions.
Supports windows explorer, TotalCommander and file managers WinRar and 7Zip.
You need to enable file extensions in File Explorer.
In the archiver - short list mode (only names should be displayed.

nvdaRd.description:
The NVDARd add-on adds support for accessing remote desktop sessions on NVDA using Microsoft Remote Desktop, Citrix, or VMware Horizon.
When NVDA is installed on both the client and server, speech and braille generated on the server will be spoken and played back on the client machine.
Thus, the user is able to manage a remote system as effectively as a local one.

My-IP.description:
The MyIP add-on announces the current IP address.
Press the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+I to find it out.
You can change the combination in input gestures, subsection My IP address.

lineMessage.description:
The LineMessage add-on will send a copy of the text message to Line.
Keyboard shortcut NVDA+L.

lunar.description:
The Lunar add-on adds the Chinese lunar calendar.
To display information about the lunar calendar, press NVDA+F12 twice; if you press it once, you will hear the current time.

klicktel.description:
The Klicktel add-on improves the accessibility of the Klicktel program of the same name from German developers.
With Klicktel the whole city is at your fingertips. Here you will find all addresses, phone numbers and information from your region.
Features of clicktel:
Telephone and business directory with over 28 million phone numbers and addresses.
Restaurants, ATMs, doctors, shops, gas stations and much more, find it quickly and easily.
Current film programs, parties, theater performances and concerts in your city.
klicktel - convenient categories and quick search
• Reverse lookup of unknown phone numbers.
Hundreds of thousands of user reviews will help you choose the best supplier in your area.
Useful features: saving found contacts, map views, local search, emergency services, etc.

lazarus.description: The Lazarus Add-on improves the availability of the open source lazarus development environment for NVDA users.

ExplorerEnhancements.description:
Explorer enhancements is an experimental module for Explorer that addresses some of the shortcomings of the original appModule.
About issues #3152 and #5759:
For testing, this add-on implements the Notification function that the folder is empty.

brlkey.description:
The BrlKey add-on is a new version of the Braille keyboard.
Supplement in Chinese.

brlReader.description:
The BrlReader add-on reports the content of a Braille document.
NVDA+ keyboard shortcut. (dot).

CloseAll.description: CloseAll add-on for the convenience of working with the CloseAll program of the same name for closing program windows.

Becky.description:
Becky add-on to improve the accessibility of the Becky email client of the same name! Internet mail.
NVDA+Shift+U - reports the number of all and unread messages in the current folder.
NVDA+Shift+a - In the message composer, moves focus to the list of attachments, if visible.
These keyboard shortcuts can be reassigned in the Becky category from the Input Gestures dialog.

Add-on Packager by Technology and News.description:
The AddonPackagerByTechnologyAndNews add-on will help you quickly create backup copies of add-ons.
After installation, the add-on interface is available in the NVDA menu, Service submenu.
You can read more in the add-on help.

bluetoothaudio.description:
BluetoothAudio is an add-on for NVDA that improves sound quality when working with headphones or speakers connected via Bluetooth.
Most Bluetooth devices go into standby mode after a few seconds of inactivity. This means that when NVDA starts talking again, the first split second of audio will be lost. The Bluetooth Audio add-on prevents Bluetooth devices from going into standby mode by constantly playing a quiet sound that is inaudible to the human ear.
The add-on has no keyboard shortcuts and works immediately after installation or activation.

calsci.description:
The Calsci add-on improves the use of the Calsci program of the same name with a number of useful automations
These include:
When we insert a calculation into calsci, commas are replaced with dots 
When copying a calculation or result from calsci, the periods are replaced by commas.
When writing calculations directly in Calsci, when you press the comma for a decimal number, a period is automatically added.
To get the result, you can press Enter instead of Alt+C, which may be faster.
Option to add a braille shortcut to command gestures when copying and pasting in Calsci.
The add-on has an automatic update feature that can be used with the following keyboard shortcuts:
NVDA+Alt+C to search for updates manually.
NVDA+Shift+Alt+C to activate/deactivate search for updates.

CCBE.description:
The CCBE add-on adds the ability to convert braille to Chinese braille when using the NotePad program.
Alt+Left Arrow: Decrease width.
Alt+Right Arrow: Increase width.
Alt+C: Convert Braille to Chinese.
Control+R: Change the selection order.
NVDA+Space: Search down empty lines.
Shift+NVDA+Space: Search for an empty line up.
Alt+F1: Add-on Help.

ChangeOutputDevice.description:
The ChangeOutputDevice add-on allows you to quickly change the output device.
Cyclic switching of audio devices using the NVDA+Windows+D key combination.
The command presented can be changed in input gestures.

webcamHelper.description:
The WebcamHelper add-on will help you position yourself in front of the camera during video calls.
It will tell you if you are too close or too far from the camera,
whether you are too far to the left or to the right, whether you are too high or too low,
and if the lighting is too dark or too bright.
It will also tell you if you are too close to the edge of the frame, which may mean you are too close to the edge of the camera's field of view.
After installing the add-on, press NVDA+Shift+W and follow the instructions.
After you hear the message (Face is positioned correctly) - you can press the Escape key to stop the function and release the camera.

Winboard.description: The Winboard add-on improves accessibility when using the Winboard chess program of the same name with NVDA.

brailleMultiline.description:
The BrailleMultiline add-on is a prototype for multiline braille support using NVDA.
Keyboard shortcut.
Stop tracking at line 1: Keyboard, all layouts: NVDA+shift+control+1.
Opens the Multiline Braille add-on settings: Keyboard, all layouts: NVDA+=.
Braille display scroll forward in buffer 0: No gesture.
Braille display scroll forward in buffer 1: No gesture.
Braille display scroll forward in buffer 2: No gesture.
Braille display scroll forward in buffer 3: No gesture.
Braille display scrolling back in buffer 0: No gesture.
Braille display scrolling back in buffer 1: No gesture.
Braille display scrolling back in buffer 2: No gesture.
Braille display scrolling back in buffer 3: No gesture.
Set line 1 to track the navigator object: Keyboard, all layouts: NVDA+control+1.

cursorMovements.description: CursorMovements add-on to create mouse cursor movements that you can use when creating screen recordings for demonstration and support.

FindExtended.description:
The FindExtended add-on removes the dialog box that appears when no more occurrences are found during a search operation.
Instead, only a message is issued.
The add-on has no settings.

NVDAScripts.description:
The NVDAScripts add-on is a set of several scripts.
Cyclical switching of the automatic speech language detection mode: off, language only and language+dialect using the NVDA+shift+L key combination.
Cyclic switching of audio output devices.
Changing speech parameters while working Read everything without stopping Read everything.
Remove the dialog box that appears when no more matches are found during a search.
Change speech rate when a language other than the default language is detected.
Open PDF recognition in Adobe Reader using MS word.
Adaptation of CamelCase word separation rules to eliminate cases of Roman ordinal numbers used in French.
And some others.

zPod.description:
ZPod add-on that will allow you to quickly view a folder with a large number of media files without going into the player.
This is useful for those people who need to quickly view the contents of a media file and act on it, unless it is someone who wants to quickly move on to the next one and view it.
This plugin can play up to 139 media extensions.
It is valid for both audio and video extensions, but clearly if it were a video only the audio would be heard, this plugin has no interface and handles everything using user assigned keys.
This plugin does not require any additional programs installed on the system and does not depend on any library outside the plugin, so it is valid for previewing the media file at any point in time when we do not have a shared player.

ocr.description:
The OCR add-on performs optical character recognition (OCR) to extract text from an inaccessible object.
The Tesseract text recognition engine is used.
To perform recognition, navigate to the object in question using object navigation and press the NVDA+R key combination.
You can configure the recognition language by going to the NVDA settings panel and selecting Recognition Options. The keyboard shortcut can be reassigned from the NVDA Input Gesture dialog box in the Miscellaneous category.
Important: If you are using NVDA 2017.3 or newer on Windows 10, please consider using built-in recognition
Windows 10

zPodCast.description:
The ZPodCast add-on will add a player for listening, adding podcast channels and managing added podcasts.
An Internet connection is required for the add-on to work.
Detailed instructions for the add-on can be found in the help.

zBackup.description:
ZBackup add-on for creating and restoring backup copies of a Windows partition.
This means that the disk or partition containing the Windows installation can be saved for recovery.
zBackup can do hot backups without stopping applications or stopping what we're doing.
zBackup is based on Drive Snapshot, so it uses an application external to NVDA. This application weighs less than 500 KB and will be downloaded from the official website when we launch the plugin.
Drive SnapShot is not a free app and has its limitations. The application can be used for 30 days in full, but after this time the only thing you will not be left with is to continue creating backups, albeit restoring and mounting them.

YoutubePlay.description:
The YoutubePlay add-on provides functionality for playing Youtube links from the clipboard.
Copy the Youtube link to any video to the clipboard.
Use the command NVDA+Control+SHIFT+H to try to play the video.
If everything happens as expected, the video should start playing.
If this is not possible, you will hear a message about this.
Keyboard shortcuts during playback:
NVDA+Control+SHIFT+J: Decrease volume.
NVDA+Control+SHIFT+K: Pause or resume video playback.
NVDA+Control+SHIFT+L: Increase volume.
Commands can be changed in input gestures.

WinSel.description:
The WinSel add-on provides hotkeys to quickly switch between foreground windows.
Control+Shift+Windows+F1/F12 - saves the current window in the foreground to the corresponding cell.
Shift+Windows+F1/F12 - brings a previously saved window to the foreground and expands it to full screen.

whatsapp_enhansements.description:
The WhatsappEnhancements add-on adds several improvements to the New WhatsApp Beta demo app for windows 10 and 11.
The addition includes a number of keyboard shortcuts to make various parts of the software easier to access, as well as minor improvements to the pronunciation of items.
The keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on help.

whiteNoise.description:
The WhiteNoise add-on prevents the sound card from going into standby mode by playing white noise.
The add-on has no settings and starts working immediately after installation.

spellcheck.description:
The SpellCheck add-on adds multilingual spell checking. Detects spelling errors in selected text and provides correction suggestions.
The purpose of the add-on is to quickly find and correct spelling errors in written text; In addition, you can create a list of words, called a personal dictionary; words that will be added to the list of misspelled words sentences.
You can find out more about how to use the add-on in the add-on help.
