WhatsApp-desktop.description:
The WhatsAppDesktop add-on adds keyboard shortcuts for quick access to certain functions of the WhatsApp Desktop application of the same name - from the Windows store.
The keyboard shortcut can be found in the help after installing the add-on.

vnDict.description:
The VnDict add-on adds functionality to switch voices between English and Vietnamese.
Keyboard shortcut: NVDA+(backtick) and (backtap).

volume_on_startup.description:
The VolumeOnStartup add-on adds functionality for adjusting Windows volume immediately after starting NVDA.
The volume level can be set in the NVDA menu, Tools submenu.

virtualViewer.description:
The VirtualViewer add-on uses the NVDA+Alt+W key combination to open a virtual viewer with the text of the current window.
After this, you can read the text in a convenient way, as well as select and copy it to the clipboard.
You can close the window using the Escape key.

unigram.description:
A Unigram add-on that improves accessibility and experience with the Unigram app from the Windows store.
The add-on adds a number of keyboard shortcuts and automatic actions for some functions.
More information about keyboard shortcuts can be found in the add-on help.

unitConverter.description:
With the UnitConverter add-on, you can convert between different measurements, such as Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius temperature.
To get started, simply press the key combination NVDA+Shift+U.
You can change the gesture for this add-on in the Input Gestures manager, in the Miscellaneous category.

toneMaster.description:
The ToneMaster add-on plays musical melodies created from tone data files using NVDA audio signals.
To get started, go to NVDA->Tools->Tone Master.
Press NVDA+Alt+T to play the loaded tone data file. To stop playback, press NVDA+Alt+Shift+T.

teamviewerQS.description: The TeamWiewerQS add-on improves the accessibility and ease of use of the TeamViewerQS program of the same name with NVDA.

Texto para telegram.description:
The TextoParaTelegram add-on sends the text that is currently in the transmission area for a non-Telegram bot.
To send the text, press the command NVDA+0.

speechSpyBroadcaster.description:
The SpeechBroadcaster add-on adds the function of broadcasting speech messages using UDP Multicast.
To configure this add-on, open the NVDA menu, go to Options, then Settings, then Broadcast Speech.
Note: The add-on can only be configured in the NVDA Normal Configuration profile. The add-on is profile independent.
This add-on has one keyboard shortcut by default.
You can change it in Input Gestures, subcategory Tools.
Find (Toggle Local Speech Broadcast).

SmartKeyboard.description:
The SmartKeyboard add-on eliminates the use of unintuitive NVDA laptop keyboard shortcuts, 
and also makes it easier to work with keyboards that lack some groups of keys.
A detailed description of the add-on functionality, as well as tables with keyboard shortcuts, can be found in the add-on help.

sleep.description:
The Sleep add-on will add a delayed sleep function.
Press NVDA+Slash and then enter the number of minutes after which NVDA speech will stop.
Then confirm Yes or No whether your computer should go to sleep after speech stops.
After that, launch the read all mode, enjoy reading and don’t worry if you fall asleep, NVDA will also go to sleep after the set time.

qrvocabulary.description:
The QRVocabulary add-on allows you to find the meaning of a selected word or open an editable panel dialog to search the language dictionary.
Available dictionaries:
Spanish dictionary.
English dictionary.
Italian dictionary.
The keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on help.

SoundSymbols.description:
The SoundSymbols add-on plays sounds when typing symbols after disabling their reading via NVDA+2.
Using the NVDA+Control+Shift+S key combination you can turn on and off sounds when typing characters.

simpleSelection.description:
The SimpleSelection add-on selects text under the viewing cursor.
If the selection is not possible, it copies it to the clipboard.
The keyboard shortcut must be assigned independently in input gestures, in the Miscellaneous section for the shortcut (Selects or copies text under the viewing cursor).
The first click sets the start mark, and the second click sets the end mark and selects a piece of text.
After that, all you have to do is press Control+C.

scriptmanager.description:
The ScriptManager add-on uses the built-in editor to create an application module for the currently running application.
When you press the command NVDA+Shift+0, the application module for the application that is currently focused on is loaded into the editing window.
If the application module is missing, the template is loaded.

ribbonExplorer.description:
RibbonExplorer add-on to improve work with the ribbon menu.
Currently only for Microsoft office products.
Confirmed (by users) Works in Microsoft Office 2019, 365 and 2021.
Compatibility with older versions of NVDA and Office is not guaranteed.
Simply install, open the Office app, press Alt to access the Ribbon, and check out the new menu layout.
You can use the keys: arrows, TAB, Enter, Escape, just like in a regular menu.
Alt+Down Arrow/Up Arrow are also supported to expand some controls.

NVBox.description:
The NVBox add-on extends the functionality of NVDA.
This plugin adds verification code recognition, OCR text recognition, weather/stocks/funds/exchange rate query, Android device assistance, iFlytek offline voice, VVTTS voice and advanced support for Tencent QQ, WeChat and YY voice to NVDA.
The add-on uses Chinese services.

RAT_OCR.description:
The RAT_OCR add-on, performs real-time OCR on the entire screen, refreshing it at a specified interval... or by pressing: NVDA + Windows + F5.>> or Auto OCR: Any location or focus changes, this option will be performed when you select Location Assistant - Navigator Objects.
Switch the mode for the RAT_OCR service using: two presses of the NVDA+Windows+F5 key combinations.
To open the add-on settings, press: NVDA+Alt+F5.
Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in input gestures, in the corresponding section for additions.

piper_neural_voices.description:
The Piper add-on is a driver for neural voices based on Piper.
Voices can be installed from the NVDA main menu, Piper Voices Gallery.

QuickAdjustment.description:
QuickAdjustment add-on used to quickly adjust certain functions.
Current features include Microsoft's Quanpin/Shuangpin Pinyin input mode switching in the Chinese language environment, Quick Switch touchpad, and Applications keystroke simulation [keys and others.

chessmart.description:
The ChessMart add-on is the most affordable chessboard on planet Earth.
The add-on provides a fully accessible chess playing environment for blind and visually impaired chess players.
Chess Variant: The add-on supports standard chess and other 7 different chess variants including Chess 960, Anti Chess, Atomic Chess, Kings of the Hill, Race of Kings, Horde and Three Checks.
Time Control: Choose between classic, quick play, blitz, shootout or custom time control.
FEN: Use the custom checkerboard Fen.
If the game mode is user versus computer; you can customize engine settings, including difficulty and startup delay.

profilesSwitcher.description:
The ProfilesSwitcher add-on allows you to switch between two profiles of your choice.
After installing the add-on, select your profiles by going to settings and selecting the Profile Switcher category.
For this add-on to work, you must create a profile in the NVDA Configuration Profiles dialog.
Use NVDA+Shift+P - to switch profiles. The command can be changed in Input Gestures, in the Configurations category.

powerStatusTones.description:
The PowerStatusTones add-on plays a beep when the power status changes.
The add-on does not have settings or keyboard shortcuts.

positionInfo.description:
The PositionInfo addition reports the position of an element in a group.
For example, 2 out of 222) when you need a function for one-time use, and not enable it on an ongoing basis in the settings).
There is no default command assigned.
You can assign a keyboard shortcut in input gestures, subsection Miscellaneous, Tells the position of an element in a group.

pinfo.description:
A small PInfo add-on for NVDA that allows the user to check the current process path and resource usage.
NVDA+Shift+F1 (default): Click once to read information about the current process's path and resource usage, click twice to copy the current process's path to the clipboard.

percentage checker.description:
The PercentageChecker add-on allows you to check how far - in percentage - you are in a text or list.
This information may be provided by either a voice message or an audio signal.
Additionally, you can jump to a specific percentage or line number in the text.

NVDA PC by Technology and News.summary: NVDA PC by Technology and News
NVDA PC by Technology and News.description:
The NVDAPcByTechnologyAndNews add-on plays object sounds.
The add-on is a separate sound theme, but has the functions of turning sounds off and on, as well as reading object types.
Incert+Alt+N: Press once to enable or disable sound playback.
Incert+Alt+N: Double-click to disable or enable object type readings.
You can change this keyboard command by going to: NVDA Menu, Submenu Options, Input Gestures, Category NVDA PC Sound Theme from Technology and news.

NVDA by technology and news.description:
The NVDAByTechnologyAndNews add-on plays sounds when you move around certain objects.
The add-on is a separate sound theme, but has the functions of turning sounds off and on, as well as reading object types.
Incert+Alt+B: Press once to enable or disable sound playback.
Incert+Alt+B: Pressing twice disables or enables object type readings.
You can change this keyboard command by going to: NVDA Menu, Submenu Options, Input Gestures, Category NVDA Sound Theme from Technology and news.

NoteManager.description:
The NoteManager add-on allows you to create, save, select and copy your own notes. For example, a message you use often, a reminder or note, etc.
The add-on provides the following features:
saving notes to a file so that notes will be available even after restarting NVDA.
dialog for managing and viewing notes.
Search for notes in the Notes Manager dialog.
the ability to view, multi-select elements and copy the current element or elements selected in the note manager dialog.
gestures to view notes without opening the note manager.

mouseWheel.description:
The MouseWheel add-on simulates the scrolling of a mouse wheel.
Windows+Page Up - Scrolls the mouse wheel forward.
Windows+Page Down - Scrolls the mouse wheel backwards.

nauEnhancements.description:
The NauEnhancements add-on improves the accessibility of NAU - a database of regulatory legal acts of Ukraine.
To learn more, click the add-on's help button.

mouseTracking.description:
The MouseTracking add-on adds mouse tracking functionality.
The add-on has no settings or keyboard shortcuts.

mouse moving controller.description:
MouseMovingController add-on for moving the mouse cursor around the screen using keyboard shortcuts.
Alt+Shift+Right Arrow - Move the mouse to the right.
Alt+Shift+Left Arrow - Move the mouse to the left.
Alt+Shift+Down Arrow - Move the mouse down.
Alt+Shift+Up Arrow - Move the mouse up.
Alt+Shift+O - Say the coordinates of the mouse cursor.
You cannot change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures.

mb408sl-driver.description: The MB408SLDriver add-on is a driver that provides NVDA support for the MDV MB408 S and L braille display.

maxReaderSleep.description:
The MaxReaderSleep add-on is very simple, it performs the following function.
As soon as NVDA's focus falls into the MaxReader program window and its Biblioman subroutine, the synthesizer automatically goes to sleep.
Thus, when listening to books, NVDA speech does not interfere.
The addition will be useful for book lovers who regularly read books using the MaxReader program and when the reading program is almost always running.
If you need to enable sleep mode temporarily in the MAxreder program, do not install this add-on, but use the NVDA function and the NVDA+Shift+S key combination to enable and disable sleep mode.
The add-on has no settings; it starts working immediately after installation or activation.

luna.description:
The Luna add-on provides information about the moon phase, moon position, and visibility.
You must assign a shortcut in the Input Gestures section before you can use the add-on.
reads a short message informing about the phase of the Moon and its visibility.
reads additional information about the Moon, such as distance and age.
Reads the latest information about the Moon.
A navigation message is displayed with the sunrise and sunset information received for your city.
A message box displays the latest information received.
Please note that the information will be received from an Italian server.

islamicRadio.description:
The IslamicRadio add-on plays Holy Quran radio broadcasts, online reader radio stations, and Islamic Diversity radio stations online.
Press hotkey + + A to switch between radio modes and turn it off.
Then press F 1 to open the help file.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in the Input Gestures settings.

linkManager.description:
LinkManager add-on for managing links, whose tasks include:
saving links, searching for saved links, opening links from the clipboard and much more.

landropPlus.description:
The LandropPlus add-on makes selecting a target device more accessible in the Landrop program of the same name.
Landrop for Windows transfers files from PC to iPhone and Android via Wi-Fi.

ipan.description:
The IpAn add-on will allow you to obtain information about the IP address using the key combination NVDA+Shift+I.
After which you will hear the following information.
IP address, Country, Region, City, Provider.
The keyboard shortcut can be changed in input gestures.

InterferingPhrases.description:
InterferingPhrases add-on to disable or enable the following interfering phrases:
(View List Items) in Explorer.
By default, NVDA always reports this phrase when opening a directory, every time you enter a directory or leave a directory to a previous level. NVDA does not have any basic function to disable this phrase.
The command to disable or enable interfering phrases is NVDA+Alt+Z (You can change it in input gestures).
Also, unnecessary phrases have been removed when the focus is on different buttons, in particular on buttons located on the taskbar.

ipInfo.description:
The IpInfo add-on adds viewing information about the IP address.
NVDA+Shift+I - Reports information about the IP address and geographic location.
NVDA+Shift+U - Reports information about the IP address provider.
You can change the keyboard shortcut in input gestures.

insertSymbols.description:
The InsertSymbols add-on allows you to copy symbols such as symbols, emojis and others.
Press NVDA+X, then Alt to select a category with symbols.
Enter key, copies the selected character to the clipboard.

idate.description:
The IDate add-on announces the Islamic date using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+H.
Please note that I am not responsible for incorrect data provided by this add-on.
This is due to the fact that different Islamic countries have their own calculation methods.

HighlighterPlus.description:
The HighlighterPlus add-on is a copy of NVDA's highlighting functionality and is also a proof of concept for improving the current NVDA's highlighting.
Current improvements are as follows: the marker regularly checks the position of objects to be tracked and updates the rectangles.

HerramientasReaper.description: HerramientasReaper add-on for easy access to tutorials on the ReaperYOtrasYerbas.com website, direct download of reaper installers and additional tools, as well as publishing sites with vst plugins.

ePubLibre.description:
The EPubLibre add-on provides a graphical interface for the ePubLibre.org online library.
The add-on allows you to download books in Spanish in EPub format via the built-in Torrent client or via an external Torrent client.
Attention! The interface could not be fully localized, so use an add-on with automatic translation.

Foobar2000.description:
The Foobar2000 add-on for the Foobar2000 multimedia player of the same name automatically pronounces song lyrics as playback progresses.
This is a small NVDA plugin, specifically for the ESLYRIC lyrics plugin of the Foobar2000 player.
Its main function is that it can automatically read song lyrics at the appropriate point in time as Foobar2000 plays.
After installing this plugin, there is no need to make any settings. As long as Foobar2000 can display lyrics normally, they can be read normally.

focusHighlight.description:
The FocusHighlight add-on highlights the focus location.
By drawing a colored rectangle, this add-on allows visually impaired users, sighted teachers, or developers to track the location of a navigator object.
The colors used in this add-on are:
A green thin rectangle with a dotted line indicates that NVDA is in view mode and it is a navigator object.
The red thin rectangle indicates that NVDA is in view mode and this is the focused object/control.
The red thick rectangle shows that NVDA is in view mode, and this is both the navigator object and the focused object, which overlap.
A blue thick rectangle with a dotted line indicates that NVDA is in focus mode, i.e. key types are passed to the control.
To toggle focus tracking, press the command NVDA+Alt+P, the command can be changed in input gestures.

geoLatConverter.description:
The GeoLatConverter add-on converts Georgian characters to Latin and vice versa.
This add-on allows you to transliterate Georgian text into English and vice versa.
It was created due to the fact that there is a large amount of literature in Georgian written in Latin scripts, so it is difficult to read such texts.
Command NVDA+L - Converts the selected text to the Latin alphabet.
Command NVDA+G - Converts the selected text into the Georgian alphabet.

emulateNumpadMode.description:
The EmulateNumpadMode add-on emulates the navigation function of the numeric keypad keys on part of the main keyboard.
By default, the add-on uses the keyboard shortcut Shift+NVDA+F4 to switch between normal mode and numpad mode, which can be changed in the input gestures dialog.

enhancedAria.description:
The EnhancedAria add-on allows you to specify which area landmarks are reported when viewing a website.
The add-on supports additional landmarks that are not included by default in NVDA.

EmojiFromIOS.description:
EmojiFromIOS add-on for reading and inserting emoji emoticons 
from iOS on your computer.
This add-on voices Emoji smiles in spoken text.
Emoji descriptions in most cases coincide with the pronounced names of emoticons in the IOS operating system version 15.6.1.
There are currently 3,680 emoji emoticons available, divided into 8 categories and 80 groups.
This addon also allows you to read and copy elements from downloaded user dictionaries. Files of the “Speech Dictionary” type (speechDictHandler) and files of the “Character/Punctuation Pronunciation” type (characterProcessing) are supported.
If you encounter text that contains an excessive number of emoji smileys, then you can exclude them from the pronunciation of the speech. To do this, switch the addon mode to dictionary exceptions.
Other features and keyboard shortcuts are described in the add-on help.

EasySynthesizerSwiching.description:
The EasySynthesizerSwiching add-on adds the ability to switch to the desired synthesizer using keyboard commands.
In the Input Gestures, Miscellaneous settings, you can reassign commands.
Incert+Control+1 Switch to Acapela TTS.
Incert+Control+2 Switch to Eloquence.
Incert+Control+3 Switch to Espeak.
Incert+Control+4 Switch to SAPI4.
Incert+Control+5 Switch to SAPI5.
Incert+Control+6 Switch to Vocalizer Expressive.
Incert+Control+7 Switch to Vocalizer Expressive2.
Attention! If you don’t have any synthesizers or won’t use them, then remove the commands from the ones you don’t need.

DdummyKeyboard.description:
The DummyKeyboard add-on will allow you to simulate input on devices without the following blocks on the keyboard:
Mode 1, Keyboard - Numbers.
Mode 2, Keyboard hotkey.
Mode 3, Functional keyboard - extended.
Mode 4, Application Media Keyboard - Advanced.
When the virtual keyboard is enabled, some number/letter keys will be simulated as numeric keypad keys.
Press a specific number/letter button to get the corresponding keyboard button effect.

cricricri.description:
The CriCriCri add-on will add functionality to quickly change the value of the lastTestedNVDAVersion parameter (the latest tested version of NVDA) in all or selected add-on manifests.
Please note that changing the value of this setting does not always restore compatibility with a newer version of the NVDA API, and in some cases causes various unexplained problems in NVDA.

contactBook.description:
The ContactBook add-on is specially designed to help visually impaired people manage their contact list more easily and effectively.
With this add-on, you can add, edit, and delete contacts, and search for names and contact information quickly and easily.
Moreover, the add-on provides you with the ability to export and import your contact list so that you can share it or transfer it to another device.
The Address Book add-on for NVDA is easy to use and has an intuitive interface, making it an ideal choice for anyone who needs to effectively manage their contact list.

copyPhrase.description:
The CopyPhrase add-on copies the last spoken NVDA phrase to the clipboard when you press the F12 key.
The keyboard shortcut cannot be changed.

cliptools.description:
The ClipTools add-on allows you to manage your clipboard in a variety of ways.
Currently cliptools can do the following:
Clear the clipboard of all content.
Edit the text currently on your clipboard.

CaptvtyAddon.description: Addition CaptvtyAddon to improve the accessibility of the Captvty program of the same name.

classicSelection.description:
The ClassicSelection add-on includes the previous block selection behavior using the hotkeys Incert+F9 and Incert+F10, which was introduced in NVDA 2016.3.
The old behavior copies the selection to the clipboard on the first press of NVDA+f10, while the new behavior selects on the first press and copies on the second.
The new behavior has some disadvantages. Text cannot be copied without highlighting (and therefore moving the cursor) if available. For places where this is not the case (like the console), it adds an additional NVDA+f10 press.

ChromeUtilities.description:
The ChromeUtilities add-on adds small scripts to improve your Chrome browser experience.

Shift+F4: Toggle looping on/off.
NVDA+F6: Opens the tab list dialog.
F7: Shows your browsing history backwards.
F8: Shows your browsing history forward.
F9: Turn reading mode on and off.
Shift+F9: Start continuous reading in reading mode.

ClipboardAssist.description:
The Clipboard assist add-on determines the type of clipboard content: text, image/screenshot (bitmap) data, file, or unknown data.
It will also clear your clipboard.
Command NVDA+Shift+Z: When pressed once, the content type is reported, when pressed twice, the clipboard is cleared.
You can change this keyboard shortcut through the Input Gestures dialog.

BrLauncher.description: The BrLauncher add-on improves the accessibility of the Brother Utilities app by labeling buttons and providing tooltips.

Braille.description: The Braille add-on combines two extensions: Braille Extender and pcKbBrl. This add-on was developed to help blind people who want to use Braille writing on their computer.

audiothemes.description:
The AudioThemes add-on creates a virtual audio display that plays sounds when focusing or navigating objects, the sound will play in the location corresponding to the location of the object on the visual display.
The add-on also allows you to add, delete, edit, create and distribute audio theme packs.

addonPacker.description:
The AddonPacker add-on allows you to quickly back up installed add-ons and save them in the standard NVDA add-on file format.
You can share such a copy of the add-on with another user or simply save it in the archive of your programs.

audioChart.description: The AudioChart add-on for NVDA allows you to play Excel time series as continuous audio.

Almaany.description:
The Almaany add-on adds the ability to find out the meaning of a word.
First choose the right word
press nvda+windows+a to get the meaning of Arabic word in Arabic dictionary
press nvda+windows+e to find out the meaning of an Arabic or English word in another language
press nvda+windows+f to find out the meaning of an Arabic or French word in another language
The meaning and information about the word will be displayed in a message box that you can view.

AcortadorURL.description: AcortadorURL add-on for quick URL shortening using four URL shortening services.

akNVDA.description:
The AkNVDA add-on uses file IPC to interact with Zamok.
The addon will write (true) or (false) to a file (.dat) and Zamok will watch for changes in that file and update its state accordingly.

contrast.description: The Contrast add-on introduces a pause before pronouncing the control type, as happens on a smartphone in the TalkBack screen reader on Android.

extendedWinampPlus.description: Add-ons ExtendedWinampPlus provides new functionality for interacting with the Winamp and Wacup music players.

imageCaptioning.description:
The ImageCaptioning add-on allows users to create captions for images present on the screen and receive captions describing the image in English.
The result can be announced to the user or presented in a virtual viewable window, allowing users to access the result character by character, word by word, as a whole, and even copy the result.
This add-on only works well with (natural images) of people, animals and ordinary objects.

objectDetection.description:
The ObjectDetection add-on allows users to perform object detection on image elements present on the screen and get the results in the form of a sentence and bounding boxes drawn around the detected objects.
Users can move the mouse pointer or finger (in the case of touch screens) within the bounding box to hear the name of the object.
The resulting sentence can be spoken or presented in a virtual preview window, allowing users to view the result character by character, word by word, in its entirety, and even copy it.
This add-on only works well with (natural images) of people, animals and some common objects.

Avira-configuration.description: The AviraConfiguration add-on improves the availability of the configuration section for the free antivirus software Avira-Free-Antivirus.

boo.description:
The Boo add-on is just a joke add-on.
This is so creepy that I won't even write what I read.

VKSmiliesReader.author: Artem Plaksin AKA maniyax <admin@maniyax.ru>
VKSmiliesReader.description:
VKSmiliesReader add-on for reading VKontakte emoticons and other Unicode characters.
Enabling or disabling automatic reading of emoticons and symbols is done by pressing the key combination NVDA+Alt+E.

UnigramHelper.description:
The UnigramHelper add-on adds some helper functions for Unigram.
nvda+control+1-nvda+control+4 - switch between tabs.
nvda+control+m - go to the list of messages.

ventrilo.description:
The Ventrilo add-on improves the availability of the Ventrilo program of the same name.
Beta version of the script for second generation ventrilo.

vitalSourceBookshelf.description:
The VitalSourceBookshelf add-on increases the availability of the ePUB VitalSource Bookshelf e-book reader program of the same name.
The add-on makes it possible to return focus to the document when closing menus or dialogs.

unigramAccess.description:
The UnigramAccess add-on adds some improvements that make the unigram app more accessible.
The add-on improves the display of information in multiple list views and labels unlabeled controls.

debugHelper.description:
The DebugHelper add-on makes debugging easier for developers and others trying to solve problems.
Inserts sequentially numbered lines of marks into the log when you press NVDA+shift+F1 to make things easier to find by marking them.

FixChineseIME.description:
The FixChineseIME add-on improves the Chinese input method for reading aloud according to home usage habits.
This plugin changes the way NVDA reads the input method out loud to be more consistent with domestic user habits.

formatfactory.description:
The FormatFactory addition will increase the accessibility of the Format factory program of the same name by simplifying navigation in the main window.

you can navigate using the left and right arrow buttons.
you can switch between tabs using ctrl+tab and ctrl+shift+tab.

AudioThemes3D.description: The AudioThemes3D add-on creates a virtual audio display that plays sounds when you focus on or navigate objects, and the sound will play in a location that matches the object's location on the visual display. The add-on also allows you to activate, install, delete, edit, create and distribute sound theme packs.

iFree-Skype-Recorder-2.0.description:
The IFreeSkypeRecorder add-on improves the availability of the iFree Skype Recorder software of the same name for recording calls on Skype.
The add-on is outdated and has not been supported for a long time, as well as the program itself.

googleSpeechRecognition.description:
The GoogleSpeechRecognition add-on provides speech recognition for all supported Google languages.
The add-on allows you to use speech recognition to write text
With a few keystrokes, you can start recording speech, then send it for recognition (transcription), and after receiving the result, insert the text in the desired place.

cecitek.description: Cecitek Add-on for viewing podcasts from the French Website cecitek.fr.

CustomLouisTables.description:
The CustomLouisTables add-on provides the custom tables feature.
If there is a file in louis/tables called custom_original_tables, it will be used first.
For example, if there is a file called custom_original_tables in louis/tables, it will be used first when there is a file called custom_original_tables in braille settings.
and louis/tables has custom_zh-tw.ctb, then this table will be used first.
You can also enable or disable custom tables.
To configure a hotkey, go to Input Gestures->CustomLouisTables->Toggle CustomLouisTables.
After that, you can use the shortcut key to enable this feature.

firefox56BookmarkEnhance.description:
Firefox56BookmarkEnhance add-on returns normal operation of the application key in the bookmarks menu
after it stopped working in the latest version of Firefox 56.

dvbviewer.description:
The DVBViewer add-on will increase the accessibility of the dvbviewer OSD menu by speaking and displaying the currently selected OSD menu item during navigation.
This add-on is still in development.

Bookmark&Search.description: BookmarkSearch add-on to search for text you want to find in specific virtual documents.

CdBurnerXP.description:
The CdBurnerXP add-on makes it easier to work with the CdBurnerXP program of the same name.
It includes

scripts for navigating to tree, list and compilation zones using control+comma, control+comma, control+ colon.
script for activating the audio player using control+shift+L.
script to pause or restart audio files using control+P.
script to activate the add button (files or folders) using control+shift+J.

bpmanalyzer-helper.description:
The BPManalyzerHelper add-on slightly improves the accessibility of the BPManalyzer program.
The add-on simplifies the selection of files for analysis.
Press the keyboard shortcut NVDA+O to open the selection dialog.

BTSync.description:
BTSync add-on to improve the accessibility of the BTSync program of the same name:

Prevents list view object focus events from firing multiple times.  Without this fix, NVDA would constantly repeat the currently focused list item in some list views.
Allows the user to navigate between the Translations tab item and the Translations list using tab and shift-tab.
Marking some edit fields in the program that have incorrect or missing labels.
Allows the user to navigate the inaccessible first three screens of the Setup Wizard using the keyboard.

clipCopy.description:
The ClipCopy add-on will allow you to copy the last message spoken by NVDA to the clipboard.
Press F12 to copy the last message.
Press Shift+F12 to turn on a beep when new text appears.

bridgeSynth.description:
The BridgeSynth add-on connects NVDA to OS X.
Synth bridge between NVDA and OS X

clipSave.description:
The ClipSave add-on works as a quick-access Notepad for taking notes.
Using the assigned keyboard shortcut NVDA+A, any contents of the clipboard will be saved to disk as an html file and opened in the default web browser.

accurate_weather.description:
The AccurateWeather add-on provides minute-by-minute precipitation reports based on precise geolocation.
This addon uses the API from the ColorfulCloud service.

CiscoJabber.description:
The CiscoJabber Add-on adds initial support for Cisco Jabber:

Improved ability to track focus as the user moves across screens.
Correct contact tree support.
Correct support for radio buttons Contacts, Chats, etc. on the main screen, including displaying the number of unread/missed events (icons).
Support for Jabber drop-down (combined) fields.
Improved reporting of checkbox state changes.
Improved naming of many fields.
Improved voice acting of NVDA+B dialog information on some screens.
Basic support for navigating Cisco Jabber error message dialogs.
Added commands, all of which appear in the Cisco Jabber category in the NVDA Preferences/Input Gestures tree:
Ins+T - more detailed information, currently only information about warning windows when they are present.
Ctrl+ and Ctrl+Shift+ cycle through Jabber alert windows when present.
Ctrl+E and Ctrl+H move to the editing (input) and history parts of the chat window.
NVDA+Shift+V announces the version number of Cisco Jabber.

brailleNotDriver.description: The BrailleNoteDriver add-on contains the driver for the BrailleNote Classic braille display.

Comodo Dragon.description: The ComodoDragon add-on adds support for the SRWare Iron browser, a faster and more secure Chrome-based browser developed by the Comodo Group.

brailleChart.description:
The BrailleChart add-on adds a Braille chart to NVDA for use in Excel to visualize a data set.
A Braille display is required to use it.

ChizhikPizhik.description:
The ChizhikPizhik add-on is just an example of an add-on that plays the Chizhik-Pizhik song.
An example of an add-on from the Tiflocomp portal.

CaptionSpeed.description:
CaptionSpeed ​​add-on to increase the reading speed of your captions.
Control+Shift+V - Report the speed of the inscription.
Control+Shift+S - Start time.
Control+Shift+Space - Pause.
Control+Shift+C - Report elapsed time.

beefText.description:
The BeefText add-on improves the accessibility of the BeeflText program of the same name.
BeefText is an open source text substitution tool for Windows.

BGT_Lullaby.description: The BGTLullaby add-on causes NVDA to go into sleep mode when running BGT games.

btceApi.description:
The BtceApi add-on is an Api monitor for btc-e.nz.
The add-on allows NVDA users to view the trading status on the btc-e.nz exchange.
Usage:
By default, the pair (BTC_USD) is selected.
Press the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Shift+D to get information.
Press NVDA+Shift+A to change settings.

BrailleNSpeak2000.description:
The BNS add-on is a draille 'n Speak 2000 driver for NVDA.
Should work for other Blazie notetakers users too. So far this has little effect.

autoOCR.description:
The AutoOCR add-on adds the functionality to automatically perform Windows 10 OCR when the current navigator object changes.
Command to turn on and off Control+Semicolon.

bme2NVDASupport.description:
Addition Bme2NvdaSupport to make the BME2 program available using NVDA.
BME2 is a Braille Music Editor program.

blackHawk.description: The BlackHawk add-on improves the availability of the BlackHawk Web browser for Windows, which is developed based on the Chromium engine.

bitChe.description: The BitChe add-on improves the accessibility of Bit Che, NVDA's torrent search client.

BitChe.description:
BitCheappModule addition to improve the accessibility of the Bit Che program of the same name.
Improves list view and context menu settings.

voiceOverByTecnologyAndNews.description:
The VoiceOverSounds add-on adds a sound theme with Voice Over sounds.
Sounds can be turned on or off with the command NVDA+Alt+V.

VoiceOverByM_maker.description:
The VoiceOverSounds add-on adds a sound theme with Voice Over sounds.
Sounds can be turned on or off with the command NVDA+Alt+O.

MIViewer.description: The MIViewer add-on will allow you to find and listen to all the melodies of MIDI instruments.

MOEdic.description:
The MOEdic add-on adds a quick check for Chinese characters.
The Ministry of Education is re-compiling a revised version of the Chinese dictionary with a simple query interface.
Key command - Windows + number pad 2.

shortbrl.description: The ShortBrl add-on will allow you to use a dot-display keyboard to enter one or two Braille characters in Chinese.

QuickType.description: The QuickType add-on adds a custom Kombat quick input method for the Chinese language.

English-Number filter.description:
The EngNum add-on has an entry only in Chinese.
The keyboard shortcut to enable is Shift+NVDA+E.

AccessolutionsNVDAPro.description:
NVDA Pro Accessolutions adds new features and improvements to your screen reader
NVDA, making it more convenient to use and making the transition easier
Switching from other screen readers.

4kYoutubeVideoDownloader.description: The 4KYoutubeVideoDownloader add-on will help you read the names of video clips in the download list in the 4k video downloader program.

eurobrailleDriver.description: The EuroBrailleDriver add-on contains the driver for the EuroBraille braille device.

moonPhase.description:
The MoonPhase add-on adds a keyboard shortcut to quickly check the moon phase.
Find out the phase of the moon - Windows+NVDA+M.
Uses Weather Underground, but does not use its API. See www.braille.wunderground.com.

brailleme.description: The BrailleMe add-on is a driver for the BrailleME display from the company from Innovision Tech (Innovative Technology).

MetecBD.description: The MetecBD add-on is a driver for the MetecBD braille display.

bme2.description:
Bme2 add-on to improve accessibility of bme2 (Braille Music Editor) program using NVDA
In the main editor and the special editing field, when you move the cursor and during editing, musical elements are spoken correctly and presented on the Braille display.
Additionally, you can use the following commands:
Nvda+Alt+upper arrow: reads from the beginning of the text to the cursor position.
Nvda+alt+down arrow: read from the cursor position to the end of the text.
Nvda+o: Reads the properties of the musical element, if any.
F12: Reports the song lyrics of the element under the cursor, if any.

Total Commander enhanced.description: The TotalCommanderEnhanced add-on works in TotalCommander 32bit and 64bit. Tells you which panel you are in - left or right, even with FTP connections. Adds a file index, spoken after the list item. Speaks the top or bottom line at the beginning and end of the list. Says the tab name if the list view uses tabs. Adds an Alt-1 hotkey to say where you are, left or right, tab name, or current directory. sends special output at the beginning to braille: 1. and 2. to determine whether the file is on the left or right, 1x and 2x if it is selected.

nvda-for-eclipse.description: Support for speech and braille when working with the Eclipse IDE. Automatic notification of code completion elements. Reporting errors, warnings, and debugger breakpoints with auto-focus braille.

Nour.description:
The Nour add-on provides the ability to control the sound level in the Noor program of the same name.
Press Alt+U to increase volume.
Press Alt+D to decrease the volume.

ShabakatAlsafa.description:
Open a dialogue for easy access to the latest news and various forums on the site.
To display the Safa network dialog, click the command associated with the gesture add-on.
To go to any topic or forum, open the context menu, use the down arrow to select Open, and press Enter.

myArabicLibrary.description:
MyArabicLibrary add-on for organizing your downloaded books.
you select a library or book category in the first dialog box.
and in the library dialog you can access the book information, size, url, other url if any, of the book.
In addition, using the context menu in the book list, you can add, edit, delete, delete all, and sort books by author or title.
you can open the main libraries dialog using the keyboard shortcut: nvda+control+windows+a
And as always, you can change this command using: NVDA menu, Options, Input Gestures, My Arabic Library.

4shared.description:
The New4shared add-on adds the ability to download files from the 4shared website quickly and easily.
To start downloading, copy the download link and press the keyboard shortcut:
Control + Shift + D.

contextualTranslator.description:
The ContextualTranslator add-on helps you find out the meaning of words or phrases in several Arabic-foreign dictionaries.
The default keyboard shortcut for addition is Alt+ Shift+ C.

ForwardTacotron.description:
The ForwardTacotron add-on is a driver that adds support for the ForwardTacotron speech synthesis model for NVDA.
Flask server is used.

vocalizer_expressive_driver.description:
Driver and interface for Nuance Vocalizer expressive version 1.1.
To use it, you must have a valid license and install at least one voice, downloadable from https://vocalizer-nvda.com/downloads

fakeClipboardAnouncement.description:
FakeClipboardAnouncement - Forces commands such as copy, paste, undo, select all and cut to be announced, regardless of whether NVDA is able to determine the reality of the situation.
That is, this addition only speaks when pressing the indicated commands.

Yandex-Spell-Checker.description: Yandex spell check - correct the selected word using the Yandex spell check service.

nvMathViewer.description: nvMathViewer add-on for viewing mathematical formulas and symbols in LaTeX and AsciiMath notations as MathML in review mode.

sonar.description: Provides access to the Cakewalk Sonar digital virtual studio.

word.description:
This module complements the scripts built into the base version of NVDA and brings:

keyboard control NVDA+alt+F5 to get a list of various Word objects (comments, changes, bookmarks,...), 
keyboard control Alt+Delete to find out if: the row, column and page number at the system cursor position, the beginning and end of the selection, or the row and column number of the current table cell (indicating possible positions in relation to the left margin and above),
keyboard control NVDA+shift+alt+ c to insert a comment at the cursor position,
keyboard control NVDA+alt+n to read footnotes or at the end at the cursor position,
keyboard control NVDA+alt+r for reading editing text at the cursor position,
adding to the basic scenarios movement from point to point (Control+down or up arrow), the ability is configured to skip empty paragraphs,
scripts for moving in a table or reading its elements (row, column, cell),
declaring a title level change when using the keyboard command shift+alt+right or left arrow for a word,
full mode navigation for NVDA new commands in Microsoft Word,
moving a word in a sentence (keyboard commands alt+ down or up arrow.

For more information, see Using the Module.

typing sound by technology and news.summary: Typing Sound by Technology and News
typing sound by technology and news.description:
Plays sound effects when you type in a text field.
Enable or disable sounds using the keyboard shortcut NVDA+Control+Shift+T.

WiFiFileSender.description: This module improves the availability of the WiFi file Sender client

TT-text-splitter.description: Allows you to split text from the clipboard into parts of less than 256 characters. nvda+alt+s, breakdown by sentence. nvda+alt+ctrl+s, breakdown by words. Due to the termination of support by the author of the add-on, the author of the add-on has been changed. I don't claim credit for anyone's code, I just keep it up to date.

Mzoo-helper.description: Simplifies navigation in the online game Zoo. Use the combinations nvda+alt+1 to nvda+alt+5 to navigate through the main sections of the game; other gestures can be assigned in the corresponding NVDA settings dialog.

myFavoriteTopics.description: Allows you to display and view a list of websites, contacts, magazines or applications that you can change to your liking.

eSpeakPatch.description:
Corrects the pronunciation of some numbers by the eSpeak synthesizer, adds digits above a billion.
The functionality is implemented by writing your own number handler; the pronunciation may differ from the original.
The pronunciation of some letter combinations has also been corrected.
To activate/deactivate use nvda+ctrl+e.

SleepMode-DOSVOX-APPS.description: This add-on supports NVDA sleep mode in 432 Dosvox applications. Original archive extracted from NVDA and adapted for many Wagner Soares applications.

delayedCharacterDescriptions.description: This padding speaks the character description for the last character read after n milliseconds when the character was read by character view commands, such as the left and right arrow keys, character view left, right, or right view commands, etc.

goToSleep.description: Adds a keyboard shortcut to put Windows to sleep.

bitviseHelper.description: Improves the availability of the Bitvise SSH Client program.

appInfo.description: Provides information about the current target application.

UsefulDictionary.description: Provides information from dictionaries or Wikipedia about the highlighted word or phrase, for more details, read the readme

teamViewer.description:
Improves TeamViewer accessibility using NVDA.
TeamViewer can be used for online meetings as well as remote access/support.
For further information about the TeamViewer application see:
http://www.teamviewer.com

soundCustomizer.description: Addition for personalizing .wav sounds in NVDA.

profileDictionary.description:
allows you to create profile dictionaries,
using the NVDA + shift + p keyboard shortcut to access the dictionary of the current NVDA user profile.
Note: You cannot add a profile dictionary to a regular NVDA configuration.

DictSwitcher.description: Corrects polyphonic characters and braille dictionaries. Use NVDA+Alt+D to switch the pronunciation dictionary.

Intec_SystemUtilities.description: Shut down and restart the PC with the classic Windows sound. View and inspect complete system information, open the Roaming folder and run system tools directly.

ManusAssistantEnhanced.description: Enhanced NVDA add-on module with automatic responses for interacting with the Manus AI assistant.

NVDA-WCT.description: With AI support, automatically correct your writing, translate, convert your text to speech, or copy it to the clipboard.

NVDAext_Alcatel-Lucent-4059mac.description: Add-on for the Alcatel-Lucent 4059 IP standard software.

RayoAI_connector.description: Add-on to describe the object navigator with RayoAI.

TranslateOffline.description: Automatic translation add-on based on neural networks with no internet required. Models developed at the University of Helsinki and (now) at Stockholm University. Various translation utilities. Online mode with Google Translate. See the documentation for more information.

USB-D.description: An add-on for using a braille display upside down. The braille output, routing switches and some keys of the supported braille display are inverted.

abaAcademy.description: A complete educational academy inside NVDA for Arabic-speaking blind users: Arabic (grammar and dictation up to the Al-Ajurrumiyya level), English, French, Braille, computers and NVDA, Windows and Office skills, mathematics, science, history, geography, and general culture. More than seven hundred lessons with a real progressive path, a standard lesson engine (JSON), a limitless procedural question generator that produces endless examples, spaced repetition, statistics, and typing challenges. No external library needs to be installed: the database is embedded inside the add-on (SQLite when available, otherwise a pure Python engine). The interface is always in Arabic regardless of the NVDA language. Press Escape to close, and Shift+Escape to exit completely. The window can be reopened in the same session after being closed.

brailleExport.description: Intercepts NVDA's braille output and exports it as Unicode braille .txt or BRF .brf files.

brailleTableSwitcher.description: NVDA+Alt+B cycles through output braille tables; NVDA+Alt+I cycles through input braille tables; NVDA+Alt+O announces the current braille table.

clipboardProcessor.description: Uses the OpenAI API to process text from the clipboard or a text selection.

correctorOrtografico.description: Add-on for checking spelling in NVDA. Based on the work of the Blind Pandas team.

favoritos.description: Allows you to add links, folders and shortcuts to files or programs to a favorites menu accessible from NVDA's Tools menu.

mlrecorder.description: This add-on provides global NVDA commands to isolate and record the audio of the focused process, microphone or mixed audio using MLRecorder.

mouseReadAfterStopDelay.description: Speaks the content under the mouse pointer only after a pause. The delay is adjustable in NVDA settings.

odooTasks.description: Accessible search of the Odoo tasks the user is subscribed to.

sayDescription.description: Use a shortcut to check the description attribute of a specific element. Refer to the readme file for add-on usage.

selectorSalidaAudioNVDA.description: Allows you to select an application with active audio and send it to a specific output device. Includes SoundVolumeView as a portable external engine to apply the per-application output change. NVDA is hidden for security to prevent the user from losing the screen reader's voice.

speakActions.description: This add-on checks stock prices and the Selic rate.

textToAudioConverter.description: Converts text from PDF files into MP3 files with Brazilian Portuguese neural voices.

vozNativaDoDosvox.summary: Voz Nativa do DOSVOX (DOSVOX Native Voice)
vozNativaDoDosvox.description: Portuguese synthesizer for NVDA based on the native voice originating from the DOSVOX system, developed at UFRJ from 1993.

youtube_subtitle_reader.description: Reads subtitles with NVDA when focus is on the YouTube video player.

zhDict.description: Select text and press Alt+NVDA+K to automatically detect Chinese or English: Chinese is looked up in the Ministry of Education Mandarin dictionary (MoeDict), and English is translated into Chinese.

zhuyin_say.description: When Zhuyin explanation mode is on, pressing a keyboard key does not type text, but instead speaks the Zhuyin symbol and tone corresponding to that key.

BraiLab PC Beszédszintetizátor.summary: BraiLab PC Beszédszintetizátor (BraiLab PC Speech Synthesizer)
BraiLab PC Beszédszintetizátor.description: This is the BraiLab PC speech system, based on the work of András Arató and KFKI. A very portable and lightweight synthesizer, albeit with a somewhat robotic sound.

JadwalKu.description: Add-on for reminders of routine schedules (daily/weekly), periodic time reminders (from 5 minutes to 1 hour), a calendar, a world clock, and a standalone SAPI 5 TTS engine that is 100% screen reader accessibility friendly. Managed with an easy Combo Box & Checkbox interface via the NVDA + / Command Mode shortcut.

ListeIconesZoneNotification.summary: Liste Icones Zone Notification (Notification Area Icons List)
ListeIconesZoneNotification.description: Displays the list of icons in the notification area with NVDA+F11.

Milena_MBROLA.description: NVDA add-on with the Polish Milena synthesizer and MBROLA backend.

arubaSignCampiFirma.description: Detects the signature fields in ArubaSign's "Graphic Signature" view and lets you place a graphic signature on each field (or all of them) without using the mouse. Press NVDA+Shift+S in the ArubaSign window to open the list of fields.

fileContentManager.description: Manages the content of text files and paths from Windows Explorer.

mgDados.description: A utility that lets you roll dice of different types and keep track of players' scores. Designed to give you dice in NVDA for playing role-playing games.

pctalker.description: Three Hungarian speech synthesizers by József Király, with the original DOS engines, running in the Unicorn CPU emulator within NVDA's own process. No DOSBox and no external program.

pyr.description: An accessible question-and-answer game by categories for NVDA.

python_tutor.description: An NVDA add-on designed to make learning the Python programming language easier for people with visual impairments through a fast navigation and control interface.

showSelectionWhenBrailleTetheredToReview.summary: Show Selection When Braille Tethered to Review

sonidos_navegacion_ruben.description: NVDA add-on for navigation and typing sound effects with customizable sound packages, support for browse mode, and mouse feedback.

sopAccess.description: Provides screen reader support for the visual novel "Sister Other Paranoia": automatically reads dialogue and character names, announces mind-reading inner thoughts, announces options and hints at how to select them, announces menus and buttons, echoes mind-reading input, and provides shortcuts for browsing and rereading dialogue history. Requires the corresponding BepInEx plugin (SopAccess.dll) installed in the game directory.

talk back by technology and news.summary: Talk Back by Technology and News

winGlulxe.description: This module works automatically with the winGlulxe interpreter with any adventure, automatically reads and allows navigation through the text with object commands.

youtubeMusicPlayer.description: Search for and play music from YouTube and YouTube Music directly in NVDA.

zararadio.description: Provides some shortcuts for quick access to relevant information and focus adjustment to cover all controls.

batteryAlarm.description: Plays a sound when the battery reaches a configurable percentage, both when discharging and when charging.

biblia-acessivel.description:
Bible with fully accessible reading so you can grow closer to the Word of God.
It has 10 Bible versions, search by biblical passages and a complete notes system (create, edit and remove).
Includes shortcut keys for quick navigation between chapters, access to the book list, version selection and opening the main menu.
Activate the application with NVDA+Shift+I.

blackbox_v8.description: Standalone NVDA driver with the native BlackBox V8 engine.

listLevelAddon.description: An NVDA add-on that reads the level of lists, their count and the number of items in the current level of the current list.

meteoFrance.description: Easily get weather forecasts via the Météo-France service.

Vnspeak.description: The Vnspeak reader for NVDA, created by Lê Anh Tuấn together with the Nhật Hồng Blind Support Center with sponsorship from CBM. The copyright and intellectual property of the reader belong to the author Lê Anh Tuấn.

zhcnViDict.description:
A specialized Chinese-Vietnamese dictionary add-on for visually impaired gamers to experience Chinese game titles through NVDA.
The dictionary data was developed by the Convert Chinese-Vietnamese stories community and converted to an NVDA-compatible format by Lê Trọng Tấn.

blindGame.description:
Your games hub in NVDA. Activate the add-on with the NVDA+Shift+J shortcut, choose your favorite game and have fun.
Pause and resume the soundtrack with the NVDA+Shift+P shortcut.

flixgrab.description: This extension improves the accessibility of FlixGrab by labeling many elements.

iexplorer.description:
This extension improves the accessibility of Macroplanet's iExplorer, a program for accessing iOS devices.
This version of the extension improves the accessibility of iExplorer's detail view.

localisateur.description: This module lets you read the information area without moving the focus, and find out which forms are present in the window when the focus is in the sources list. The command is Control+Space.

Pico Synthesizer for NVDA..description: Run Control+NVDA+S to select the synthesizer.
